tgt: Saul akastand up toka kwa grao, lakini venye alifungua macho akaget kumezimwa taa, hacheki any. So wakampeleka hand in hand hadi Damascus.

tgt: Siku tatu zimefuatana, jamaa alikuwa mblind, hadi hangemanga ama kudrink anything.

src: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, "Ananias!" "Yes, Lord," he answered.
tgt: Akikuaga Damascua kulikuwa na disciple nifla alimeseka ka Ananias. Sir Godi akamwita niaje, kwa vision, 'Ananias!' akaitika, "Sema Bwana".

src: The Lord told him, "Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
tgt: Sir Godi akamshow, Ishia hadi kwa mbanyu ya Judee huko Straight Street uulizie boy fulani toka majuu Tarsus anameseka ka Saulo, je ako juu ya maombi.

src: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight."
tgt: Ndani ya vision ameshoiwa msee anaitwa Ananias akicome kuwekelea mikono juu yake njo aanze kuona tena."

src: 13"Lord," Ananias answered, "I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your saints in Jerusalem.
tgt: "Boss," Ananias akaanza kuteta, "Nishaget ma reports za huyo mse, na vile amewa doiya ma saints wako damage huko Jerusaa.

tgt: Na ati amekam hapa na warrant toka kwa bez ya makuhani ku arrest wadhi wote wenye wanaku worship wakicall on jina yako.

src: But the Lord said to Ananias, "Go! This man is my chosen instrument to carry my name before the Gentiles and their kings and before the people of Israel.
tgt: Lakini Sir Godi akainsistia Ananaina, "Ebu enda! Huyu ni mse wangu chosen kabisa, ka tool ya ku carry name yangu mbele ya ma gentiles na masonkwo wao na hadi mbele wa

tgt: Baada ya mango, akaget nguvu zake tena. So Saulo akaspend masiku kadhaa na majenerali wa JC pale Damascus.

tgt: Mara moja akabegin ku unleash neno kwa synagogue vile that JC njo the Son wa sir Godi.

src: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, "Isn't he the man who raised havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn't he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?"

src: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
tgt: Anyway, Saulo alizidi, hadi akagrow more powerful na kushangaza wayahudi walikuwa wakipoleaga Damascus kwa kuwa provia that enyewe JC njo the Christ.

src: After many days had gone by, the Jews conspired to kill him,
tgt: Baada ya madays mingi kupita, wayahudi wakaplot kum assasinate,

tgt: Lakini Saul akamesea plot yao. Usiku na mchana walimsurvey gate za jiji njo wapate kum murder.

src: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.
tgt: Lakini mafans wakamsafirisha usiku wakamshusha ki clandestine ndani ya kikapu kupitia kampenyo kwa wall.

src: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.
tgt: Vile ali arrive Jerusa, alitry kujoin ma disciple wengine kikaumana, walikuwa bado wamegwaya juu yake na historia yake, hawangeamini ati saa alikuwa disciple cha ukwela.

src: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.
tgt: Lakini Barnabas akamchukua akampeleka hadi kwa wale mapapa wa church. Akawashow life story ya Saul, vile kwa msafara kuishia Damascusalikuwa amecheki Bwana Yesu

src: So Saul stayed with them and moved about freely in Jerusalem, speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
tgt: So Saulo akapoleaga nao wakiishia maziara bila stress Jerusa wakipreach ki harden kwa ile jina ya Jesus.

src: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.
tgt: Alibonga na kuletana kwa debate na wayahudi wa origin ya greece, lakini majamaa wakatry kum mada.

src: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
tgt: Vile ma bruzza walimesea iyo plot, walimkwachu na kumpeleka hadi Caesarea hadi wakamtuma off majuu hadi Tarsus.

src: Action za MaJenerali wa JC Episode ya Kenda- Acts 9 Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace. It was strengthened; and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it grew in numbers, living in the fear of the Lord.

src: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.
tgt: Vile Peter ali safiri hapa na pale kwa nchi, aliishia kuvisit wadhii saints huko Lydda.

src: There he found a man named Aeneas, a paralytic who had been bedridden for eight years.
tgt: Hapo akaget jamaa aliitwa Aeneas, mse paralytic na alikuwaga amelazwa bed miaka nane.

src: 34"Aeneas," Peter said to him, "Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and take care of your mat." Immediately Aeneas got up.
tgt: Peter akamshow,"Aeneas, Jesus Christ anakuheal. Rauka ushughulikie mat yako." Mara hio hio Aeneas akarauka.

src: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
tgt: Wananchi wa Lydda na Sharon walimcheki hivi, wakaamua ni idhaa ya kuokoka na kumesea sir Godi.

src: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which, then translated, is Dorcas[b]), who was always doing good and helping the poor.
tgt: Pale Joppa kulikuwa na disciple fulani kwa jina Tabitha(Ukiitranslate, ni Dorcas), alikuwaga on the daily ana do stuff poa na akihelp wasee msoto.

src: About that time she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
tgt: Saa iyo tu maidhaa idhaa akakuwa msick hadi akakick, body yake ikaoshwa halafu ika placeiwa kwa room fulani upstairs.

src: Lydda was near Joppa; so when the disciples heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him and urged him, "Please come at once!"
tgt: Lydda ilikuwa tu place karibu na Jopa; kwa hivo vile ma disciple waliskia ati Pitaa ako Lydda, wakamtumania teke, maboy wawili kumwuliza, "Please, ebu tokezea mara hio

src: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
tgt: Pitaa akachomoka nao, na vile alidondoka pale, alipelekwa upstairs kwa ile room. Widows wote walimzunguka tu na ma ngwee, wakinshow zile gowns na makladi that Dorcas

src: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, "Tabitha, get up." She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.
tgt: Pitaa akawafukuza kwa room, akashuka kwa magoti akapray. Akapinduka kucheki yule mathe maiti, akasema, "Tabitha, ebu rauka." Dada akafungua macho aisee! akacheki

src: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called the believers and the widows and presented her to them alive.
tgt: Akamchukua na mkono akamhelp kustand kwa miguu yake. Kisha akaita ma belivers na wajane akampresent kwao akiwa alive.

src: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
tgt: Story ikasambazwa Joppa yothes kupitia duru za kuaminika mse wangu, hadi wasee umati wakaaminia sir Godi.

src: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.
tgt: Pitaa akatuliaga Joppa for some time kwa mchuna ngozi fulani stadi alimeseka ka Simo.

src: 13.On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph's family.
tgt: Of course kwa ziara ya mbe, Josee aliwashow mabruzza wake his real self, na Pharaoh akajifunza stori ya famo ya man Josee.

src: 14.After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.
tgt: After hapo, Josee alitumanisha mzae wake Jacob aletwe na hadi famo yake nzima, wasee Sevente faee wote.

src: 15.Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.
tgt: Halo njo Jacob akaishia down hadi Egypt, place ye na wahenga walidie.

src: 16.Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a certain sum of money.
tgt: Maiti zao tu njo zilirudishwa hadi Shechem na kuwekwa ndani ya grave yenye buzzenga Abraham alikuwa ameboti from mavijanaa wa Hamor pale tu Shechem, wakamkanja mundee fulani.

src: 17."As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt greatly increased.
tgt: Sa ikawa isVipi! Maidhaa zimeshafika za Sir Godi Ku come through na promise yake kwa Abraham, hesabu ya wadhii wetu Egypt ilikuwa juu kinyama.

src: 18.Then another king, who knew nothing about Joseph, became ruler of Egypt.
tgt: Sonkwo fulani {politician sana} mwenye hakumesea any ju ya Man Josee akarauka kutawala Egypt.

src: 19.He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our forefathers by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.
tgt: Akadeal kimangoto vi excess na mamtu wetu na akawa oppress wahenga by kuwa force watupe watoi wao, wenye walikuwa wamezaliwa tu ati njo wadedi.

src: 20."At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child."For three months he was cared for in his father's house.
tgt: "Mara iyo iyo Mosee akaboniwa, na ye hakuwa katoi ordinaree." Miezi tatu, walim take care kwa hao ya fadhe wake.

src: 21.When he was placed outside, Pharaoh's daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
tgt: Vile aliwekwa nje, dotee wa Sonkwo wa hiyo day, pharaoh akamkwachu na kulea ka mtoi wake personal.

src: 22.Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
tgt: Mose akaishia chuo za ki barbie za them days, akashoiwa kismat yote ya ma Egyptians.Ikabidi lugha yake ni mambo yote, na pia ma action zikakuwa juu.

src: 23."When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his fellow Israelites.
tgt: "Vile Mose alidunga forty, alidecide tu siku moja kuvisit wasee wake ma Israelites.

src: 24.He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.
tgt: Akacheki mmoja wao amehandwa na Mu egyptian mbaya, so ya akaishia kumwokolea na katika ile hali akamlipishia kwa kumada mu egyptian.

src: 25. Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.
tgt: Mose alikuwa anaunganisha ati mamtus wake wangemesea that Sir Godi alikuwa anam use kuwaokolea, lakini hawakunyita.

src: 26.The next day Moses came upon two Israelites who were fighting. He tried to reconcile them by saying, 'Men, you are brothers; why do you want to hurt each other?'
tgt: Siku next Mose akapatana na ma israelite mbe wikifungulia war. Akatry kubring peace talks akiwashow, 'Maboy, nyi mi ma bro, niaje mmeamua kuumizana.?'

src: 27."But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, 'Who made you ruler and judge over us?
tgt: Lakini yule first bondi kati yao akapush Mosee kando akimshow,' Tangu lini. Nani alikumake dozi ju yetu ati ukuwe njo judge?

src: 28.Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?'"
tgt: Ama umeplani kunimada ka yule mse wa jana wa egypt?"

src: 29.When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.
tgt: Mosee kuskia ivo, akajikata spidi hadi Midian, place alitulia ka refugee na kwa ile hali akaget watoi maboi mtu mbili.

src: Action za masoja wa Jenerali JC, Chapta ya sita-Acts 6 1.In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Grecian Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.
tgt: Sa katika hizo madays, vile namba ya mamemba ilikuwa ikiongezeka, wayahudi wenye walitokezeaga Greece wakazusha sana ju ya wayahudi mahebrew- ati ju ma widows walikuwa wakilengwa katika ile projo ya kusambaziwa dishi daily.

src: 2.So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, "It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.
tgt: Ju ya hiyo food scandal, wale wadhii disciples twelve wote tugezza wakagazza wakisay niaje," Haiwezi kuwa right kwetu ati tulenge huduma ya word ya Sir Godi njo tuanze kukimbizana na order za dishi kwa matebo.

src: 3.Brothers, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them
tgt: Mabruzza, chagueni mtu saba kati yenu wenye wanameseka kuwa wamejazwa na Roho na hekima. Tutapeana hii janta na responsibility yote kwao

src: 4.and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word."
tgt: na tutaweka attention yetu kwa maombi na huduma ya word."

src: 5.This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
tgt: Hii proposal ilikuwa smarta, ikafurahisha wadhii wa group yote. Wakachagua Steve, mse amejaa imani vifiti na mwenye ako na Holy Spirit; pia Phillo, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas na Nico toka Antioch, mse aliconvert to Judaism.

src: 6.They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
tgt: Wakapresent hawa wadhii kwa ma apostles, wakawaombea na kuwawekelea mikono.

src: 7.So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.
tgt: So word ya Sir Godi ikasambaa. Ile namba ya wafuasi Jerusa ikazidi kujaajaa chap chap, na rende bwaku ya mapriests wakakuwa obedient kwa the faith.

src: 8.Now Stephen, a man full of God's grace and power, did great wonders and miraculous signs among the people.
tgt: Sa Stevo, mdhii alikuwa amejawa na grace na nguvu ya sir Godi vinomient, alikuwa aki do ma signs miraculous sana kati ya wadhii.

src: 9.Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)—Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia. These men began to argue with Stephen,
tgt: Lakini pia opposition ikatokea toka kwa mamemba wa synagogue ya wadhii free (Ka vile ilimeseka) - wayahudi wa Cyrene na Alexandria pia tena wadhii wa Cilicia na Asia. Hawa wasee walianza kuzua arguments na Stevo,

src: 10.but they could not stand up against his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.
tgt: lakini hawengemake kutoboa wisdom yake ama yule Roho aliongelea kupitia.

src: 11.Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, "We have heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God."
tgt: Kisha wakaconvince wadhii in secret wakam waseme, "Tumeskia Stevo akibonga maneno za blasphemy against Mose na against Sir Godi."

src: 12.So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.
tgt: So wakazua wadhii na wazae na kuwachokora, pia pamoja na mamode wa law. Wakakwachu Stevo na kumleta mbele ya Sanhedrin.

src: 13.They produced false witnesses, who testified, "This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
tgt: Wakaproduce mawitness wa uwongo wenye walitestify, "Huyu Chali hawachagi kubonga against Holy spirit na against sheria.

src: 14.For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us."
tgt: Ju tumesha skia akinego ati huyu Jesus wa Nazareth atadestroy hii place nakubadilisha customs za Mose zenye aligeana down kwetu."

src: 15.All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
tgt: Wote wenye walikuwa wakipolea kwa Sanhedrin wakacheki Stevo kwa makini, na wakacheki that face yake ilikuwa ka face ya Angel.

src: Matendo za masoja wa Jenerali JC, Chapta Ngovo-Acts 5 1.Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.
tgt: Sa Jamaa mmoja anaitwa Ananias, pamoja na wife wake Sapphira, pia walikinda kipande ya maburungo zao.

src: 2.With his wife's full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles' feet.
tgt: Bado wife wake akimesea kabisa Ananias akapiga operation ya kiasi ya hizo doh kando za kujipanga nazo, lakini akaletatherest akaseti kwa miguu za ma apostles.

src: 3.Then Peter said, "Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?
tgt: Manze Peter akabonga, "Ananias niaje shaito amejaa kwa heart yako ivo hadi umepanga Holy spirit mauongo na ukaji wekea kiasi yaile munde uliget from kuuza shake yenu?

src: 4.Didn't it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn't the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied to men but to God."
tgt: Si ilikuwaga yako bafore ikindwe? Na vile ilikindwa,simunde ilikuwa yakop ku do chenye ungetaka? Ni what ilikufanya u think ku do kitu ka iyo?Hujadanganya wasee umedanganya sir Godi."

src: 5.When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.
tgt: Vile Ananias aliskia ivo, akadunda down akakick. Na njeve meja ikakwachu wadhii wote wenye waliskizia chenye kilihappen.

src: 6.Then the young men came forward, wrapped up his body, and carried him out and buried him.
tgt: Kisha mavijanaa chali wakakam mbele, wakafunika body yake, wakambeba wakamzika.

src: 7.About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
tgt: Kedo masaa matatu bahadayes waif akatokezea, na hakumesea ni nini kilikuwa kimehappen.

src: 8.Peter asked her, "Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?" "Yes," she said, "that is the price."
tgt: Peter akamwuliza niaje, "Nishow je? Hii njo ile price yenye wewe na Ananias mliget for iyo shake?" Waif akasema,"Eeh, hiyo njo price yake."

src: 9.Peter said to her, "How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also."
tgt: Pitaa akamshow niaje, "Mbona mli agree kutest Spirit wa sir Godi? Cheki! Zile miguu za majamaa wali bury hazi wako ziko kwa dooa,na watakubeba wewe pia."

src: 10.At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
tgt: Hapo hapo hiyo maithaa akadunda down kwa miguu yake akadedi. Kisha wale jamaa wa yankee wakakam ndani na, wakimget amededi, wakambeba nje na kumzika beside hazi wake.

src: 11.Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.
tgt: Njeve meja ikakwachu kanisa mzima na wote wenye waliskia jua ya hizi vitu.

src: 12.The apostles performed many miraculous signs and wonders among the people. And all the believers used to meet together in Solomon's Colonnade.
tgt: Ma apostles waka-perform ishara mob na mawonders kati ya wadhii.

src: 13.No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.
tgt: hakuna msealijaribu kuwa join,hata ingawa walikuwa wamedungwa respect na wadhii.

src: 14.Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.
tgt: Na though ilikuwa hivo, wasee zaidi na zaidi majamaa na ma dem waliamini sir Godi na wakaongezeka kwa namba yao.

src: 15.As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter's shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.
tgt: Ju ya hiyo stori,wadhi walileta wasee sick hadi kwa streetsnakuwaweka kwama bed na ma mat njo at least shadow ya Peter ianguke kwa wasee kiasi vile alikuwa akipita.

src: 16.Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by evil spirits, and all of them were healed.
tgt: Rende ika gather pia toka kwa ma tao zenye zimezunguka Jerusa, wakileta wadhii wao wa sick na wale wameteswa na ma shaito,nahao wote wakakuwa healed.

src: 17.Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.
tgt: Kisha wale mahigh priest na wadhi wote wasaidizi wake, wenyewalikuwa ma memba wa ile rende ya ma sadduccee wakajawa na wivu.

src: 18.They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.
tgt: Wakawa arrest na kuwatupa Jail na kuwaseti kwa ile jela public.

src: 19.But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.
tgt: Lakini timeza usiku malaika wa sir Godi akafungua doaa za jela na kuwa leta nje.

src: 20."Go, stand in the temple courts," he said, "and tell the people the full message of this new life."
tgt: Akawashow,"ishieni mkasimame ndani ya verandah za temple, mkawashow hawa wadhi message full ya hii life mpya."

src: 21.At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people.
tgt: When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin—the full

src: 22.But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,
tgt: Lakini kuarrive ivi kwa jela,ma mr. officer hawakuwaget huko. So wakaishia back kuripoti,

src: 23."We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside."
tgt: "Tuliget jela imefungwa vi secure, pamoja na maguards kustand kwa doaa; lakini vile tuliopen milango, hatukuget mse ndani."

src: 24.On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were puzzled, wondering what would come of this.
tgt: Kuskia hii ripoti, capuu wa mabanga wa temple na ma priest dozi wakatatizika, waka wonder kwanini nini inaweza kuwa ilitokezea.

src: 25.Then someone came and said, "Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people."
tgt: Kisha mdhii fulani akatokezea na kudai, "Cheki! Wale majamaa mliweka ndani ya jela wana stand ndani ya temple wakiteach wadhii."

src: 26.At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.
tgt: kwa hiyo stori, capuu akaishia na ma mr. ofisa na kuletaapostles. Hawaku use force, ju waliogopa ati wasee wangewapiga mawe.

src: 27.Having brought the apostles, they made them appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.
tgt: Vile waliletama apostles, wakawamake wa appear mbele ya sanhedrin kuulizwa maswali na high priest

src: 28."We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name," he said. "Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man's blood."
tgt: Akasema, "tuligeiana ma orders strict msi teach na hii jina,lakini mmejaza Jerusa na teachings zenu na mko determined ku tumake guilty of blood ya huyu jamaa."

src: 29.Peter and the other apostles replied: "We must obey God rather than men!
tgt: Pitaa na wale apostles wengine wakareply: "Lazima tu tuobey sir Godi kuliko wadhii!

src: 30.The God of our fathers raised Jesus from the dead—whom you had killed by hanging him on a tree.
tgt: Sir Godi wa mambuyuz wetu aliraise JC toka kwa the dead- mwenye mlimada kwa kumhang kwa mti.

src: 31.God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might give repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.
tgt: Sir Godi alimuinua juu hadi kwa mkono wake wa right ka Prince sonkwo na mwokozi njo aweze geiana repentance na kusameheana kwa dhambi za Israel.

src: 32.We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him."
tgt: Si ni ma witness wa izi vitu, na pia Holy spirit, mwenyesir Godi amesha geiana kwa wale wanamu obey."

src: 33.When they heard this, they were furious and wanted to put them to death.
tgt: Vile waliskia hivi, wakajam mbaya na kudai kuwamada.

src: 34.But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.
tgt: Lakini mpharisayo fulani alimeseka ka Gamaliel, modee wa power wa sheria, mwenye alidungwa respect na wasee wote,akasimama kati kati ya sanhedrin nakudai wale majamaa watoke nje kiasi.

src: 35.Then he addressed them: "Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.
tgt: Kisha ye akawadunga speech:"Majamaa waIsrael, consider vi carefully chenye mna intend ku doiya hawa wadhii.

src: 36.Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.
tgt: Time fulani si mbali sana Theudas alitokezea, anadai ati yeni somebody, na ka wadhii soo nne

src: 37.After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
tgt: After yeye, Judas, jamaa wa Galilee akatokezea zile days za census aka lead wadhi kadhaa kwa revolution. Ye pia alidedishwa, na mafans wake wote waka scatter.

src: 38.Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.
tgt: Kwa hivo,ju ya hii case hapa nawa advise: Achaneni na hawa wadhii peke yao! Wasare waishie! Ju ka miradi zao ni kazi ya mwili, wata fail.

src: 39.But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God."
tgt: Lakini ka ni from sir Godi,hamtaweza kustop hawa wadhii; mtajipata tu mkifight sir Godi."

src: 40.His speech persuaded them. They called the apostles in and had them flogged. Then they ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
tgt: Speech yake ikawaconvince. Wakaitana ma apostles ndani wakawawasha nyahunyo. Alafuwakawa order wasibonge ju ya ile jina ya Jesus,wakawasare waishie.

src: 41.The apostles left the Sanhedrin, rejoicing because they had been counted worthy of suffering disgrace for the Name.
tgt: Mitume wakatoka sanhedrin, wakijazika niaje, ju walikuwa wamehesabika wako worth kusuffer dharau ju ya Jina ya JC.

src: 42.Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.
tgt: Siku after siku,ndani ya ma veranda za temple na kutoka kejamoja hadi ingine,hawakuwahi acha ku teachna kuproclaim ile habari njema that Jesus njo Kristo.

src: Ma-action na ma vitendo za masoja wa Jenerali JC, Flow ya nne- Acts 4 1.The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.
tgt: Ma priest na hadi capi wa mabanga wa temple na ma sadducees wakakam up kwa Pitaa na Johnie vile walikuwa wakibonga na wasee.

src: 2.They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.
tgt: Walikuwa wameumwa sana ati ma apostles wanabonga wakifunza wadhii na kudai kwa jina la Yesu ati kuna kurauka kwa the dead.

src: 3.They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.
tgt: So bila kuwaweka, walishika Pitaa na Johnie na ju ilikuwa ma evening, waliwatupa jail hadi day next.

src: 4.But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.
tgt: Lakini wadhii wengi wenye waliskia hiyo message walibelieve, na ile number ya wadhii ma member ikagrow hadi five k.

src: 5.The next day the rulers, elders and teachers of the law met in Jerusalem.
tgt: Day ya next masonkwo wanarule, wazae na maodijo wa sheria wakakutana Jerusa.

src: 6.Annas the high priest was there, and so were Caiaphas, John, Alexander and the other men of the high priest's family.
tgt: Annas yule high priest alikuwaga pale, pia Caiaphashakuhata, Johnie, Alexander na wadhii wengine majamaa wa famo ya the high priest.

src: 7.They had Peter and John brought before them and began to question them: "By what power or what name did you do this?"
tgt: Wakahave Peter aletwe pamoja na Johnie mbele yao na wakaanza kuwadunga maswali: "Na powergani ama jina gani mna do ivi?"

src: 8.Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: "Rulers and elders of the people!
tgt: Kisha Peter, akiwa amejazwa na holyspirit, akadai kwao: "Ma rulers na wazaewa wadhii!

src: 9.If we are being called to account today for an act of kindness shown to a cripple and are asked how he was healed,
tgt: Ka tuna calliwa tutoe report leo ati niaje tulioneshana kindness kwa jamaa cripple na tunaulizwa niaje vile ali healiwa,

src: 10.then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.
tgt: kisha jueni ivi, nyi na wadhii wote wasee wa israel:ni kwa jina la Yesu Kristo yule jamaawa

src: 11.He is " 'the stone you builders rejected, which has become the capstone.'
tgt: Yeye njo " ' ile jiwe, ma contractor wa ku build mbanyu mlichuja, yenye sasa chenki njo jiwe ya korna, yenye inapimanisha zingine.'

src: 12.Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved."
tgt: Wokovu haipatikani kwa mse mwingine,ju hanaku jina ingine chini yaheaven yenye imepeanwa kwawadhii by which tu ni lazima wasave-ike.

src: 13.When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.
tgt: Vile walicheki the courage ya Peter na Johnie na wakamesea ati hawa wadhii walikuwa hawajafika shule kusoma, wananchi ordinaree, walishangazwa meja hadi ikabidi wametake note ati hawa wajamaa walikuwaga wame hangout na JC.

src: 14.But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.
tgt: Lakini ju pia walikuwa wakicheki jamaa mwenye alipona amestand pale pale nao, hanaku tuki wangebonga.

src: 15.So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.
tgt: So waka waamrisha wakitoe from hiyo meeting iliitwa sanhedrin, njo at least wazae wado ka consultation ki siri siri.

src: 16."What are we going to do with these men?" they asked. "Everybody living in Jerusalem knows they have done an outstanding miracle, and we cannot deny it.
tgt: Wakaulizana niaje,"Tuta do what na hawa wadhii?Kila msee mwenye anapoleaga Jerusa ashamesea kuwa hawa ma chali wame do miracle ingine tu outsnadingtumbaya, hatuwezi kwara.

src: 17.But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn these men to speak no longer to anyone in this name."
tgt: Lakini njo tusiwaweke na ku prevent hii something isi spread zaidi kati ya wadhii, lazima tuwapee onyo ingine kali wasibonge kwa mse any na hii name."

src: 18.Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.
tgt: So wakawa call ndani tena na kuwa command wasibonge na hiyo jina ama ku teach kabisa na the name ya Jesus.

src: 19.But Peter and John replied, "Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God's sight to obey you rather than God.
tgt: Lakini Peter na Johnie wakashow kitu iko,"Kuweni ma judge nyi wenyewekama nipoa kwa macho ya sir Godi tukiwaobey kuliko sir Godi.

src: 20.For we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard."
tgt: Ju si hatuwezi jizuia kubonga ju ya zile drama tumecheki na kuskia."

src: 21.After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.
tgt: Sa baada ya vitisho wakawaachilia ku go. Hawange decide vile ya kuwapunish,ju wadhii wote walikuwa wakipraise sir Godi ju ya chenye kilikuwa kimehappen.

src: 22.For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
tgt: Ju yule boy mwenye aliponywa vi miraculously alikuwa over miaka forty.

src: 23.On their release, Peter and John went back to their own people and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.
tgt: Vile waliget release yao hivi, Peter na Johnie waliishia back kwa wadhii wao na kureport kila kitu chenye priest masonkwo na wazae walikuwa wamewashow.

src: 24.When they heard this, they raised their voices together in prayer to God. "Sovereign Lord," they said, "you made the heaven and the earth and the sea, and everything in them.
tgt: Vile waliskia ivi, wakapaza sauti zao tugezza wakipray sir Godi.Wakasema niaje,"Mtukufu bwana, ume make heaven na earth na sea, na kila kitu in them.

src: 25.You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: " 'Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
tgt: Ulispeak na the holy spirit kupitia mdomo ya servant wako,mbuyuz wetu Davie:" 'Mbona ma nations zinaleta hasira na wadhii wanapanga mipango empty?

src: 26.The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against his Anointed One.'
tgt: Kings masonkwo wa the earth washa take stand zao na ma leaders washa gather tugezza against bwana mdosi na against yule annointed wake.'

src: 27.Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.
tgt: Cha ukweli Hero na Pontius Pilate walimeet pamoja na ma nations zingine pamoja na wadhii wa Israel kwa hiijiji kuchora mradi against servant wakomholy, JC, mwenye uli annoint.

src: 28.They did what your power and will had decided beforehand should happen.
tgt: Walido chenye power yako na will yako ilidecide kabla that i happen.

src: 29.Now, Lord, consider their threats and enable your servants to speak your word with great boldness.
tgt: Sa bwana mdos, consider vitisho zao na u make ma servants wako wa speak word yako kimangoto.

src: 30.Stretch out your hand to heal and perform miraculous signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus."
tgt: Stretch outmkono yako kuheal na ku perform ishara miraculous pamoja na ma wonders kupitia jina ya servant wako JC."

src: 31.After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
tgt: Bahada yao kupray, place yenye walikuwa wakidunga meeting ika shakeiwa.Na wakajazwa wote na the holy spirit wakanego word ya sir Godi na boldness.

src: 32.All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they had.
tgt: Wote believers wenye walikuwa hapo walikuwa in one mind na heart moja. Hanakumse alileta kujua ati chochote chake kilikuwa chake pekee, lakini wote walishare kila kitu chenye walikuwa nacho.

src: 33.With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and much grace was upon them all.
tgt: Sa na nguvu zingine meja ma apostles walizidi ku testify ju ya kuraushwa kwa bwanamdos Jc from the dead, na grace inginetumassoive ilikuwa juu yao wote.

src: 34.There were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned lands or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales
tgt: Hakukuwa na mse yeyote msoto kati yao. Ju kila time wale wadhii walikuwa na ma shakee ama makeja walizikinda,waka gazza munde ya toka kwa izo ma property

src: 35.and put it at the apostles' feet, and it was distributed to anyone as he had need.
tgt: wakaziwekelea kwa miguu za ma apostles,na ikadistibutiwa kwa kila mse kulingana na vile alikuwa amesota.

src: 36.Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means Son of Encouragement),
tgt: Jose, mse mmoja levite kutoka cyprus, mwenye ma apostle waliitaga Barnabas (yenye inamaanishaga jamaa wa kuencourage wasee),

src: 37.sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles' feet.
tgt: alisell shakee yake personal na akaleta iyo munde akaiwekeleakwa miguu ya ma apostles.

src: Action zenye ziligo down za masoja wa Jeneralli JC, account ya tatu-Acts 3 1.One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer—at three in the afternoon.
tgt: Sa day moja, Peter na Johnie walikuwa wapipanda juu kwa temple ile matime ya maombi - masaa tisa ivi afte.

src: 2.Now a man crippled from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.
tgt: Sa mse mmoja cripple toka kuzaliwa alikuwa akibebwa hadi kwa gate ya temple inaitwa beautiful, place alikuwa akiwekwa kila day ku omba omba toka kwa wale wadhi walikuwa wakiingia kwa temple.

src: 3.When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
tgt: Vile Peter na Johnie walikuwa karibu kuingia, akawauliza wamkanje munde kiasi.

src: 4.Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, "Look at us!"
tgt: Peter akamcheki straight kama tu Johnie.Alafu Peter akadai, "Ebu tucheki!"

src: 5.So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them. 6.Then Peter said, "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk."
tgt: Kisha Peter akadai,"Masilver ama gold hatuna,lakini chenye niko nacho nakugei. Katika Jina la Jesus christ yule jamaa wa Nazareth, tembea."

src: 7.Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man's feet and ankles became strong.
tgt: Akimkwachu by the right hand, akamsaidia kurauka,na vi instant miguu za jamaa na ankles za jamaa zikapata nguvu.

src: 8.He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.
tgt: Akajump kwa miguu zake na kuanza kutembea. Kisha vile aliishia nao kwa verandah za temple, akiwalk na kuruka tu na kupraise sir Godi.

src: 9.When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
tgt: Vile wadhii wote walicheki akitembea na kupraise sir Godi,

src: 10.they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
tgt: Wakamrecognize kama yule jamaa same tu mwenye alikuwa akipoleaga akibeg kwa mlango ya temple, hapo kwa gate iliitwaga Beautiful,na wakajazwa na kushangaa na kujazzika at chenye kilim-happenia.

src: 11.While the beggar held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon's Colonnade.
tgt: Sa beggar akizidi kushikilia akina Pitaa na Johnie, wadhii wote walikuwa wameshangaa na walikam wakikimbia kwao iyo place iliitwaga porch ya Solomon.

src: 12.When Peter saw this, he said to them: "Men of Israel, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?
tgt: Vile Pitaa alicheki hivi akawashow: "Wadhii wa-israel, mbona hii inawa surprise? Mbona mnastare at sisi ni ka kwa nguvu zetu ama ju si ni wase godly saana ati tume make huyu jamaa a walk?

src: 13.The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.
tgt: Yule God wa Abraham, Izzo na Jacob, buzzenga wa mambuyus wetu, amesha glorify servant wake JC. Mlimsare over amadwe, na mkamruka mbele ya Pilate, ingawa Pilate alikuwa ameshapanga kumwachilia a go.

src: 14.You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.
tgt: Mlisha m-disown yule mse holy na mse righteous na kudai ati jamaa mwuwaji asareiwe kwenu.

src: 15.You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.
tgt: Mlimada yule mwanzo wa life, lakini sir Godi alimraise toka from the dead. Si ni ma witness wa hii.

src: 16.By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus' name and the faith that comes through him that has given this complete healing to him, as you can all see.
tgt: By faith katika jina la Yesu, this jamaa mwenye mnacheki na mwenye mnajua alimakeiwa mstrong. Ilikuwa katika jina la yesu na faith yenye inakam through yeye that aligeiwa healing complete kwake, ka vile nyi wote mnacheki.

src: 17."Now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.
tgt: "sa mabro, namesea kuwa mli act kwa kuto jua, kama tu ma leaders wenu.

src: 18.But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Christ would suffer.
tgt: Lakini hivi tu njo sir Godi alifulfill chenye kilielezewa through ma prophets wote, akidai that

src: 19.Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,
tgt: Repentini basi na m-turn kwa sir Godi, njo hata dhambi zenu zi wipe-iwe off, halafu hadi matimes za kucheki refreshing zitakam from sir Godi,

src: 20.and that he may send the Christ, who has been appointed for you—even Jesus.
tgt: na that pia a send Christ, mwenye ali appointiwa ju yenu- yaani Jesus.

src: 21.He must remain in heaven until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.
tgt: Lazima tu abaki heaven hadi ile ma time inakam for sir Godi ku restorekila kitu, kama tuvile ali promise kitambo kupitia maprophets wake wa holy.

src: 22.For Moses said, 'The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.
tgt: Ju Mosee alidai aje, "Bwana mdosi sir Godi wenu atawa appointia prophet kama mimi toka kwa wasee wenu; na ni lazima mskize kila kitu chenye anawashow.

src: 23.Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from among his people.'
tgt: Mse yeyote mwenye hawezi mskiza atachujwakabisa from among wadhii wake.'

src: 24."Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have foretold these days.
tgt: "Kabisa,wadhiiwote toka kwa Samuel kuelekea on, wengi kama vile tu wengi wamebonga, walisha foretell hizi siku.

src: 25.And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, 'Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.'
tgt: Na nyi ni wasee wa ku inherit toka kwa ma prophets na tokakwa agreement yenye sir Godi alimake na mambuyuz wenu. Alisema to Abraham, 'Kupitia watoi wako wadhii wote earth watablessika.'

src: 26.When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."
tgt: Vile sir Godi aliinua up servant wake, alimsend kwanza kwenu kuwabless by kuwa turn kila mmoja wenu toka your wicked ways."

src: Chapta mbe ya Ma action za ma soja wa Jeneralli JC - Acts 2 1.When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
tgt: Vile day ya pentecost ilikam, walikuwa wote pamoja place moja.

src: 2.Suddenly a sound like the blowing of a violent wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
tgt: Vi sudden sauti kama upepo strong ajabu ikakam toka heaven na kujaza hao mzima place walikuwa wamebangaiza.

src: 3.They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
tgt: Wakacheki chenye kilikuwa kama ulimi za moto zikiachana na kukam kutulia ju ya kila mmoja wao.

src: 4.All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
tgt: Wote wakajazwa na holy spirit na wakaanza kubonga na lugha zingine mbichi vile holy spirit aliwawezesha.

src: 5.Now there were staying in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
tgt: Sa walikuwa awakipoleaga ndani ya jerusa wasee fulani God fearing toka kila nchi chini ya heaven.

src: 6.When they heard this sound, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking in his own language.
tgt: Vile waliskia hii sound, rende moja ikakam pamoja ikiwa imeshangaa,ju kila mmoja wao aliskia wale wafuasi wa JC wakibonga language yao ya home.

src: 7.Utterly amazed, they asked: "Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?
tgt: Wakiwa wameshangazwa vimeja wakauliza: "Si hawa wadhii wote wanabonga wanatokezea Galilee?

src: 8.Then how is it that each of us hears them in his own native language?
tgt: Basi itakuwaje ati kila mmoja wetu anawaskia na mothertongue yake?

src: 9.Parthians, Medes and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
tgt: Ma Parthians,ma Medes ma Elamites;wase wanaishi Mesopotamia, Judea na Cappadocia, Pontus na Asia,

src: 10.Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome
tgt: Hadi Phrygia na Pamphylia, Egypt na hadi places zingine huko ma Libya karibu na Cyrene; hata wdhii toka Rome

src: 11.(both Jews and converts to Judaism); Cretans and Arabs-we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!"
tgt: (Wote ma Jew na wase wameconvert hadi Judaism); Wase waCrete na waarabu - tunawaskia wakibonga zile wonders za sir Godi na mother tongue yetu!"

src: 12.Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, "What does this mean?"
tgt: Wakiwa wamejazzika na pia wameshangaa, wakaulizana niaje, "Hii inamaanisha what?"

src: 13.Some, however, made fun of them and said, "They have had too much wine."
tgt: Wengine, lakini, wakawachongoa wakidai, "Hawa wadhii wamekunywa kamnyweso mob."

src: 14.Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: "Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.
tgt: Kisha Peter akastand up na wale eleven, akaraise voice yake na kushow crowd niaje: "Ma jews wenzangu na wasee wote wanapoleaga Jerusa, wacha niwashow explanation ya hii situation; skizeni vi careful chenye nawashow.

src: 15.These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It's only nine in the morning!
tgt: Hawa wasee sio drunk,ka mnavyodhani. Si ni saa tatu tu morning!

src: 16.No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
tgt: Zi, Hi ni ile story ilibongeshwa juu yake na higher man Joel:

src: 17." 'In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
tgt: " ' Siku za mwisho, sir Godi anadai aje, Nitapour outSpirit yangu juu ya wadhii wote. Ma sons wenu na ma daughters wenu wataprophesy, majamaa wenu wa young watacheki visions, wazae wenu wata dream dreams.

src: 14.At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.
tgt: Kufika hapo, aka turn around akacheki JC amesimama hapo,lakini hakurealize ilikuwa JC.

src: 15."Woman," he said, "why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?" Thinking he was the gardener, she said, "Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him."
tgt: Jesus akamwuliza, "Mama, mbona umeangua kilio? Unasaka nani?" Madam, akifikiria ni shamba boy akadai, "Boss, kama ni wewe umemchukua away nishow place umemweka, nitamget."

src: 16.Jesus said to her, "Mary."She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, "Rabboni!" (which means Teacher).
tgt: JC akamjibu madam, "Mary." Madam akageuka toward JC na kuwika na ki Aramaic, "Rabboni!" (word yenye hu mean Odijo).

src: 17.Jesus said, "Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet returned to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, 'I am returning to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.' "
tgt: JC akamshow, "Usinikwamilie, ju bado sijarudi yet kwa Mbuyu. Ishia instead hadi kwa bros zangu uwashow, 'Ninarudi kwa mbuyu wanguna mbuyuwenu, kwa sir godi wangu na sir Godi wenu.' "

src: 18.Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: "I have seen the Lord!" And she told them that he had said these things to her.
tgt: Mary Magda akaishia kwa wafuasi wake nahabari: "Nimecheki bwana mdosi!" Na alafu akawashow kuwa JC alikuwa amebonga zile vitu zote kwake.

src: 19.On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"
tgt: Ile jioni yathat first day ya wiki, vile wafuasi walikuwa pamoja,na doaa zimefungwa ju ya

src: 20.After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.
tgt: After alikuwa amesema hivi, aliwashow mikono zake na sideyake. ma disciples walikuwa overjoyed vilewalicheki bwana mdosi.

src: 21.Again Jesus said, "Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you."
tgt: Tena JC akasema, "Peace ikuwe na nyinyi! Vile mbuyuamenituma pia nawatuma."

src: 22.And with that he breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit.
tgt: Na with that akawabreathia na kusema, "Receive-ini Holy Spirit.

src: 23.If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven."
tgt: Mki forgive mse yeyote dhambi zake, wameforgiviwa; msipowasamehea, hawajasamehewa."

src: 24.Now Thomas (called Didymus), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
tgt: Sa Thomas mwenye pia alimeseka ka Didymus, mmoja wa wale twelve, hakuwa na disciples wenzake vile JC alikam.

src: 25.So the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe it."
tgt: Kwa ivo wale wafuasi wengine wakamshow niaje, "Tumeshacheki bwana mdosi!" Lakini akawashow, "Unless nicheki zile marks za misumari kwa mikono zake,na niweke kidole yangu place nails zilikuwa,na niweke mkono yangu kwa side yake, sita believe."

src: 26.A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"
tgt: Wiki moja later wafuasi wake walikuwa ndani yambanyu tena,na Thomas alikuwa nao. Ingawa ma doaa zilikuwa locked, JC alikam akasimama kati yao nakuwashow, "Peace iwe na nyinyi!"

src: 27.Then he said to Thomas, "Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe."
tgt: Kishakashow Thomas, "Wekelea kidole yako hapa; cheki mikono zangu. Direct mkono yako na uiwekendani ya sideyangu. Wacha ku doubt na uamini.

src: 28.Thomas said to him, "My Lord and my God!"
tgt: Thomas akamshow, "bwana mdosi wangu na sir Godi wangu!"

src: 29.Then Jesus told him, "Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."
tgt: Kisha JC akamshow niaje, "Ju umenicheki,umeamini; wameblessika wote wenye hawajanicheki lakini wameamini."

src: 30.Jesus did many other miraculous signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.
tgt: JC ali do signs mob miraculousmbele ya wafuasi wake, zenye hazijaandikwa kwa hii book.

src: Johnie Chapta ya nineteen-John 19 1.Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
tgt: Alafu Pilate akakwachu Jesus akamsare kuwashwa viboko.

src: 2.The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe
tgt: Masoja wakakunja kunja tugezza ka crown ka miba wakamwekea kwa head yake. Wakamvalisha clad fulani, robe, ya purple

src: 3.and went up to him again and again, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!" And they struck him in the face.
tgt: Alafu wakaishia kwake tena na tena wakimshow, "Oyee, king wa ma jews!" Na wakamwai vibare za uso.

src: 4.Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews, "Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him."
tgt: Maraingine tena Pilate akakam nje kubongesha wayahudi niaje,"Chekini, nalete JC nje kwenu njo niwafanye mumesee that sioni beef ina warrant mu press charges against yeye."

src: 5.When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, "Here is the man!"
tgt: Vile JC alitokezea amevalishwa crown ya ma miiba na kabuti yapurple, Pilate akawabongesha, "Huyu hapa huyo jamaa!"

src: 6.As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" But Pilate answered, "You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him. "
tgt: Vile tu ma priest sonkwo na ma officiale walimcheki, wakaanza kuwika tena,"Mcrucify! mcrucify!" Lakini akawajibu niaje, "mchukueni mkamcrucify. Lakini for mimi, sioni beef yoyote ya kuleta such charges against JC."

src: 7.The Jews insisted, "We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God."
tgt: Wale wayahudi wakadai niaje, "Tuko na constitution wajamaa, na kulingana na constitution yetu lazima amadwe, ju alidai ye ni son wa sir Godi."

src: 8.When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
tgt: Weh!Pilate kuskizia hizo latest developments akaingiza mnjeve sa ile zaidi,

src: 9.and he went back inside the palace. "Where do you come from?" he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.
tgt: akaishia ndani ya palace tena. "Unatokezea wapi jamaa?" Akauliza Jesus, lakini Jesus akakwara kumjibu.

src: 10."Do you refuse to speak to me?" Pilate said. "Don't you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?"
tgt: Pilate akamshow niaje, "Unakwara kubongana mimi? Haumesei niko na powers za either kukufree ama kukucrucify kwa cross?"

src: 11.Jesus answered, "You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin."
tgt: JC akamjibu mara one, "Haungekuwa na powers ju ya mimi ka hazingekuwa zilipeanwa kwako toka mbinguni.Kwa hivo ju ya hiyo stori yule jamaa alinisare kwako ako guilty ju ya dhambi bwaku zaidi."

src: 12.From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jews kept shouting, "If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar."
tgt: Toka hapo sa, Pilate akatry kumwachilia JC as a free jamaa, lajkini wayahudi mtu wangu, wayahudi walibaki kuwika tu, "Ukiset huyujamaa free aishie tu, we basi sio beshte wa Caesar. Ju kila mse

src: 13.When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge's seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).
tgt: Vile Pilate aliskia hiyo siasa mbaya, alileta JC nje akapolea kwa kiti ya judge place ilijulikana ka pevu ya stone (In aramaic inameseka ka Gabbatha).

src: 14.It was the day of Preparation of Passover Week, about the sixth hour."Here is your king," Pilate said to the Jews.
tgt: Ilikuwaga ile day ya preps za passover week, kitu ka masaa sita ivi. Pilate akaanza kubonga, "Njo huyu king wenu."

src: 15.But they shouted, "Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!" "Shall I crucify your king?" Pilate asked."We have no king but Caesar," the chief priests answered.
tgt: Lakini vile walishout, "Matake-ini away! Mtake-ini away! Mcrucifyini!" Pilate akauliza niaje, "Kwani nita crucify King wenu?" Ma priests wasonkwo wakasema, "Si hatuna king except Caesar."

src: 16.Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.
tgt: Mwishowe Pilate akamsare over kwa wayahudi wam crucify. Kwa ivo masoja waka chukua charge over JC.

src: 17.Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).
tgt: Akibeba cross yake mwenyewe, wakaishia out hadi wakafika ile place ya skull (penye in aramaic inaitwaga Golgotha).

src: 18.Here they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.
tgt: Hapo wakam crucify, yeye pamoja wasee wengine waili madingo-mmoja kwa side yake ya left na mwingine kwa side yake ya right na JC katikati.

src: 19.Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
tgt: Pilate aka-order notice imake-iwe akaichapilia kwa cross. Ilisoma: Jesus wa Nazareth, King wa Jews.

src: 20.Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.
tgt: Wengi wa wayahudi walisoma hiyo lebo, ju ile place yenye JC alikuwa amecrucifyiwa ilikuwa karibu ya jiji, na notice ilikuwa imeandikwa na Aramaic, Latin na greek.

src: 21.The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, "Do not write 'The King of the Jews,' but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews."
tgt: Yule mdosi wa ma pasii wa kiyahudi alicomplain kwa Pilate,"Usiandike ati, 'King wa wayahudi,' lakini that huyu jamaa alidai kuwa 'King wa the Jews."

src: 22.Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
tgt: Pilate akasema, "Chenye nimechora, nimechora."

src: 23.When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
tgt: Vile wale masoja walicrucify JC, walikwachu cladi zake, wakazigawanya kwa vipande nne, moja ya kila mmoja wao, na ile underwear ikibakishwa. Underwear ilikuwa kitambaa moja tu haina hem, imeshonwa ka kipande kimoja from juu hadi down.

src: 24."Let's not tear it," they said to one another. "Let's decide by lot who will get it." This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled which said,"They divided my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing." So this is what the soldiers did.
tgt: Wakareason aje wakiwa together, "Tusiirarue. Tu decide na coin ni nani ataiget." Hii ilihapen njo scripture ikuwe fulfilled yenye husema, "Walidivide clothes zangu kati yao na kutoss coin ju ya kladi zangu." So ivo njo masoja walido.

src: 25.Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
tgt: Karibu tu ya cross ya Jesus,kulikuwa na mathaake, siz wa mathaake, Merii waif wa Clopas na Mary Magdalne wamesimama hapo.

src: 26.When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, "Dear woman, here is your son," 27.and to the disciple, "Here is your mother." From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.
tgt: na kwa yule mfuasi, "Huyu njo mathaako." Toka hiyo time kuendelea, disciple wake akamchukua matha wa JC na wakaishi kwake.

src: 28.Later, knowing that all was now completed, and so that the Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, "I am thirsty."
tgt: Bahadayez, akimesea kila something ilikuwa imemalizika, na pia njo scripture ika kuwa kweli, JC akasema, "Niko thirsty."

src: 29.A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesus' lips.
tgt: Chupa ya wine imesha chacha kuwa vinegar ilikuwa hapo, wakatumbukiza sponge ndani, wakawekelea sponge kwa kijiti ya plant inaitwa hyssop wakaiinua hadi kwa lips za JC.

src: 30.When he had received the drink, Jesus said, "It is finished." With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
tgt: Vile alimada kukwachu drink, Jesus akasema, "Imekwisha kukwisha."Na with that, aka bow head na kuasare spirit yake.

src: 31.Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jews did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.
tgt: Sa ilikuwa ni siku ya preps, na ile day next njo ilikuwa ikuwe sabbath ile special. Ju wayahudi

src: 32.The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.
tgt: Wale mabanga wakakam wakavunja miguu za dingo wa fao mwenyealikuwaamecrucifyiwa na pamoja JC, alafu pia wakavunja za dingo wa pili.

src: 33.But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
tgt: Lakini vile walikam kwa JC na kukuta asha kick, hawaku break miguu zake.

src: 34.Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus' side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
tgt: Instead mmoja wao mabanga alimdunga JC kwa side na spear, ikaleta flow ya blood na wode vi sudden.

src: 35.The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.
tgt: Yule jamaa alicheki hii drama alipeana ushahidi, na testimony yake ni ukweli.Anamesea that anabonga ukweli, na anatestify njo hata nyi muamini.

src: 36.These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: "Not one of his bones will be broken,"
tgt: Hizi vitu zilihappen njo scripture itimike: "Hata mmoja ya bones zake haitavunjika,"

src: 37.and, as another scripture says, "They will look on the one they have pierced."
tgt: na, scripture ingine inasay, "Watacheki yule jamaa mwenye walidunga."

src: 38.Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jews. With Pilate's permission, he came and took the body away.
tgt: Baadaye, Josewa arimathea akauliza Pilate amgei mwili ya JC. Sa Jose alikuwa disciple wa JC, lakini ki clande ju aliogopa wayahudi. Na perm ya Pilate, akakam akakwachu mwili ya JC akaishia nayo.

src: 39.He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
tgt: Nicodemus alikuwa amemzindii yule jamaa, Nicodemus mwenye mapema kidogo alikuwa amevisit JC usiku.

src: 40.Taking Jesus' body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.
tgt: Wakikwachu mwili ya JC, hao wadhi mbe waliifunikia, wakiwa wameipaka ma spices, nadni ya vitambaa za khaki. Hiyo ilikuwa kulinganana traditions za wayahudi.

src: 41.At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid. which no one had ever been laid.
tgt: Kwa ile placeJC alikuwa amecrucifyiwa, kulikuwa na shakee, na ndani ya shakee kulikuwa na kaburi mbichi, yenye hanaku msealikuwa amezikwa ndani.

src: Johnie Chapta ya eighteen -John 18 1.When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was an olive grove, and he and his disciples went into it.
tgt: Vile alimada kusali, Jesus akakitoa pamoja na wafuasi na ku cross kidron ile valley. Ile ngambo ingine, abroad, kulikuwa na kichaka cha ma olives, na hapo JC na wafuasi wakajichoma ndani.

src: 2.Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.
tgt: Sa Judee, mwenyealimwuza, alimesea ile place, ju JC alikuwaga mara most akiishia kumeet hapo na wafuasi.

src: 3.So Judas came to the grove, guiding a detachment of soldiers and some officials from the chief priests and Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns and weapons.
tgt: Kwa ivo Judee akasogelea kichaka, akiguide unit moja ja mabanga pamoja na wadosi fulani toka kwa mapriest sonkwo na mafarisayo. Walikuwa wakibeba torch na koroboi na ma weapons.

src: 4.Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, "Who is it you want?"
tgt: JC ju alimesea kila kitu chenye kilikuwa kinaenda kuhappen kwake, aliishia nje na kudai,"Ni nani mna want?"

src: 5."Jesus of Nazareth," they replied. "I am he," Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)
tgt: "JC mse wa Nazareth," wakamshow. JC akawashow, "Mi njo yeye." (Judee mwuzaji alikuwa amesimama apo nao)

src: 6.When Jesus said, "I am he," they drew back and fell to the ground.
tgt: Vile JC alisema, "Mi njo yeye," wakarudi nyuma na kudundakwa grao.

src: 7.Again he asked them, "Who is it you want?" And they said, "Jesus of Nazareth."
tgt: Kisha tena akawauliza niaje, "Ni nani mnawant?" Waadai tena, "Jesus yule wa Nazareth."

src: 8."I told you that I am he," Jesus answered. "If you are looking for me, then let these men go."
tgt: JC akawareplyia, "Nimewashow mi njo yeye. Ka mnanisaka basi achaneni na hawa wadhii wakiteme."

src: 9.This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: "I have not lost one of those you gave me."
tgt: Hi ilihappen njo zile words alikuwa amebonga zingefulfillika: "Sijalostisha hata mmoja wa wale ulinigei."

src: 10.Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear.(The sevrvant's name was Malchus.)
tgt: The Kisha Simo yule pitaa, mwenye alikuwa na njora, akaichomoa na kumwai mboch mmoja hapo ivo alikuwaga servant wa high priest, akakata skio yake ya right(Jina ya huyo mboch ilikuwa Malchus.)

src: 11.Jesus commanded Peter, "Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?"
tgt: Jesus akacommand Pitaa, "Ebu weka njora yako away! Kwani sitakunywa ile cup mbuyuz amenigei?"

src: 12.Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him
tgt: Kisha ile unit ya mabanga pamoja na OCPD wao na wale wadosi wayahudi waka arrest JC. Wakamfunga

src: 13.and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
tgt: wakamleta place ya fao kwa Annas, yule jamaa alikuwa fadhein law wa Caiaphas, high priest sasa wa hiyo mwaka.

src: 14.Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be good if one man died for the people.
tgt: Caiaphas alikuwaga the one mwenye alikuwa amedunga wayahudi advise that ingekuwa poa ka mse mmoja ange die for wadhii.

src: 15.Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest's courtyard,
tgt: Simo yule Pitaa na mfuasi mwingine walikuwa wakifuata JC bumper. Ju huyu mfuasi alikuwa anajulikana kwa high priest, aliingia na JC hadi kwa verandah za high priest,

src: 16.but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the girl on duty there and brought Peter in.
tgt: lakini Pitaa ikabidi amekabaki amengoja kwa doaa. Yule mfuasi celeb, mwenye alimeseka na high priest akarejelea, akanego na dem alikuwa duty iyo time wakaingiza Pitaa ndani.

src: 17."You are not one of his disciples, are you?" the girl at the door asked Peter. He replied, "I am not."
tgt: Yule dem alikuwa kwa doaa akahoji Peter,"We sio mmoja wa wahaudi sio, ama we ni member?" Jamaa akajibu, Zii, mi si member jo!"

src: 18.It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.
tgt: Ilikuwa usiku moja ya njeve, na wale mboch na wadosi wadosi walikuwa wamepoze around nare njo at least wakuwe warm. Pitaa pia alikuwa amedunga poze apo nao akiji warm.

src: 19.Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
tgt: Kukiendelea ivo, yule priest sonkwo akauliza JC maswali ju ya mafans wake na teachings zake.

src: 20."I have spoken openly to the world," Jesus replied. "I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
tgt: JC akajibu,"Nimebonga wazi kwa ya world, nimekuwa always nikifundisha kwa ma sinagogue ama kwa temple, place wadhi wote wayahudi hukusanyika tugezza. Sijasema anything kisirisiri.

src: 21.Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said."
tgt: Mbona munaniquestion? Ulizeni wale walinizkiza. For sure wanamesea chenye nilibonga."

src: 22.When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby struck him in the face. "Is this the way you answer the high priest?" he demanded.
tgt: Vile JC aliskia ivo, mmoja wa wale wadosi karibu akamwai kibare ya face. "Hivinjo vile unaweza bonga na high priest?" Akadai kujua.

src: 23."If I said something wrong," Jesus replied, "testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?"
tgt: JC akasema, "Ka nimebonga kitu wrong, testifyuseme ni what nimesema iko wrong. Lakini kama nimebonga ukweli, mbona mlinigonga?"

src: 24.Then Annas sent him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
tgt: Kisha Annas akamsend, bado amefungwa, hadi kwa Caiaphas yule high priest.

src: 25.As Simon Peter stood warming himself, he was asked, "You are not one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it, saying, "I am not."
tgt: Vile Simon Peter alisimama akijiwarm, aliulizwa niaje, "Si we ni mmoja wa wadhii disciples wake, ama sio?" Pitaa akakwara zi akibonga, "Sio mimi."

src: 26.One of the high priest's servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, "Didn't I see you with him in the olive grove?"
tgt: Mmoja wa wale mboch wa priest mdosi kabisa, rela wa jamaa alikatwa skio na Pitaa, akamleta juu, "Si nilikucheki na yeye ndani ya ile kichaka ya Olive?"

src: 27.Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.
tgt: Kisha tena Pitaa akakwara, na iyo time vile likwara tu jogoo akaanza kuwika.

src: 28.Then the Jews led Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness the Jews did not enter the palace; they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.
tgt: Alafu wayahudi wakapeleka JC toka kwa Caiaphas hadi kwa palace ya governor mroman. Kufikia sa hiyo ilikuwa asubuhima ngwarekabisa, na ku avoid ile kujimake religiously unfit for the bash ma jews wakadinda kuingia palace; manzi walitaka kudishi mlo ya passover.

src: 29.So Pilate came out to them and asked, "What charges are you bringing against this man?"
tgt: Kisha Pilate akawatokezea pale nje na kuwashow, "Ni charges gani man bring againts huyu jamaa?"

src: 30."If he were not a criminal," they replied, "we would not have handed him over to you."
tgt: Wakajibu, "Kama si ati ni jangili, hatungem peana kwenu.

src: 31.Pilate said, "Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law." "But we have no right to execute anyone," the Jews objected.
tgt: Pilate akabonga aje, "Mtake-ini nyi wenyewe na mumjugde na constitution yenu." Wayahudi wakateta,"Lakini hatuna rights za ku execute mse yeyote."

src: 32.This happened so that the words Jesus had spoken indicating the kind of death he was going to die would be fulfilled.
tgt: Hii ilihappen njo zile words zenye Jesus alikuwa amebonga kushow ni death gani angededi zikuwe fulfilled.

src: 33.Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?"
tgt: Pilate akarudi back hadi ndani ya ile palace, akaita JC na kumwuliza niaje,"We njo yule king wa wayahudi?"

src: 34."Is that your own idea," Jesus asked, "or did others talk to you about me?"
tgt: JC akauliza,"Iyo ni idea yako mwenyewe, ama ni wadhii wengine walikuguzia tu ju ya mimi?"

src: 35."Am I a Jew?" Pilate replied. "It was your people and your chief priests who handed you over to me. What is it you have done?"
tgt: Pilate aka answer,"Kwani mi ni jew? Ilikuwa ni wadhii wenu na priest mabuda njo walikuleta over kwangu under arrest. Ni nini kwani ume do?"

src: 36.Jesus said, "My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jews. But now my kingdom is from another place."
tgt: Jesus akadai, "Kingdom ya mine sio ya hii worlkd. Ka ingekuwa, ma servantswa mine wangetokwa war ku prevent arrest yangu na majews. Lakini sasa kingdom hii ni ya place ingine."

src: 37."You are a king, then!" said Pilate.Jesus answered, "You are right in saying I am a king. In fact, for this reason I was born, and for this I came into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me."
tgt: "We ni king basi!" Pilate akadai. JC akamjibu, "Uko sawa ukisema atimi ni mfalme. For real, kwanzaju ya hii reason njo maana nilizaliwa, na ju ya hii reason njo nilikam ndani ya world, kutestify ju ya ukweli."Kila mse mwenye ako kwa side ya truth yuu niskizia."

src: 38."What is truth?" Pilate asked. With this he went out again to the Jews and said, "I find no basis for a charge against him.
tgt: "Truth ni what sasa?" Pilate akadai. So from hapo akaishia out tena kwa majews na kusema, "Si find reason any nzuri ya a charge against huyu jamaa.

src: 39.But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release 'the king of the Jews'?"
tgt: Lakini ni kama kawa ya mimi kurelease kwenu angalau prisoner mmoja izi time za bash ya passover. Mnawant nimrelease'?"

src: 40.They shouted back, "No, not him! Give us Barabbas!" Now Barabbas had taken part in a rebellion.
tgt: Waka holla back, "Sio yeye! Tugeini Barabbas!" Sa Barabbas alikuwa ametake partkwa rebellion.

src: Johnie Chapta ya seventeen-John 17 1.After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: "Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.
tgt: Baada ya JC kusema ivi, alicheki juu heaven na kupray: "Daddy, time imekam. Glorify son wako,njo son wako aku glorify.

src: 2.For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.
tgt: Ju umemgei say ju ya wadhi wote njo apeane life ya milele kwa wale wote umempea.

src: 3.Now this is eternal life: that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.
tgt: Sa hii njo life ya forever: wakujue, God yule wa ukweli, na Jesus Christ, mwenye umetuma.

src: 4.I have brought you glory on earth by completing the work you gave me to do.
tgt: Nishakuletea glory kwa earth vile nimemada works yako yenye ulinigei kufanya.

src: 5.And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.
tgt: Na sasa fadhe, niglorify ndani ya presence yako na ile glory nilikuwa nayo na wewe kabla world ianze.

src: 6."I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.
tgt: "Nishakureveal kwa wale wadhi ulinigei toka kwa world. Wao ni wako; uliwagei kwangu na wame obey word yako.

src: 7.Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
tgt: Sa wanamesea that kila kitu umenigei inakam from wewe.

src: 8.For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.
tgt: Ju niligeiana kwao words zenye ulinipea na wakazikubali. Walimesea kwa hakika that nimekam from wewe, na wakaamini umenisend.

src: 9.I pray for them. I am not praying for the world,but for those you have given me, for they are yours.
tgt: Nawaprayia. Sipray for world, lakini for wale umenigei, ju hao ni wako.

src: 10.All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.
tgt: Kila samo niko nayo ni yako, a kila samo uko nayo ni yangu.Na glory imeshakam kwangu kuwapitia.

src: 11.I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name—the name you gave me—so that they may be one as we are one.
tgt: Sitabakia ndani ya world zaidi, lakini wao bado wako ndani ya world, na ninakam kwako. Mbuyuz mholy, waprotect kwa kupitia nguvu za jina yako- jina ulinipea- njo wakuwe one kama tu vile si tuko one.

src: 12.While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.
tgt: Vile nilikuwa nao, niliwaprotect na kuwaweka safe na jina yako yenye ulinipa. Hanaku hata mmoja mwenye amelost except yule alipangiwa kuwa destroyed njo scripture ikuwe fulfilled.

src: 13."I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.
tgt: Na kam kwako sasa, lakini nasema hizi vitu vile bado niko kwa world, njo sasa wawe na mgawo full ya furaha yangu ndani yao.

src: 14.I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.
tgt: Nishawagei word yako na ju ya hiyo world imewahate, ju wao sio wa world kama tu ya vile mimi sio wa world.

src: 15.My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.
tgt: Prayer ya mine sio that uwachomoe from world lakini that uwa protect from yule mwiked.

src: 16.They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.
tgt: Wao sio wa world kama vile pia mimi sio wa world.

src: 17.Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.
tgt: Waweke set apart by ukweli; word yako ni ukweli.

src: 18.As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.
tgt: Vile ulinituma ndani ya world, nimewatuma ndani ya world.

src: 19.For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.
tgt: Kwa sababu yao nimejiseti apart,njo nao pia wakuwe set apart vi thorough.

src: 20."My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,
tgt: "Prayer ya mine sio for wao alone. Naprayia pia wote wenye watabelieve in mimi through message yao,

src: 21.that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
tgt: that wote watakuwa one, Daddy, kama tu vile we uko in mimi na mimi in wewe. Wacha wao pia wawe ndani yetu njo world i believe that umenituma.

src: 22.I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one:
tgt: nimewagei ile glory that ulinigei, that wao pia wakuwe one kama vile tuko one:

src: 23.I in them and you in me. May they be brought to complete unity to let the world know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.
tgt: Mi in wao na wewe in me. Wacha wabringiwe to complete unity ku let the world ijue that ulinisend na that umewapenda ka tu vile umenipenda.

src: 24."Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.
tgt: "Mbuyuz, nataka wale umenigei wakuwe na mimi place niko, na kucheki glory yangu, ile glory umenigei ju ulinipenda kabla ya kucreate the world.

src: 25."Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.
tgt: " Fadhe mrighteous,ingawa world haikumesei, ninakujua, na wanamesea that ushanisend.

src: 26.I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them."
tgt: Nishakuintroduce kwao hadi wakakujua, na nitazidi kukufanya ujulikane nao njo love uko nayo kwangu pia ikuwe ndani yao na that mi mwenyewe nikuwe in wao."

src: Johnie Kumi na sita - John 16 1."All this I have told you so that you will not go astray.
tgt: "Hii stori yote nimewadondolea njo msiishie astray.

src: 2.They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
tgt: Watawachuja toka kwa synagogue; kwanza for real, kuna time inakam yenye mse yeyote atawamada atadhani ana doiya sir Godi janta.

src: 3.They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.
tgt: Watado vitu ka hizi ju hawajajua mbuyuz wangu au mimi.

src: 4.I have told you this, so that when the time comes you will remember that I warned you. I did not tell you this at first because I was with you.
tgt: Nimewashow hivi, njo vile iyo time inakam mtakumbuka that niliwa warn. Sikuwashow this at first ju nilikuwa na nyinyi.

src: 5."Now I am going to him who sent me, yet none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'
tgt: "Sa naishia kwa yule mse alinisend, yet hakuna mmoja wenu ananiuliza , 'Niaje, unaishia where?'

src: 6.Because I have said these things, you are filled with grief.
tgt: Ju nimebonga hizi vitu, mmejazwa na huzuni.
