src: 39."Abraham is our father," they answered."If you were Abraham's children," said Jesus, "then you would do the things Abraham did.
tgt: Wakajibu, "Abraham njo mbuyuz wetu." JC akasema, "Ka nyi ni watoi wa Abraham, basi mnge do zile vitu Abraham ali do.

src: 40.As it is, you are determined to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.
tgt: Lakini vile iko saa hii, mmejitolea vilivyo kunimaliza,mse mwenye amewadunga realli that nimeskia from sir Godi.Abraham hange do vitu ka hizo.

src: 41.You are doing the things your own father does." "We are not illegitimate children," they protested. "The only Father we have is God himself."
tgt: na do zile vitu mbuyuwenu hu do." wakazusha wakisema,"Si sio watoi wa nje, yule mbuyuz pekee mwenye tuko naye ni sir Godi mwenyewe."

src: 42.Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God and now am here. I have not come on my own; but he sent me.
tgt: JC akawashow, "Ka sir Godi ni mbuyuz wenu, mngenipenda, ju nilitoka fro sir Godi na sasa niko asapa. Sijakam kwa niaba yangu mwenyewe; lakini amenisend.

src: 43.Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.
tgt: Mbona lugha yangu bado haieleweki kwenu vi clear? Ju bado mmeshindwa kuniskia chenye

src: 44.You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father's desire. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
tgt: Mna belong kwa mbuyuz wenu, the devil, na mnataka ku do mapenzi ya mbuyuz wenu. Ye alikuwa murderer from beginning, bila kushikilia ukweli, ju hanaku ukweli in him. Akidanganya, anabonga mother tongue yake, ju he is a liar na ni mbuyu wa uongo.

src: 45.Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!
tgt: Yet ju nawashow ukweli,hamuniamini!

src: 46.Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don't you believe me?
tgt: Kuna any of you anaweza ku prove niko guilty na dhambi? Ka nawashow ukweli basi, mbona bado hamniamini?

src: 47.He who belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God."
tgt: Mwenyeanabelong kwa sir Godi anaskiza chenye sir Godi anabonga. Ile reason hamskii ni ju hamubelong kwa sir Godi."

src: 48.The Jews answered him, "Aren't we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?"
tgt: Wayahudi wakadai, "Si sasa tuko sawa tukidai that wewe ni samaritan kwanza mwenye amepagawa na shaitula?"

src: 49."I am not possessed by a demon," said Jesus, "but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
tgt: JC akasema, "Sijapagawa na devo, lakini na respect mbuyuz wangu na nyi mnanidharau.

src: 50.I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.
tgt: Sitafuti glory yangu mwenyewe;lakini kunamwenye anaisaka,na ye njo the judge.

src: 51.I tell you the truth, if anyone keeps my word, he will never see death."
tgt: Nakushow ukweli, ka mse atakeep word yangu, hatawahi cheki death."

src: 52.At this the Jews exclaimed, "Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that if anyone keeps your word, he will never taste death.
tgt: Kufika hapo wale wayahudi wakawika,"Sa tunamesea wewe umepagawa mashaito! Abraham alisha die na hadi ma prophet, yet unadai that ka mse any atakeep word yako,

src: 53.Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"
tgt: Kwani weni mbwaku kumshinda mbuyuz Abraham? Ye alidedi, na pia wale maprophets. Kwani who do you think you are?"

src: 54.Jesus replied, "If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.
tgt: JC akajibu, "Nikiji glorify mwenyewe, glory yangu hai mean any. Mbuyuz wangu,mwenye mnadai njo sir Godi wenu, ye njo ameniglorify.

src: 55.Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and keep his word.
tgt: Though hamummesei, namujua. Ka nilisei simjui, ningekuwa mwongo ka nyinyi, lakini nammesea na na keep word yake.

src: 56.Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad."
tgt: Mbuyuz wenu Abraham alirejoice at the thought ya kucheki siku yangu; alicheki na akajazika sana."

src: 57."You are not yet fifty years old," the Jews said to him, "and you have seen Abraham!"
tgt: Wayahudi wakamcheki,"We hata bado haujafikisha miaka fifty,na ushacheki Abraham!"

tgt: JC akashoiwa na mabro wake ati,"Una faa kuishia toka hapa na uende Judea, njo hapo sasa, disciples wako wacheki zile miracles una do.

src: 4.No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world."
tgt: Ju hakuna mse anataka kuwa celeb mwenye atafanya vitu chini ya maji. Sa Ju wewe unado hizi vitu, jionyeshe kwa world wazi wazi."

src: 5.For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
tgt: Ju hadima bro wake wenyewe hawakumbelieve.

src: 6.Therefore Jesus told them, "The right time for me has not yet come; for you any time is right.
tgt: Kwa ivo JC akawashow, "ile time yangu right haijafika; ju kwenu kila time ni poa.

tgt: World haiwezi wa hate, lakini inani hate ju na testify kuwa chenyeina do ni wiked.

src: 8.You go to the Feast. I am not yet going up to this Feast, because for me the right time has not yet come."
tgt: Nyi ishieni kwa bash. Mimi bado siendi juu kwa hii bash, ju for mimi ile time sawa bado haijafika."

src: 10.However, after his brothers had left for the Feast, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.
tgt: However, baada ya mabro wake kuishia kwa bash, ye pia akaishia, lakini sio vi wazi wazi, but in secret.

src: 11.Now at the Feast the Jews were watching for him and asking, "Where is that man?"
tgt: Sa pale kwa lundee ma jews walikuwa wakisaka signs zake kuwa kwa bash wakiulizaga, "Ako wapi yule jamaa?"

tgt: Kati ya zile crowds kulikuwa na mnong'ono widespread abouthim, wase waki whisper ju yake. Wengine walisema, "Ye ni mse mpoa." Others wakadai, "Zii, ye hupanga wasee."

src: 13.But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the Jews.
tgt: Lakini hanaku mdhi angesema anything wazi wazi ju yakecoz wasee waliogopa wayahudi.

src: 14.Not until halfway through the Feast did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.
tgt: Sio hadi time paree ilikuwa katikati njo JC akaishia juu hadi kwa zile verandah za temple na kuanza kufunza.

src: 15.The Jews were amazed and asked, "How did this man get such learning without having studied?"
tgt: Wale Jews wakakuwa amazed na kuuliza, "Huyu mse aliget aje masomo ya maana ivi bila kuwa class kucrack mbuku?"

src: 16.Jesus answered, "My teaching is not my own. It comes from him who sent me.
tgt: JC akawajibu, "Teachings zenye nawagei sio zangu origi. Zinatokea from yeye mwenye

tgt: Kama mse any atachoose ku do will ya sir Godi, basi atafind out kama teaching zangu zinakam from God ama whether na speak mavitu zangu tu.

src: 18.He who speaks on his own does so to gain honor for himself, but he who works for the honor of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.
tgt: Ye mwenye huspeak mavitu zake hu do ivo njo aget respect yake mwenyewe, lakini yeye mwenye anadunga wax for ile respect ya mwenye amemtuma nimse wa ukweli; hanaku tuki ya uongo kumhusu.

src: 19.Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?"
tgt: Kwani, si Mose ashawagei Sheria? Lakini hanaku hata mmoja wenu mwenye ana keep sheria. Mbona mnajaribu kunimada?

src: 20."You are demon-possessed," the crowd answered. "Who is trying to kill you?"
tgt: Lakini wase kwa rende wakamjibu, "We umepossessiwa na shaito, nani sasa anatry kukumada?"

src: 21.Jesus said to them, "I did one miracle, and you are all astonished.
tgt: JC akawashow niaje, "Nili do miujiza moja, na nyi wote mka shtuka sana.

src: 22.Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a child on the Sabbath.
tgt: Yet ju Mose aliwagei kutairi (lakini actually haikukam toka kwa Mose lakini from wahenga)

src: 24.Stop judging by mere appearances, and make a right judgment."
tgt: Acheni kujudge based on appearance, na mu make a right judgement."

tgt: Sa at that point wase kadha wa Jerusa wakaanza kubonga na kuuliza, "Si huyu jamaa ni yule mse wanatry kumada?

tgt: Na ako hapa,anaongea vi open, na hawasemi word yoyote kwake. Ama hawa wasee wenye

tgt: Kufikia hapo wakatry kumshika, lakini hakuna mse alimwekelea mkono kumshika,junyakati yake haikuwa imefika.

src: 31.Still, many in the crowd put their faith in him. They said, "When the Christ comes, will he do more miraculous signs than this man?"
tgt: Bado, wengi ndani ya ile mob waliweka faith yao in him.Wakasema, "Vile kristo atakam, atawai do miracles za kushinda huyu jamaa?"

src: 32.The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.
tgt: Ma farisayo wakaskizia vile mob ya wadhii ilikuwa ikiwhisper hizi vitu ju yake.Kisha yule chief priest na walemapharisayo wakatuma masoja wa temple kum arrest.

src: 33.Jesus said, "I am with you for only a short time, and then I go to the one who sent me.
tgt: JC akasema, "Niko tu na nyinyi for a short while, kisha nitaishia to the one mwenye alinisend.

tgt: Mtanisaka, lakini hamtaniget;naile place nitakuwa niko, hamuwezi come.

tgt: Siku ya mwisho, ile bash inashika kabisa, JC akasimama na kubongana sauti bwaku, "Ka

tgt: Mwenye ameniamini,ka tu scripture zinadai, streams of living water zitaflow toka ndani yake."

src: 39.By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.
tgt: By this alimaanisha yule Spirit,mwenye wale wamebelieve ndani yake wange receive. Hadi that point the Spirit hakuwa amegeianwa, ju JC hakuwa ameglorifaiwa.

src: 40.On hearing his words, some of the people said, "Surely this man is the Prophet."
tgt: Kuskia ma words zake, some of the guys wakasema, "For sure huyu jamaa Walipo skia words zake, wengine kati ya wale wasee wakadai, "For sure huyu jamaa ni the prophet."

src: 41.Others said, "He is the Christ." Still others asked, "How can the Christ come from Galilee?
tgt: Wengine wakadai, "Ye njo the christ." Lakini wengine wakauliza aje, "Itakuwa vipi tena Christ akam toka Galilee?'

src: 42.Does not the Scripture say that the Christ will come from David's family and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?"
tgt: Si hata scripture inasema that Kristo atatokezea kwa famo ya Davie na toka Bethlehem, ile tao Davie aliishigi?"

src: 43.Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.
tgt: Na ni ivo njo wasee walisplit ju ya JC.

src: 44.Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.
tgt: Wase fulani walitaka kumshika, lakini hakuna mse alimgusa.

src: 45.Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, "Why didn't you bring him in?"
tgt: Mwishowe wale watchie wa temple wakarudi back kwa ma priest sonkwo na mapharisees wakawauliza niaje, "mbona hamkumbring ndani?"

tgt: Hadi mawatchie wakadai, "Hanaku mse mwenye amebonga ile njia huyu jama hubonga."

tgt: Mafarisayo wakajibu na double, "Una mean asha wapanga pia nyinyi?"

tgt: "Je kuna mse any kati ya wale ma pharisee sonkwo wamemuamini?

tgt: Zi! Lakini hii rende yenye haijui any kuhusu law - kuna curse ju yao.

src: Johnie Chapta ya Six - John 6 1. After these things Jesus went over the Sea of Galilee, which is the Sea of Tiberias.
tgt: Baada ya hizi stuff JC akaishia akavuka ile sea ya Galilee, ambayo pia ni sea ya Tiberias.

src: 2.Then a great multitude followed Him, because they saw His signs which He performed on those who were diseased.
tgt: Kisha rende kubwa ikamfuata, ju walicheki ishara zake zenye alikuwa ame do kwa wale walikuwa wa sick.

src: 3.And Jesus went up on the mountain, and there He sat with His disciples.
tgt: Na JC akaishia juu yamountain, na hapo akapoa down na disciples wake.

src: 4.Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.
tgt: Sa ile passover, bash ya wayahudi, ilikuwa imefika.

src: 5.Then Jesus lifted up His eyes, and seeing a great multitude coming toward Him, He said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread, that these may eat?"
tgt: Kisha JC akainua machi hivi, na akicjeki rende kubwa sana ikikam towards yeye akashow Philo, "Tutatoa wapi dibre ya kuboti, njo hawa wadishi?"

src: 6.But this He said to test him, for He Himself knew what He would do.
tgt: Lakini hii alisema kuwapima, ju ye mwenyewe alimeseani nini ange do.

src: 7.Philip answered Him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may have a little."
tgt: Philo akamjibu, "Mkanyo ya denarii soo mbe za mkanyo sio enoughkwao, ati kila mse atataste kadogo."

src: 8.One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to Him,
tgt: Mmoja wa wale disciples wake, Andrew, bro wa Simon Peter akamshow,

src: 9."There is a lad here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what are they among so many?"
tgt: Kuna kijana hapa ako na dibre za barley tano na fish mbe, lakini sa hizo ni nini kati ya hawa wasee wote?"

src: 10.Then Jesus said, "Make the people sit down." Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
tgt: Kisha JC akamshow, "Make wasee wapoe down." Sa kulikuwa na grass mob ile place. So wale wadhi chali,wasee ka thao tano.

src: 11.And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks He distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those sitting down; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted.
tgt: Na JC akakwachu zile loaf,na vile alikuwa asha give thanks akazi distribute kwa wale disciples, na wale disciples wakagei wasee wenye walikuwa wamepoa down; pia zile fish, zikagawanywa mob kwa wasee vile tu waliwant.

src: 12. So when they were filled, He said to His disciples, "Gather up the fragments that remain, so that nothing is lost."
tgt: Si vile walishiba,akashow disciples wake, "Okoteni up zile pieces zimebakia, njo chochote imebaki isitupwe."

src: 13.Therefore they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten.
tgt: Kwa ivo wakaokota zote,na kuzijaza juala twelve na mapieces za dibre ya barley zenye zilibakia toka kwa wale walidishi.

src: Then those men, when they had seen the sign that Jesus did, said, "This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world."
tgt: Kisha wale wadhii, vilewalikuwa wamecheki ile sign yenyeJC alikuwa ame do wakasema, "Huyu njo yule prophet waukwela kabisa mwenyealifaa kuingia earth."

src: 15.Therefore when Jesus perceived that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, He departed again to the mountain by Himself alone.
tgt: Kwa ivo vileJC alimesea that walikuwa wamepangakutokezea na kumchukua by force kumfanya king, akahepa tena hadi kwa milima akiwa solo.

src: 16.Now when evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
tgt: Sa vile jioni ilikam, wafuasi wake qakaishia down hadi kwa bahari,

src: 17.got into the boat, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was already dark, and Jesus had not come to them.
tgt: wakajichapilia ndani ya MV fainana wakavuka bahari wakielekea Capernaum. Na ilikuwa tayari ni giza, na JC hakuwa amekam kwao.

src: 18.Then the sea arose because a great wind was blowing.
tgt: Kisha ile bahari ikaamka ju kulikuwa na wind ya maajabu ilikuwa iki blow.

src: 19.So when they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near the boat; and they were afraid.
tgt: So vile wali row maili tatu nne hivi wakcheki JC akiwalk kwa maji ya bahari akikaribia boat; wote wakaogopa.

src: 20.But He said to them, "It is I; do not be afraid."
tgt: Lakini akawashow niaje, "Ni mimijoh; msiogope.'

src: 21.Then they willingly received Him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.
tgt: Wakakubalia wakamreceive ndani ya boat,na one time chap chap boat ikafika dry ground place walikuwa wakiishia.

src: 22.On the following day, when the people who were standing on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except that one which His disciples had entered, and that Jesus had not entered the boat with His disciples, but His disciples had gone away alone--
tgt: Iyo siku next, vile wadhi wenye walikuwa wakisimama ile side ingine ya bahari walicheki ati hakuna boat hapo, except ile yenye wafuasi wake walikuwa wame dandia, na ati JC alikuwa hajaidandia na discipleswake, lakini disciples wake walikuwa wameishia away pekee yao--

src: 23.however, other boats came from Tiberias, near the place where they ate bread after the Lord had given thanks--
tgt: japokuwa pia boat zingine zilikuwa zimekam toka Tiberias,karibu na the place yenye walikuwa wamedishi dibre baada ya bwana mdosi kugive thanks--

src: 24.when the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they also got into boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus. 25.And when they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You come here?" 26.Jesus answered them and said, "Most assuredly, I say to you, you seek Me, not because you saw the signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.
tgt: JC akawajibu akawashow niaje,"For sure nawashow cha ukweli,mnanisaka, sio ati ju mlichekima signs, lakini ju mlidishi zile ma loaf na mka shiba.

src: 27."Do not labor for the food which perishes, but for the food which endures to everlasting life, which the Son of Man will give you, because God the Father has set His seal on Him."
tgt: "Msidungfe wax nabidii sanaju ya dishiyenye huoza, lakini ju ya ile dishi yenye huzudi kuwa hadi kufikia everlasting life,yenye mtoi son wa adam atawagei, ju Sir Godi yule Mbuyu ashamwekea stamp ya acceptance ju yake."

src: 28. Then they said to Him, "What shall we do, that we may work the works of God?"
tgt: Kisha wakamshow, "Tutado nini, njo tu do ile works ya sir Godi?"

src: 29.Jesus answered and said to them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in Him whom He sent."
tgt: JC akajibu na kuwashow, "Hii njo job ya sir Godi, ni kuamini yule mwenye alimsend."

src: 30.Therefore they said to Him, "What sign will You perform then, that we may see it and believe You? What work will You do?
tgt: Kwaivo wakamshow,"Ni sign gani utatufanya, njo tucheki na alafu tukuamini" Uta do wax gani?

src: 31."Our fathers ate the manna in the desert; as it is written, 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat.'"
tgt: "Mambuyu wetu walidishi manna kwa jungle; vile tu imeandikwa, 'aliwagei dibre from heaven ya kumanga.' "

src: 32.Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but My Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
tgt: Kisha JC akawashow niaje,"Cha ukweli nawashow, mose hakuwagei dibre from heaven, lakini ni mbuyu wangunjo anawageigi ilemkanyo ya ukweli toka heaven.

src: 33."For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."
tgt: "Ju ile dibre ya sir Godi ni yule mwenye anakam chini toka heaven nakugeiana life kwa world."

src: 34.Then they said to Him, "Lord, give us this bread always."
tgt: Kisha wakamshow niaje, "Bwana mdosi, si utugei hii dibre kila always yaani."

src: 35.And Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life. He who comes to Me shall never hunger, and he who believes in Me shall never thirst.
tgt: Na JC akawashow, "Mimi njo bread ya life. Mwenye anakam kwangu hatawahi kuwa na ubao, na mwenye amenibelieve hatawai kuwa kiu.

src: 36."But I said to you that you have seen Me and yet do not believe.
tgt: "Lakini nawashow ivi, that mmenicheki na yet bado hamjaamini.

src: 37."All that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will by no means cast out.
tgt: "Wote wenye mbuyuz amenigei watakam kwangu,na yule mwenye anakam kwangu sitawahi na njia yoyote mfukuza.

src: 38."For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
tgt: "Ju nimekam down toka heaven, sio tu ku do will yangu personally, lakini ku do will ya mwenye alinituma.

src: 39."This is the will of the Father who sent Me, that of all He has given Me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.
tgt: "Hii njo mapenzi ya mbuyu mwenye alinituma, ni kuwa kwa wale wote amenigei nisi lose yeyote,lakini niwa raise up ilesiku ya last.

src: 40."And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him may have everlasting life; and I will raise him up at the last day."
tgt: "Na hii njo will ya mwenye alinituma, ni kuwa kila msee mwenye amecheki the son na kumwamini awe na life ya foree; na nitam rausha from kifo ile siku ya kiama."

src: 41.The Jews then complained about Him, because He said, "I am the bread which came down from heaven."
tgt: Wale ma jews wakazusha ju yake, atiju alisema, "Mimi njo mkate yenye ilikam down toka juu heaven."

src: 42.And they said, "Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How is it then that He says, 'I have come down from heaven'?"
tgt: Nao wakasema, "Si huyu ni Jesus, yule mtoi wa Jose, mwenye fadhaake na mathaake tunamesea? Itakuwaje basi tena that atuambie, 'Nimekam chini from heaven'?"

src: 43.Jesus therefore answered and said to them, "Do not murmur among yourselves.
tgt: JKwa hivo JC akajibu nakuwashow wote, "Msilalamike kati yenu.

src: 44. "No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him; and I will raise him up at the last day.
tgt: Hakuna mse anaweza Kam kwangu Unless Mbuyu mwenye alinituma amvute; na nitamrausha up ile siku ya mwisho.

src: 45."It is written in the prophets, 'And they shall all be taught by God.' Therefore everyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to Me.
tgt: "Imeandikwa kwa ma prophets, "Na watafunzwa wote na sir Godi.' Kwa hivo kila mse mwenye alishaskia na kujifunza toka kwa mbuyu yu hukam kwangu.

src: 46."Not that anyone has seen the Father, except He who is from God; He has seen the Father.
tgt: "Sio kuwa ati mse yeyote amecheki mbuyu, except ye mwenye alitokakwa sir Godi; ye amecheki mbuyu.

src: 47."Most assuredly, I say to you, he who believes in Me has everlasting life.
tgt: "Cha ukweli, nawashow, ye mwenye anaamini in me ako na everlasting life.

src: 48."I am the bread of life.
tgt: Mi njo mkanyo ya life.

src: 49."Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
tgt: Ma baba zenu walikula manna ndani ya jangwa, wa washa kick.

src: 50."This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that one may eat of it and not die.
tgt: "Hii njo mkanyo ilikam down toka heaven, yenye mse anaweza imanga na asi die.

src: 51."I am the living bread which came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever; and the bread that I shall give is My flesh, which I shall give for the life of the world."
tgt: "Mi njo mkanyo iko living yenye ilikam chini toka heaven. Mse any akidishi hii mkanyo, ataishi foree; na loaf yenye nitampa ni mwili wangu, yenye nitapeana for the life ya world.

src: 52.The Jews therefore quarreled among themselves, saying, "How can this Man give us His flesh to eat?"
tgt: Wale wayahudi hapo nahapo wakaanza vita vya maneno kati yao wakidai, "Huyu jamaa anwezaje kutupatia mwili wake tudishi?"

src: 53.Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you have no life in you.
tgt: Kisha JC akawashow, "Cha ukweli,nawashow, bilaya nyi kudishi mwili wa son wa adam na kunywa blood yake, hamna life ndani yenu.

src: 54."Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
tgt: "Yeyote mwenye anadishi mwili wangu na kudrink damu yangu ana eternal life, na nitamrausha tena ile siku ya last.

src: 55."For My flesh is food indeed, and My blood is drink indeed.
tgt: "Ju mwili yangu ni chakula kamili, na damu yanguni drink kamili.

src: 56."He who eats My flesh and drinks My blood abides in Me, and I in him.
tgt: "Mwenye anadishi mwili wangu na kudrink blood yangu anabaki ndani yangu, na mimi ndani yake.

src: 57."As the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
tgt: "Ka vile mbuyu wangu alinisend, na naishi ju ya mbuyu,ivo pia ye mwenye ananidishi ataishi ju yangu.

src: 58."This is the bread which came down from heaven--not as your fathers ate the manna, and are dead. He who eats this bread will live forever."
tgt: "Hii njo ile mkanyo ilikam down toka heaven -- sio ka vile mambuyu wenu walidishi manna nabado wakakick. Yule mwenye anadishi hii loaf ataishi foree."

src: 59.These things He said in the synagogue as He taught in Capernaum.
tgt: Hizi vitu alibonga kwa synagogue vile alikuwa aki teach mtaa wa Capernaum.

src: 60.Therefore many of His disciples, when they heard this, said, "This is a hard saying; who can understand it?"
tgt: Kwa hivo wase mob kati wa wale disciples wake, vile waliskia ivi wakasema niaje, "hii ni teaching ngumu jo; nani anaeza inyita?"

src: 61.When Jesus knew in Himself that His disciples complained about this, He said to them, "Does this offend you?
tgt: Vile JC alimesea inhim kuwa disciples wake walikuwa wamecomplain ju ya this, akawashow, "Kwani hii imewakasirisha?"

src: 62."What then if you should see the Son of Man ascend where He was before?
tgt: "Sa itakuwa aje ka mtacheki mtoi chali wa adam akipanda juuhadi ile place alikuwa before?

src: 63."It is the Spirit who gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life.
tgt: "Ni the Spirit njo hugive life; mwili hai count hapo kitu.Zile ma words zenye nawabongesha ni Spirit na ni life.

src: 64."But there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who did not believe, and who would betray Him.
tgt: Lakini kuna wase wengine kati yenuwenye hamjaamini." Ju JC alijua from mwanzo ni nani walikuwa hawaamini, na nani wange mbetray.

src: 65.And He said, "Therefore I have said to you that no one can come to Me unless it has been granted to him by My Father."
tgt: Na ye akawashow,"Kwa ivo nimewashow kuwa hakuna mseanaweza kam kwangu unless imekubalika kupeanwa kwakena mbuyu wangu."

src: 66.From that time many of His disciples went back and walked with Him no more.
tgt: Toka iyo time wengi wa wafuasiwake wakatia zi kumfuata kabisa waka backslide.

src: 67.Then Jesus said to the twelve, "Do you also want to go away?"
tgt: Kisha JC akashow wale twelve, "Pia nyinyi mnataka kuishia zenu?"

src: 68.But Simon Peter answered Him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
tgt: Lakini Simon Peter akamjibu, "Lord, ni kwa nani tutaishia kwake? We una zile ma words za eternal life.

src: 69."Also we have come to believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
tgt: "Pia tumekam ku believe na kujua kuwa wewe njo yule kristo, mtoi wa Sir Godi mwenye yuko alive."

src: 70.Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?"
tgt: JC akawajibu, "Si niliwachagua, nyi twelve, na mmoja wenu ni shaitula?"

src: 71.He spoke of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, for it was he who would betray Him, being one of the twelve.
tgt: Alibonga Ju ya Jude iscariot, yule mtoi chali wa Simo, ju ilikuwa ni yeye mwenye angebetray JC, akiwa bado mmoja wa wale twelve.

src: Johnie Chapta ya Ngovo - John 5 1.After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
tgt: Kisha baada ya this kulikuwa na feast ya wayahudi, JC akaishia up hadi Jerusa.

src: 2.Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, which is called in Hebrew, Bethesda, having five porches.
tgt: Sa kulikuwa pale tu Jerusa karibu na Sheep Gate, pool fulani, yenye inaitwa kwa kilugha ya hebrew Bethesda, ambayo ina verandah kinde.

src: 3.In these lay a great multitude of sick people, blind, lame, paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water.
tgt: Hapo kumelazwa umati bwaku ya wadhii wa sick, blind, walemavu, wasee paralyzes, wakingoja tu ile maji ikorogwe.

src: 4.For an angel went down at a certain time into the pool and stirred up the water; then whoever stepped in first, after the stirring of the water, was made well of whatever disease he had.
tgt: Ju angel alikuwa akishuka down time fulani ndani ya pool na kukoroga ile maji; kisha yule mse wa fao kuingia, baada ya maji kukorogwa, alikuwa healed disease yoyote alikuwa nayo.

src: 5.Now a certain man was there who had an infirmity thirty-eight years.
tgt: Sa kulikuwan na a certain jamaa mwenye alikuwa ameget sickness ika kwama na yeye miaka thirty eight.

src: 6.When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he already had been in that condition a long time, He said to him, "Do you want to be made well?"
tgt: Vile JC alimcheki akilala hapo, na akamesea that alikuwa tayari ametulia kwa hiyo condition miaka mob, akamshow, "Unataka kuwa poa?"

src: 7.The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another steps down before me."
tgt: Ule mse msick akamjibu,"Biss, sinamse wa kuniweka ndani ya pool ile ithaa maji inakorogwa; lakini vile bado nianasogelea, manze, jamaa mwingine anawai mbele yangu."

src: 8.Jesus said to him, "Rise, take up your bed and walk."
tgt: JC akamshow niaje,"Rise chukua bed yako na utembee."

src: 9.And immediately the man was made well, took up his bed, and walked. And that day was the Sabbath.
tgt: Mara one jamaa akakuwa poa, akapick up bed yake, akawalk. Na that day ilikuwa ni the sabbath.

src: 10.The Jews therefore said to him who was cured, "It is the Sabbath; it is not lawful for you to carry your bed."
tgt: Wale ma Jews basi wakamshow niaje umepona aje, "kwanza ni sabbath , haufai kubeba bed yako, sio lawful."

src: 11.He answered them, "He who made me well said to me, 'Take up your bed and walk.' "
tgt: Akawajibu, "Ye mwenye alini make poa alinishow,'Chukua mat yako na utembee.' "

src: 12.Then they asked him, "Who is the Man who said to you, 'Take up your bed and walk'?"
tgt: Kisha wakamask, "Nani njo ule mse alikushow ati Chukua bed yako u walk'?"

src: 13.But the one who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a multitude being in that place.
tgt: Lakini yule mse alikuwa amehealiwa hakumesea ni nani alikuwa amemshow ivo, ju JC alikuwa amehepa ndani ya rende, ju rende ikiwa ile place.

src: 14.Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, "See, you have been made well. Sin no more, lest a worse thing come upon you."
tgt: Bahadayez JC akampata ndani ya hekalu, akamwambia niaje, "Cheki mtu wangu, usha fanywa poa. Usi do dhambi tena, ama kitu worse itakufanyikia."

src: 15.The man departed and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
tgt: Mse akaishia na kushow wale wayahdi, "by the way ilikuwa JC njo alini fanya poa.

src: 16.For this reason the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill Him, because He had done these things on the Sabbath.
tgt: Ju ya hii reason wale jews wakamhanda JC, hata wakasaka njia ya kummada, ju alikuwa ame do vitu hizi siku ya sabbath.

src: 17.But Jesus answered them, "My Father has been working until now, and I have been working."
tgt: Lakini JC akawajibu, "Mbuyuz wangu ako wira hadi wa sasa manze, na mimi pia nimekuwa janta."

src: 18.Therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill Him, because He not only broke the Sabbath, but also said that God was His Father, making Himself equal with God.
tgt: Kwa ivo wale wayahudi wakasaka ha ta zaidi vile watamwua, ju hakuwa tu ati amevunja sabbath laws, lakini sasa alikuwa anadai ati sir Godi ni mbuyus wake, yani kujitoshanisha na sir Godi.

src: 19.Then Jesus answered and said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself, but what He sees the Father do; for whatever He does, the Son also does in like manner.
tgt: Kisha JC aliwajibu nakuwashow, "For real kabisa nawashow hivi kuwa assure, mtoi son hawezi do anything pekee yake, lakini anado vile amecheki mbuyuz wake aki do; ju chochote mbuyu wake hufanya, mtoi son pia anaifanya ivo ivo vile mbuyu amefanya.

src: 20."For the Father loves the Son, and shows Him all things that He Himself does; and He will show Him greater works than these, that you may marvel.
tgt: "Jumbuyuz ana love mtoi wake son, na anamshow kila kitu chenye ye ana fanya; na pia atamshow vitubwaku kuliko hapo vile amemshow, hadi mshangae.

src: 21."For as the Father raises the dead and gives life to them, even so the Son gives life to whom He will.
tgt: "Ju vile tu fadhe hurausha wasee wenye wamededi hadi akawagei uhai, ivo tu hata mtoi Chali hupeana uhai kwa yule amependa.

src: 22."For the Father judges no one, but has committed all judgment to the Son,
tgt: "Ju fadhe ha judge mse, lakini amewachia iyo kazi yote ya ku judge wasee to the son,

src: 23."that all should honor the Son just as they honor the Father. He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
tgt: "njo kila mse apeane respect andhonor kwa mtoi son vile tu wanarespect na ku honor the father.

src: 24."Most assuredly, I say to you, he who hears My word and believes in Him who sent Me has everlasting life, and shall not come into judgment, but has passed from death into life.
tgt: "For real nawahakikishia nikiwashow ivi, yeyemwenye anaskiza word yangu na kuamini in mwenye alinituma amepokea eternal life, na hataingia into judgement, lakini asha vuka from kifo into life.

src: 25."Most assuredly, I say to you, the hour is coming, and now is, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God; and those who hear will live.
tgt: "For real nawahakikishia nikiwashow ivi, ithaa inakam, na hata njo hii, nyakati wale wamedie wataskia sauti ya mtoi chali wa sir Godi; na wale wataiskia wataishi.

src: 26."For as the Father has life in Himself, so He has granted the Son to have life in Himself,
tgt: "Ju vile tu fathe ako na life ndani yake, pia amekubali hatamtoi wake son akuwe na life ndani yake,

src: 27."and has given Him authority to execute judgment also, because He is the Son of Man.
tgt: "Na amegeiana mamlaka kwa son yake yakutoa judgement pia, ju yeye ni mtoi wa adam.

src: 28. "Do not marvel at this; for the hour is coming in which all who are in the graves will hear His voice
tgt: Msi shangae Ju ya hizi vitu; ju saa inakam ambapo kila mse mwenyeamelala kea kaburi ataskia sauti yake

src: 29. "and come forth--those who have done good, to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of condemnation.
tgt: "Na kutokezea--walewamedo vitu poa, waingie into the resurrection ya life, na wale wamedo vituwicked, kwa ile resurrection ya kuhukumika.

src: 30."I can of Myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is righteous, because I do not seek My own will but the will of the Father who sent Me.
tgt: "Mi kwapekee yangu siwezi do anything. Vile nimeskia, na judge; na judgement yangu ni righteous, ju sijitafutii mya own way lakini nasajka ile will ya sir Godi fathe mwenye alinituma.

src: 31."If I bear witness of Myself, My witness is not true.
tgt: "Nikipeana ushahidi wa myself, ushahidi wangu sio kweli.

src: 32."There is another who bears witness of Me, and I know that the witness which He witnesses of Me is true.
tgt: kuna mwingine anatoa ushahidi ju yangu, na najua kuwa ile ushahidi yake juu yangu ni true.

src: 33."You have sent to John, and he has borne witness to the truth.
tgt: "Mlitumana kwa Johnie,na akashuhudia to the truth.

src: 34."Yet I do not receive testimony from man, but I say these things that you may be saved.
tgt: "Lakini sikubali ushahidi from mse, lakini nasema izi vitu njomkuwe saved.

src: 35."He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.
tgt: "Alikuwaga ile mwangaza inachoma na kuwaka, na nyi mlijitolea for some time kujazika kwa iyo light yake.

src: 36."But I have a greater witness than John's; for the works which the Father has given Me to finish--the very works that I do--bear witness of Me, that the Father has sent Me.
tgt: "Lakini nikona ushahidi greater than ya Johnie; ju works zangu zile mbuyuz amenipea kumalizia -- izo izo works zenye na do -- zinanitolea ushahidi, that mbuyuz amenituma.

src: 37."And the Father Himself, who sent Me, has testified of Me. You have neither heard His voice at any time, nor seen His form.
tgt: "Na mbuyuz mwenyewe, mwenye alinituma, asha toa testimony ya mimi. Hamja skia voice yake time yoyote wala hamjacheki form yake.

src: 38 "But you do not have His word abiding in you, because whom He sent, Him you do not believe.
tgt: "Lakini hamna word yake yenye imepolea ndani yenu,ju mwenye alituma, yeye hamja mwamini.

src: 39."You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; and these are they which testify of Me.
tgt: "Mnasaka sripture, ju mnadhani ndani yake kuna eternal life; na hizi njo zile zinashuhudia ju yangu.

src: 40."But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.
tgt: "Lakini hamko willing kukam kwangu njo mpate uzima wa milele.

src: 41."I do not receive honor from men.
tgt: "Sipokeagi ma respect za wasee.

src: 42. "But I know you, that you do not have the love of God in you.
tgt: Lakini nawajua, that hamna love ya sir Godi ndani yenu.

src: 43."I have come in My Father's name, and you do not receive Me; if another comes in his own name, him you will receive.
tgt: "Nimekam na jina ya Mbuyu wangu,na hamja nipokea; ka mwingine ata show up na CV yake, yeye mtampokea.

src: 44."How can you believe, who receive honor from one another, and do not seek the honor that comes from the only God?
tgt: "Mnaezaje believe, wenye mnapokea respect zenyu wenyewe,na hamtafuti respect ile inatoka kwa sir Godi?

src: 45."Do not think that I shall accuse you to the Father; there is one who accuses you--Moses, in whom you trust.
tgt: "Usidhani that nina washtaki kwa mbuyu wangu; kuna mse anawashtaki--Mose, in whom mmeamini.

src: 46."For if you believed Moses, you would believe Me; for he wrote about Me.
tgt: "Ju ka mmeamini Mose,mngeniamini; ju aliandika kunihusu.

src: 47."But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"
tgt: "Lakini ka hamuamini writings zake, mta aminije ma words zangu?"

src: Johnie chapta nne-John 4 1.The Pharisees heard that Jesus was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John,
tgt: Wale mafarisayo wakaskia ati JC alikuwa akiget wasee more ka disciples na kuwa baptize hata kushinda Johnie,

src: 2.although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.
tgt: although haikuwa ivo, ju infacthaikuwa JC alikuwa ana baptize, ilikuwa disciples wake.

src: 3.When the Lord learned of this, he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.
tgt: Vile bwana mdosi alijifunza of this, akakitoa from Judea na kwenda back mara ingine hadi Galilee.

src: 4.Now he had to go through Samaria.
tgt: Lakini sasa ilibidi amepasulia baro through Samaria.

src: 5.So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
tgt: Kwa hivo aka kam kwa tao ndani ya samaria iliitagwa Sychar, karibu na ile plot ya grao Jacob aligeiana kwa son wake Josee.

src: 6.Jacob's well was there,and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
tgt: Ile kisima ya Jacob ilikuwa hapo, na JC, Ju alikuwa ameisha ju ya ile safari, akapoa down pale kwa well.Ilikuwa ka saa sita.

src: 7.When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, "Will you give me a drink?"
tgt: Sa vile matha msamaritan alishow upo kuteka maji, JC akamwuliza, "Je, utanigei a drink?"

src: 8.(His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
tgt: (Disciples wake walikuwa wameishia hadi tao ku buy dishi.)

src: 9.The Samaritan woman said to him, "You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?" (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
tgt: Yule mdem msamaritanakamshow niaje,"Wewe ni myahudi na mi ni manzi msamaria. Unaezaje niuliza a drink?" (Ju wayahudi hawa mixigi ama kupatana na samaritans kabisa.)

src: 10.Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water."
tgt: Jesus akamjibu dem, "Ka ungejua gift ya sir Godi na ni nani mwenye anakuuliza for a drink, ungesha muask na angekugei maji living."

src: 11."Sir," the woman said, "you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?
tgt: Huyo madam akadai, "Boss,hauna any ya kuchotea nayo na pia kisima ni deep. Wapi basi utaget hii maji living?

src: 12.Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his flocks and herds?"
tgt: Kwani wewe ni mdosi kushinda mbuyu wetu Jacob,mwenyealitugei hii well na pia aka drink kutoka kwake ye mwentewe, kama tu pia sons wake na groups za mifugo wake?"

src: 13.Jesus answered, "Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,
tgt: JC akajibu aje,"Kila mse mwenye ana drink hiimaji atakuwa thirsty tena,

src: 14.but whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life."
tgt: lakini mwenye anadrink ile maji nitamgei hatawahi kuwana thirst. Kwa kweli, ile wode nitamgei itakuwa ndani yake ka spring ya maji ikiover flow to maisha ya fore."

src: 15.The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water so that I won't get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water."
tgt: Yule matha akamshow,"Boss, nigei hii maji basi njo sitaget kiu yenye inaniforce kuwa nikirudi rudi hapa kuchota maji."

src: 16.He told her, "Go, call your husband and come back."
tgt: JC akamshow, "Ishia,ita hazi yako na alafu urudi."

src: 17. "I have no husband," she replied.Jesus said to her, "You are right when you say you have no husband.
tgt: Akamshow, "Sina hazi."JC akamshow, "Uko right vile umesema hauna hazi.

src: 18.The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true."
tgt: Fact ni, umekuwa na hazi watano, na yule jamaa mwenye ukona yeye saa hii si hazi yako. Chenye umebonga ni kweli kabisa."

src: 19."Sir," the woman said, "I can see that you are a prophet.
tgt: Yule madam akasema,"Boss, nacheki thatwewe ni prophet.

src: 20.Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem."
tgt: Mafadhe wetu wali worship kwa hii mlima,lakini nyi jews mnadai that ile place wasee lazima tu abudu sir Godi ni Jerusa."

src: 21.Jesus declared, "Believe me, woman, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
tgt: JC akadai, "Niamini, madam, time inakam when hamta worship the Mbuyu wa heaven kwa hii mlima ama Jerusa."

src: 22.You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
tgt: Nyi samaritans mna worship chenye hamjui; si tuna worship chenye tunajua, ju salvation ni ya from wayahudi.

src: 23.Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.
tgt: Lakini time inakam na sasa isha kam that wale wasee wana worship cha cha ukwela watamworship kwa spirit na truth, ju hao njo wale worshipers mbuyu anatafuta.

src: 24.God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in spirit and in truth."
tgt: God ni spirit, na wale worshipers wake lazima wamworship in spiritna in truth."

src: 25.The woman said, "I know that Messiah" (called Christ) "is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us."
tgt: Yule madam akasema, "Najua Messiah (yule kristo) anakam. Navile akikam ivi ata explain kila kitu to us."

src: 26.Then Jesus declared, "I who speak to you am he."
tgt: Kisha JC akadeclare, "Mimwenye nakubongesha njo yeye."

src: 27.Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, "What do you want?" or "Why are you talking with her?"
tgt: Mara ile ile disciples wake wakarejeana kushangaa ati JC anabongesha madam. Lakini hakuna mse aliuliza, "Unataka what?" ama "Mbona unabonga na huyo madam?"

src: 28.Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,
tgt: Kisha, akiacha mtungi yake ya maji, yule matha akarudi hadi tao na kushow wasee,

src: 29."Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?"
tgt: "Kamuni mcheki jamaa mwenye amenishow kila kitu nimewahi do. Kwani je, huyuanaweza kuwa njo kristo?"

src: 30.They came out of the town and made their way toward him.
tgt: So wakakam out toka tao na kusaka njia hadi wakafika kwake.

src: 31.Meanwhile his disciples urged him, "Rabbi, eat something."
tgt: Katika ile hali disciples wake wakampressure, "Rabbi, ebu dishi something at least."

src: 32.But he said to them, "I have food to eat that you know nothing about."
tgt: Lakiniakawaashow, "Niko na demo ya kumanga yenye hata nyinyi hamjui any kuihusu."

src: 33.Then his disciples said to each other, "Could someone have brought him food?"
tgt: Kisha disciples wake wakasemezana,"Mse anaweza kuwa alimletea dishi?"

src: 34."My food," said Jesus, "is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.
tgt: "Dishi yangu,"JC akasema, "ni ku do mapenzi ya yule alinisend na kumaliza janta yake.

src: 35.Do you not say, 'Four months more and then the harvest'? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.
tgt: Sinyi husay, 'Months zzingine nne zaidi na alafu harvest iive'? Baas! Nawashow, fungueni eyes zenu na mcheki mashake!Ziko tayari kuvunwa.

src: 36.Even now the reaper draws his wages, even now he harvests the crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.
tgt: Hata sasa mse wa kuvuna anapokea salo yake, hata sasa ana harvest ile crop ya maisha ya milele,njo yule mwenye ameplant na mwenye amevuna wajazike pamoja.

src: 37.Thus the saying 'One sows and another reaps' is true.
tgt: Njo sasa ile msemo 'Mmoja anaplant na mwengine anavuna' ni ukweli.

src: 38.I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor."
tgt: Niliwatuma kuvuna chenye hamku sweatia kwa wira. Wengine wali do janta ile hard, na nyinyi mna vuna faida ya bidii yao."

src: 39.Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the woman's testimony, "He told me everything I ever did."
tgt: Wengiwa wale samaritams toka hiyotao wakaamini in him ju ya ile ushahidi ya madam, "Alinishow kila kitu nimewahi fanya."

src: 40.So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.
tgt: Kwa hivo wale wasamaria wakamkamia, wakambembe apolee nao zaidi,na akatulia nao siku mbili.

src: 41.And because of his words many more became believers. 42.They said to the woman, "We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world."
tgt: Wakashow yule matha, "Hatuanini tu ati ju ya chenye ulitushow pekee; sa tushajiskizia wenyewe, na tumemesea that huyu chali for real njo savior wa world yote."

src: 43.After the two days he left for Galilee.
tgt: Na baada ya zile siku mbe JC akakitoa kuishia Galilee.

src: 44.(Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)
tgt: (Sa JC mwenyewe njo alishow wadhi ile point ati prophet hanaga respect kwa nchi yake

src: 45.When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, for they also had been there.
tgt: Vile alifika Galilee, wale Galileans walimkaribisha. Walikuwa wamecheki kila kitu chenye alikuwa ame do pale Jersua kwa paree ya passover, jupia wao walikuwaga hapo.

src: 46.Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
tgt: Mara ingine akavisit Cana ya Galilee, place alikuwa amebadilisha maji ikakuwa kamnyweso. Na hapokulikuwa na jamaa fulani msonkwo, official alidowia royalty jobo mwenye mtoi wake alikuwa msick Capernaum.

src: 47.When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.
tgt: Vile huyu man aliskia ati JC ameshawasili in Galilee toka Judea, akaishia out kwake na kumbembe akam aponye son wake, mwenye alikuwa this close, ku kick.

src: 48."Unless you people see miraculous signs and wonders," Jesus told him, "you will never believe."
tgt: JC akamshow, "Yaani unless mcheki ishara moja miraculous na ma wonders, hamtawai kuja believe."

src: 49.The royal official said, "Sir, come down before my child dies."
tgt: Yule official wa mfalme akanego, "Boss, tufike down kabla mtoi wa mine haja dedi."

src: 50.Jesus replied, "You may go. Your son will live." The man took Jesus at his word and departed.
tgt: JC akajibu, "Unaweza ishia. Mtoi son yako ataishi." Jamaa akachukua JC at his word na kuishia.

src: 51.While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.
tgt: Vile walikuwa bado far kwa baro akiishia, ma mboch wake wakakutana na yeye wakimletea the news kuwa boy wake alikuwa alive.

src: 52.When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, "The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour."
tgt: Nyakati aliulizia ilikuwa time gani when mtoi wake chali aliget better, wakamshow, "Fever ilimsare jana ka saa saba."

src: 53.Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, "Your son will live." So he and all his household believed.
tgt: Hapo mbuyu akashikanisha that ilikuwa njo theexact moment ambayo JC alikuwa amemshow,"Mtoi wako ataishi." So yeye na hao yao nzima wakaamini.

src: 54.This was the second miraculous sign that Jesus performed, having come from Judea to Galilee.
tgt: Hii njo ilikuwa miracle yasecond yenye JC aliperform, wakati alikuwa ametoka Judea hadi Galilee.

src: Johnie tatu- John 3 1.Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a member of the Jewish ruling council.
tgt: Sa kulikuwa na jamaa mmoja wa wale ma pharisees aliitwa Nicodemus, msee memba wa ile kanjo ilikuwa ina tawala jews.

src: 2.He came to Jesus at night and said, "Rabbi, we know you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the miraculous signs you are doing if God were not with him."
tgt: Akakamia JC usiku na kusema, "Rabbi, tunajua we ni odijo mwenye amekam from sir Godi.Ju hakuna mse anaweza ku do izo miracles zenye una do ka sir Godi si partner wake kwa iyo janta."

src: 3.In reply Jesus declared, "I tell you the truth, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again."
tgt: Kwa kureply JC akadeclare, "Nakushow ile ukweli, hakuna mse anaweza kucheki kingdom ya sir Godi unless ako born again."

src: 4."How can a man be born when he is old?" Nicodemus asked. "Surely he cannot enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!"
tgt: Nico akaulizia, "Aaih! Itakuwaje mse azaliwe tena ile time asha kuwa mu old? For sure hawezi kuingia mara ya mbe ndani ya tumbo ya mathaake njo azaliwe!"

src: 5.Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
tgt: JC akamshow, "Nakushow ukweli, hakuna mse anaweza kuingia kingdom ya sir Godi unless

src: 6.Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.
tgt: Nyama hu give birth to nyama, lakini spirit inazaa spirit.

src: 7.You should not be surprised at my saying, 'You must be born again.'
tgt: Hautakiwi kushangazwa na what ninasema, "Lazima uzaliwe again.'

src: 8.The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit."
tgt: Ju upepo hu blow popote imetamani. Utaskia sauti yake, but hauwezi tell place imetokezea ama ile place inaishia. Ivo pia njo huwa na kila mse amezaliwa na the Spirit.

src: 9."How can this be?" Nicodemus asked.
tgt: Nicodemus akaulizia, "Itakuwaje hivi?"

src: 10."You are Israel's teacher," said Jesus, "and do you not understand these things?
tgt: JC akasema,"Haiya, wewe njo modee wa Israel,na haunyiti hizi vitu?

src: 11.I tell you the truth, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.
tgt: Nakushow cha ukwela, tunabonga ju ya chenye tuna know, na kutoa ushahidi ju ya zile vitu tumecheki,lakini bado nyi wasee hamkubali testimony yetu.

src: 12.I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?
tgt: Nimekubongesha ju ya vitu zaearth pekee na haujaamini; utaamini vipi sasa nikibonga ju ya vitu za heaven?

src: 13.No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.
tgt: Hakuna mse asha wahi ingia heaven except mwenye alichomoka toka heaven- mtoi chali wa Adam.

src: 14.Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the desert, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
tgt: Vile tu Mosee aliinua nyoka uko kwa jangwa, ivo njo yule son wa man lazima akuwe lifted up,

src: 15.that everyone who believes in him may have eternal life.
tgt: njo kila mse mwenye ameamini in him ataget eternal life.

src: 16."For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son,that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
tgt: "Ju sir Godi ali penda theworld vimeja tu sana hadiakageiana his opne and only mtoi son, that mse whoever ataamini in him asiperish lakini aget eternal life.

src: 17.For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.
tgt: Ju sir Godi hakutuma mtoi wake son ndani ya world ku-curse world ju ya dhambi,lakini kuokoa world kupitia yeye.

src: 18.Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because he has not believed in the name of God's one and only Son.
tgt: Mse whoever anaamini in him hawezi laaniwa, lakini mse yeyote mwenye haamini amestand condemned tayari ju hajabelieve ndani ya ile name ya mtoi the one and only wa sir Godi.

src: 19.This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but men loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.
tgt: Hii njo verdict ya hiyo situation:Light imekam ndani ya world, lakini wasee wamependa sana giza badala ya light jumatendo zao zilikuwa wiked.

src: 20.Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
tgt: Kilamse mwenye ana do evil ana hate light, na hatakam ndani ya light ju anaogopa matendo zake zitakuwa exposed.

src: 21.But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what he has done has been done through God."
tgt: Lakini mwenye anaishi by the truth anakam ndani ya light, so that itaonekana wazi wazi that chenye ame do kimefanyika through sir Godi."

src: 22.After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.
tgt: After this,JC na disciples wake wakaishia out hadi zile ocha ocha za Judea mashinani, na huko akaspend masaa nao, na akabaptize.

src: 23.Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were constantly coming to be baptized.
tgt: Sa Johnie pia alikuwa anabaptize place inaitwa Aenon karibu na Salim,ju kulikuwaga na wode moba hapo, na wasee walikuwa wakikam constantly kwake kubaptiziwa.

src: 24.(This was before John was put in prison.)
tgt: (Hii ilikuwa before Johnie awekwe inprison.)

src: 25.An argument developed between some of John's disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.
tgt: Sa argument fulani ikazuka mse wangu, kati ya wale rende ya disciples wa Johnie na myahudi fulani ju ya stori za kunawa in fulfillment ya religion.

src: 26.They came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan—the one you testified about—well, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him."
tgt: Wakakam kwa Johnie na kumshow, "Rabbi, yule jamaa mwenye alikuwa na wewe ile side ingine ya rivee Jordan- yule ulitestify ju yake- poa, sa anabaptize,na kila mse anaishia kwake jo."

src: 27.To this John replied, "A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
tgt: kujibu hii stori Johnie akasema, "Jamaa anaweza tu kupokea what amepewa from heaven.

src: 28.You yourselves can testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ but am sent ahead of him.'
tgt: Nyi wenyewe mnaweza kubali chenye nilisema, "Mi sio thechrist lakini nimetumwa mbele yake.'

src: 29.The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroom's voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
tgt: Bi harusi ana belong kwa bwana harusi. Yule beshte mwenye anashughulikia bwana harusi anategea akingoja kumskia, na ye hujazika vi meja time anaskia ile voice ya bwana harusi. Hiyo kujazika ni saa yangu, na isha kamilika.

src: 30.He must become greater; I must become less.
tgt: Ni lazima akuwe mbwaku;na mimi nikuwe mless.

src: 31."The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.
tgt: "Yule anakam from juu ako juu ya all; yule mwenye anakam from the earth anabelong kwa the earth, na anaspeak ka mse from the earth. Mwenye anatoka heaven ako above wote.

src: 32.He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.
tgt: Ye anatestify chenye amecheki na kuskia, lakini hakuna mse ana accept tesimony yake.

src: 33.The man who has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.
tgt: Yule mse mwenye amesha accept tesimony ameconfirm kuwa sir Godi ni mtruthful.

src: 34.For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
tgt: Ju yule mwenye sir Godi ametuma anaspeak zile words za sir Godi,ju sir Godi anapeana Spirit ya His bila kupimia.

src: 35.The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.
tgt: Fadhe amependa mtoi son wake na ame weka kila kitu ndani ya hands zake.

src: 36.Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God's wrath remains on him."
tgt: Mwenye amebelieve ndani ya son wa God ako na eternal life, lakini yule amereject the son hatacheki life, ju hasiraya sir Godi imebakia juu yake."

src: Johnie Mbe - John 2 1.On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus' mother was there,
tgt: Siku ya tatu ka wedo kali happen ile place inaitwa cana pale Galilee. Matha wa JC alikuwa in attendance pia,

src: 2.and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
tgt: na JC na wale disciples wake walikuwa pia wame invitiwa watokee wedo.

src: 3.When the wine was gone, Jesus' mother said to him, "They have no more wine."
tgt: Vile ile kamnyweso ilivanish, matha wa JC akamshow niaje, "Hawana kamnyweso ingine."

src: 4."Dear woman, why do you involve me?" Jesus replied, "My time has not yet come."
tgt: JC akamshow,"Mama mpendwa, mbona unanipea shughuli? "Hata matime zangu bado hazijakam."

src: 5.His mother said to the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."
tgt: Mathaake akashow wale mamboch, "Do ini chenye amewashow m-do."

src: 6.Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.
tgt: Karibu pali simamishagwa mitungi sita za mawe, za maji, ile type hutumika kwa kunawia njo mse awe religiously msafi, na kila moja ilihold toka jerry-can mbao hadi thirty.

src: 7.Jesus said to the servants, "Fill the jars with water"; so they filled them to the brim.
tgt: JC akawashow wale wafanya kazi, "Jazeni zile mitungi na wode"; kwa hivo wakazijaza hadi pomoni.

src: 8.Then he told them, "Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet." They did so,
tgt: Kisha akawashow, "Sa choteni kiasi na muipelekee yule MC wa bash." Waka do ivo,

src: 9.and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
tgt: MC akaonja hivi ile wode yenye sa ilikuwa imegeuka kamnyweso.Hakushikanisha ilikuwa imetolewa wea, although wale servants wenye walikuwa wamechota iyo wode walimesea.

src: 10.and said, "Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now."
tgt: akamshow,"mtu wangu,kila jamaa hu unleash ile kamnyweso origi ya pesa kwanza alafu ile kanyweso ya kumi kumi bahada ya ma guests kupewa sana; lakini we umeficha ile kamnyweso imestand hadi saa hii."

src: 11.This, the first of his miraculous signs, Jesus performed in Cana of Galilee. He thus revealed his glory, and his disciples put their faith in him.
tgt: Hii,miracle ya fao in his collection, JC ali perform pale cana ya Galilee. Ivo basi akafichua glory yake, na madisciples wake wakaweka faith yao ndani yake.

src: 12.After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.
tgt: Baada ya hapo akashuka hadi capernaum pamoja na mathaake na ma brazas wake na ma disciples wake. Hapo wakapolea siku kadhaa.

src: 13.When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
tgt: Vile ilikuwa almost maithaa za passover ya jews, JC akaishia juu hadi Jerusa.

src: 14.In the temple courts he found men selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.
tgt: Ndani ya maverandah za temple alipata wasee wana do mali kwa mali, biashara ya ng'ombe, kondoo na ma ndush, na wengine walikuwa wametulia kwa tebo wanado forex exchance na munde.

src: 15.So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple area, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
tgt: Ju ya hiyo stori akaunda nyahunyo ya makamba, akatimua wale wadhii waote walikuwa kwa compounds za temple, pamoja na kondoo na mifugo; akascatter zile coins za wasee wa forex na kupindua tebo zao.

src: 16.To those who sold doves he said, "Get these out of here! How dare you turn my Father's house into a market!"
tgt: Kwa wale wadhii walikinda ndush akasema, "toeni hizi hapa! Mnawezaje ku dare kubadilisha hao ya mbuyuz wangu igeuke soko!

src: 17.His disciples remembered that it is written: "Zeal for your house will consume me."
tgt: Disciples wake wakamesea chenye kiliandikwa: "Psyke ya hao yako itanikwachu, itanimaliza."

src: 18.Then the Jews demanded of him, "What miraculous sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?"
tgt: Kisha wale majews wakadai about him, "Ni ishara gani miraculous unaweza kutuonyesha kuprove say yako ya ku do hizi vitu zote?"

src: 19.Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days."
tgt: JC akamshow niaje, "Kudestroy hii temple alafu kuiinua tena ndani ya siku tatu."

src: 20.The Jews replied, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?"
tgt: Wale Jews wakamshow, "Ime take miaka fortysix kujenga hii temple, na unadai utaiinua na siku tatu?"

src: 21.But the temple he had spoken of was his body.
tgt: Lakini ile temple aliogelea ilikuwa ya mwili wake.

src: 22.After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the Scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.
tgt: Baada yake kuraushwa from the dead, wale disciples wake wakakumbuka chenye alikuwaamedai. Kisha wakaamini ma scripture na zile words zenye JC alikuwa amebonga.

src: 23.Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the miraculous signs he was doing and believed in his name.
tgt: Katika ile hali vile alikuwa Jerusa kwa ile Passover bash, wasee wengi walicheki zile signs miraculous alikuwa aki do na wakaamini in his name.

src: 24.But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all men.
tgt: Lakini JC hangeji entrust himself kwao, ju alikjua wasee wote.

src: 25.He did not need man's testimony about man, for he knew what was in a man.
tgt: Hakuhitaji a man's testimony kumhusu man, ju alijua ile kitu ilikuwa ndani ya man.

src: Johnie Wahed -John 1 1.In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
tgt: Vile kulianzaga kulikuwa na word, na iyo word ilikuwa na sir Godi, na iyo word ilikuwa sir Godi.

src: 2.He was with God in the beginning.
tgt: Alikuwaga na sir Godi from tenee kwa ile beginning.

src: 3.Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.
tgt: Kumpitia yeye kila something iliundwa; bila yeye hakuna anything yenye iliundwa yenye ingeundwa.

src: 4.In him was life, and that life was the light of men.
tgt: Ndani ya him kulipolea life, na iyo life njo sasa ilikuwa taa ya wasee.

src: 5.The light shines in the darkness, but the darkness has not understood it.
tgt: Light yenyewe hung'ara in the darkness, lakini darkness haija imesea.

src: 6.There came a man who was sent from God; his name was John.
tgt: Kulikuja mse mmoja mwenye alikuwa sent toka kwa sir Godi; jina yake Johnie.

src: 7.He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all men might believe.
tgt: Alikam ka witness kutestify ju ya hiyo taa, njo sasa kupitia kwake wasee wote wangebelieve.

src: 8.He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.
tgt: Ye mwenyewe hakuwa iyo light; alikam tu kama a witness kwa hiyo light.

src: 9.The true light that gives light to every man was coming into the world.
tgt: Light ile for real, ile true yenye hupeana taa kwa kila mse ilikuwa ikikam ndani ya world.

src: 10.He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.
tgt: Alikuwa ndani ya world, na hata ka the world iliundwa kupitia yeye, world haikumrecognize.

src: 11.He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
tgt: Alikam kwa kile chenye kilikuwa chake, lakini chake hakikumrecognize.

src: 12.Yet to all who received him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—
tgt: Lakini bado wote wenye walimreceive, kwa wasee wenye waliamini in his name, aliwagei the right ya kuwa watoi wa sir Godi-

src: 13.children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.
tgt: Watoi sio wenye walizaliwa kupitia natural line age, pia sio ju ya decision human ali-make ama ju ya mapenzi ya hazi, lakini waliozaliwa na sir Godi.

src: 14.The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the One and Only, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.
tgt: Word ika-became flesh, ikamake makao yake kati yetu. Tumecheki glory yake, glory yathe one and only, mwenye alikam from yule mbuyuz, akiwa amejazwa fully grace na uweli.

src: 15.John testifies concerning him. He cries out, saying, "This was he of whom I said, 'He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.' "
tgt: Johnie ni shahidi wake ju yake. Anacry out akidai, "Huyu njo yeye mwenye nilisema juu yake, 'Mwenye alikam baada yamimi ameshaa nipita ju yeye alikuwa mbele yangu.' "

src: 16.From the fullness of his grace we have all received one blessing after another.
tgt: Kutoka kwa fullness ya grace yake sote tumepokea blessing moja baada ya nyingine.

src: 17.For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
tgt: Ju sheria ilipeanwa through Mosee; neema na ukweli zikakam kumpitia Jesus Christ.

src: 18.No one has ever seen God, but God the One and Only,who is at the Father's side, has made him known.
tgt: Ju hakuna msee amewahi cheki sir Godi, lakini sir Godi the one and only, mwenye ako kwa side ya mbuyuz, ashamfanya ajulikane.

src: 19.Now this was John's testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.
tgt: Saa hii njo ile ushahidi ya Johnie vile wale jews wa Jerusa walituma ma priests na ma livites kumwuliza maswali ju yake,ati ye ni nani.

src: 20.He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Christ."
tgt: Hakufail ku-confess, lakini alisema wazi wazi, "Mi sio the christ."

src: 21.They asked him, "Then who are you? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."
tgt: Wakamwuliza, "Basi we ni nani? We ni Elijah?" Akawashow, "Mi sio yeye." Wewe ni ka prophet ivi?" Akawajibu, "Zi."

src: 22.Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"
tgt: Mwishoni wakasema, "Wewe ni who? Ebu tugei jibu tupelekee wale wasee walitusend huku. Nini unaweza say ju yako mwenyewe?"

src: 23.John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, "I am the voice of one calling in the desert, 'Make straight the way for the Lord.' "
tgt: Johnie akawajibu in the words za Izzo the prophet,"Mi ni ile voice yamse fulani anawika kwa jungle, 'Undeni straight iyo barokwa ajili ya sir Godi. ' "

src: 24.Now some Pharisees who had been sent
tgt: Sa mafarisayo wengine wenyewalikuwa wametumwa

src: 25.questioned him, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
tgt: wakamdunga examination, "Kwa nini basi una baptize wasee ka wewe si the Christ, wala si Elijah, wala si the prophet?"

src: 26."I baptize with water," John replied, "but among you stands one you do not know.
tgt: Johnie akawajibu, "Na baptize na wode,lakini kati yenu amestand mse mmoja nyinyi wenyewe hamummesei.

src: 27.He is the one who comes after me, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie."
tgt: Ye njo the one mwenye ana kam after mimi, hata straps za sandale zake siko worth hata kuzifungua."

src: 28.This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
tgt: Hii yote ilihappen pale Bethany ile side ingine ya Jordan,place Johnie alikuwa akibaptize.

src: 29.The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, "Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
tgt: Siku next Johnie alicheki Jesus akikam kwa place alikuwa akasema, "Cheki, lamb of God, mwenye anatake away sin ya ulimwengu!

src: 30.This is the one I meant when I said, 'A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.'
tgt: Huyu njo the one nilimaanisha nikisema, 'Mse mwenye amekam baada yangu amesha nipita ju alikuwa mbele yangu.'

src: 31.I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel."
tgt: Mi mwenyewe sikumjua, lakini ile reason nilikam nikibaptize na wode noi so that aoneshwe wazi kwa Israel."

src: 32.Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.
tgt: Kisha Johnie akapeana hii ushahidi:"Nilicheki Spirit ikishuka down toka heaven ka dove na kubaki juu yake.

src: 33.I would not have known him, except that the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, 'The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.'
tgt: Singemjua ni yeye, except yule mwenye alinisend ku baptize na maji alinishow niaje, 'Yule jamaa on whom unacheki the Spirit ikikam down na kutulia kwake ni yeye mwenye atabaptize na the holy spirit.'

src: 34.I have seen and I testify that this is the Son of God."
tgt: Nimesha cheki na nina ushahidi that huyu njo the son wa sir Godi."

src: 35.The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
tgt: Day next Johnie alikuwa hapo tena pamoja na wafuasi wawili wake.

src: 36.When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Lamb of God!"
tgt: Vile alicheki JC aki pita by, akasema, "Cheki, lamb wa Sir Godi!"

src: 37.When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
tgt: Vile wale disciples limbiwaliskia akisema hivo, wakamfuata Jesus.

src: 38.Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, "What do you want?" They said, "Rabbi" (which means Teacher), "where are you staying?"
tgt: Akipinduka nyuma, JC akawacheki wakimfuata na kuwauliza, "Ni nini mnataka?" Wakamshow, "Rabbi( inamaanisha teacher), "unapolea wapi?"

src: 39."Come," he replied, "and you will see." So they went and saw where he was staying, and spent that day with him. It was about the tenth hour.
tgt: Akawa reply-ia, "Kamuni na mtacheki." Kwa hivo wakaishia na kucheki ile place alikuwa anapolea, na wakaspend iyo siku na yeye. Na ilikuwa about the tenth hour.

src: 40.Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.
tgt: Andrew, bro wa Simon Peter, alikuwa mmoja wa wale wasee waliskia chenye Johnie alidai na wenye walikuwa wamefuata JC.

src: 41.The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, "We have found the Messiah" (that is, the Christ).
tgt: Kitu ya fao Andrew ali-do ni kusaka bro wake Simo na kumshow, "Tumesha get messiah ninani' (yaani, the christ).

src: 42.And he brought him to Jesus.Jesus looked at him and said, "You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas" (which, when translated, is Peter).
tgt: Na akamleta hadi kwa JC.JC akamcheki ivi na kumshow, "We njo Simo mtoi chali wa Johnie. Utaitagwa Cephas" (yenye uki translate ni Pitaa).

src: 43.The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, "Follow me."
tgt: Day next JC aka decide kutoka aishie Galilee. Akimpata Philo, akamshow niaje, "Fuata mimi."

src: 44.Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.
tgt: Philo pia tu ka Andrew na Pitaa, alikuwa toka tao ya bethsaida.

src: 45.Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."
tgt: Philo akampata Nathanael na kumshow, "tumeshaget yule Mose aliandika kumhusu kwa the law, na mwenye about ma higherman pia walichora kumhusu -JC wa Nazareth, mtoi chali wa Josee."

src: 46"Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?" Nathanael asked."Come and see," said Philip.
tgt: Nathanael akadai,"Ati Nazareth! Kwani kitu gani freshi inaweza tokea from huko ivo?" Philo akamshow, "Kam na ucheki."

src: 47.When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is nothing false."
tgt: Vile JC alicheki Nathanael akimkamia, akabonga juu yake akisema, "Njo huyu Israelite wa cha ukwela, na ndani yake hakuna kitu cha uongo."

src: 48."How do you know me?" Nathanael asked.Jesus answered, "I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you."
tgt: Nathanael akamwuliza, "Niaje unanimesea?" JC akamshow, "Nilikucheki vile ulikuwa still pale chini ya mti wa mkuyu kabla hata Philo hajakushtua."

src: 49.Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the King of Israel."
tgt: Kisha Nathanael akasema, "Rabbi, wewe ni mtoi chali wasir Godi; we njo king wa Israel."

src: 50.Jesus said, "You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You shall see greater things than that."
tgt: JC akamshow, "Unabelieve ju nilikushow nimekucheki chini ya mkuyu. Utacheki vitu bwaku, ajabb kushinda izo."

src: 51.He then added, "I tell you the truth, you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."
tgt: Akamshow akiongezea, "Nakushow reality, ukweli, utacheki heaven ikifunguka, na ma angels wa sir Godi wakipanda na kushuka kwa mtoi chali wa sir Godi."

src: Luka flow ya twenty four- Luke 24 1.On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women took the spices they had prepared and went to the tomb.
tgt: Kwa ile day ya fao ya week, ngware kabisa morning, mamatha wakakwachu zile spices walikuwa wamesuka suka na wakaishiakwa grave.

src: 2.They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
tgt: Wakaget haiya!, stone ya entrance ilikuwa imesukumwa kando na grave ikawa wazi.

src: 3.but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
tgt: lakini vile walidonjo tomb hawakuget body ya the lord Jesus.

src: 4.While they were wondering about this, suddenly two men in clothes that gleamed like lightning stood beside them.
tgt: Sa vile walikuwa waki genya ju ya hii stori, vi sudden, mara pap! wasee limbi wakiwa wamedunga cladi ingine ina mng'aro ka lighting wakasimama kando yao.

src: 5.In their fright the women bowed down with their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, "Why do you look for the living among the dead?
tgt: Wakiwa wamegwaya wale mamatha waka bow chini na uso zao kwa grao, lakini wale wadhii wakawashow, "Mbona tena mnasaka wale wana live place ya wale wamesha kick?

src: 6.He is not here; he has risen! Remember how he told you, while he was still with you in Galilee:
tgt: Ye hayuko hasapa; alisha rise! Kumbuka tu vile aliwashow, time alikuwa angali na nyinyi huko Galilee:

src: 7.'The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified and on the third day be raised again.' "
tgt: 'Mtoi chali wa adam lazima tu apeanwe into mikono ya majamaa wa sinful, akuwe crucified na ile siku ya tatu akuwe raised tena toka grave.' "

src: 8.Then they remembered his words.
tgt: Kisha hapo na hapo wakakumbuka ma words zake.

src: 9.When they came back from the tomb, they told all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
tgt: Vile walirudi from ile grave, walishow vitu hizi zote kwa wale eleven wengine wote.

src: 10.It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the others with them who told this to the apostles.
tgt: Ilikuwaga ni Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary matha wa Jaymo, na wengine wenye walikuwa waki hang out nao njo wenye walitoa hiyo ripoti kwa ma apostles.

src: 11.But they did not believe the women, because their words seemed to them like nonsense.
tgt: Lakini hawakubelieve wale mamatha, ju ma words zao zilikaa kama upuuzi tu.

src: 12.Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.
tgt: Pitaa, lakini akainuka na kuhepa mbio hadi kwa grave. Akainama ndani akacheki vitambaa za linen zimeachwa hapo kando pekee, na akakitoa away, akijiulizaga kwani ni what ilikuwa imehappen.

src: 13.Now that same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
tgt: Sasa iyo iyo siku, mtu mbili, ma memba wa wale wafuasi, walikuwa wakiishia hadi ka ghetto fulani kaliitagwa Emmaus, distance ka tuseme maili saba from Jerusa.

src: 14.They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.
tgt: Sa walikuwa wakishika gumzo pamoja ju ya zile drama zote zilikuwa zimehappen.

src: 15.As they talked and discussed these things with each other, Jesus himself came up and walked along with them;
tgt: Wakibonga na ku analyse hizi vitu pamoja, JC mwenyewe akatokezea na kuanza kupita route 11 nao.

src: 16.but they were kept from recognizing him.
tgt: lakini wakakosa kummesea ni JC ju walizuiwa.
