src: 17.He asked them, "What are you discussing together as you walk along?"They stood still, their faces downcast.
tgt: Akawauliza, "Ni what mnaanalyze hivo na double mkiwalk hapa kwa baro?" Wakasimama kwanza, wakiwa wamejaa na sadness wakacheki down.

src: 18.One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, "Are you only a visitor to Jerusalem and do not know the things that have happened there in these days?"
tgt: Mmoja wao alikuwa anameseka ka Cleopas akamwuliza, "unataka kutushow we tu ni mgeni hapa Jerusa na haumesei ni vitu gani zimekuwa zikihappen hapa hizi siku tu kadhaa zimepita?"

src: 19."What things?" he asked."About Jesus of Nazareth," they replied. "He was a prophet, powerful in word and deed before God and all the people.
tgt: JC akawauliza, "Vitu gani?" Wakamshow, "Kuhusu Jesus yule mse wa Nazareth. Alikuwa higher man mwingine wa strength, alibonga wordna power na ma actions mbele ya sir Godi na ma ordinaree wote.

src: 20.The chief priests and our rulers handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him;
tgt: Wale priest ma sonkwo tugetha with viongozi walimpeana over ili ahukumiwe death sentence, na kisha wakam crucify;

src: 21.but we had hoped that he was the one who was going to redeem Israel. And what is more, it is the third day since all this took place.
tgt: lakini tulikuwa tumetegea at least yeye njo alitumwa aokolee Israel. Na bado, si unacheki ni the thirdt day since hizi vitu zote zifanyike.

src: 22.In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning
tgt: Kuongezea drama, leo mamatha wetu wengine hapo ivo walitushtua tu. Waliishia hadi kwa ile grave ngware asubuhi ya leo

src: 23.but didn't find his body. They came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels, who said he was alive.
tgt: lakini hawakufind body yake. Wakakam wakatushow ati walikuwa wamecheki vision ya ma

src: 24.Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but him they did not see."
tgt: So hapo hapo maboy wengine wetuwakaishia kucheki kaburi wakaiget iko tu vile wale mamatha walikuwa wamesema,lakini JC mwenyewe hawakumcheki."

src: 25.He said to them, "How foolish you are, and how slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
tgt: JC akawashow live, "Manze munawezaje kuwa wajinga ivo, na manze si mko slow kwa hearts zenu hata tu kuamini kila kitu chenye wale prophets walishabonga!

src: 26.Did not the Christ have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?"
tgt: Kwani si ilibidi Kristo apitie mateso ya hizi drama alafu atfer aingie utukufu yake?"

src: 27.And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he explained to them what was said in all the Scriptures concerning himself.
tgt: Na aki start na Mosee na ma prophets wote, akaexplain kwao chenye kilisemwa kwa mascripture zote kumhusu ye personally.

src: 28.As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus acted as if he were going farther.
tgt: Sa vile walikaribia kufika ile gherro ambapo ilikuwa njo destination, JC akajidai anaendelea mbele kidogo.

src: 29.But they urged him strongly, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over." So he went in to stay with them.
tgt: Lakini wakamshow wakimsweet talks sana, 'Dondokea hapa pia upolee na sisi, ju tayari

src: 30.When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.
tgt: Vile alikuwa amedunga pose nao kwa table, akakwachu dibre, akagive thanks, akaivunja na kuanza kuwagei.

src: 31.Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.
tgt: Hapo macho zao zikafunguka na wakammesea ni nani, naye aka disappear mbele ya macho yao ivo tu.

src: 32.They asked each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?"
tgt: Wakaulizana,"Haiya! si hearts zetu zilikuwa on fire ndani ndani ile time tukiwalk na yeye kwa baro na ye akituchanua na ma verse za scripture?"

src: 33.They got up and returned at once to Jerusalem. There they found the Eleven and those with them, assembled together
tgt: Wakaamka haraka upesi na kurejea hadi Jerusa mara one. Hapo wakaget wale wasee eleven na mafans,wamekusanyika tugetha

src: 34.and saying, "It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon."
tgt: na wakabonga wakisema, "By the way ni ukweli! Bwana JC mwenyewe asha rise hadi ametokezea Simo."

src: 35.Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.
tgt: Kisha wale wasee wawili wakawasho ni what ilikuwa imehappen kwa baro,na vile walimtambua JC na vile alivunja ile mkanyo.

src: 36.While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, "Peace be with you."
tgt: Vilewalikuwa bado wanabonga kuhusu hii stori, JC mwenyewe akasimaa kati yao na kuwashow, "Peace iwe pamoja na nyinyi."

src: 37.They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.
tgt: wakashangaa na kugwaya, wakidhani wamecheki ghost.

src: 38.He said to them, "Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds? lakini akawashow, "Mbona mnakaa mna sumbuka, nambonamko na doubt kwa minds zenu?
tgt: lakini akawashow, "Mbona mnakaa mna sumbuka, nambonamko na doubt kwa minds zenu?

src: 39.Look at my hands and my feet. It is I myself! Touch me and see; a ghost does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have."
tgt: Cheki mikono zangu na miguu zangu. Ni mi mwenyewe! Niguse na mcheki muone; ghost haikuwagi na flesh ama bones, ka vile mnacheki niko nazo."

src: 40.When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
tgt: Vile alisema hivo, akawashow mikono na miguu zake.

src: 41.And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"
tgt: Na ju bado hawakuamini coz walikuwa wamejazika na wameshangaa, akadai,"Mko na kitu chochote hapa mse anaweza manga?"

src: 42.They gave him a piece of broiled fish,
tgt: Wakamwai piece ya mkanyo na ka fish boiro,

src: 43.and he took it and ate it in their presence.
tgt: akaichukua akaidema mbele yao.

src: 44.He said to them, "This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms."
tgt: Akawashow,"Hii njo what niliwashow vile nilikuwa badona nyinyi: kila kitu lazima ikuwe fulfilled ka tu venye imeandikwa about mimi kwa ile sheria yaMose, ma prophets na hadi zile psalms."

src: 45.Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.
tgt: Kisha akafungua minds zao njo waweze kuelewa the scriptures.

src: 46.He told them, "This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
tgt: Akawashow, "Hivi njo imeandikwa: yule kristo ata suffer na atarauka from the dead siku ya tatu.

src: 47.and repentance and forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
tgt: naku repent nakusamehewa kwa madhambi itapreachiwa na jina yake kwa countries zote na ma tribes, kuanzia Jerusa.

src: 48.You are witnesses of these things.
tgt: Nyi ni nashahidi wa hizi vitu.

src: 49.I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high."
tgt: Nitawatumania chenye mbuyu wangu alisha promise; lakini tulieni ndani yajiji hadi nyakati mtafunikwa na nguvu toka juu."

src: 50.When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.
tgt: Vile alikuwa amewaongoza nje hadi kando kando ya Bethany, akainua up mikono yao na kuwa bless.

src: 51.While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.
tgt: Vile alikuwa akiwabariki, aliwaacha na akapelekwa juu hadi into heaven.

src: 52.Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.
tgt: Kisha wakam worship na kurudi Jerusa na furaha mob.

src: 53.And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.
tgt: Wakazidi kubakiaga kwa temple kama kawaida wakimshukuru God sana.

src: Luka twenty three - Luke 23 1.Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.
tgt: Kisha wasee wote ordinari kwa assembly wakarauka na kumpeleka off kwa Pilate.

src: 2.And they began to accuse him, saying, "We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Christ, a king."
tgt: Wakaanza kum accuse wakisema, "Tumeget huyu mse akijaribu ku angusha nation yetu.Ye hu oppose kulipa munde ya tax kwa Caesar na anadai ye ni kristo, yaani king."

src: 3.So Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the king of the Jews?" "Yes, it is as you say," Jesus replied.
tgt: So pilate aka ask Jesus, "we njo yule king wa Jews?" JC akajibu,"Eh,ni vile tu umesema.

src: 4.Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."
tgt: Kisha Pilate akatoa announcement kwa wale masonkwo wa mapriests na crowd, "Sijapata reason ya nguvu ya accusations zenu against huyu chali."

src: 5.But they insisted, "He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here."
tgt: Lakini waka insist, "Ye huvuruga wasee kila kwote Judea na teachings zake. Alianza Galilee na amekam all theway hadi hapa."

src: 6.On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.
tgt: Kuskia hivo,Pilate akauliza ka yule jamaa alikuwa Galilean.

src: 7.When he learned that Jesus was under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.
tgt: Vile aliskia ati JC alikuwa under goverment ya Herod, akamsend kwa Herod,mwenye pia alikuwa Jerusa hiyo time.

src: 8.When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform some miracle.
tgt: Vile Herod alicheki Jesus,alijazika meja sana, ju kwa mudamrefu alikuwa akidai kumcheki JC. Zile stori alikuwa ameskia kumhusu zilikuwa noma hadi akawa na hopes JC ata do miracle fulani acheki.

src: 9.He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.
tgt: Akamhanda na maswali mob, lakini JC hakumgei answer hata moja.

src: 10.The chief priests and the teachers of the law were standing there, vehemently accusing him.
tgt: Wale ma chief priest na ma mode wa law walikuwa wamesimama pale,waki m-accuse vimeja.

src: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.
tgt: Kisha Herod na masoja wake wakamkejeli na kumdiss. Wakamvalisha robe ingine smart designer, wakamsend back hadi kwa Pilate.

src: 12.That day Herod and Pilate became friends—before this they had been enemies.
tgt: Hiyo day Herod na Pilate hadi wakakuwa mabeshte - na kabla ya hapo walikuwaga wana hate iana.

src: 13.Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,
tgt: Pilate akaitana wale masonkwo wa mapriest, ma viongozi pamoja na wasee ordinare,

src: 14.and said to them, "You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.
tgt: na akawashow, 'Mliniletea huyu jamaa ka mmoja wa wale wadhii walikuwa wakipsyche wase wa rebel.Nimemchunguza mbele yenu na sijaget reason ya nguvu ya accusations zenu.

src: 15.Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.
tgt: HataHerod bado hajaget, ju alimtuma back kwetu; na vile mnacheki, ye hajado anything ina deserve kifo.

src: 16.Therefore, I will punish him and then release him."
tgt: Ju ya hiyo stori,nitam pano alafu nimwachilie."

src: 18.With one voice they cried out, "Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!"
tgt: Na voice moja united wakashout,"Aishie huyu jamaa! Tu release-ie Barabbas kwetu!"

src: 19.(Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
tgt: (Barabba alikuwa ametupwa in Jail ju ya coup plot moja ndani ya jiji na pia ju ya murder.)

src: 20.Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.
tgt: Ju alitaka kumwachilia JC, Pilate akadunga appeal kwa wale wajamaa tena.

src: 21.But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"
tgt: Lakini wale wasee wakazidi kudai, "Mcrucify! mcrucify!"

src: 22.For the third time he spoke to them: "Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him."
tgt: So akabonga tena mara ya tatu: "Kwa nini? Amecommit crime gani huyumse? Nimemget hana any reason ya kudeserve pano ya death.Kwa hivo nitampano alafu nitamwachilia."

src: 23.But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.
tgt: Lakini kwa sauti loud walikataa waka insistthat JC akuwe crucified, na shout zao zikafaulu.

src: 24.So Pilate decided to grant their demand.
tgt: Kwa ivo pilate aka decide kuwagei demand yao.

src: 25.He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.
tgt: Akarelease yule jamaa mwenye alikuwa ametupwa jela ju ya rebellion na murder,yule walikuwa wamedai, na aka surrender Jesus kwa will yao.

src: 26.As they led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.
tgt: Savile walikuwa wakimpeleka zao, wakamshika Simo toka Cyrene, mwenye alikuwa njiani akiingia from ocha, na wakamforce abebe cross akifuata JC nyuma.

src: 27.A large number of people followed him, including women who mourned and wailed for him.
tgt: Rende bwaku ya wasee ordinare ilimfuata, wakiwa pia mamatha wenye walitoa kilio na kumlilia.

src: 28.Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.
tgt: JC akageuka na kuwashopw niaje,"Madotee wa Jerusa,msilie ju yangu; jililieni wenyewe na for watoi wenu.

src: 29.For the time will come when you will say, 'Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!'
tgt: Ju time inakam yenye mtadai, 'Wako blessed wale mamatha tasa, nazile tumbo hazija zaa ama zile matiti hazijanyonyesha!'

src: 30.Then " 'they will say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, " Cover us!" '
tgt: Kisha " 'Mtauliza milima, "tuangukieni!" na zile ma hills, "tufunikeni!" '

src: 31.For if men do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?"
tgt: Juka wasee wamnado izi vitu ilhali mti ni mbichi, naje ni nini itahappen ikiwa dry.

src: 32.Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed.
tgt: Wasee wengine wawili,wote mathegi, wenye pia walikuwa na yeye walipelekwa pia kumadwa.

src: 33.When they came to the place called the Skull, there they crucified him, along with the criminals—one on his right, the other on his left.
tgt: Vile walikam kwa ile place inaitwa skull, hapo wali crucifyiwa, mmoja kwa his right na mwengine kwa his left.

src: 34.Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
tgt: JC akasema, "mbuyu,waforgive wote, ju hawajui chenye wanado." Na waka divide up nguo zake kwa kutumia patapotea.

src: 35.The people stood watching, and the rulers even sneered at him. They said, "He saved others; let him save himself if he is the Christ of God, the Chosen One."
tgt: Wase walikuwa wamesimama wanacheki, na wale ma viongozi hadi wakamkunjia uso na dharau.

src: 36.The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar
tgt: Wale masoja pia wakasogelea karibu kumkejeli. Wakamwai wine imeekwa vinegar.

src: 37.and said, "If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself."
tgt: Wakasema,"Ka wewe njo the king wa majews, basi jiokoe."

src: 38.There was a written notice above him, which read: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
tgt: Na kulikwa na poster imeekwa juu yake, inadai: HUYU NJO THE KING WA MAJEWS.

src: 39.One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: "Aren't you the Christ? Save yourself and us!"
tgt: Mmoja wa wale mathegi alikuwa amehang pale akamrushia matusi: "Si we njo kristo? Jiokoe mse! Na pia sisi!"

src: 40.But the other criminal rebuked him. "Don't you fear God," he said, "since you are under the same sentence?
tgt: Lakini yule thegi mwingine akamsomea. "Kwani hauogopi sir Godi, ju tuko na pano same?

src: 41.We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong."
tgt: Si tumegeiwapano inatufaa, ju tunaget chenye actions zetu zinafaa. Lakini huyu msee haja do kitu yoyote wrong."

src: 42.Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom."
tgt: kisha akasema,"Jesus, nikumbuke ukiingia kwa ile kingdom yako."

src: 43.Jesus answered him, "I tell you the truth, today you will be with me in paradise."
tgt: JC akamjibu, "For real nakushow uweli, leo utakuwana mimi in paradise."

src: 44.It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour,
tgt: Na ilikuwa saa kama saa sita, na giza ilikuwa imetamba juu ya land yote hadi saa tisa,

src: 45. for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.
tgt: ju hadi jua ilikuwa imeacha kushine. Na ile pazia ya temple ikararuka in two.

src: 46.Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit." When he had said this, he breathed his last.
tgt: JC akaitana na sauti kubwa, "Daddy, kwa hands zako naweka spirityangu." Vile alimada kusema ivo, aka breath yake ya last.

src: 47.The centurion, seeing what had happened, praised God and said, "Surely this was a righteous man."
tgt: Yule mdosi wa masoja soo moja, akacheki chenyekilikuwa kimehappen, akapraise sir Godi na kusema, "for sure huyu mse alikuwa mse mrighteous."

src: 48.When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.
tgt: Vile wase wote wenye walikuwa wamegather pale kucheki izo drama walicheki chenye kilihappen, wakapiga vifua zao wakiishia.

src: 49.But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.
tgt: Lakini wote wenye walimjuaga, hadi pia wale mamatha wenye walikuwa wakimfuata from galilee, walisimama kwambali wakicheki hizi vitu.

src: 50.Now there was a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, a good and upright man,
tgt: Sa kulikuwa na jamaa anaitwa Jose, mmoja wa kanjo, mse upright sana na mpoa,

src: 51.who had not consented to their decision and action. He came from the Judean town of Arimathea and he was waiting for the kingdom of God.
tgt: mwenye hakukubali decision yao na vile wali do. Akakam toka tao moa Judea iliitagwa Arimathea na alikuwa akingojea ile kingdomya Sir Godi.

src: 52.Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus' body.
tgt: Akiishia kwa pilate akamshow ampatie body ya jC.

src: 3.Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in the rock, one in which no one had yet been laid.
tgt: Vile aliishusha down, akaifunika kwa shiti safi ya linenna kuiweka ndani ya kaburiimekatwa ndani ya rock,moja yenye hanaku mse alikuwa ameingizwa ndani.

src: 54.It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.
tgt: ilikuwa siku ya ku prepare, na sabbath njo ilikuwa tu ianze.

src: 55.The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and saw the tomb and how his body was laid in it.
tgt: Wale ma matha wenye walikuwa wamekam na JC toka Galilee walifuata Josee na kucheki kaburi yenye aliweka mwili na vile aliiweka hapo.

src: 56.Then they went home and prepared spices and perfumes. But they rested on the Sabbath in obedience to the commandment.
tgt: kisha wakaishia home nakuandaa ma spices na marashi. Lakini wakatulia ile siku ya sabbath vile tu in obedience kwa ile commandment.

src: Luka Mbao na mbe-Luke 22 1.Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
tgt: Sa bash ya mkate chapo AKA Passover ilikuwa inafika,

src: 2.and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.
tgt: Na priest ma sonkwo na pia ma modee walikuwa wanasaka njia fulani crooked ya kummaliza Jesus, ju walikuwa wameogopa wasee.

src: 3.Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.
tgt: Kisha shaitula akamwingia Judee, pia jina ingine ni Iscariot, mmoja wa wale thenashara.

src: 4.And Judas went to the chief priests and the officers of the temple guard and discussed with them how he might betray Jesus.
tgt: Na Judee akaishia kwa wale ma sonkwo priests na mabwana officer wa watchie wa temple

src: 5.They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
tgt: Waka jazika sana ju ya hiyo proposal, na wakakubali kumkanja munde.

src: 6.He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.
tgt: Akakubali, na akaanza kutafuta upenyo y kumgeiana JC kwao vile rende ya wadhii haikuwa.

src: 7.Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.
tgt: Vile ile siku ya mkate chapo ilikam, ile day ilikuwa lazima passover lamb ikuwe sacrificed.

src: 8.Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover."
tgt: Jesus akasend Pitaa na Johnie akisema, "Ishieni m do matayarisho njo tuweze kudishi passover."

src: 9."Where do you want us to prepare for it?" they asked.
tgt: Wakamwuliza, "Unataka tuifanyie matayarisho wapi?"

src: 10.He replied, "As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,
tgt: Akajibu, "Vile mkiingia jiji, mse amebeba ndoo ya maji atakutana na nyinyi. Mfuate bumper hadi ile keja yenye ataingia,

src: 11.and say to the owner of the house, 'The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'
tgt: kisha mshow mwenye mbanyu, 'Mwalimu anauliza:Wapi ile room ya wageni, place naweza manga passoverna wafuasi wa mine?'

src: 12.He will show you a large upper room, all furnished. Make preparations there."
tgt: Atawashow room bwaku sana yenye iko up stairs, fully furnished. Make-ini preparations hapo."

src: 13.They left and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
tgt: Wakaishia na kuget vitu ziko tu vile JC alikuwa amewashow. Kwa hivyo waka prepare ile passover.

src: 14.When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.
tgt: Vile ithaa ilifika, JC na ma apostles wake wakarelax kwa tebo.

src: 15.And he said to them, "I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
tgt: Akawashow,"Nimetamani na dabo mudishi hi passover nanyinyi kabla sija siffer.

src: 16.For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God."
tgt: Ju nawashow, sitaidishi tena hadi ifikie fulfillment ndani ya kingdom ya sir Godi."

src: 17.After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, "Take this and divide it among you.
tgt: Baada ya kuchukua ile cup, akagive thanks na kusema, "Chukueni hii na muidivide kati yenu.

src: 18.For I tell you I will not drink again of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."
tgt: Ju nawashow sita drink tena juo ya ma grapes hadi ile kingdom ya sir Godi itimie."

src: 19.And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me."
tgt: Akachukua dibre akagive thanks na kuivunja, akawagei akisema,"Hii ni body yangu yenye imepeanwa ju yenu; fanyeni this ikiwa in rememberance of me."

src: 20.In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.
tgt: Na njia hiyo hiyo, naada ya supper akakwachu ile cup akabonga, "Hii ni cup ya the new agreement ikitumia blood yangu, yenye imemwagwa out for you.

src: 21.But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.
tgt: Lakini mkono ya yule jamaa atani betray iko pamoja na yangu kwa tebo.

src: 22.The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed, but woe to that man who betrays him."
tgt: Mtoi son wa Adam ataishia tu vile imesemekana, lakini ole yule guy ana mbetray."

src: 23.They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.
tgt: Wote wakaanza kuulizana maswali kati yao ni nani mwenye imekuwa hadi afanye hivi.

src: 24. Also a dispute arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.
tgt: Pia mvutano ikaanza kati yao ju ya nani alikuwa amehesabika as the greatest.

src: 25.Jesus said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.
tgt: Jesus akawaambia, "Wafalme wa mataifa wanakuwaga ma dictator juu ya ma ordinaree; na wale wako na say juu yao hujiita donors.

src: 26.But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.
tgt: Lakini hamfai kuwa ivo. Lakini instead mnafaa the greatest kati yenu awe njo the youngest, na mwenye ni sonkwo awe njo kama mwenye ni mboch wake.

src: 27.For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.
tgt: Ju nani njo yule ni greater, mwenye ako amepolea kwa tebo ama mwenye ni waiter? Si ni yule mwenye ako amepolea kwa tebo? Lakini niko kati yenu ka mwenye ana serve.

src: 28.You are those who have stood by me in my trials.
tgt: Nyi njo wale wadhii wamesimama na mimi kwa majaribu zangu.

src: 29.And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,
tgt: Na nawapea award ya Kingdom, kama tuvile mbuyuz wangu aligeiana moja juu yangu,

src: 30.so that you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
tgt: ili pia nyi muweze kudishi na kudrink kwa tebo yangu ndani ya kingdom yangu na kuketi kwa thrones, mki judge zile kabila twelve za Israel.

src: 31."Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift you as wheat.
tgt: "Simo, Simo, shaitula ameuliza permission akupepete ka ngano.

src: 32.But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."
tgt: Lakini nimekuombea Simo, njo faith yako isicollapse. Na ukisharudi back, pea nguvu ma bro wako."

src: 33.But he replied, "Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death."
tgt: Lakini akajibu, "Bwana, niko ready kuishia na wewe to prison, hadi hata to death."

src: 34.Jesus answered, "I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me."
tgt: JC akamjibu, "Nakushow ukweli, Pitaa, kabla ile jogoo i crow leo, utani kwara mara tatu ati haunijui."

src: 35.Then Jesus asked them, "When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?" "Nothing," they answered.
tgt: Kisha JC akawauliza, "Vile niliwasend bila wallenje, bag ama sandale, kwani muli-lack kitu?" Wakamjibu, "Hakuna."

src: 36.He said to them, "But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don't have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.
tgt: Akawashow ivi, "Lakini sasa kama uko na mfuko, ichukue, na pia bag; na kama hauna njora, uza kabuti yako u buy moja.

src: 37.It is written: 'And he was numbered with the transgressors'; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment."
tgt: Imeandikwa: 'Na alikauntiwa na wenye dhambi'; na nawashow hii lazima ikam kuwa fulfilled kwangu. Eeh, ndio, chenye kimeandikwa kunihusu kina fikia kufulfilliwa.

src: 38.The disciples said, "See, Lord, here are two swords." "That is enough," he replied.
tgt: Wale wafuasi wakasema, "Cheki, bwana mdosi, hapa tuko na njora mbe." Akamshow,"Hizo ni enough."

src: 39.Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.
tgt: JC akaishia nje kama kawa hadi kwa mlima Olives, na disciples wake wakamfuata.

src: 40.On reaching the place, he said to them, "Pray that you will not fall into temptation."
tgt: Vile walifika ile place, akawashow niaje, "Prayini njo msi fall ndani ya temptations."

src: 41.He withdrew about a stone's throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,
tgt: Ye akajiondoa akishia place ka stone throw ivi mbeleyao, aka kneel down kusali,

src: 42."Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done."
tgt: "Mbuyu, ka unapenda, chukua hii cup from mimi; lakini si vile nimependa, wacha iwe ni vile umependa ifanyike."

src: 43.An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.
tgt: Sa angel toka heaven akamtokezea na kumpea nguvu.

src: 44.And being in anguish, he prayed more earnestly, and his sweat was like drops of blood falling to the ground.
tgt: Na akiwa na machungu, akaomba hata zaidi, hadi sweat yake ikawa ka drops za damu iki fall kwa grao.

src: 45.When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
tgt: Vile aliamka from kusali aliishia back kwa wafuasi wake, akawaget wote wame doze, kwa kuchoka na huzuni.

src: 46"Why are you sleeping?" he asked them. "Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation."
tgt: JC akawauliza,"Mbona mna doze? Raukeni mpray ili msidunde ndani ya temptations."

src: 47.While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,
tgt: Vile alikuwa bado anabonga rendeikatokezea, na yule jamaa aliitwa Judee, mmoja wa wale twelve, alikuwa anawalead. Aka approach JC Kumkiss,

src: 48.but Jesus asked him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"
tgt: Lakini JC akauliza niaje, "Judee, kwani una betray mtoi chali wa adam na kiss?"

src: 49.When Jesus' followers saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"
tgt: Vile wafuasi wa JC walicheki ni what ilikuwa inaenda kuhappen, wakadai,"Bwana mdosi, tuwawai na sword zetu?"

src: 50.And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
tgt: Na mmoja wao hadi akamwai mboch wa high priest,akamkata off skio yake ya right.

src: 51.But Jesus answered, "No more of this!" And he touched the man's ear and healed him.
tgt: Lakini JC akajibu, "Hii mambo isiendelee!" Akamgusa yule jamaa skio lake na kumheal.

src: 52.Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, "Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?
tgt: Kisha JC akasema kwa yule ma priest masonkwo, ma officer wadosi wa watchie wa temple, na wazae, wenye walikuwa wamemkamia,

src: 53.Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on me. But this is your hour—when darkness reigns."
tgt: Daily nilikuwa na nyinyi kwa verandah za temple nikifunza, na hamkuniwekelea hata mkono.Lakini hii njo ithaa yenu- time giza imeshikilia usukani."

src: 54.Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.
tgt: Kisha wakamshika by force, wakampeleka away hadi kwa mbanyu ya priest mkuu. Pitaa alifuatilia kwa mbali.

src: 55.But when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.
tgt: Lakini venye waliwasha moto katikati ya front yard wakapolea down pamoja, pitaa akakaa down pamoja nao.

src: 56.A servant girl saw him seated there in the firelight. She looked closely at him and said, "This man was with him."
tgt: Namanzi fulani mboch alimcheki ametulia pale kwa ile light ya moto.Akamsorora poa alafu akasema, "Huyu mse alikuwaga pamoja na JC."

src: 57.But he denied it. "Woman, I don't know him," he said.
tgt: Lakini akakwara hiyo stori. Akamshow,"Wee! Madam,simjui."

src: 58.A little later someone else saw him and said, "You also are one of them." "Man, I am not!" Peter replied.
tgt: Muda kidogo tu after, mse mwingine alimcheki akasema,"wewe pia ni mmoja wao." Pitaa

src: 59.About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."
tgt: Baada ya kitu one hour hivi mmojaakadai, "Kabisa, huyu msee alikuwa na JC, ju yeye ni Galilean."

src: 60.Peter replied, "Man, I don't know what you're talking about!" Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.
tgt: Pitaa akamjibu,"Jamaa, sijui unadai about nini!" Vile tu alikuwa akibonga, jogoo akaanza kuwika.

src: 61.The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: "Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times."
tgt: Bwana mdosi akapinduka na kucheki Pitaa straight.Kisha Pitaa akakumbuka ile word yenye JC alikuwa amembongesha about: "kabla ile jogoo kuwika leo, utakuwa umenikwara mara tatu."

src: 62.And he went outside and wept bitterly.
tgt: Akaishia nje na kulia na machungu.

src: 63.The men who were guarding Jesus began mocking and beating him.
tgt: Wale wasee walikuwa wanamchunga JC wakaanza kumdiss na kumwai vibare.

src: 64.They blindfolded him and demanded, "Prophesy! Who hit you?"
tgt: Wakam blindfold na kudai, "Ebu prophesy! Nani alikugonga?"

src: 65.And they said many other insulting things to him.
tgt: Na wakasema vitu zingine mob kwake ili kumtusi.

src: 66.At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.
tgt: Sa at daybreak, ile kanjo ya wazae wa wasee ordinare, wote priest masonkwo na maodijo wa sheria, waka get together, na JC akafikishwa mbele yao.

src: 67."If you are the Christ," they said, "tell us."Jesus answered, "If I tell you, you will not believe me,
tgt: Wakamshow, "Ka wewe ni kristo, ebu kwanzatuambie." JC akawashow, "Nikiwaambaia, badohamtani believe,

src: 68.and if I asked you, you would not answer.
tgt: na nikiwauliza, bado hamtanipa jibu.

src: 69.But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God."
tgt: Lakini from sasa, mtoi chali wa adam atakuwa amepozi kwa mkono wa right wa the almighty Jah."

src: 70.They all asked, "Are you then the Son of God?"He replied, "You are right in saying I am."
tgt: Kisha wote wakamwuliza, "Wewe basi ni yule mtoi chali wa sir Godi? Akajibu, "Uko sawa ukisema mimi ni yeye."

src: 71.Then they said, "Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips."
tgt: Kisha wakasema, "Kwani tunahitaji mashahidi wengine?Si sii wpte tumeskia toka kwa lips zake mwenyewe."

src: Luka twenty one-Luke 21 1.As he looked up, Jesus saw the rich putting their gifts into the temple treasury.
tgt: Kisha akalook up, Jesus akacheki wase masonkwo wakiweka gifts zao ndani ya treasury ya hekalu.

src: 2.He also saw a poor widow put in two very small copper coins.
tgt: Pia akacheki widow mmoja amesota akiweka ndani coins mbe small sana za copper.

src: 3."I tell you the truth," he said, "this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
tgt: Akasema, "Nawashow ukeli huyu mjane maskini ameweka sadaka zaidi kuwaliko wale wengine wote.

src: 4.All these people gave their gifts out of their wealth; but she out of her poverty put in all she had to live on."
tgt: Hawa wasee wote walipeana gift zao from ile mali yao; lakini yeye toka kwa umaskini aliweka ndani all chenyalikuwa amebaki nayo ya kuishi.

src: 5.Some of his disciples were remarking about how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and with gifts dedicated to God. But Jesus said,
tgt: Wengine kati ya madisciples wake walikuwa wakicomment vile temple ilikuwa imesukwa na mastones smart na pia gifts ka special dedications kwa sir Godi. Lakini JC akasema,

src: 6."As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; everyone of them will be thrown down."
tgt: "Sa zile vitu mnaona hapa, time inakam when hata moja ya hizo stones haitabaki ju ya ingine; kila mmoja yao zitatupwa down."

src: 7."Teacher," they asked, "when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?"
tgt: Wakamwuliza, "Mwalimu, ni lini when hizi vitu zitahappen? Na what itakuwa ishara that ziko karibu kufanyika?"

src: 8.He replied: "Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am he,' and, 'The time is near.' Do not follow them.
tgt: Akawajibu: "Jihadhari njo msidanganyike.Ju waseewengi watakam na jina yangu, wakidai,"Ni mimi yeye,'na,'Time iko karibu.' Msiwafuate.

src: 9.When you hear of wars and revolutions, do not be frightened. These things must happen first, but the end will not come right away."
tgt: Mkiskia ju ya war na mapinduzi,msikuwe waoga.Hizi vitulazima zihappen kwanza, lakini mwisho haitakam immediately."

src: 10.Then he said to them: "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
tgt: Kisha akawashow: "Nchi ita rise against nchi, na kingdom against kingdom.

src: 11.There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.
tgt: Kutakuwa na earthquakes zingine meja, njaa na magonjwa kwa places kila aina,na event za kushtua hadi hata ishara za maajabu toka heaven.

src: 12."But before all this, they will lay hands on you and persecute you. They will deliver you to synagogues and prisons, and you will be brought before kings and governors, and all on account of my name.
tgt: "Lakini Kabla ya hii yote, watawashikana kuwa tesa. Watawasare kwa synagogues na ma prison, na mtaletwambele yama kingsna ma govana, nyote kwa jili ya Jina yangu.

src: 13.This will result in your being witnesses to them.
tgt: Hii itaresult nanyinyi kuwa ma witnesses kwao about mimi.

src: 14.But make up your mind not to worry beforehand how you will defend yourselves.
tgt: Lakini amua mapema kwa mind yako ati hauta worry kabla ya iyo time, ati vile mtajitetea.

src: 15.For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
tgt: Ju nitawapea ma word na wisdom zingine noma hadi hata wale wapinzani wenu hawataweza kuresist ama kuwa contradict.

src: 16.You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.
tgt: Mtauzwa hadi hata na mapero, mabro, ma rela na mabeshte,na wataweka some of you to death.

src: 17.All men will hate you because of me.
tgt: Kila mse atawa hate ju yangu.

src: 18.But not a hair of your head will perish.
tgt: Lakini hata nywele moja ya kichwa chako haitaangamia.

src: 19.By standing firm you will gain life.
tgt: Lakini kwa kusimama wima mtagain life.

src: 20."When you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.
tgt: "Mkicheki Jerusa iki surroundiwa na ma army, mtajua kuwa time yake ya kuhandwa iko near.

src: 21.Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.
tgt: Kisha wacha wale wako ndani yaJudea wahepe hadi kwa milima, wacha wale wanapoleaga kwa jiji watoke nje, na wacha wale wako kwa ocha ocha wasiingie kwa jiji.

src: 22.For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.
tgt: Ju hii ni ile time ya pano ili ku fulfill yote yenye imeandikwa.

src: 23.How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers! There will be great distress in the land and wrath against this people.
tgt: Si itakuwa ni noma hizo ma days kwa wale madem pregnant na wale mamatha wananyonyesha!Kutakuwa na mateso ingine massive in the land na hasira against hawa wadhii.

src: 24.They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
tgt: Watachinjwa na sword na kuchukuliwa ka wafungwa kwa mataifa zote. Jerusa itakanyagwa na wale gentiles hadi time ya gentiles ikuwe fulfilled.

src: 25."There will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.
tgt: "Kutakuwa na ishara kwajua, mwezi hadi stars. Juu kwa earth, countries zitakuwa in hardship na kusumbuka ju ya vile bahari itakuwa imechafuka na ikinguruma.

src: 26.Men will faint from terror, apprehensive of what is coming on the world, for the heavenly bodies will be shaken.
tgt: Wasee watafaintju ya terror, wakiwa wameogopa ni nini inakam kwathe earth, hadi zile heavenlybodies zitashake-iwa.

src: 27.At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
tgt: Katika iyo time watacheki son wa adam akikam kwa wingu akiwa na nguvu na glory mob.

src: 28.When these things begin to take place, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near."
tgt: Vile hizi vitu zitaanza kuhappen, simama up na muinue vichwa zenu, ju wokovu wenu umekaribia."

src: 29.He told them this parable: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
tgt: Akawashow hii parable: "Cheki fig tree nahadi zile miti zingine.

src: 30.When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
tgt: Vile zinasprout ma leaves, unaweza jichekia mwenyewe na ujue ni summer imefika.

src: 31.Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that the kingdom of God is near.
tgt: Hivo pia, vile utacheki hizi vitu zinahappen, utajua that kingdom ya sir Godi iko karibu.

src: 32."I tell you the truth, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
tgt: "Nawashow ukweli,hii generation haita pass away kabla ya hizi vitu zote kufanyika.

src: 33.Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
tgt: Heaven na earth zita pass away,lakini ma words zangu hazitawahi pass away.

src: 34."Be careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with dissipation, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you unexpectedly like a trap.
tgt: "Kuwa careful, ama mioyo zenu zitakuwa weighed down na hepi, ulevi na wasi wasi za life, hadi iyo siku ikushike vi unexpected ka trap.

src: 35.For it will come upon all those who live on the face of the whole earth.
tgt: Ju itakuja ju ya wase wote wenye wanaishi kwa uso wa dunia yote.

src: 36.Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man."
tgt: Kilatime kuwa rithoukiwatch, un uombe that utakuwa able kuhepa yote iko aboputku happen, and that utaweza kusimama mbele yathe son of man."

src: 37.Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,
tgt: Kila siku JC alikuwa akifunza kwa temple, na kila jioni aliishia out kuspend usiku kwa ile mlima inaitwa Olives,

src: 38.and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.
tgt: na wasee wote walikam ngware asubuhi kumskizia pale kwa temple.

src: Luka Chapta Mbao -Luke 20 1.One day as he was teaching the people in the temple courts and preaching the gospel, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.
tgt: Siku moja vile alikuwa akifundisha wadhii ndani ya verandah za temple na ku preach gospel, priest wale chief na ma mode wa sheria, pamoja na wazae wakakam kwake.

src: 2."Tell us by what authority you are doing these things," they said. "Who gave you this authority?"
tgt: Wakamwuliza,"Tuelezee na say ya nani una tekeleza hizi vitu, nani alikupea hii authority?"

src: 3.He replied, "I will also ask you a question. Tell me,
tgt: Akawajibu,"Pia mi nitawauliza swali. Nishowini,

src: 4.John's baptism—was it from heaven, or from men?"
tgt: Ubatizo ya Johnie- ilikuwa ya heaven, ama from wadhii?"

src: 5.They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask, 'Why didn't you believe him?'
tgt: Wakazungumza kiasi ju ya swali, kati yao wenyewe alafu wakasema,"Tukisema, 'from heaven', atauliza, 'mbona hamkumuamini?'

src: 6.But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet."
tgt: Lakini tukisema, 'From wasee,' He! kila mse atatutupia mawe, ju wako persuaded kuwa Johnie alikuwa prophet."

src: 7.So they answered, "We don't know where it was from."
tgt: Kwa hivo wakajibu,"Hatujui from where ilitoka."

src: 8.Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."
tgt: JC akasema, "Basi pia mimi sitawashow ni by say gani na do hizi vitu."

src: 9.He went on to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers and went away for a long time.
tgt: Akaendelea na kuwashow wadhi hii parable: "Mse aliplant shakee ya grapes,akairentisha kwa some wakulima na akaishia away for along time.

src: 10.At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants so they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
tgt: Time ya harvest akatumanisha servant wake kwa wale wapangaji njo wampatie fruits tu kiasi toka kwa ile shakee.Lakini wale wapangaji wakampiga na kumrudishwa mkono mtupu.

src: 11.He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.
tgt: Akatumana tena servant mwingine, lakini huyo pia wakampiga na kumdharau na kumfukuza away akiwa mkono mtupu.

src: 12.He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.
tgt: Alitumana tena mse wa tatu, na wakamwumiza na kumchuja nje.

src: 13."Then the owner of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.'
tgt: "Sa mwenye shakee ya ma grapes akashangaa, 'Nitafanya nini sasa? Nitasend mtoi wangu boy, mwenye na love; pengine watamshow some respect.'

src: 14."But when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. 'This is the heir,' they said. 'Let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'
tgt: "Lakini vile wale wapangaji walimcheki, wakabonga ju ya hiyo stori. 'Huyu njo mwenye ana inherit, wacha tummade, na inheritance yote itakuwa yetu.'

src: 15.So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him."What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
tgt: Kwa ivo wakamchuja nje ya shakee na kum mada."Ni nini basi chenye yule mwenye ile shakee ata do kwao?

src: 16.He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others." When the people heard this, they said, "May this never be!"
tgt: Atakam na kuwaua wale ma servants nakugeiana ile shake kwa wengine." Vile wadhii waliskia hii,wakasema, "isiwahi kuhappen hivi!"

src: 17.Jesus looked directly at them and asked, "Then what is the meaning of that which is written:" 'The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone'?
tgt: JC akawacheki direct alafu akauliza,"Ni nini basi meaning ya chenye kimeandikwa:"

src: 18.Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces,but he on whom it falls will be crushed."
tgt: Kila mseataangukia hiyo stone atavunjika vunjika in pieces,lakini yule mwenye itaangukia atakuwa crushed."

src: 19.The teachers of the law and the chief priests looked for a way to arrest him immediately, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they were afraid of the people.
tgt: Wale mamode wa law na wale ma chief priest wakatafuta a way ya ku arrest JC mara moja, ju walinyita alikuwa amebonga hiyo parable against then. Lakini waligwaya ju ya rende.

src: 20.Keeping a close watch on him, they sent spies, who pretended to be honest. They hoped to catch Jesus in something he said so that they might hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.
tgt: Wakiwa wamecheki JC vi closely, walitumanisha ma spies, wenye walijidai hao ni honest. Walikuwa wana hope kumbamba JB kwa something yenye angesema alafu wamsare kwa powers za governor.

src: 21.So the spies questioned him: "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
tgt: So wale ma spies wakamwuliza maswali: "Mwalimu, tunajua that we hubonga na ku teach chenyeni right, na that wewe haushowigi partiality lakini unafundisha theway ya sir Godi kulingana na the truth.

src: 22.Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
tgt: Ebu nishow, je ni right kwa sisikulipa tax kwa Caesar ama tu sare?"

src: 23.He saw through their duplicity and said to them,
tgt: Akacheki through ukora yao akawashow,

src: 24"Show me a denarius. Whose portrait and inscription are on it?"
tgt: "Nionyesheni coin denarius. Mchoro ya nani namaandishi ya nani iko juu yake?"

src: 25."Caesar's," they replied. He said to them, "Then give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."
tgt: Wakamshow, "Ya Caesar." Akawashow,'Basi peaneni chenye ni cha Caesar kwa Caesar na chenye ni cha sir Godi kwa sir Godi."

src: 26.They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.
tgt: Wakakuwa wameshindwa kumtrap in what alisema kwa public. Na wakishangazwa na answer yake, wakanyamaza.

src: 27.Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question. Sa some of wale sadducees, wenye hudai hakuna resurrection, wakamkamia JC na swali. 28."Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and have children for his brother.
tgt: Wakasema, "Mwalimu, Mose alituandikia ati kama mse, bro wake ame dedi na ameacha wife lakini hana wakidi, basi yule boy lazima a marry widow na aget watoi for his bro.

src: 29.Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a woman and died childless.
tgt: Sa kulikuwa na mabro wa saba. Wakwanza akaoa manzi lakini akadedi bila wakidi.

src: 30.The second
tgt: wa pili

src: 31.and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.
tgt: Alafupia watatu akam marry, na ivo ivo wote seven waka dedi bila kuacha watoi.

src: 32.Finally, the woman died too.
tgt: Mwishowe, yule matha pia akadedi.

src: 33.Now then, at the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"
tgt: Sasa basi, ile siku ya resurrection atakuwa waif wa nani, ju wote seven walikuwa wamem marry?"

src: 34.Jesus replied, "The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.
tgt: JC akajibu, "Wadhii wa hii age wana marry na kupeanwa in marriage.

src: 35.But those who are considered worthy of taking part in that age and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,
tgt: Lakini wale wako considered waorthy kuwa part of kizazi kipya na part of resurrection ya the dead hawata oa ama kuolewa,

src: 36.and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God's children, since they are children of the resurrection.
tgt: na hawawezi dedi tena; jua wao ni ka wale angels. Ni watoi wa sir Godi, ju ni watoi wa resurrection.

src: 37.But in the account of the bush, even Moses showed that the dead rise, for he calls the Lord 'the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'
tgt: Lakini kwa ile account ya burning bush, hadi Mosee aliwashow kuwa wale wasee wame die hurise, ju anaita bwana' sir Godi wa Abraham, sir Godi wa Isaac na sir Godi wa Jacob.'

src: 38.He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive."
tgt: Ye sio Mungu wa wale wasee wamededi, lakini wale wako living,ju kwake wote wako alive."

src: 39.Some of the teachers of the law responded, "Well said, teacher!"
tgt: Wengine wa wale ma mode wa sheria wakajibu, "Umesema poa, mwalimu!"

src: 40.And no one dared to ask him any more questions.
tgt: Na hakuna mwenye alijaribu kumwuliza maswali zingine zaidi.

src: 41.Then Jesus said to them, "How is it that they say the Christ is the Son of David?
tgt: Kisha JC akawashow, "Niaje ikuwe ati wanasemaga kristo ni mtoi chali wa Davie?

src: 42.David himself declares in the Book of Psalms: " 'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand
tgt: Davie mwenyewe amesha declare kwa mbuku ya Psalms: " 'Bwana mdosi alisema kwa bwana wangu: "Kaa at my right hand

src: 43.until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet." '
tgt: hadi niwafanye mahaters wako footstool ya miguu zako." '

src: 44.David calls him 'Lord.' How then can he be his son?"
tgt: Davie anamwuita 'Bwana.'Itakuwaje tena akuwe ni son wake?"

src: 45.While all the people were listening, Jesus said to his disciples,
tgt: Wasee wote wakimsikiliza, JC akawashow wale disciples wake,

src: 46."Beware of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and love to be greeted in the marketplaces and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
tgt: "Chunga ju ya ma mode wa sheria. Ju wao hu-like kutembea around na robe zinaflow na hupenda kugotewa kwa zile soko na kupewa the the most important seats kwa synagogues na place za VIP kwa ma bash.

src: 47.They devour widows' houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. Such men will be punished most severely."
tgt: Wanatoanisha ma mbanyu za widowa na ju ya show wanaomba maombi ndefu. Wasee kama hawa watapanoiwa kwa ukali sana."

src: Luka, vile huwa chapta nineteen-Luke 19 1.Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.
tgt: JC akadonjo Jeri na alikuwa akipitia tu.

src: 2.A man was there by the name of Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was wealthy.
tgt: Kulikuwa na boy fulani hapo aliitagwa Zacchaeus ama Zax; na alikuwa chief sonkwo wa wasakanyaji wa munde ya tax kwa ivo ju ya hiyo stori alikuwa ameosa mbaya.

src: 3.He wanted to see who Jesus was, but being a short man he could not, because of the crowd.
tgt: Na alitaka kucheki JC ni mse mgani, lakini ju alikuwa kapyenga hange make, ju ya rende.

src: 4.So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.
tgt: Kwa ivo akakimbia mbele akakwaya sycamore fig tree ili angalau amcheki, ju JC alikuwa akikam na hiyo baro.

src: 5.When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, "Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today."
tgt: Vile time JC alifika hapo ivo, alicheki juu, akamshow,"Zax, ebu shuka down chap chap. Leo lazima tu nitulie kwa keja yako."

src: 6.So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.
tgt: so akashuka down mara one na kumkaribisha aki hepi.

src: 7.All the people saw this and began to mutter, "He has gone to be the guest of a 'sinner.' "
tgt: Vile wasee walicheki hii stori wakaanza kubonga kimya kimya, "Itakuwaje! Ashaishia kukuwa mgeni wa jamaa 'sinner.' "

src: 8.But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount."
tgt: Lakini Zax akasimama up na kumshow sa Bwana mdosi, "Cheki, Sonkwo! Hapa na sasa napeana half ya burungo zangu zote kwa wase poor, na kama nimegonga mse chochote, narudisha back mara four ya chenye nili take."

src: 9.Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.
tgt: JC akamshow,"Leo salvation imekam kwa hii mbanyu, ju huyu jamaa, pia, ni mtoi wa Abraham.

src: 10.For the Son of Man came to seek and to save what was lost."
tgt: Ju mtoi chali wa adam alikam kusakanya na kuokoa kile kilipotezwa."

src: 11.While they were listening to this, he went on to tell them a parable, because he was near Jerusalem and the people thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear at once.
tgt: Nyakati walikuwa wanaskiliza hii, akazidi na kuwashow parable moja hivi, ju alikuwa karibu kuingia Jerusa, na wasee walidhani ati kingdom ya sir Godi inge appear tu mara once.

src: 12.He said: "A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.
tgt: Akawashow: "Jamaa wa a noble birth aliishia to a distant country kufanywa mwenyewe akuwe king na alafu arejee.

src: 13.So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas.'Put this money to work,' he said, 'until I come back.'
tgt: Kwa ivo akawaita wasee kinde ma servants wake akawagei shilingi kinde. Akawashow niaje,'Wekeni hii munde to work, hadi vile nitarudi.'

src: 14."But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, 'We don't want this man to be our king.'
tgt: "Lakini wale raia wake walikuwaga ma haters wake mbaya so wakatuma delegation kusema ati, 'Hatutaki huyu jamaa akuwe king wetu.'

src: 15."He was made king, however, and returned home. Then he sent for the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained with it.
tgt: Lakini akafanywa king bado, alafu akarudi home. Kisha akatumana wale mamboch wenye alikuwa amegei munde, wakam, njo a find out ni what walikuwa wame make profit nayo.

src: 16."The first one came and said, 'Sir, your mina has earned ten more.'
tgt: "Wa kwanza akakam akasema, "sonkwo, shilingi ya yours ime make kumi zaidi.'

src: 17." 'Well done, my good servant!' his master replied. 'Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.'
tgt: Sonkwo wake akamshow,"' Ume do poa, servant wangu mzuri! Ju umeaminika kwa kitu small sana, chukua control ya cities kumi.'

src: 18."The second came and said, 'Sir, your mina has earned five more.'
tgt: "Yule wa pili aka kam akasema, "Mdosi, shilingi yako ime make zingine tano.'

src: 19."His master answered, 'You take charge of five cities.'
tgt: "Sonkwo wake akamshow, 'Chukua charge ya cities tano.'

src: 20."Then another servant came and said, 'Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.
tgt: "Kisha servant mwingine akakam akasema, 'Mdosi, njo hii shilingi yako hapa; nimekuwa nikii keep away ikiwa kwa kiraka.

src: 21.I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.'
tgt: Nilikuwa nimegwaya juu yako, because we ni mse mgumu. Unachukua out chenye haukuweka ndani na kuvuna chenye hauku plant.'

src: 22."His master replied, 'I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant! You knew, did you, that I am a hard man, taking out what I did not put in, and reaping what I did not sow?
tgt: "Sonkwo wake akajibu, 'Nitaku judge na maneno yako mwenyewe, we servant m wiked! Ulijua sio, ati mi nimse mgumu, na chukua out chenye sikuweka ndani, na kuvuna place sikupanda?

src: 23.Why then didn't you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?'
tgt: Mbona basi haukuweka mundee zangu on deposit, alafu at least nikirudi, ningeicollect na interest?'

src: 24."Then he said to those standing by, 'Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.'
tgt: "So akashow wale walikuwa wamesimama kando, 'Chukua shilingi yake from him na uipeane kwa the one mwenye ako na shilingi kumi.'

src: 25." 'Sir,' they said, 'he already has ten!'
tgt: Wakamshow, " 'Mdosi, tayari ana shilingi kumi!'

src: 26."He replied, 'I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what he has will be taken away.
tgt: "Kisha akajibu, 'Nawashow kuwa kila mse ako nazo, zaidi zitaongezwa, lakini yule mwenye hana any, hata zenye ako nazo zitachukuliwa.

src: 27.But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them—bring them here and kill them in front of me."
tgt: Lakini wale ma haters wangu wenye hawakutaka niwe king juu yao- walete over here na uwamade mbele zangu."

src: 28.After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
tgt: Baada ya hapo JC akisha bonga ivo, aliishia mbele, aki go up hadi Jerusa.

src: 29.As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,
tgt: Akikaribia Bethphage na Bethany kwa ile hill inaitwa Mount Olives, alituma wase wawili, disciples wake, akiwashow,

src: 30."Go to the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
tgt: "Ishieni hadi mfike kwa ile village mbele yenu, na mkiingia tu, mta get mtoi wa punda amefungiliwa hapo, mwenye hakuna mse ameshawai panda. Mfungulie na mumlete hapa.

src: 31.If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying it?' tell him, 'The Lord needs it.' "
tgt: Ka mse yeyote anawauliza, 'Mbona mnamfungulia?' Mshowini, 'Mdosi anaimhitaji.' "

src: 32.Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.
tgt: Wale walikuwa wametumwa mbele waliishia wakaget vile tu walishoiwa itakuwa.

src: 33.As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, "Why are you untying the colt?"
tgt: Sa wakati walikuwa wakifungulia ile punda, wenyewe wakauliza,"Mbona mnafungulia huyo punda?"

src: 34.They replied, "The Lord needs it."
tgt: Wakajibu aje, "Mdosi anai need."

src: 35.They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.
tgt: Wakailetakwa JC,wakatupa koti zao juu ya mtoi wapunda na kumwekelea JC juu yake.

src: 36.As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.
tgt: Vile wakiishia along, wasee waka tandaza kabuti zao kwa baro.

src: 37.When he came near the place where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples began joyfully to praise God in loud voices for all the miracles they had seen:
tgt: Vile walikaribia ile place rodi ilikuwa ni kimteremko hadi Mlima Olives, rende nzima ya disciples wakaanza kujazika sana, ku praise God na voices loud ju ya zile miracles zote walicheki:

src: 38."Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!""Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"
tgt: "Ameblesika mfalme anayekam kwa jina la sir Godi!" "Amani iweheaven na glory ajabu in the highest!"

src: 39.Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples!"
tgt: Wengine wa wale mafarisayo kwa rende wakamshow jC,"Mwalimu, kemea disciples wako!"

src: 40."I tell you," he replied, "if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out."
tgt: Akawaambia, "Nawashow, kawakibaki quiet,mawe zitalia out."

src: 41.As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it
tgt: Aki fikia Jerusa na kuona jiji, akaililia

src: 42.and said, "If you,even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace—but now it is hidden from your eyes.
tgt: akabeonga,"Kama wewe, yani wewe ungalijua ni nini hii siku ingeke bring-ia amani- lakinifor now iko hidden from your eyes.

src: 43.The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.
tgt: Masiku zinakam kwako wakati ma haters wako watajenga ukuta against you na kukuzunguka na kukufunikia kila mahali.

src: 44.They will dash you to the ground, you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of God's coming to you."
tgt: Wataku smash kwa grao, wewe na wakidi wako ndani ya kuta zako. Hawatasare hata stone moja juu ya nyingine, ju hamkunyita time yenye sir Godi alikam kwenu."

src: 45.Then he entered the temple area and began driving out those who were selling.
tgt: Kisha akaingia kwa area ya temple na kuanza kufukuza out wale walikuwa waki do mali kwa mali business.

src: 46."It is written," he said to them, " 'My house will be a house of prayer'; but you have made it 'a den of robbers.'"
tgt: Akawashow,"Imeandikwa, hao yangu itakuwa ni hao ya prayer'; lakini mmeifanya dwelling ya wagondi.' "

src: 47.Every day he was teaching at the temple. But the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the leaders among the people were trying to kill him.
tgt: Kila siku alikuwa anafunza kwa temple. Lakini wale machief priest, waalimu wa law na wale leaders wao walikuwa wanatry kummada.

src: 48.Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.
tgt: Lakini hawakufind njia any ya kudo ivo, ju wase wote walikwamilia ma words zake.

src: Luka eighteen - Luke 18 1.Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.
tgt: Kisha JC akashow wale disciples wake parable moja ya nguvu ju ya prayer njo at least wanyite lazima kila time wa pray bila ku give up.

src: 2.He said: "In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared about men.
tgt: Akasay: "Kwa tao fulani kulikuwa na jaji mwenye hakuogopa God ama kujali na wasee.

src: 3.And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, 'Grant me justice against my adversary.'
tgt: Na kulikuwa na a widow kwa hiyo tao mwenye alikuwaga akirudi rudi kwa judge na one request,'Nigei justice against my adversary.'

src: 4."For some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, 'Even though I don't fear God or care about men,
tgt: "Kwa muda jamaa akakataa. Lakini finally akajiambia, 'Hata kama siogopi sir Godi wala sijali stori ya wasee,

src: 5.yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will see that she gets justice, so that she won't eventually wear me out with her coming!' "
tgt: Lakini ju huyumjane alikuwa kila saa ananisumbua, nitahakikisha anaget justice, njo mwishowe asinichokeshe kabisa na kurudi rudi kwake!'"

src: 6.And the Lord said, "Listen to what the unjust judge says.
tgt: Kisha the lord akasema,"Skiza chenye yule judge mu unfair alidai.

src: 7.And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?
tgt: Na sa God je, si atahakikisha kuwa justice imehappen for wale amewachagua, wenye wanacry out kila day and night kwake? Atazidi kuwalenga akiwa put off?

src: 8.I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly.However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?"
tgt: Nawashow aje, atacheki kuwa mnaget justice, Tena chap chap. Lakini je, time son wa God atakam earth je ataget faith kwa earth?"

src: 9.To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everybody else, Jesus told this parable:
tgt: Kwa wengine wenye walikuwa confident ju ya righteousness yao na wali look down kwa kila msee,JC akawashow hii parable:

src: 10."Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
tgt: "Wasee wawili waliishia kwatemple ku pray, mmoja alikuwaga pharisee na yule mwingine alikuwaga msakanyaji wa munde ya tax..

src: 11.The Pharisee stood up and prayed about himself: 'God, I thank you that I am not like other men—robbers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
tgt: Yule pharisee akasimama na kupray about himself: 'God, nakushukuru ju siko kama wale wasee wengine majambazi, wakora, wahanyaji- ama hata ka huyu msakanyaji wa tax.

src: 12.I fast twice a week and give a tenth of all I get.'
tgt: Na fastigi twice kwa wiki na mi hupeana tithe ya kila kitu naget.'

src: 13."But the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, 'God, have mercy on me, a sinner.'
tgt: "Lakini msakanyaji wa munde ya tax, akasimamia kwa bali.Hata hangecheki juu to heaven, lakini akabeat breast yake ka sign ya kulia,'Sir Godi, nioneehuruma mi sinner.'

src: 14."I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."
tgt: "Nakushow kuwa huyo jamaa, na si yule mwingine,aliishia home ako justified mbele ya sir Godi.Ju kila mse mwenye anajiinua atashushwa na kila mse anajishusha atainuliwa juu."

src: 15.People were also bringing babies to Jesus to have him touch them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.
tgt: Wasee walikuwa pia wakileta watoi kwa JC ili awaguse wapone. Vile disciples walicheki ivo, wakawazushia.

src: 16.But Jesus called the children to him and said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
tgt: Lakini JC akawaita kwake kuwashow, wacha watoi wadogo wakam kwangu,na usiwakataze, ju kingdom ya sir Godi inabelong kwa kama hao.

src: 17.I tell you the truth, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it."
tgt: Nawaelimisha ivi ukweli, mse any mwenye hata receive kingdom yasir Godi kama mtoi mdogo hatawaiingia huko."

src: 18.A certain ruler asked him, "Good teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
tgt: Kisha sonkwo fulani akamwuliza,"My good mwalimu, ni what njo lazima ni do kuinherit eternal life?"

src: 19."Why do you call me good?" Jesus answered. "No one is good—except God alone.
tgt: JC akamwuliza, "Mbona unaniita mpoa? Hakuna mse mpoa except sir Godi pekee.

src: 20.You know the commandments: 'Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.' "
tgt: Si unamesea commandments:' Usi commit adultery, usi madee, usi thegi, usipeane ma witnessings za uwongo, heshimu mbuyu wakona masa wako.' "

src: 21."All these I have kept since I was a boy," he said.
tgt: Akamshow,"Hizi zote nime keep toka nikuwe boy."

src: 22.When Jesus heard this, he said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
tgt: Wakati JC aliskia ivo, akamshow, "Bado una lack kitu moja. Uza kila kitu yako naugeiane kwa wasee poor, na utakuwa na treasure in heaven.Kisha kamu unifuate.

src: 23.When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was a man of great wealth.
tgt: Vile aliskizia ivo, akashuka moyo down sana, ju alikuwa mse ana wealth ingine meja.

src: 24.Jesus looked at him and said, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
tgt: JC akamcheki ivi na akamshow niaje,"Ni Vigumu sana for the rich kuingia kwa kingdom ya sir Godi!

src: 25.Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."
tgt: For real,ni easier for acamel ku go through jicho ya sindano kuliko ata for mse rich kuingia kingdom ya sir Godi."

src: 26.Those who heard this asked, "Who then can be saved?"
tgt: Wale wazeiya waliskizia iyo tamko wakaulizana,"Kwaivo ni nani sasa basi anaweza okolewa?"

src: 28.Peter said to him, "We have left all we had to follow you!"
tgt: Pitaa akamshow niaje, "Tumesare kila kitu tulikuwanacho njo tukufuate!"

src: 29."I tell you the truth," Jesus said to them, "no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
tgt: "JC akawajibu,"Nawashow cha ukweli, hanakumse mwenye aliacha home ama wife ama ma bro ama masiz ama mapero ama watoi ju ya Kingdom ya sir Godi

src: 30.will fail to receive many times as much in this age and, in the age to come, eternal life."
tgt: mwenye atakosa ku-receive mara mob as much kwa hii age na, kwa ileage inakam, maisha

src: 31.Jesus took the Twelve aside and told them, "We are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written by the prophets about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.
tgt: JC akakwachu wale twelve kuwa take aside akawashow, "Tunaishia up hadi Jerusa, na kila kitu chenye kimechorwa by wale prophets kumhusu son wa man kitakuwa fulfilled.

src: 32.He will be handed over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him, spit on him, flog him and kill him.
tgt: Atasareiwa hadi kwa wase unbelievers.Watamchongoa, watamtusi, watamtemea mate, watampiga viboko na kummada.

src: 33.On the third day he will rise again."
tgt: Siku ya third lakini ata rise tena from the dead."

src: 34.The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.
tgt: Wale disciples hawakushikanisha chochote hapo. Maana yake ikakuwa hidden toka kwao,

src: 35.As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.
tgt: Sa JC aki approach Jeri, mse blind alikuwa amepolea by the baro anabeg.

src: 36.When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
tgt: Ithaa aliskia rende ina pass by, akauliza ni nini ilikuwa ina happen.

src: 37.They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."
tgt: Wakamshow niaje,"Jesus wa Nazareti ana pass by akiishia."

src: 38.He called out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
tgt: Akaitana kwa sauti bwaku, "JC, mtoi chali wa Davie, nionee huruma!"

src: 39.Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"
tgt: Wale walikuwa waki lead the way wakamzomea mbaya hadi wakamshow abaki silent, lakini

src: 40.Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,
tgt: JC akasimama na kuamrisha yule jamaa aletwe kwake. Vile alikaribia,Jesus akamwuliza,

src: 41."What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord, I want to see," he replied.
tgt: "Unataka niku do-iye nini?" Jamaa akamjibu, "Bwana mdosi,minataka kuona."

src: 42.Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has healed you."
tgt: JC akamwambia, "Pokea sight yako; faith yako imekufanya ukuwe healed."

src: 43.Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, praising God. When all the people saw it, they also praised God.
tgt: Tayari hapo na hapo, akapokea sightyake nakufuata JC,akipraiz God.Kisha nyakati wasee walicheki,wao pia wakapraiz sir Godi.

src: Luka Vibes za chapta kinde na seven -Luke 17 1.Jesus said to his disciples: "Things that cause people to sin are bound to come, but woe to that person through whom they come.
tgt: JC akashow disciples wake niaje: "ma something za kukwaza wasee njo wa sin ni lazima tu zi kam, lakini ole wake yule mse through whom zitakam.

src: 2.It would be better for him to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around his neck than for him to cause one of these little ones to sin.
tgt: Ni better kwake ka angetupwa ndani ya baharina mawe ya rego rego ka necklace than kwake kufanya mmoja wa hawa watoi a sin.

src: 3.So watch yourselves. "If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him.
tgt: Kwa ivo jichungeni. "Bro wako aki commit dhambi, mrebuke,na aki tubu dhambi, mforgive.

src: 4.If he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times comes back to you and says, 'I repent,' forgive him."
tgt: Aki do dhambi against you mara saba kwasiku, na marasaba akam back kwako akushow,

src: 5.The apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!"
tgt: Wale ma apostles wakashow JC, "Increase faith yetu!"

src: 6.He replied, "If you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, 'Be uprooted and planted in the sea,' and it will obey you.
tgt: Akamjibu, "Kama una faith small kama seed ya haradali, unaweza show hadi hii mulberry tree, 'Kuwa uprooted na upandwe ndni ya bahari,' na itaku obey.

src: 7."Suppose one of you had a servant plowing or looking after the sheep. Would he say to the servant when he comes in from the field, 'Come along now and sit down to eat'?
tgt: "Tuseme mmoja wenu alikuwa na servant wake ana take care ya kondoo zake. Je, atamshow yule servant akikam home toka kwa viwanja, 'Kam hapa kando sasa upoe down udishi?'

src: 8.Would he not rather say, 'Prepare my supper, get yourself ready and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may eat and drink'?
tgt: Si badala yake atamshow, 'Tayarisha ka supper kangu, jiandae kuniserve nikidishi na kunywa; alafu baadaye unaweza dishi na kunywa?'

src: 9.Would he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?
tgt: Kwani tena atamthank yule mboch ju ati ali do chenye alishoiwa ku do?

src: 10.So you also, when you have done everything you were told to do, should say, 'We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.' "
tgt: So nyi pia,mkisha do kila kitu chenye mmeshoiwa, mnafaa kusema, 'Si ni servants unworthy; tume do duty yetu' "

src: 11.Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.
tgt: Sa akiishia on his way to Jerusalem, JC akatravel along ile border kati ya Samaria na Galilee.

src: 12.As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosymet him. They stood at a distance
tgt: Sa vile alikuwa akiingia kwa village, wasee kumi wenye walikuwa na ukoma wakamkuta.Wakasimama kwa distance mbali

src: 13.and called out in a loud voice, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"
tgt: na wakiita kwa sauti ya juu, "JC,Boss,kuwa na huruma juu yetu!"

src: 14.When he saw them, he said, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." And as they went, they were cleansed.
tgt: NyakatiJC aliwacheki hivi, akasema,"Ishia mjishowini kwa wale ma priest." Na vile walikuwa wakienda, wakaponywa.

src: 15.One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.
tgt: Mmoja wao, vile alicheki ameponywa, akakam back, akipraise God kwa sauti loud.

src: 16.He threw himself at Jesus' feet and thanked him—and he was a Samaritan.
tgt: Akajitupa kwa feet za JC akamshukuru sana-na alikuwa samaritan.

src: 17.Jesus asked, "Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?
tgt: JC akauliza, "Si wote kumi waliponywa? Wale wengine nine wako wapi?

src: 18.Was no one found to return and give praise to God except this foreigner?"
tgt: Kwani hakukupatikana mse mmoja wa kurudi kusema thanks na praise kwa Sir Godi except

src: 19.Then he said to him, "Rise and go; your faith has made you well."
tgt: Akamshow yule jamaa,"Rauka nauishie; faith yako imekuweka poa."

src: 20.Once, having been asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, "The kingdom of God does not come with your careful observation,
tgt: Time moja, ju alikuwa ameulizwa na mafarisayo when kingdom ya sir Godi ingekam,

src: 21.nor will people say, 'Here it is,' or 'There it is,' because the kingdom of God is within you."
tgt: bali wasee hawatasema, 'Njo hii hapa,' ama 'Njo ile pale,' ju kingdom ya sir Godi iko ndani yenu."

src: 22.Then he said to his disciples, "The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
tgt: Kisha akashow disciples wake,"Time inakam when mtatamani kucheki hatamoja yamasiku za mtoi son wa adam, lakini hamtaicheki.

src: 23.Men will tell you, 'There he is!' or 'Here he is!' Do not go running off after them.
tgt: Majamaa watawashow, 'Yuko pale ivo!' ama 'Yuko hapa ivi!' Msikimbilie off kuwafuata.

src: 24.For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.
tgt: Ju mtoi sonwa adam in his day atakuwa kama lightning, yenye inachapa nakulight sky toka kona moja hadi nyingine.

src: 25.But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
tgt: Lakini kwanza lazima ago through suffering mob na arejectiwe na hii generation.

src: 26."Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.
tgt: "Vile tu ilikuwaga days za Noah, ivo pia njo itakuwa siku za mtoi chali wa adam.

src: 27.People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
tgt: Waseewalikuwa wakidishi, na kubambua,wakioa na kupeanwa kwa wedo hadi ile day Noah alidonjo kwa ark. Kisha ile elnino ilikuwa hapo msee ilikam ikawadestroy wote.

src: 28."It was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
tgt: "Ilikuwa ivo pia sikuza Lot. Wase walikuwa wakidishi nakubambua tu, wakiboti cargo nakuuza zingine,wakiplant mashake naku do mijengo.

src: 29.But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
tgt: Lakini ile day Lot alichomoka tu ivi akaacha Sodom, nare na sulfur zilinyesha down from heaven na kuwa destroy wote.

src: 30."It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
