tgt: Itakuwa tu ivi ile siku mtoi son wa adam ana kuwa revealed.

src: 31.On that day no one who is on the roof of his house, with his goods inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.
tgt: Hiyo day kusiwe na mse mwenye amepatikana ju ya roof ya keja yake, na burungo zake ndani, mwenye atashuka kuzicollect. Ivo pia, hakuna mse ndani ya kiwanja anafaa kurudia chochote.

src: 32.Remember Lot's wife!
tgt: Kumbuka wife wa lot!

src: 33.Whoever tries to keep his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will preserve it.
tgt: Mwenye ametry kukeep life yake ataipoteza, na mwenyeamepoteza life yake ataihifadhi.

src: 34.I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.
tgt: Nawashow, iyo usiku wasee wawili watakuwa wanadoro kwa bed moja; mmojaakwachuliwe namwingine abaki.

src: 35.Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left."
tgt: Mamanzi wawili watakuwa wakisiaga nafaka kwa rego rego pamoja; mmoja achukuliwe na mwingine abaki."

src: 37."Where, Lord?" they asked.He replied, "Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather."
tgt: "Wapi bwana mdosi?" wakauliza. Akajibu "Penye kuna dead body, hapo pia kunguru watagather."

src: Luka Flow ya Sixteen - Luke 16 1.Jesus told his disciples: "There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
tgt: JC akashow disciples wake niaje: "Kulikuwa na sonkwo mmoja mwenye manager wa ma biz

src: 2.So he called him in and asked him, 'What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your management, because you cannot be manager any longer.'
tgt: Kwa ivo mdosi akamwita na akamwuliza, 'Ni stori gani hii naskia ju yako? Nipee account kwanza ya vile una manage, ju hauwezi baki manager tena any more.'

src: 3."The manager said to himself, 'What shall I do now? My master is taking away my job. I'm not strong enough to dig, and I'm ashamed to beg—
tgt: "Yule manager akajibongesha, 'Wuui!Nitado what sasa manze? Mdosi asha ni sack akachukua job yangu away. Siko mstrong vile niseme ati nitaenda kulima shake, na mapepe zangu na status, niko ashamed ku beg-

src: 4.I know what I'll do so that, when I lose my job here, people will welcome me into their houses.'
tgt: Najua chenye nita do njo sasa, hatatime napoteza job hapa, watu watanikaribisha kwa ma hao zao.'

src: 5."So he called in each one of his master's debtors. He asked the first, 'How much do you owe my master?'
tgt: Kwa hivo akaita ndani kila mmoja ya wale wase walikuwa na madeni za mdosi. Akauliza wa fao, 'Dongela ngapi una owe mdosi wa mine?'

src: 6." 'Eight hundred gallons of olive oil,' he replied."The manager told him, 'Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it four hundred.'
tgt: Mdeni akasema," ' Galans soo nane za olive oil.' Maneja akamshow, 'Haya! Chukua bill yako, kaa down chap chap, ichange ikuwe soo nne.'

src: 7."Then he asked the second, 'And how much do you owe?' " 'A thousand bushels of wheat,' he replied. "He told him, 'Take your bill and make it eight hundred.'
tgt: " Kisha akaulizathe second,'Na wee unatu-owe how much?' Akajibu," 'Gorogoro Tenga moja za ngano.' Akamshow, 'Chukua bill yako na uchange ikuwe soo nane.'

src: 8."The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the people of this world are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the people of the light.
tgt: "Yukle sonkwo alibaki amemsare tu,hadi akamcongratulate maneja mkora huski, ju ali act na ujanja ya hustler.Ju wasee wa hi dunia wana ujanja ya kuhustle more wakati wana deal na wenzao hatakuliko majamaa wa nuru.

src: 9.I tell you, use worldly wealth to gain friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, you will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.
tgt: Nawashow, tumia mali ya dunia kuget mabeshte for yourselves, njo ikisha die, ime go, utakaribishwa kwa ma cribs zenyeni za milele.

src: 10."Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
tgt: "Mwenyeni mtrust worthy kwa vitu kidogo kidogo anaweza kuwa trusted na much, na mwenye ni mkoramkora haaminiki kwa vitu ndogo ndogo hawezi atakuwa mkora wa vitu mob.

src: 11.So if you have not been trustworthy in handling worldly wealth, who will trust you with true riches?
tgt: Kwa ivo ka we haujatrustiwa ku handle mali yaworld, sa nani njo ataku trust na ile mali ya real?

src: 12.And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else's property, who will give you property of your own?
tgt: Na kama haujaaminika na burungo ya mse mwingine, nani atajugei mali yako we mwenyewe?

src: 13."No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and Money."
tgt: "Hanaku servant mwenye anaweza tumikia ma sonkwo wawili.Labda ata hate mmoja na apende yule mwingine ama atajitolea zaidi kwa mse mmoja na adharau yule mwingine. Hauwezi ku serve sir Godi na Munde."

src: 14.The Pharisees, who loved money, heard all this and were sneering at Jesus.
tgt: Wale mapharisayo, wenye walipenda pesa, wakaskia hiyo yote na wakaanza kumcheki JC na dharau.

src: 15.He said to them, "You are the ones who justify yourselves in the eyes of men, but God knows your hearts. What is highly valued among men is detestable in God's sight.
tgt: JC akawaambia, "Nyi njo mnajipendekezaga mbele ya macho ya wasee, lakini God ashajua heart zenu.Chenye kiko na value mob kwa majamaa kiko hated mbele ya macho ya sir Godi.

src: 16."The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the good news of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
tgt: "Law na ma prophets walikuwa wakitangazwa hadi time ya Johnie.Toka hapo iyo time, ile good news ya kingdom ya sir Godi ina preachiwa, na kila mse anaingia kimangoto,by force.

src: 17.It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.
tgt: Ni easy zaidi for heaven na earth ku disappear kuliko hata ile maandishi ndogo kabisa ya kalamu kuanguka toka kwa law.

src: 18."Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and the man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
tgt: "Kila mtu mwenye anadivorce waifudhes wake na kumarry manzi mwingine ana commit adultery, na yule jamaa ana marry a divorced woman pia anacommit adultery.

src: 19."There was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.
tgt: "Kulikuwa na mse rich alikuwa anadunga nguo za purple na linen fine na aliishi kwa raha kila daily.

src: 20.At his gate was laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores
tgt: Kwa gate yake kulikuwa na beggar fulani aliitwa lazarus, mwenye body yake ilifunikwa na vidonda.

src: 21.and longing to eat what fell from the rich man's table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
tgt: Naalitamani kudishi hata tu chenye kilianguka from meza ya sonkwo. Hata dogi zilikuwa zinakam kuramba vidonda zake. Yak!

src: 22."The time came when the beggar died and the angels carried him to Abraham's side. The rich man also died and was buried.
tgt: "Ile time ikakamu na beggar aka kick na ma angels wakamkamia wakambeba hadi kando ya Abraham. Yule jamaa richpia akadie na akazikwa.

src: 23.In hell, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.
tgt: Huko hell, place alikuwaga aki go through torture, akacheki juu na akaona Abraham huko mbaali, na Lazaro kando yake.

src: 24.So he called to him, 'Father Abraham, have pity on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this fire.'
tgt: Kwa hivo aka call out kwake, 'Daddy Abraham, kuwana huruma kwangu jo na utume Lazaro a dip fingertip yake kwa maji akam apoeshe ulimi yangu, ju naumia sana kwa hii nare.'

src: 25"But Abraham replied, 'Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here and you are in agony.
tgt: "Lakini Abraham akajibu, "Son, kumbuka tu ile wakati ya life yako ulipokea vitu freshi freshi, lakini Lazaro alikuwaga tu na vitumboff, lakini sasa ako comfortable hapa na wewe unaumia.

src: And besides all this, between us and you a great chasm has been fixed, so that those who want to go from here to you cannot, nor can anyone cross over from there to us.'
tgt: Hatakama tungelenga hiyo stori, kati yetu na wewe kuna mtaro ingine ya nguvu ime fixiwa hapo, hadi hata kama wale wasee wako hapa wanataka kwenda toka hapa hadi kwako hawawezi, na wale wanataka ku cross toka kwako kukam hapa hawawezi.'

src: 27."He answered, 'Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my father's house,
tgt: Akamjibu,'Basi please nakuomba, mbuyu, send Lazaro kwa hao ya mbuyu wangu,

src: 28.for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also come to this place of torment.'
tgt: Ju nina mabro wa five.Wacha awashow warning, njo pia nao wasikam hapa kwa hii place ya mateso.'

src: 29."Abraham replied, 'They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.'
tgt: Abraham akajibu, 'Wako na Mosee na ma prophets; wacha; wacha wawasikilize wao.'

src: 30." 'No, father Abraham,' he said, 'but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.'
tgt: Sonkwo akadai," ' Zi, mbuyu Abraham,lakini mse akitoka from the dead aishie kwao, wata repent.'

src: 31."He said to him, 'If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.' "
tgt: "Akamshow niaje, 'Wasipo skiliza Mose nama prophets, hawatawai kuwaconvinced hadi hata mse akifufuka from the dead.' "

src: Luka Flow ya Kumi na Tano-Luke 15 1.Now the tax collectors and "sinners" were all gathering around to hear him.
tgt: So sasa hadi wale wajamaa wa kucollect munde ya gava,tax, na "wenye dhambi' walikuwa wanajikusanya karibu kumskiza.

src: 2.But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law muttered, "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them."
tgt: Lakini wale ma pharisayo na ma odijo wa law wakabonga kisirisiri, "Huyu mse ana karibisha wase wa gizani na pia anadishi nao."

src: 3.Then Jesus told them this parable:
tgt: JC akawaelimisha na hii parable:

src: 4."Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them. Does he not leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost sheep until he finds it?
tgt: "Tuseme pengine mmoja wenu ako na kondoo soo moja alafu alostishe mmoja. Si anaachaga wale wengine ninety nine kwa field open alafuanaishia after ile sheep yenye imelost akiisaka hadi aiget?

src: 5.And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders
tgt: Na akiiget, je? Si anaisunda juu ya mabega na kuibeba.

src: 6.and goes home. Then he calls his friends and neighbors together and says, 'Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.'
tgt: Kisha anaishia kejani.Ambapo sasa anaita washikaji wake wote hadi na maneiba tugezza na kuwashow,'Celebrate na mimi; ju nimeget sheep yangu yenye ilikuwa imelost.'

src: 7.I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.
tgt: So nawaeleza for real ivo ivo in the same way kuna kuwaga na hadi celebrations za nguvu heaven ju ya sinner mmoja akirepent kuliko hata ju ya wasee ninety nine wa holy wenye hawa need ku repent.

src: 8."Or suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Does she not light a lamp, sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?
tgt: "Ama imagine kuna matha mwenye ako na ma silver coins kinde na alostishe moja. Si ye ata washa taa, asweep hao yake akidunga msako meja vi carefully hadi aget hiyo coin?

src: 9.And when she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together and says, 'Rejoice with me; I have found my lost coin.'
tgt: Na akisha ipata, ye huita the ladies chama washikaji wake na maneiba wote pamoja na kudai, 'Celebrate na mimi mase; nimesakanya lost coin ya mine.'

src: 10.In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents."
tgt: Ivo ivo tu, nawaelimisha hivi, kuna paree ya strength mbele ya presence ya angels wa sir Godi ju ya sinner mmoja aki repent."

src: 11.Jesus continued: "There was a man who had two sons.
tgt: JC akazidi na teachings akidai:"Kulikuwa na mse mmoja na watoi chali wambee.

src: 12.The younger one said to his father, 'Father, give me my share of the estate.' So he divided his property between them.
tgt: Yule m young zaidi akashow buzzenga wa his, 'Mbuyu niaje,nigei portion yangu ya inheritance yangu.' So mbuyuz akagawa mali kati yao.'

src: 13."Not long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living.
tgt: "Sio long after hiyo njo yule mtoi son youngest akasakanya burungo zake za inheritance plus vitu zake zote, akaishia safari ya mpango hadi majuu na hapo akahepi ka kubaff akakula mali yake aki live it up na life wild.

src: 14.After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need.
tgt: Bahadaye when alishaparty hadi akasota, kukashuka famine ingine wiked kwa hiyo country yote, hadi akaanza kuwa na mahitaji hawezi meet.

src: 15.So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs.
tgt: Ju ya hiyo stress akaishia akajiuza ka kandaya moko kwa raia ya hiyo country,mwenye alimtuma kwa shakeyake kulisha pigs.

src: 16.He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.
tgt: Manze alikuwa na ubao massive hadi akatamani kujaza tumbo na zile maganda zenye nguruwe zilidishi, lakini hakuna jamaa alimgei any.

src: 17."When he came to his senses, he said, 'How many of my father's hired men have food to spare, and here I am starving to death!
tgt: "Alipojirudia akaanza kuona sense, akasema,'Manze ni servants wangapi wa mbuyu wangu wenye wana hadi dishi ya kuspare,na mi niko hapa na starve hata karibu ni die!"

src: 18.I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
tgt: Nitapiuga safari nirudi kwa mbuyu wa mine nimshow niaje:Daddy nimemess up nikaji waste, nimesin against heaven na wewe.

src: 19.I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired men.'
tgt: Sa hii siko worth kuitwa mtoi son wako; nifanye kama mmoja wa kanda ya moko, mse unalipa kukudungia janta.'

src: 20.So he got up and went to his father. "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.
tgt: Kwa ivo akarauka akaishia kwa mbuyu wake. "Lakini akiwa anatokezea from very far bado, buzzenga akamcheki akajazika na hureuma ju yta son wake; akakitoa unyoya hadi akamfikia mtoi wake, akamrushia mikono around akamhug na kumkiss.

src: 21."The son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.'
tgt: "Yule son wake akashow mbuyuz wake,'Daddy,nimesin against heaven na against wewe. Siko worth kuitwa mtoi wako.'

src: 22."But the father said to his servants, 'Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
tgt: "Lakini mbuyuwake akawashow ma mboch, 'Chap chap! Leta ile Koti freshi kabisa na umvalishe. Wekelea ring kwa finger yake na sadnale kwa miguu zake.

src: 23.Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let's have a feast and celebrate.
tgt: Leta yule ndama mmemnonesha na umchinje. Tukuweni na paree ya maana kucelebrate.

src: 24.For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.' So they began to celebrate.
tgt: Ju huyu mkidi wangu alikuwa amededi na ni alive tena; alikuwaga amelost lakini sa amepatikana. So wakaanza wasee kucelebrate.

src: 25."Meanwhile, the older son was in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.
tgt: So katika ile hali, mtoi chali older alikuwa kwa shake. Nyakati alikamu karibu na mbanyu, akaskia sauti ya lundee- mangoma na kukatika.

src: 26.So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.
tgt: Ju ya hiyo stori akaita mmoja wa wale servants wao kum ask niaje, kwani ni what inaendelea.

src: 27.'Your brother has come,' he replied, 'and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.'
tgt: Servant akamjibu,'Bro wako ame return na fathee wenu amechinja ile ndama nono ju amempata back akiwa safe and sound.'

src: 28."The older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.
tgt: "Bro mbigi akajam mbaya hadi akakwara kuingia ndani ya keja. So mbuyu wao akaishia nje at least ambembeleze.

src: 29.But he answered his father, 'Look! All these years I've been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.
tgt: Lakini akajibu mbuyuz wake, 'Cheki! Hizi miaka zoote nimekuwa na do wax ka slave wako bilahataku disobey hataorder yako moja. Lakini haukuwai nigei hata kale kambuzi kayoung njo ni paree na mabeshte zangu.

src: 30.But when this son of yours who has squandered your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!'
tgt: Lakini time huyumtoi son wako mwenye ameblow munde yako kwa mapoko anakam home, unamchinjia yule ndama mnono, ju yake tu!'

src: 31." 'My son,' the father said, 'you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.
tgt: Mbuyu akamshow, " 'Son wangu we kila time uko na mimi, na kila kitu yangu ni yako.

src: 32.But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.' "
tgt: Lakini ilibidi ka celebration na shukrani jo, ju huyu bro wako mdogo alikuwa maiti lakini sa hii ako alive tena; alikuwa amelost lakini sasa ako found.' "

src: Luka Flow ya fourteen-Luke 14 1.One Sabbath, when Jesus went to eat in the house of a prominent Pharisee, he was being carefully watched.
tgt: Sa Sabato moja ivi, time JC alicheck in kudishi kwa mbanyu ya don fulani wa mapharisee, alikuwa under the spotlight anaexaminiwa vinoma.

src: 2.There in front of him was a man suffering from dropsy.
tgt: Hapo tu mbele yake alikuwa jamaa ana suffer epilepsy.

src: 3.Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in the law, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?"
tgt: JC akawapea exam question mapharisee na ma pro wa sheria niaje,"Je ni poa ki sheria ku heal kwa day ya sabato ama vipi?"

src: 4.But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him away.
tgt: Lakini wakabaki wamenyamaza.So akikwachu yule mse, akamponya na akamtuma aende zake.

src: 5.Then he asked them, "If one of you has a son or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull him out?"
tgt: Kisha akawauliza, "Ka mmoja wenu ako na mtoi son ama pengine ng'ombe ndume yenye imedunda kwa kisima siku ya sabato, si utamchomoa chap chap?"

src: 6.And they had nothing to say.
tgt: Wakabaki speechless, bila word ya kubonga.

src: 7.When he noticed how the guests picked the places of honor at the table, he told them this parable:
tgt: Kisha alinotice vile wale wageni walijichagulia place ya ma VIP kwa tebo, akawashow hii parable:

src: 8."When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for a person more distinguished than you may have been invited.
tgt: "Vile mse anaku invite kwa paree ya wedo, usiende ukachukue area ya ma VIP, ju sonkwo mwingine don kukuliko anaweza kuwa aliinvitiwa.

src: 9.If so, the host who invited both of you will come and say to you, 'Give this man your seat.' Then, humiliated, you will have to take the least important place.
tgt: Na ka ni ivo, mwenye paree, mwenye aliwaalika wawili atakam akushow, 'Pea huyu msee kiti yako jo.' Kisha,upatikane na maaibu ndogo ndogo, alafu uishie upewe place yenye iko down.

src: 10.But when you are invited, take the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, 'Friend, move up to a better place.' Then you will be honored in the presence of all your fellow guests.
tgt: Lakini uki invitiwa, chukua place ile ya nichi, njo hata time sonkwo wa paree akikam, atakushow, 'Beshte, kuja kwa place better.' So unacheki hapo utakuwa na respect zako mbele ya wasee wale wengine wame attend paree.

src: 11.For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."
tgt: Ju kila mse mwenye anajiinua sana atakuwa humbled, lakini yule mse amenyenyekea atainuliwa."

src: 12.Then Jesus said to his host, "When you give a luncheon or dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers or relatives, or your rich neighbors; if you do, they may invite you back and so you will be repaid.
tgt: Kisha JC akamshow don mwenye alimualika dinner, "Time unageiana ka lunch ivi ama hata supper, usiite wale mabeshte wako, mabro wako ama ma rela, ama pengine ma don wenzako maneiba; ju uki do ivo, wataku invite tena na hapo utapata malipo yako.

src: 13.But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,
tgt: Lakini ukithrow bash, invite wale wasee wamesota, wale viwete, vilema, wase blind,

src: 14.and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous."
tgt: na utablessika. Hata wasipokulipa, utalipwa time ya kiama wasee righteous wakifufuka."

src: 15.When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, "Blessed is the man who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God."
tgt: Vile mmoja wa wale wasee kwa table waliskia hii mambo, wakashow JC, "Ako blessed yule jamaa atadishi kwa bash ya kingdom ya sir Godi."

src: 16.Jesus replied: "A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.
tgt: JC aka reply: "Jamaa fulani alikuwa anaandaa bash moja massive. Akaita wengi.

src: 17.At the time of the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, 'Come, for everything is now ready.'
tgt: Day ya paree ithaa kufika akatuma mamboch wake waishie kushow wote walioalikwa, 'Kamuni, ju kila kitu kiko poa.'

src: 18."But they all alike began to make excuses. The first said, 'I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.'
tgt: "Lakini wote wakaanza kutoa visababu ka excuses. Wa kwanza akabonga, 'Nishaboti field moja ya pesa, lazima niishie kuicheki. Tafadhali ni excuse.'

src: 19."Another said, 'I have just bought five yoke of oxen, and I'm on my way to try them out. Please excuse me.'
tgt: "Haya, mwingine akasema, 'Nimeboti tu pair ngovo za dume wa grade manze, hadi niko njiani kuzifanyia test-drive mtu wangu. Tafadhali ni excuse.'

src: 20."Still another said, 'I just got married, so I can't come.'
tgt: "Pia mwingine akabonga akasema, 'Nimeshaingiza manzi kwa box na nikaseal deal na wedo, si unajua saa ni mpango ya honey moon mtu wangu, so siwezi kam.'

src: 21."The servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and ordered his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind and the lame.'
tgt: "Yule mboch akarudi akapeana ripoti kwa sonkwo wake. Kisha yule mdosi wa mbanyu akajam, akaamrisha servant wake, 'Ishia chap chap kwa mitaa na vichochoro za tao, chap chap walete wase wamesota, wase crippled, wase blind, hadi wase walemavu.

src: 22." 'Sir,' the servant said, 'what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.'
tgt: servant akamshow, " 'Boss, chenye umeagiza kimefanywa, lakini bado kuna space mob.'

src: 23."Then the master told his servant, 'Go out to the roads and country lanes and make them come in, so that my house will be full.
tgt: "Mdosi akashow servant wake, 'Ishia nje kwa ma baro na hadi hata ocha kwa njia njia na uwa make wase wakam ndani, njo hao yangu ishone.

src: 24.I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.' "
tgt: Nawashow, hakuna hata mse mmoja aliinvitiwa kwa paree ya mine ataonja bash yangu. ' "

src: 25.Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:
tgt: Crowds kubwa zilikuwa zikisafiri na JC, akawacheki akawashow hivi:

src: 26."If anyone comes to me and does not hate his father and mother, his wife and children, his brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be my disciple.
tgt: "Ka mse atakam kwangu na hawezi hate mbuyu wake ama matha wake, waifudhes wa his ama watoi, bro wake ama masiz wake- eeh, hadi life yake pia- hawezi kuwa disciple wangu.

src: 27.And anyone who does not carry his cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.
tgt: Na mse yeyote mwenye hawezi beba cross yake na anifuate hawezi make kuwa disciple wangu.

src: 28."Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Will he not first sit down and estimate the cost to see if he has enough money to complete it?
tgt: "Tuseme mmoja wenu anataka ku-build mnara. Si kwanza ataketi down na apime ni pesa ngapi ako nayo na kama itamaliza hiyo projo?

src: 29.For if he lays the foundation and is not able to finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
tgt: Ju akianza project awekelee msingi alafu akose kumaliza, wasee wote wenye watacheki projo watamdiss,

src: 30.saying, 'This fellow began to build and was not able to finish.'
tgt: Wakisay, 'Huyu jamaa alianza mradi ya mjengo lakini akashindwa kumada.'

src: 31."Or suppose a king is about to go to war against another king. Will he not first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
tgt: "Ama tuseme king fulani ako tayari kuishia war against king mwingine. Si kwanza ataketi down kuchunguza kama vile ako na soja tenga kinde anaweza kushinda war ama anaweza na tenga mbao?

src: 32.If he is not able, he will send a delegation while the other is still a long way off and will ask for terms of peace.
tgt: Kama hawezi make it, atatuma ka delegation ivi nyakati yule mfalme mwingine ako bado mbali na amwulize terms and conditions za kutumika ili kuwe na amani.

src: 33.In the same way, any of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be my disciple.
tgt: Ivo ivo tu, mse any kati yenu mwenye hajapeana kila kitu yake hawezi kuwa disciple wangu.

src: 34."Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?
tgt: "Salt ni poa, lakini ikiacha ku taste, sa itafanywa kuwa salt tena aje?

src: 35.It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out. "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."
tgt: Haiko poa ya kutumiwa kwa mchanga ama kwa rundo la mbolea; inachujagwa nje.

src: Luka flow ya kinde plus three - Luke 13 1.Now there were some present at that time who told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
tgt: Sasa kuna venye, wasee wengine walikuwaga hapo iyo time wakamshow JC kuhusu ile kisanga ya watu wa hood ya Galilee wenye walimadwa alafu damu yao ika mixiwa na sadaka za Pilate.

src: 2.Jesus answered, "Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans because they suffered this way?
tgt: JC akajibu, "Unadhani ati hao wasee wa Galilee njo walikuwa wale sinners wanoma sana kuliko sinners wengine galilee ju waliumia hivo?

src: 3.I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
tgt: Nawashow zii! Lakini pia nyinyi msipo repent, nyote tu mtaisha.

src: 4.Or those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them—do you think they were more guilty than all the others living in Jerusalem?
tgt: Ama wale mtu eighteen wali die vile ilt tower ya Siloam ilidunda juu yao- unadhani walikuwa ni wasee wengine more guilty than wenzao wenye walikuwa wakipolea Jerusa?

src: 5.I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish."
tgt: Nawaelimisha hapa, zi! Lakini msipo repent, jua pia nyinyi mtaisha."

src: 6.Then he told this parable: "A man had a fig tree, planted in his vineyard, and he went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.
tgt: Basi akawatolea ka parable kiasi: "Jamaa alikuwa na mti wa mkuyu, yaani figs, akaipanda kwa shake yake ya grapes, alafu akaishia kutafuta matundakwa hiyo mti, lakini akakosa hata kadha.

src: 7.So he said to the man who took care of the vineyard, 'For three years now I've been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven't found any. Cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?'
tgt: Kwa hivo akamshow jamaa yule alikuwaga aki take care ya shakee,'Niaje, kwa miaka tatu sasa nimekuwa nikikam hapa kutafuta fruits kwa hii mkuyu lakini si get. Do hivi, ikate down! Mbona i use mchanga poa bure?'

src: 8." 'Sir,' the man replied, 'leave it alone for one more year, and I'll dig around it and fertilize it.
tgt: Kanda ya moko akamshow, " 'Boss, wachana nayo at least mwaka ingine moja, nitachimba around it hadi niweke mbolea, ka fertilizer.

src: 9.If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.' "
tgt: Ikitoa matunda next year, poa! Ikikwara, basi ikatwe down.' "

src: 10.On a Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
tgt: Siku moja sabbath ivi,Jesus alikuwa akitoa somo kwa moja ya zile synagogues,

src: 11.and a woman was there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.
tgt: na matha mwingine alikuwa, manze akose achekwe,zi! Na alikuwa kiwete ju ya shaito fulani for miaka eighteen. Alikuwa amepinda down hata hangesimama straight kabisa.

src: 12.When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, "Woman, you are set free from your infirmity."
tgt: Time JC alimcheki, akamwita mbele akamwambia, "Matha, uko free from iyo ugonjwa yako."

src: 13.Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.
tgt: Kisha akawekelea mikono yake juu ya matha, na maraone akastrighten up aka praise sir Godi.

src: 14.Indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, the synagogue ruler said to the people, "There are six days for work. So come and be healed on those days, not on the Sabbath."
tgt: Jamaa sonkwo wa sunagogue alijam, ati ju JC ali heal kwa sabbath,hadi akatoa notice time ya announcements kwa wadhii ati,"Kuna siku six za janta. Kwa hivo wasee wakam kuponywa hizo ma days, siyo siku ya sabbath."

src: 15.The Lord answered him, "You hypocrites! Doesn't each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it out to give it water?
tgt: JC akamshow niaje, "We ni mse phony sana!Si kila msee hapa siku ya sabbath unafunguliaga ndume wako ama punda from kibanda yake ju unafaa kumpatia wode?

src: 16.Then should not this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be set free on the Sabbath day from what bound her?"
tgt: Basi mbona huyu matha, mtoi wa Abraham, mwenye shaito amefunga kwa miaka hizi zote eighteen, time long ivo, asifunguliwe on the sabbath from chenye kimemfunga?

src: 17.When he said this, all his opponents were humiliated, but the people were delighted with all the wonderful things he was doing.
tgt: Aliposema hivo wasee wote walikuwa wakimpiga opposition waka aibika, lakini raia wakabambika na vitu zote wonderful alikuwa anado.

src: 18.Then Jesus asked, "What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?
tgt: Kisha JC akauliza, "Kingdom ya sir Godi ni like nini?Naweza i compare to what?

src: 19.It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air perched in its branches."
tgt: Bass! Ni kaa mbegu ya haradali, yenye jamaa alichukua akapada kwa shamba yake. Ikamea hadi ikakuwa bonge la mti, nandush wakatokezea kupoleaga kwa mabranch zake."

src: 20.Again he asked, "What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?
tgt: Tena akauliza, "Ni nini nitacompare kingdom ya sir Godi to?

src: 21.It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into a large amount of flour until it worked all through the dough."
tgt: Man nika baking powder, chapa mandashi,yenye mathe alikwachu aka mix poa kwa mfuko large ya unga hadi ika work ndani ya hiyo mix ya wode na unga.

src: 22.Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.
tgt: Kisha JC akapiga raundi akipitia zile ma vijiji na ma gherro, akitoa teachings mzito mzito akielekeaga Jerusa.

src: Someone asked him, "Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?"He said to them,
tgt: Mse akamtupia JC swali,"Bwana mdosi, kwani ni wasee fewpekee njo watasevika?"Akawashow,

src: 24."Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able to.
tgt: "Tia bidii, watu wangu, kazana kabisa na bidii zote, ku make sureume ingilia mlango mdogo, ju wengi, nawashow, watajaribu kupenya lakini hawata make.

src: 25.Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, 'Sir, open the door for us.' "But he will answer, 'I don't know you or where you come from.'
tgt: Ju manze ile wakati tu sonkwo wa mbanyu amerauka up na kufunga doaa, mtasimama nje mkigonga mlango na ku plead, 'Boss tufungulie doaa.' Lakini atajibu, 'Siwamesei na simesei mnatokezea wapi.'

src: 26."Then you will say, 'We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.'
tgt: Kisha muta dai, Aaaih!'Tulidishi na wewe na kudrink na wewe, ulifunzaga kwa ma street corners zetu, mtaani.'

src: 27."But he will reply, 'I don't know you or where you come from. Away from me, all you evildoers!'
tgt: "Lakini atawajibu, "Siwamesei wala simesei mmetoka wapi. Niondokeeni, nyi wasee wa ma wax evil!

src: 28."There will be weeping there, and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves thrown out.
tgt: "Manze kutakuwa kilio hapo niaje, na waseewata grind meno zao, mkicheki Abraham, Izzo na Jacob na wale prophets wote wakiwa kwa kingdom ya sir Godi, lakini nyi wenyewe mmetupwa out.

src: 29.People will come from east and west and north and south, and will take their places at the feast in the kingdom of God.
tgt: Hadi wasee watatokezea from mashariki na magharibi hadi north na south, na wakikwachu space zao kwa ile bash ya kingdom ya sor Godi.

src: 30.Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last."
tgt: For real kuna wale wako last itabaki wako fao, na wale wa fao wabaki wako last."

src: 31.At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, "Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you."
tgt: Hiyo ma time ma farisayo fulani wakamkamia JC wakamshow,"Ng'ooka hapa na uishie place ingine.Herod amekupangia kukumada."

src: 32.He replied, "Go tell that fox, 'I will drive out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach my goal.'
tgt: JCakawajibu, "Endeni mshow huyo mbweha,'Nitatimua mashaito nakuponya wagonjwa leona morro, na siku ya tatu nita reach goal yangu.'

src: 33.In any case, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day—for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!
tgt: Kwa vyovyote vile anyway, Ni lazima ni keep nikitravel leo, morro na siku next- ju for sure hakuna prophet mwenye anaweza kick outside ya Jerusa!

src: 34."O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing!
tgt: "Oh Jerusa, maze Jerusaa, nyi wenye mnadaga ma prophets na kuwastone wote wametumwa kwenu, kamgejua ni marangapi nimetamani tu kuwa kusanya pamoja, ka hen vile hukusanya ma ngweks wadogo chini yawings zake, lakini hamkuwa na roho!

src: 35.Look, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.'"
tgt: Cheki hao yenu imeachwa kwenu solo, desserted.Nawashow live, hamtanicheki again hadi ile time mta confess, ' Blessed ni yule mse anakam kwa Jina ya sir Godi.' "

src: Luka flow ya kinde na mbe - Luke 12 1.Meanwhile, when a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling on one another, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples, saying: "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
tgt: Tayari ikiwa ivo, rende ya wajamaa mathao ikawa imegather, hadi point waseewalikuwa wanakanyagiana down, JC akaanza lecture series yake latest, kwanza akibongesha wafuasi wake akisema:"Kuweni ritho majamaa kujikinga na ile chachu ya mapharisees, yenye ni kuwa ma phony.

src: 2.There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.
tgt: Hanaku tuki iko hidden yenye haitawekwa open, ama yenye imefichika yenye haitawekwa wazi wasee wanyite.

src: 3.What you have said in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the roofs.
tgt: Chenye umebonga kwa giza itaskika kwa mchana, na chenye ume whisper kwa skio kwa place secret ya keja njo kwanza itashoutiwa from juu ya mabati.

src: 4."I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
tgt: "Mawashow, mabeshte zangu, msigwaye ju ya wale wakora wanadedisha tumwili na alafu hawawezi do kitu ingine zaidi.

src: 5.But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear him who, after the killing of the body, has power to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him.
tgt: Lakini nitawashow ni nani mnafaa kuingiza njeve ju yake: ogopa yule mwenye, bahada ya kudedisha mwili, bado ako na mbinu na vungu ya kukuchuja ndani ya hell. EEh, manze, nakushow huyo, maze mugwaye.

src: 6.Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
tgt: Si mali kwa mali watakukindia ndush ngovo for peni limbi? Hadi bado hata mmoja yao haija sahaulika na sir Godi.

src: 7.Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
tgt: Kwa kweli jo, zile nywele za head yako zote zimepewa namba. Msiogope; nyi ni more valuable kuliko ndush mob.

src: 8."I tell you, whoever acknowledges me before men, the Son of Man will also acknowledge him before the angels of God.
tgt: "Tena nawashow aje, yule mmoja wenu mwenye amenikubali mbele ya wasee, mtoi son of sir Godi atamtambua mbele ya angels wa sir Godi.

src: 9.But he who disowns me before men will be disowned before the angels of God.
tgt: Lakini mwenye amenitema mbele ya wasee pia atatemwa mbele ya ma angels wa sir Godi.

src: 10.And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
tgt: Na kila mse ataspeak word against son wa Adam atasamehewa, lakini mse any atacurse against holy spirit hatasamehewa.

src: 11."When you are brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say,
tgt: "Ithaamnaletwa mbele ya wale wadhii wanarun synagogues, masonkwo na wenye say, msiwe jamaa wa kumaka ati ni vipi mtajitetea, ama ni vipi mtabonga.

src: 12.for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say."
tgt: Ju Holy Spirit atawapea mafunzo crush program iyo time ya chenye mtasema."

src: 13.Someone in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."
tgt: Mse mmoja kwa crowd akawika kwake akioomba, "Modee, show bro wa mine agawe burungo ya inheritance na mimi."

src: 14.Jesus replied, "Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?"
tgt: JC akamjibe,"Buda, nani alini appoint niwe hakimu wa kesi ka iyo yako kati yenu?"

src: 15.Then he said to them, "Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; a man's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions."
tgt: Kisha akabonganao wote,"Chunga! Kuwwa macho umejikinga against greed za variety zote-kila aina; life ya mse haikuagi ndani ya vile ako sonkwo wa vitu mob."

src: 16.And he told them this parable: "The ground of a certain rich man produced a good crop.
tgt: Na alafu akafafanua na example moja ya nguvu: "Ile shake ya don fulani sonkwo ilizaa na ubaya crop ya bidii sana.

src: 17.He thought to himself, 'What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.'
tgt: He! akajuiliza, 'Sa ni nini nita do?Sina space mtu wangu! hata space ya kustore zao langu.'

src: 18."Then he said, 'This is what I'll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.
tgt: "Aha, 'akasema', Nitado ivi, nitabomoa down warehouse zangu zote alafu nijenge zile sasa za kutisha, na hapo niweke nafaka yangu na burungo zangu.

src: 19.And I'll say to myself, "You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink and be merry." '
tgt: Alafu nitaji show, "Uko na mambo mzuri teletele zimekungoja tu miaka na miaka.Take it eazee eazee; jitibu na dish na drinks proper na ujibambe."

src: 20."But God said to him, 'You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?'
tgt: "Lakini sir Godi akamshow, 'We pumbavu! Usiku huu huu life yako itaitishwa from wewe.

src: 21."This is how it will be with anyone who stores up things for himself but is not rich toward God."
tgt: "Ivo tu njo ita go down kwa wale wase wowote wanajipangia vitu for wao tu lakini sio masonkwo kwa side ya kupea God."

src: 22.Then Jesus said to his disciples: "Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear.
tgt: Kisha JC akashow disciples wake: "Kwa ivo nawashow, msiwe mnakondeshwa na worry ju ya life zenu, chenye mta dishi; ama mwili zenu, chenye mta dunga.

src: 23.Life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
tgt: Maisha ni more than dishi-french fries na burger, na mwili ni more than kladi-lebo kali kali.

src: 24.Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!
tgt: Tafakari ju ya kunguru jo; Ye kwanza hapandagi wala havuni, hana ka store ivi ama warehouse; lakini cheki sir Godi pasonali huwadunga service ya waiter akiwa feed. Na nyinyi si ni more than ati kunguru!

src: 25.Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
tgt: Nani hapa kwa mawazo zake anaweza kuongeza hata one hour kwa life yake?

src: 26.Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?
tgt: Ju hamwezi do kitu small ka hiyo, mbona mka worry ju ya zile vitu zingine?

src: 27."Consider how the lilies grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.
tgt: "Tafakari vile mauahu grow. Hazinaga ati kutia bidii ama kushona nguo.Lakini nawachanua that hadi Solomon na mapepe na glamor zake zote hangewai dunga vismart ka hizi.

src: 28.If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today, and tomorrow is thrown into the fire, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith!
tgt: So ka hivo njo sir Godi hucladi nyasi uwanjani, zenye ziko hapa leo, na kesho zimesha chujwa kwa nare, mtavalishwa zaidi aje cladi nyinyi, jamani wasee wenye imani small.

src: 29.And do not set your heart on what you will eat or drink; do not worry about it.
tgt: Na msijiwekee heart zenu kufikiria ju ya dishi ama kinywaji; hata msi mind ju yake.

src: 30.For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.
tgt: Ju wase atheists hukimbilia kushughulikia hizi vitu zote, na mbuyu wenu ashashikanisha mnazihitaji.

src: 31.But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.
tgt: Lakini saka kwanza ufalme wa sir Godi, alafu hizi vitu zote mtageiwa pia.

src: 32."Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.
tgt: "Msiwe na woga, kondoo wadogo, ju mbuyu wenu asha jazika kuwagei ufalme.

src: 33.Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide purses for yourselves that will not wear out, a treasure in heaven that will not be exhausted, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.
tgt: Uza cargo zako na usaidie wasee poor. Jisort na wallet zenye haziezi chapa, treasure ya heaven yenye hakuna financial meltdown, yenye hakuna mwizi atakaribia na moth kuimess.

src: 34.For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
tgt: Ju place treasure yako iko, hapo pia heart yako itakuwa.

src: 35."Be dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,
tgt: "Kuwa umedunga tayari kwa utumishi na uweke koroboi yako ikiwa inawaka.

src: 36.like men waiting for their master to return from a wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks they can immediately open the door for him.
tgt: ka wasee wakingojea mdosi wao arudi from wedo ivi, hadi time akikam a-knock wanaweza

src: 37.It will be good for those servants whose master finds them watching when he comes. I tell you the truth, he will dress himself to serve, will have them recline at the table and will come and wait on them.
tgt: Itakuwa poa kwa wale jamaa wenye mdosi wao atawaget wakiwa radar akirudi. Nawapea reality, atajipima kladi mwenyewe kuwa waiter, atawaweka watulie kwa tebo na atakam awashughulikie.

src: 38.It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night.
tgt: Itakuwa poa kwa wale servants wenye walipatikana na mdosi wao wakiwa ready, hata

src: 39.But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
tgt: Lakini elewa ivi: kama mwenye hao angelijua ni time gani thegi alikuwa anakam, hangewacha hao yake isanyiwe.

src: 40.You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him."
tgt: Lazima nyi pia muwe tayari, ju mtoi son wa adam atatokezea ithaa hamkuwa mna expect.

src: 41.Peter asked, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?"
tgt: Pitaa akauliza sonkwo, "Bwana, unasema hizi fumbo kwetu ama kwa kila mse?"

src: 42.The Lord answered, "Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their food allowance at the proper time?
tgt: Bwana mdosi akamshow, "Nani basi ni MD yule faithful na mjanja, mwenye sonkwo aliweka in charge ya servants wake kuwagei dishi yao kwa time proper?

src: 43.It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.
tgt: Itakuwa poa sana kwa wale ma mboch wenye sonkwo atapata wako bidii yao akirejea.

src: 44.I tell you the truth, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
tgt: Nawaelimisha na reali, atawaweka in charge wasimamie burungo zote zake.

src: 45.But suppose the servant says to himself, 'My master is taking a long time in coming,' and he then begins to beat the menservants and maidservants and to eat and drink and get drunk.
tgt: Lakini imagine sa kama huyo mboch atajishow, 'Mdosi wangu amekaa for long na ha kam,' kisha aanze kuwachapa wale servants majamaa na ma maid na kudishi na kuwaka.

src: 46.The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of. He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
tgt: Mdosi atakam ithaa na siku yenye ham expect na in an hour hayuko aware. Atamkata kata vipande ansare awekwe place ya wasee wa gizani.

src: 47."That servant who knows his master's will and does not get ready or does not do what his master wants will be beaten with many blows.
tgt: "Yule mboch anaelewa mipango na will ya sonkwo wake lakini hayuko tayari amaha do chenye mdosi wake anawant atapigwa na vibare mob.

src: 48.But the one who does not know and does things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and from the one who has been entrusted with much, much more will be asked.
tgt: Lakini yule mse mwenye hanyitishi naana do vitu zina deeserve pano atawaiwa vibare few. Toka kwa kila mse mwenye amegeiwa mob, itaexpectiwa a do vitu mob; na yule jamaa mwenye alipewa mob, ataulizwa mob.

src: 49."I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled! "Nimekam kuleta nare kwa earth, na kuna vile na wish ilisha hata waka! 50.But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is completed!
tgt: Lakini nina ubatizo ingine ya ku go through, ni nina stress kibao hadi ile ithaa nitamalizana nayo!

src: 51.Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.
tgt: Mnadhani nimekam kuleta amani kwa earth?Zi, nawaelimisha, ni division.

src: 52.From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.
tgt: Toka sasa kutakuwaga na wasee tano kwa famo moja imegawanyika against each other,

src: 53.They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."
tgt: Watagawanyika, mbuyu against mtoi son na mtoi son against mbuyu, mathe against dotee na dotee against mathee, mother in law against dote wake in law na dotee in law against mathaake in law.

src: 54.He said to the crowd: "When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, 'It's going to rain,' and it does.
tgt: Kisha akashow rende: "Vile mnacheki wingu inaamka toka west, si hapo na hapo mnasema, 'Kutanyesha,' na inanyesha.

src: 55.And when the south wind blows, you say,'It's going to be hot,' and it is.
tgt: Na wakati upepo ya south inablow, si nyi husema, 'itakuwa joto,' na ni ivo.

src: 56.Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don't know how to interpret this present time?
tgt: Ma phonies! Mshaelewa vile ya kusoma ile appearance ya sky na ya earth. Mbona basi hamjui kuelewa ishara ya hizi masiku?

src: 57."Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right?
tgt: "Si mjijazie nyi wenyewe, mkipima ni nini right?

src: 58.As you are going with your adversary to the magistrate, try hard to be reconciled to him on the way, or he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge turn you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.
tgt: Unapojipeleka kwa jugde na yule accuser wako, jaribu bidii mtu wangu kupatanishana

src: 59.I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny."
tgt: Mtu wangu, nakuelimisha, hautang'oka huko hadi mpaka ulipe deni muzima hadi ile peni

src: Luka flow ya Kinde na moja- Luke 11 1. Now it came to pass, as He was praying in a certain place, when He ceased, that one of His disciples said to Him, "Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples."
tgt: Sa wazeiya, kulienda hivi, nyakati akipray place fulani, time alimada kupray tu, mmoja wa wale disciples wake wakamshow niaje, "Mdosi si utushow kuomba, ile njaro hata Johnie pia alishow wasee wake disciples kuomba."

src: 2. So He said to them, "When you pray, say: Our Father in heaven, Hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done On earth as it is in heaven.
tgt: Kwa hivo akawashow niaje, mkipray, semeni: Mbuyu wetu huko heaven, name yako ipewe respect sana. Kingdom yako ikam. Mapenzi yako ifanyike on earth kama vile inafanyikaga heaven.

src: 3. Give us day by day our daily bread.
tgt: Tugei kila daily mkanyo yetu.

src: 4. And forgive us our sins, For we also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. And do not lead us into temptation, But deliver us from the evil one."
tgt: Na utuforgive leo madhambi zetu kama vile tumeforgive kila mse mwenye ako nadeni na sisi. Na usituongoze kwa matemptaions, lakini utu deliver toka kwa shaitula.

src: 5. And He said to them, "Which of you shall have a friend, and go to him at midnight and say to him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves;
tgt: Na akawashow, "Nani kati yenu anaweza kuwa na beshte, alafu amwendeee time za midnight hivi amshow, 'mtu wangu, ni loan dibre tatu;

src: 6. 'for a friend of mine has come to me on his journey, and I have nothing to set before him';
tgt: Ju pal fulani wangu ameshakam kunicheki from safari, na sina hata ka dibre ka kumgei';

src: 7. "and he will answer from within and say, 'Do not trouble me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give to you'?
tgt: "na amjibu akiwa kwa kejani amshow, "usini hustle mtu wangu; door ishafungwa, na watoi wa mine wako na mimi kwa bed; siwezi amka nikushughulikie'?

src: 8. "I say to you, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence he will rise and give him as many as he needs.
tgt: "Nakushow, hata ka hatarauka na kumgei ju yeye ni beshte yake, lakini ju alipersist sana, atarauka amgei dibre mob ile amount anadai.

src: 9. "So I say to you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
tgt: "Kwa ivo njo nawashow, dai, na itapeanwa kwako chenye umeulizia; saka na utaget; bisha, na mlango itafunguliwa kwako.

src: 10. "For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened.
tgt: "Ju kila mse anauliza hupokea, na yule anasaka hupata, na yule jamaa hu knock mlango itafunguliwa.

src: 11. "If a son asks for bread from any father among you, will he give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will he give him a serpent instead of a fish?
tgt: "Kama mtoi chali anauliza mkanyo toka kwa mbuyu yeyote fulani kati yenu, mbuyu atamgeiaje stone? Ama akiuliza mbuta hivi, atamgeiaje nyoka badala ya fish?

src: 12. "Or if he asks for an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
tgt: "Ama akiuliza for an egg, je atamgei aje scorpion?

src: 13. "If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!"
tgt: "Kama nyinyi basi, mkiwa wakora, bado mnamesea kupeana gift poa poa kwa wakidi wenu, na sasa mbuyu wenu wa heaven vile mholy atageiana sasa gift ya ajabu aina gani ya holy spirit kwa wote wanaomwuliza!"

src: 14. And He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. So it was, when the demon had gone out, that the mute spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
tgt: Na kisha akitimua nje ka shaito, kenye kalikuwa bubu. Ikawa that nyakati pepo ilimtoka, yule jamaa bubu akaanza kubonga; hadi rende ikashangaa.

src: 15. But some of them said, "He casts out demons by Beelzebub, the ruler of the demons."
tgt: Lakini wasee kadhaa hapo wakasema, "Anatimua mashaitula akitumia Beelzebub, mdosi wa mashaitula."

src: 16. Others, testing Him, sought from Him a sign from heaven.
tgt: Wengine, wakipanga kumjaribu wakamtafuta awashow ishara from heaven.

src: 17. But He, knowing their thoughts, said to them: "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and a house divided against a house falls.
tgt: Lakini yeye, akijua fikira zao, akawashow: "Kila kingdom imejidivide against itself italetwa to its knees in destruction, na hao yenye imedividiwa against itself hu nesh.

src: 18. "If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? Because you say I cast out demons by Beelzebub.
tgt: "Ka devo amegawanyika against himself, kingdom yake itakaa how long imesimama? Ju mnasema mimi hutimua mashaitula na Beelzebub.

src: 19. "And if I cast out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your sons cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.
tgt: Na kama nina do operation kama hiyo ya kuchomoa shaito niki use Beelzebub , na nyinyi sons wenu hutumia nani kuzitimua? Hapo sasa, hao njo watakuwa jaji wenu.

src: 20. "But if I cast out demons with the finger of God, surely the kingdom of God has come upon you.
tgt: "Lakini ka nina timua mashaitula na mkono wa God, basi for real ufalme wa Kingdom ya God umekam juu yenu.

src: 21. "When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own palace, his goods are in peace.
tgt: "Ithaa mse ameshona, akiwa fully armed, ana guard palace yake, burungo zake ziko kwa amani.

src: 22. "But when a stronger than he comes upon him and overcomes him, he takes from him all his armor in which he trusted, and divides his spoils.
tgt: "Lakini the minute mse ameshona kumliko amkamia na kumshika na kumwahi terms of strength, ye hukwachu from him kila kitu chenye ali trust, na kudivide izo burungo.

src: 23. "He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
tgt: "Yule hayuko na mimi ako against mimi, na yule hana shughuli ya ku gather na mimi ana scatter.

src: 24. "When an unclean spirit goes out of a man, he goes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, 'I will return to my house from which I came.'
tgt: "Shaitula akitemwa toka kwa msee, huishia places zingine dry sana, akitafuta place ya kutuliza; akikosa hata moja, ye hudai,'Joh. nitarejelea ile hao, place nilin'golewa.

src: 25. "And when he comes, he finds it swept and put in order.
tgt: "Na wakati atakam, apate hao imesweepiwa na kuwekwa in order.

src: 26. "Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter and dwell there; and the last state of that man is worse than the first."
tgt: "Kisha hapo sasa ataishia asake shaito wale seven mambo bad kumliko, na waingie na kutulia hapo; hadi ile state ya yule msee ya mwisho ni mbovu kuliko hata ya fao."

src: 27. And it happened, as He spoke these things, that a certain woman from the crowd raised her voice and said to Him, "Blessed is the womb that bore You, and the breasts which nursed You!"
tgt: Na ikahappen, vile akibonga izi vitu, kulikuwa na jamaa fulani toka kwa ile rende akashot kwa voite ya juu akisema,"Imeblessika ile tumbo ya mamaako ilikuzaa

src: 28. But He said, "More than that, blessed are those who hear the word of God and keep it!"
tgt: Lakini akawashow, "Zaidi ya hapo, rather wameblessika sana wale wasee wameskia ile word ya sir godi na kuitimiza kwa life zao!"

src: 29. And while the crowds were thickly gathered together, He began to say, "This is an evil generation. It seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
tgt: Na vile zile crowd zilikuwa zimegather na njaro ya maajabu pamoja, akaanza kubonga akisema, "Hii ni generation wicked. Wanatafuta sign, lakini hakuna sign itageianwa except ile ya Jonah the prophet.

src: 30. "For as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so also the Son of Man will be to this generation.
tgt: "Ju vile tu Jonah alikuwaga ishara kwa wasee wa nineveh, ivo tu njo mtoi wa adam ako tu kwa hii generation.

src: 31. "The queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and indeed a greater than Solomon is here.
tgt: " Queen, don wa kusini atarize up siku ya kiama na wasee wa hii generation kuikemea, ju yeye alitoka from mwisho wa dunia kuskiza tu ile ujanja ya solomon; lakini saa mse mbwaku kushinda Solomon ako hapa.

src: 32. "The men of Nineveh will rise up in the judgment with this generation and condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and indeed a greater than Jonah is here.
tgt: "Wale jamaa wa nineveh wata rise up ile siku ya kiama na hii generation na kuicondemn, ju wali sha tubu time waliskiza preaching ya jonah na mse mmoja mnoma kuliko Jonah ako hapa.

src: 33. "No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a secret place or under a basket, but on a lampstand, that those who come in may see the light.
tgt: "Hanaku jamaa mwenye akisha ashalamp anaisunda place secret ama chini ya kikapu, lakini huiseti kwa stand yake, ili radi wale wasee wamekam ndani ya keja watacheki taa.

src: 34. "The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore, when your eye is good, your whole body also is full of light. But when your eye is bad, your body also is full of darkness.
tgt: "Koroboi ya mwili ni jicho.Ju ya hiyo stori, ka time macho yako ni poa, mwili yako yote itakuwa poa imejaa light.Lakini time macho yako ni mbovu, body yako pia itajaa giza.

src: 35. "Therefore take heed that the light which is in you is not darkness.
tgt: Kwa hivyo kuwa radar ile taa iko ndai yako isikuwe ni giza.

src: 36. "If then your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, the whole body will be full of light, as when the bright shining of a lamp gives you light."
tgt: "Kama ni ivo basi, yaani mwili yako yote iko imejaa light bila giza giza, mwili yote itakuwa imejaa taa, kama vile kumulika taa bright hukuletea mwangaza."

src: 37. And as He spoke, a certain Pharisee asked Him to dine with him. So He went in and sat down to eat.
tgt: Na akizidi kubonga, msee fulani pharisee akamwuliza aje atokee wadine pamoja. So JC akatokezea akaingia kejani akapoa down kudishi.

src: 38. When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that He had not first washed before dinner.
tgt: Ithaa yule pharisee alicheki situation, akawa ameshangaa sana vile jC hakuwa ameosha mikono kabla ya ka supper.

src: 39. Then the Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees make the outside of the cup and dish clean, but your inward part is full of greed and wickedness.
tgt: Time iyo JC akamshow, "Sa nyi nyi ma pharisees mna make nje ya cup safi na dish zikuwe clean, lakini ndani yenu iko imejaa tamaa na u wickedness.

src: 40. "Foolish ones! Did not He who made the outside make the inside also?
tgt: "Wasee pumbavu! Si yule mwenye alitengeneza nje pia alitengeneza ndani?

src: 41. "But rather give alms of such things as you have; then indeed all things are clean to you.
tgt: Si afadhali ugeiane msaada ya zile cargo uko nazo; alafu for real kila kitu kitakuwa safi kwako.

src: 42. "But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass by justice and the love of God. These you ought to have done, without leaving the others undone.
tgt: Lakini ole wenu mafarisayo! Ju nyi hu tithe hadi mint na spices kali na za kila variety, lakini mnalenga ku do vitu kama kupendana na love ya God ama kuhakikisha haki ime doiwa. Hizi njo mnge do kabisa bila kuacha ku tithe.

src: 43. "Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.
tgt: "Ole wenu mafarisayo! Ju nyi hupenda zile seats VIP kwa synagogue na kusalimika kwa sokoni.

src: 44. "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like graves which are not seen, and the men who walk over them are not aware of them."
tgt: "Ole wenu, scribes na ma pharisees, makabwela! Ju nyi ni kama kaburi zenye wasee hutembelea juu, na wasee wenye wako juu yao hata hawana habari.

src: 45. Then one of the lawyers answered and said to Him, "Teacher, by saying these things You reproach us also."
tgt: Kisha mmoja wa wale lawyer aakamjibu akimshow, "Mwalimu, ukisema hizi vitu unatusomea pia.'

src: 46. And He said, "Woe to you also, lawyers! For you load men with burdens hard to bear, and you yourselves do not touch the burdens with one of your fingers.
tgt: Akabonga hivi,"Ole wenu pia, wasee lawyers! Ju nyi hupanga wasee na mizigo mob ngumu kubeba, na nyi wenyewe hamna hata ile shughuli ya kuguza hizo mizigo hata na finger moja hivi.

src: 47. "Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
tgt: "Ole wenu! ju nyi hujenga zile kaburi za ma prophet, na ni mambuyu wenu waliwadedisha.

src: 48. "In fact, you bear witness that you approve the deeds of your fathers; for they indeed killed them, and you build their tombs.
tgt: "Kwanza, infact mnashuhudia that msha kubaliana na action za ma fathers wenu; ju cha ukwela waliwauwa, na mkawajengea kaburi.

src: 49. "Therefore the wisdom of God also said, 'I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they will kill and persecute,'
tgt: "Kwa hivo wisdom ya God akapanga aje, 'Nitawatumia ma prophets na apostles, na wengine mtauwa na kutesa,'

src: 50. "that the blood of all the prophets which was shed from the foundation of the world may be required of this generation,
tgt: "Njo ile blood yote ya ma prophets yenye ilimwagwa toka enzi za foundations za earth ikue demanded toka kwa hi generation,

src: 51. "from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah who perished between the altar and the temple. Yes, I say to you, it shall be required of this generation.
tgt: "Toka ile damu ya Abel hadi ile ya zechariah mwenye alidedi katikati ya altar na temple. Ndio, nawashow, itaulizwa toka kwa hii generation.

src: 52. "Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in you hindered."
tgt: "Ole wenu malawyer! Ju mmewanyang'anya wasee kifunguo ya knowledge. Hamkuingia nyi wenyewe, nawale walikuwa wana try kuingia mliwazuia."

src: 53. And as He said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to assail Him vehemently, and to cross-examine Him about many things,
tgt: Na vile alisema hizi vitu kwao, wale waandishi wa religion na mapharisees wakaanza kumhanda vi meja, na kum question ju ya vitu mob,

src: 54. lying in wait for Him, and seeking to catch Him in something He might say, that they might accuse Him.
tgt: wakipangia wakimngoja kumget, wakijaribu kumshika kwa njia moja kupitia something angebonga njo wam arrest.

src: Luka Flow ya Kinde - Luke 10 1.After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.
tgt: Baada ya theya, bwana JC aka appoint wasee seventy two wengine na kuwasend limbi limbi mbele yake kwa kila tao na mtaa yenye alipangia kupitia.

src: 2.He told them, "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.
tgt: Akawashow,"Harvest imeiva jo na ni mob! Lakini wasee wa jobnjo wa few sana.Uliza sonkwo wa harvest,ju ya hiyo stori, atume wasee wa wax ndani ya shake yake ya mazao.

src: 3.Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.
tgt: Ishia! Nawasend nje ka watoi wa kondoo kati ya mambweha.

src: 4.Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.
tgt: Msi kwachu hata walenje ama bag ama sandale; na msisalimie mtu yoyote kwa baro.

src: 5."When you enter a house, first say, 'Peace to this house.'
tgt: "Mkiingia kwa mbanyu, kitu ya fao kwanza muigotee ivi, 'Peace kwa hii keja.'

src: 6.If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
tgt: Ka mse wa peace ako apo, peace yako itatulia juu yake; kama hanaku, itawarudia.

src: 7.Stay in that house, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.
tgt: Tulia ndani ya iyo hao, sosi na udrink chochote wanawa gei, ju mboch anafaa mshahara wake. Msidunge kamzururo toka hao moja hadi ingine.

src: 8."When you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is set before you.
tgt: "Time mnaingia kwa tao na kukaribishwa, dishi ile kitu imeekelewa mbele yenu.

src: 9.Heal the sick who are there and tell them, 'The kingdom of God is near you.'
tgt: Ponya wale wagonjwa wenye wako na hapo mkiwashow niaje, "Kingdom ya sir Godi iko karibu na wewe.'

src: 10.But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,
tgt: Lakini mkiingia place ka tao hivi na hamjakaribishwa, ishieni kwa streets na museme aje,

src: 11.'Even the dust of your town that sticks to our feet we wipe off against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.'
tgt: 'Hadi ile dust ya tao zenu yenye imestick kwa miguu zetu tunapanguza off against you. Na mjue aje bila vako: Ile ufalme ya sir Godi iko karibu.'

src: 12.I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.
tgt: Nawashow, itakuwa better iyo siku for sodom kuliko hiyo tao.

src: 13."Woe to you, Korazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
tgt: "Ole wenu Korazin! Ole wenu,Bethsaida! Ju kama zile miujiza zili do iwa kwenu zinge do iwa Tyre na Sidon, wangekuwa walitubu zama za kale, wakiwa hadi wamedunga magunia wakipolea kwa majivu- sackcloth na ashes majamaa.

src: 14.But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
tgt: Lakini itakuwa better for hawa wasee wa Tyre na Sidon ile siku ya Judgement than for you.

src: 15.And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to the skies? No, you will go down to the depths.
tgt: Na nyinyi Capernaum, kwani mtainuliwa to the skies? Zii, mta go down hadi to the deep.

src: 16."He who listens to you listens to me; he who rejects you rejects me; but he who rejects me rejects him who sent me."
tgt: "Mwenye anawaskiza ananiskiza; mwenye amewakataa pia ameni reject;lakini yule mwenye

src: 17.The seventy-two returned with joy and said, "Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name."
tgt: Wale wasee seventy two wakarudi wamejazika sana wakashow JC, "Mdosi, hadi hata demons zimetu tii ju ya jina lako."

src: 18.He replied, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
tgt: Akawaelimisha ivi, "Nilicheki devo akianguka ka radi toka heaven.

src: 19.I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy; nothing will harm you.
tgt: Nimesha wagei say ya kucrush ma snakes na ma scorpions na kuovercome nguvu zote za shaito; hakuna kitu itawa harm.

src: 20.However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."
tgt: Lakini, msibambike ati ju devo zinawa obey, lakini jazikeni ju mko na namba kwa kingdom, jina zenu zimeandikwa heaven kwa roll call.

src: 21.At that time Jesus, full of joy through the Holy Spirit, said, "I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was your good pleasure.
tgt: Katika ile githaa JC, akiwa amejazwa na furaha ya Holy Spirit akabonga, "Naku praise mbuyu, mdosi wa heaven na earth, ju uli hide izi vitu from wale wasee werevu na wasomi, uka zireveal kwa watoi wa small. Eeh, mbuyuz, ju hii njo ilikuwa mapenzi yako.

src: 22."All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."
tgt: Kila kitu kimecommitiwa kwangu na mbuyuz wangu. Hanaku mse anaelewa yule son ni nani except buda wake, na hanaku mse anajua mbuyuz ni nani except mtoi wake son na wale mtoi son atachagua kuwajulisha.

src: 23.Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
tgt: Kisha akageukia disciples wake akawashow privately, "Zimeblessika zile macho zimecheki chenye mmecheki.

src: 24.For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it."
tgt: Ju nawashow kuwa ma prophet wengi sana na pia wafalme -ma-don walitaka kucheki chenye mnacheki lakini hawakucheki, na kuskia chenye mnaskia lakini hawakuskia."

src: 25.On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. "Teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"
tgt: Time moja pro wa law alisimama kum test JC."Tichaa, ni a must ni do what njo niget inheritance ya eternal life?"

src: 26."What is written in the Law?" he replied. "How do you read it?"
tgt: JC akamjibu, "Ni nini imechorwa kwasheria? We huisoma aje?"

src: 27.He answered: " 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind'; and, 'Love your neighbor as yourself.' "
tgt: Akajibu," 'Penda mdosi,sir Godi wako na heart muzima na nafsi muzima na nguvu zako zote na pia na mind yako yote'; na 'Penda jirani vile tu umejiluv.'

src: 28."You have answered correctly," Jesus replied. "Do this and you will live."
tgt: JC akamshow, "umejibu poa, do ivo na utaishi."

src: 29.But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
tgt: Lakini ju alitaka kuonekana kama mse ako righteous sana, bado akauliza JC, "Sasa, neiba

src: 30.In reply Jesus said: "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him and went away, leaving him half dead.
tgt: Kwa kumjibu JC akasema: "Jamaa fulani alikuwa aki go down from Jerusa hadi Jericho, na ile time akaanguka kwa mikono ya mathegi wale wazii.Wakamstrip nguo zake zote, wakamsunda vibare wakaishia wakamwacha ako tu karibu kudedi.

src: 31.A priest happened to be going down the same road, and when he saw the man, he passed by on the other side.
tgt: Sa priest fulani alikuwa akishuka na hiyo njia same tu, nyakati akacheki yule jamaa injured, manze akavuka baro zake akaishia.

src: 32.So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.
tgt: Pia bado msaidizi wa mapriest wa church, levite,akafika ileplace. Kumcheki ivi pia akavuka baro akapitia mbali aka go.

src: 33.But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.
tgt: Lakinijamaa samaritan,outcast wa religious community, akidunga safari yake, alikam place yule jamaa akikuwa; time alimcheki ivi manze akajazwa na huruma.

src: 34.He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, took him to an inn and took care of him.
tgt: Akaishia kwake akamfunika vidonda na elastoplast poa, akammwagilia mafuta kama vicks na disinfectant ya wine.

src: 35.The next day he took out two silver coins and gave them to the innkeeper. 'Look after him,' he said, 'and when I return, I will reimburse you for any extra expense you may have.'
tgt: Siku next akatoa munde, masilver limbi akageiana kwa yule mdosi wa lojo. Akamshow, 'Chekicheki mse wangu, alafu nikirudi, nitakulipa ile munde itakuwa imesalia ka bill extra yako.'

src: 36."Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?"
tgt: "Nani kati ya wote hao watatu njo ali do njaro ya maana ki neiba, akasaidia neiba wake mwenye aliwaiwa na ma thegi?"

src: 37.The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."
tgt: Pro wa sheria akamshow," Yule jamaa alionea boy huruma." JC akamshow, "Ishia na u do

src: 38.As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha opened her home to him.
tgt: Sa JC na wale disciples wake walikuwa njiani, wakafika kwa gherro fulani place madam anaitwa Martha aliwakaribisha kwa mbanyu yake.

src: 39.She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord's feet listening to what he said.
tgt: Madam alikuwa na manzi sis wake anaitwa Mary, mwenye alipoleaga kwa miguu ya JC akiskiza chenye JC alisema.

src: 40.But Martha was distracted by all the preparations that had to be made. She came to him and asked, "Lord, don't you care that my sister has left me to do the work by myself? Tell her to help me!"
tgt: Lakini Martha alikuwa ameshikika na job mob za kuandaa andaa chenye kili need kuandaliwa. Akaendea JC kumwuliza,"He,Bwana hata hau-care vile sis ameniachia janta yote peke yangu? Ebu mshow ani help!"

src: 41."Martha, Martha," the Lord answered, "you are worried and upset about many things,
tgt: JC Akamwita, "Manze Martha Jo, Martha, mbona una shtukia na kukasirikia vitu mo-ob,

src: 42. but only one thing is needed. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her."
tgt: lakini kitu mojatu njo inatakikana. Mary ashachagua chenye ni better, na hatawai nyang'anywa."

src: Luka Flow ya tisa -Luke 9 1.When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,
tgt: Wakati aliita meeting ya wale twelve tugetha, aliwagei powers na say ya kuhepesha na kutimua mashaitula zote za kila variety na kuponya magonjwa,

src: 2.and he sent them out to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
tgt: alafu akawa send waishie nje ku preach word ya kingdom ya sir Godi na ku heal wagonjwa.

src: 3.He told them: "Take nothing for the journey—no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra tunic.
tgt: Aliwashow aje: "Msichukue kitu any ya safari- sio mkongojo, sio begi, sio dibre, sio munde, wala clad za kuchange.

src: 4.Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that town.
tgt: Mbanyu yoyote mnadonjo, kaeni hapo hadi ile maithaa mtachomoka toka iyo tao.

src: 5.If people do not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave their town, as a testimony against them."
tgt: Kama wasee watagwaya kuwakaribisha, tikiseni hata ile vumbi ndogo imebaki kwa viatu mkiishia toka kwa tao yao, kama ushuhuda against iyo place."

src: 6.So they set out and went from village to village,preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.
tgt: So wakaishia out na wakazurura kila gherro hadi gherro, wakidunga waord ya gospel na ku heal waseiya wote kila di area.

src: 7.Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was going on. And he was perplexed, because some were saying that John had been raised from the dead,
tgt: Sasa Herod sonkwo wa miji minne, alipata fununu vile drama ilikuwa ikiunfold kama series. Akashangaa vi excess, ju wasee wengine walikuwa wakisema ati Johnie alikuwa amekam back from the dead.

src: 8.others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.
tgt: wengine ati Elijah alikuwa ametokezea, na hadi wengine ati mmoja wa ma higher man from the history pages tenee alikuwa amefufuka.

src: 9.But Herod said, "I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?" And he tried to see him.
tgt: Lakini Herod akabonga vi cool, "Nilichinja Johnie. Nani basi huyu ambaye naskia stori zake ajabb ajabb?" So aka try kumcheki.

src: 10.When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,
tgt: Nyakati wale apostles walirudi ivi, walirudisha dossier ya uzito kwa JC vile action ilikuwa ime go down yaani.Naye after iyo akawapeleka retreat ya maana pamoja na yeye kwa tao fulani ilitwa Bethsaida,

src: 11.but the crowds learned about it and followed him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed healing.
tgt: Lakini crowd ilimesea iyo stori na wakamfuata bumper. Akawakaribisha na kuwabongesha ju ya ufalme wa sir Godi, naaka heal wale wali need ku healiwa.

src: 12.Late in the afternoon the Twelve came to him and said, "Send the crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside and find food and lodging, because we are in a remote place here."
tgt: Maafte hata karibu ikisha wale twelve wakamkamia wakamshow, "Show wasee wajikate njo waishie kwa zile gherro zimesurround hapa na mashinani wagatha dishi na lojo ju hapa wakitulia wamejiangusha, tuko jangwani jo!"

src: 13.He replied, "You give them something to eat." They answered, "We have only five loaves of bread and two fish—unless we go and buy food for all this crowd."
tgt: JC akawashow, "Wageini samo ya kudishi." Wakamjibu,"Enyewe tuko tu na loaf kobole, na fish limbi tu- unless tuishie ku buy dishi ya hawa wananchi wote."

src: 14(About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, "Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each."
tgt: (Ju kulikuwa na wasee ngiri five- clean game.)Lakini akawashow ma disciples wake ivi, "Washow wakae down na group za waee finje finje."

src: 15.The disciples did so, and everybody sat down.
tgt: Disciples waka do ivo, na kila mse akapoa down.
