src: 16.Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke them. Then he gave them to the disciples to set before the people.
tgt: Aki kwachu zile loaf koboch na fish limbi na akicheki heaven, ali give thanks jo,akazi vunja. Kisha akageiana kwa wale disciples wake waziseti mbele ya majamaa.

src: 17.They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
tgt: Wote wakadishi hadi zikawashinda, alafu kisha followers wa JC wakaokota juala twelve zimejaa vipande vipande za ma left over.

src: 18.Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, "Who do the crowds say I am?"
tgt: Time fulani, mara ile JC alikuwa aki pray solo na pia disciples wake walikuwa na yeye, aliulizaga swali, "genge ya wajamaa hudai mi ni nani?"

src: 19.They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life."
tgt: Wakajibu, "aah! wenginehu say we ni Johnie yulebaptiser; bado kuna wenye husay Elijah; hata wengine huzidi kusay we ni mmoja wa ma prophets wa tenee mwenye amerise to life."

src: 20."But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?" Peter answered, "The Christ of God."
tgt: JC akawauliza,"Lakini,na je nyinyi? Mnasema mimi ni nani?" Pitaa akadai, "Christo wa sir Godi."

src: 21.Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
tgt: JC akawashow vi strictly iyo stori isishoiwe mse yeyote.

src: 22.And he said, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life."
tgt: Alafu akazidisha ivi, "Mtoi wa adam lazima apitie mambo mob mazito na atemwe na wazae, mapriest wale wakuu na ma odijo wa religion, na lazima amadwe na ile siku ya tatu arise to life."

src: 23.Then he said to them all: "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.
tgt: Kisha akawshow wote: "Kama mse atakam baada yangu, lazima ajinyime na akwachu cross

src: 24.For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me will save it.
tgt: Ju ule mse anawant kuokolea life yake ataipoteza, lakini yule mse atapoteza life yake ju ya mi ataiokolea.

src: 25.What good is it for a man to gain the whole world, and yet lose or forfeit his very self?
tgt: So sasa, ni kitu gani nzuri kwa hii situation, ati mse amekwachu world yote, na yet amepoteza nafsi yake for good,the living him, kabisa?

src: 26.If anyone is ashamed of me and my words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
tgt: Kama mse any ako na aibu ju yangu na ma words zangu, basi hadi son of man atakuwa na aibu ju yake ile day atakam na utukufu wake na pia glory ya mbuyu wake na wale angels holy.

src: 27.I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God."
tgt: Nawashow ukweli, kuna wananchi wamesimama hapa hawataonja death before wacheki kingdom ya sir Godi."

src: 28.About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.
tgt: Baada ya siku kama nane after JC abonge ivo, alikwachu Pitaa, Johnie na Jayme wakaishia tugezza na kupanda mlimani ku pray.

src: 29.As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.
tgt: sa katika ile hali ya prayers ivi, appearance ya face yake ika change, na kladi zake zikawa zime bling zaidi ya flash ya lighting.

src: 30.Two men, Moses and Elijah,
tgt: Mtu limbi Mosee na Elijah,

src: 31.appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus. They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.
tgt: wakatokezea na gloriy ya maajabu, wakibonga na JC. Wakatia stori ju ya vile JC angejikata, chenye alikuwa tayari anaenda kusababisha pale Jerusa ihappen.

src: 32.Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.
tgt: Pitaa na maboi wale wengine mbe walikuwa wanadoze, lakini kucheki ivi waka rudi ritho na dabo, wakacheki glory ya JC na wale mtu mbili wamesimama na yeye hapo.

src: 33.As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah." (He did not know what he was saying.)
tgt: Sa wale jamaa wawili wakati walikuwa wakiishia wakiachana na jC,Pitaa akamshow, "Bwana niaje,si ni poa tuko hapa. Hata wacha tuseti hema tatu hapa-moja yako,moja ya Mosee na moja ya Elijah.' (Hakushikanisha ni nini anasema.)

src: 34.While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
tgt: Akiwa bado ananego, wingu ikatokea na kuwafunika, hadi wakaogopa vile walikuwa wakiingia ndani ya cloud.

src: 35.A voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him."
tgt: Holla moja ikatokezea kwa cloud, ikisema "Huyu ni son wangu, nishamchagua; mskizeni."

src: 36.When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves, and told no one at that time what they had seen.
tgt: Nyakati voice ilimada kubonga, wakajikuta wao na JC solo. Wale disciples wakanyamazia hiyo stori kati yao, na hawakushow mse any iyo time chenye walicheki.

src: 37.The next day, when they came down from the mountain, a large crowd met him.
tgt: Ile siku next. wakati walishuka mlimani, rende bwaku ili kutana na JC.

src: 38.A man in the crowd called out, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.
tgt: Mse mmoja kwa rende akaitana,"Teacher teacher! Manze nakuomba ucheki son wangu, ju ye njo mtoi wangu pekee.

src: 39.A spirit seizes him and he suddenly screams; it throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It scarcely ever leaves him and is destroying him.
tgt: Kashaito fulani ka humsumbua kanamshika alafu anaanza ku scream; inamtupa into shaking ingine wiked hadi anatoa foam kwa mdomo. Na haimsare hatakidogo hadi inam destroy.

src: 40.I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not."
tgt: Nili beg crew yako disciples waikemee iishie lakini hawangemake it."

src: 41."O unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you and put up with you? Bring your son here."
tgt: JC akawashow, "Oh! Manze nyi ni generation ingine unbelieving,kwa muda gani nitabaki na nyinyi nikiwavumilia? Leta mtoi wako hapa."

src: 42.Even while the boy was coming, the demon threw him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, healed the boy and gave him back to his father.
tgt: hata time ule boy alikuwa akikaribia JC, ile shaito ikamtupa boy k

src: 43.And they were all amazed at the greatness of God.While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
tgt: Na wote wakabaki kushangaa na vile sir Godi ni mnoma. Hali waki shangaa na iyo yote JC ali do, JC alishow disciples wake,

src: 44."Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men."
tgt: "Skizeni kwa makini chenye nataka kuwashow: Yule son wa man atakuwa betrayed kwa mikono ya majamaa."

src: 45.But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.
tgt: Lakini walikosa kunyita chenye hii statement ilimaanisha. Ilikuwa imefichwa from them, hadi basi hawakushika, na wote waliogopa kuuliza.

src: 46.An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
tgt: Basi tetesi ikazuka kati ya crew ya JC ati nani kati ya disciples wote njo alikuwa ana tosha. Nani alikuwa the greatest.

src: 47.Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.
tgt: JC, akimesea fikira zao, akakwaachu mtoi kapyenga akamfanya asimame hapo kando yake.

src: 48.Then he said to them, "Whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For he who is least among you all—he is the greatest."
tgt: Kisha aka washow, "Mse any mwenye atakaribisha huyu mtoi kwa jina yangu amenikaribisha; na mse any atanikaribisha amekaribisha yule alinisend. Ju yule mse msmall kuwashinda wotenjo atakuwa njo the greatest"

src: 49."Master," said John, "we saw a man driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us."
tgt: Johnie akadai, "Sonkwo," tulicheki jamaa ametia bidii anafyatua mashaito kwa jinayako na tuka try kumkanya, ju ye si mmoja wetu."

src: 50."Do not stop him," Jesus said, "for whoever is not against you is for you."
tgt: JC akamshow, "Msimstop, ju ule jamaa hayuko against you ako na nyinyi."

src: 51.As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
tgt: Maithaa zikifika za JC kuishia heaven, akajiamulia safari ya kufika hadi Jerusa.

src: 52.And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;
tgt: Na akasend courier services mbele jamaa, wenye waliishia mbele na instructions za kuseti mambo ikuwe poa, tayari ju yake;

src: 53.but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.
tgt: lakini wale wasee hapo walidinda kumpokea, ju alikuwa akiishia Jerusa.

src: 54.When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, "Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them?"
tgt: Nyakati wajamaa wa JC Jaymo na Johnie walicheki ivi, wakauliza,"Mdosi, unawant tuitie moto ifall from heaven juu yao iwamalize kabisa?"

src: 55.But Jesus turned and rebuked them,
tgt: Lakini JC akageuka akawakaripia,

src: 56.and they went to another village.
tgt: Kisha wakaishia kwa gherro ingine.

src: 57.As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, "I will follow you wherever you go."
tgt: Sa wakiwalk along baro, jamaa akadai kwa jC, "Manze nitakufuata kila place unaishia."

src: 58.Jesus replied, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head."
tgt: JC akamshow, "Mbweha zina keja kwa mashimo na ndush zina keja kwa nests, lakinimtoi wa adam hana ataplace ya kutuliza angalau kichwa chake."

src: 59.He said to another man, "Follow me." But the man replied, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."
tgt: Akashow jamaa mwingine, "Nifuate." Lakini boy akasema aje, "Sonkwo, ngoja first niishie kuzika mbuyu wangu."

src: 60.Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God."
tgt: JC akamshow, "Wacha wase wafu wazike wasee wao wafu,lakini wewe go upreach ile kingdom ya sir Godi."

src: 61.Still another said, "I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say good-by to my family."
tgt: Bado mwingine alibonga akasay, "Nitakufuata, bwana mdosi; lakini kwanza wacha nirudi nishow famo yangu Good-bye."

src: 62.Jesus replied, "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God."
tgt: JC akamshow niaje, "hanaku mse anaweka mkono wake kwa jembe na anacheki nyuma tena ako fiti kukuwa aki serve kwa Kingdom ya sir Godi."

src: Luka flow ya nane - Luke 8 1.After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,
tgt: Baadaye JC akakwachu safari hapa na pale toka tao moja na ghetto moja hadi nyingine, aki speak iyo good news, ya kingdom ya sir Godi. Wale twelve walikuwa na yeye.

src: 2.and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;
tgt: na pia ma madam wenye walikuwa wamecure toka mashaito na disease mob: Mary a.k.a Magdalene from mwenye mashaitula twelve ziliishia;

src: 3.Joanna the wife of Cuza, the manager of Herod's household; Susanna; and many others. These women were helping to support them out of their own means.
tgt: Joanna yule waifudhes wa Cuza, MD wa jikoni ya Herod pamoja na biashara za keja yake; Suzanna; na wengine wengi mafans. Hawa ma madamwalikuwa wakidunga support huduma ya JC from dongela zao.

src: 4.While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:
tgt: Ile time rende kubwa ilikuwa inatokezea na wasee walikuwa wanakam kwa JC toka tao moja hadi ingine, akachomoa stori ya hii parable:

src: 5."A farmer went out to sow his seed. As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds of the air ate it up.
tgt: "Mkulima aliishia kupanda mbegu zake moss moss. Katika shughuli zake za kusambaza mbegu, zingine zilidunda kwa baro; zikabondwa na wapita njia, alafu ndush zikakam kusherehekea.

src: 6.Some fell on rock, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.
tgt: Zingine zikadunda kwa mawe, na time zilitokezea, zile plants zikanyauka ju hazikuwa na unyevu nyevu.

src: 7.Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.
tgt: Mbegu zingine zikanesh kwamiiba, ambapo ziligrow up na miba hadi miba ikazinyonga.

src: 8.Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up and yielded a crop, a hundred times more than was sown." When he said this, he called out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."
tgt: Bado zingine zilinesh kwa mchanga bora zaidi. Zikachomoka na kuzaa zao, mara soo ya chenye kilipandwa. "Ile wakati alibonga ivi, akashout kwa wasee na sauti,mwenye ako na maskio kuskia, wacha askie."

src: 9.His disciples asked him what this parable meant.
tgt: Wale disciples wake wakam ask chenye fumbo ili mean.

src: 10.He said, "The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, " 'though seeing, they may not see;though hearing, they may not understand.'
tgt: Akawashow, "Ujuzi ya siri za kingdom ya sir Godi zimepeanwa kwenu, lakini kwa wasee wengine nabongain codes, njo" 'hata wakicheki kwa macho, hawataona; hata wakiskia, hawataelewa.'

src: 11."This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
tgt: "Hii njo maana ya the parable: Ile mbegu ni word ya sir Godi.

src: 12.Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
tgt: Wale kando ya baro ni wasee wanaskiza word, alafu matime devo anakam anachukua iyo word from hearts zao, njo wabaki hawawezi believe na ku sevika.

src: 13.Those on the rock are the ones who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, but in the time of testing they fall away.
tgt: Wale wako juu rock ni wasee wale wamepokea ile word na furaha mob time waliiskia,

src: 14.The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life's worries, riches and pleasures, and they do not mature.
tgt: Ile mbegu imeanguka kwa miiba insimamia wale wanaskia, lakini wakienda njia zao wananyongwa na worries za life,usonkwo na hepi,hadi wanakosa kuwa matured.

src: 15.But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.
tgt: Lakini ile seed iko ju yuu ya grao poa ni wale wasee wenye wako na roho ya kishujaa, roho poa, wanaskia word, wanaimesea, wanazidi nayo hadi izae fruits.

src: 16."No one lights a lamp and hides it in a jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, he puts it on a stand, so that those who come in can see the light.
tgt: "Hakuna mse huwasha light alafu anaiweka ndani ya jug ama chini ya bed. Badala, mse huweka light juu ya stand yake,njo wasee wote wanaingia kwa keja wacheki light.

src: 17.For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.
tgt: Ju hanaku kitu any yenye iko hidden yenye haita disclosiwa, na hanaku kitu imefichika ynye haitajulikana amakuletwa nje wazi wazi.

src: 18.Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken from him."
tgt: Kwa ivo kuwa msharp uchunguze sana vile unaskiza. Yule akonazoakageiwa more; yule mse hana, hata ile anadhani ako nayo atanyang'anywa.

src: 19.Now Jesus' mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.
tgt: Sa Mathake JC nama bro wake wakakam kumcheki,lakini hawangeweza make kumkaribia ju

src: 20.Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you."
tgt: Mse fulani akaambia JC, "Niaje,mathaako na mabro wako wamesimama nje wanangoja kubonga na wewe."

src: 21.He replied, "My mother and brothers are those who hear God's word and put it into practice."
tgt: Akawajibu,"Mathaangu na ma bro wangu ni wale wase wanaskiza word ya God alafu wanaiweka into bidii yao ya daily."

src: 22.One day Jesus said to his disciples, "Let's go over to the other side of the lake." So they got into a boat and set out.
tgt: Kisha siku moja ivi JC akashow wale disciples wake, "Tuishieni ile side ingine ya lake." Wakaingia kwa boat wakaishia.

src: 23.As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.
tgt: Sa wakisail, akadoze.Storm ikawashambulia wakiwa kwa lake, hadi hata mv faina ilakwa tayari itazama, wakawa in grave danger yaani.

src: 24.The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we're going to drown!" He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.
tgt: Wale disciples wakaishia kumwamsha, wakidai, "Bwana mdosi joh, kuna vile tuta drown ya kabisa! Akarauka akazomea wind na zile waves crazy; storm ikatulia, na kila kitu kikatulia.

src: 25."Where is your faith?" he asked his disciples.In fear and amazement they asked one another, "Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him."
tgt: JC akawashow "Kwani faith yenu iko wea?" Wakiwa wamegwaya na bado pia wameshangaa wakaulizana, "kwani huyu ni nani?" Anacommand hadi wind na maji, na zinamu obey."

src: 26.They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.
tgt: Waka sail hadi ile hood ya Gerasenes, yenye ni across lake toka Galilee

src: 27.When Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothes or lived in a house, but had lived in the tombs.
tgt: Nyakati JC alistep kwa dry land ivi, alikutwa na jamaa mmoja demon possesed toka iyo tao. Jamaa alikuwa amewaacha kitambo, ju hata hakuwa akikladi ama akiishi kejani, lakini aliishi kwa grave yard.

src: 28.When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell at his feet, shouting at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don't torture me!"
tgt: Vile alimcheki JC ivi, alicry out na akaanguka down kwa miguu yake, akishout on the top of his voice, "Unawant nini na mimi JC wa nazareth,mtoi chali wa sir Godi Jah almighty? Please nakuomba, usini torture!"

src: 29.For Jesus had commanded the evil spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was chained hand and foot and kept under guard, he had broken his chains and had been driven by the demon into solitary places.
tgt: Ju JC tayari alikuwa amemfungulia war akicommand iyo shaitula iishie from yule jamaa. Mara mob ilikuwa ikimshika, na hata kama alikuwa amufungwa na chains mikono na miguu na alikuwa under guard, bado angezivunja alafu apelekwe na force kwa places zenye angebaki solo.

src: 30.Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" "Legion," he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
tgt: JC akamwuliza, "Jina yako ni who?" Akajibu, "Legion, Ju mashaito wengi walikuwa wameingia kwa soul yake.

src: 31.And they begged him repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.
tgt: Alafu wakambeg mara kwa mara asiwapeleke ndani ya bottomless pit.

src: 32.A large herd of pigs was feeding there on the hillside. The demons begged Jesus to let them go into them, and he gave them permission.
tgt: Kundi la nguruwe wengi walikuwa wakitia ndani pale by the hillside.Shaito zika beg JC ati awakubali waingie ndani ya nguruwe, akawagei perm waishie.

src: 33.When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
tgt: Zile shaito zilitoka nje yayule mse, wakaingia kwa nguruwe, na ile group yote ya nguruwe ikatoka teke wakateremka down mtere steep hadi ndani ya lake wakadrowniwa.

src: 34.When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside,
tgt: Nyakati wale wachungaji wa nguruwe walicheki ile drama ya pigs, wakatoka mbio wakaishia ku report iyo stori kwa ma ocha na tao hapo karibu.

src: 35.and the people went out to see what had happened. When they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus' feet, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
tgt: na wasee wakaishia nje ya ma keja kucheki ni nini ilikuwa imehappen.Walipokam kwa JC wakanotice yule jamaa mwenye mashaito zilikuwa zimemtema, akipolea chini ya miguu ya

src: 36.Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.
tgt: Wale walikuwa wamecheki iyo saga wakashow wasee news za vile yulejamaa alikuwa

src: 37.Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them,because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.
tgt: Kisha wasee wote wa hiyo ntaa ya Gerasenes wakapeaJC eviction notice aishie, ju walikuwa wamewezwa na uwoga. So akaingia mv faina yake akaishia.

src: 38.The man from whom the demons had gone out begged to go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,
tgt: Yule jamaa mwenye alikuwa amekuwa free from mashaito akambembeleza ati waishie na yeye, lakini JC akamtua aishia zake akimshow,

src: 39"Return home and tell how much God has done for you." So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.
tgt: "Rudi mtaani mseiya uwashow vile vitu sir Godi ame kuduiya." So jamaa akishia

src: 40.Now when Jesus returned, a crowd welcomed him, for they were all expecting him.
tgt: Sa vile JC alirudi, rende bwaku ilimkaribisha, ju wote walikuwa wanam chillia.

src: 41.Then a man named Jairus, a ruler of the synagogue, came and fell at Jesus' feet, pleading with him to come to his house
tgt: Kisha jamaa anaitwa Jairus, sonkwo wa synagogue, akakam akaanguka kwa miguu ya JC,

src: 42.because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying.As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.
tgt: Ju dote wake wa pekee, manzi ana miaka kama twelve ivi, alikuwa ana kick. JC akiishia ivi kumcheki, rende karibu wamsage sage.

src: 43.And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years,but no one could heal her.
tgt: Na matha fulani mwenye alikuwa hapo alikuwa na shida ya mentral cycle yake miaka twelve,lakini hakuna msee alieza mheal.

src: 44.She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.
tgt: Alikam nyuma ya JC akagusa pindu ya koti yake, namaraone akapona- damu ikaacha ku bleed.

src: 45."Who touched me?" Jesus asked.When they all denied it, Peter said, "Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you."
tgt: "Nani aliniguza?"JC akauliza. Wote wakamshow hawajui,Pitaa akasema,"Sonkwo, wasee wamejazana ile mbaya hadi wanakuskuma."

src: 46.But Jesus said, "Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me."
tgt: Lakini JC akazidi, "Kuna mse amenigusa; najua ivo ju nilihisi nguvu zimenitoka."

src: 47.Then the woman, seeing that she could not go unnoticed, came trembling and fell at his feet. In the presence of all the people, she told why she had touched him and how she had been instantly healed.
tgt: Nyakati izo, yule matha akamesea hawezi epa tu ivo vi discreet, so akakam akitetemeka akaanguka kwa miguu yake.Mbele ya wasee wote, akaeleza kwa nini alikuwa amemgusa JC na vile aliponywa vi instantly.

src: 48.Then he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."
tgt: JC akamshow niaje, "Dotee wangu, faith yako imekuokolea healing. Ishia na amani."

src: 49.While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue ruler. "Your daughter is dead," he said. "Don't bother the teacher any more."
tgt: JC akizidi kubongabonga, mse toka kejani kwa Jairus, sonkwo, mdosi wa synagogue akawasili na the news."Dote wako asha kick, usi sumbue mwalimu tena."

src: 50.Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, "Don't be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed."
tgt: Kuskia ivo, JC akamshow niaje, "Usiwe na ma woga;we amini tu, na atakuwa healed."

src: 51.When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child's father and mother.
tgt: Ithaa alifika kwa mbanyu ya Jairo, alikataza wase wote wasiingie ndani except Pitaa, Johnie na Jaymo, na pia mbuyuz na muthama wa mtoi.

src: 52.Meanwhile, all the people were wailing and mourning for her. "Stop wailing,"Jesus said. "She is not dead but asleep."
tgt: Iyo time yote, wasee walikuwa wakilia na kuomboleza juu ya yule dotee.JC akawashow

src: 53.They laughed at him, knowing that she was dead.
tgt: Wakamchekelea ju walikuwa wanajua manzi asha die.

src: 54.But he took her by the hand and said, "My child, get up!"
tgt: Lakini akachukua mkono wa yule manzi akasema,"Mtoi wangu, rauka!"

src: 55.Her spirit returned, and at once she stood up. Then Jesus told them to give her something to eat.
tgt: Roho yake ikarudi, na mara one akasimama. Kisha jC akawashow wampatie samo ya kudishi at least.

src: 56.Her parents were astonished, but he ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
tgt: Maparo wa mkidi wakashangaa,akapeana amri wasishow wasee wowote chenye kimehapen.

src: Luka chapta ya seven -Luke 7 1.When Jesus had finished saying all this in the hearing of the people, he entered Capernaum.
tgt: Time JC alimada kubonga hizi preaching zote kwa wasikilizaji, akadonjo Capernaum.

src: 2.There a centurion's servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.
tgt: Kulikuwa na mboch fulani wa mdosi wa jeshi, na huyo jamaa alikuwa favorite wa mdosi, lakini alikuwa msick hadi anachungulia kaburi hivi joh.

src: 3.The centurion heard of Jesus and sent some elders of the Jews to him, asking him to come and heal his servant.
tgt: Sonkwo wa jeshi akapima stori za JC vile alikuwaga aki do hadi aka send wazae fulani majews kuishia kwa JC angalau akam kuheal mboch wake.

src: 4.When they came to Jesus, they pleaded earnestly with him, "This man deserves to have you do this,
tgt: Time walikutana na JC, walimbembeleza ile meja wakidai, "Huyu jamaa ana deserve um do-iye ivo tu yaani,

src: 5.because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue."
tgt: ju ni mse ako na one love for the nation au sio hadi amejenga synagogi yetu jamaa."

src: 6.So Jesus went with them.He was not far from the house when the centurion sent friends to say to him: "Lord, don't trouble yourself, for I do not deserve to have you come under my roof.
tgt: So JC akamesea hiyo pleading yao akaishia nao. Akifika place si farthest ivo ana approach keja, mdosi wa jeshi ya wasee soo akatuma ma beshte zake kumshow; "Bwana mdosi, usihustle sana, ju mi sina nyathi enuff ya we kucheck in chini ya roof ya crib ya mine.

src: 7.That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.
tgt: Yaani siko hata worthy ya kukusogelea kukucheki. Lakini bonga tu hiyo word, na mboch wangu ataepuka manze. Atapona.

src: 8.For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and that one, 'Come,' and he comes. I say to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."
tgt: Ju mi mwenyewe ni sonkwo mwenye kusema, na masoja wako chini yangu. Mi hushow tu soja mmoja,'Ishia,' na ana go; alafu na show soja mwingine 'Kuja hapa,' na anakam teke. Nashow tu mboch wangu

src: 9.When Jesus heard this, he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following him, he said, "I tell you, I have not found such great faith even in Israel."
tgt: Nyakati JC aliskizia hiyo vibe, akajazika sana vile hiyo faith ilikuwa mbele hadi imetiwa chumvi mse, hadi akageukia rende ilikuwa imemfuata akawashow, "Nawaambia, sijaget imani mzito hivo hata ndani ya Israel yote."

src: 10.Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.
tgt: Kisha wale wazeiya wenye walikuwa wametumwa wakarejea kwa hao wakaget jamaa alishapona.

src: 11.Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.
tgt: Time kidogo baadaye, JC akaishia tao inaitwa Nain, na wale disciples wake na crowd wakaishia pamoja na yeye.

src: 12.As he approached the town gate, a dead person was being carried out—the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.
tgt: Akikaribia ile gate ya tao, a dead jamaa alikuwa akitolewa nje- mtoi only wa mathaake, na kuongezea alikuwa widow. Na rende bwaku toka kwa tao ilikuwa na yeye.

src: 13.When the Lord saw her, his heart went out to her and he said, "Don't cry."
tgt: Manze bwana mdosi JC kumcheki madam, heart yake ikuwa touched ju yake akamshow, "Usilie."

src: 14.Then he went up and touched the coffin, and those carrying it stood still. He said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!"
tgt: Kisha akasogelea hadi akagusa ile coffin, wale wasee walikuwa wanaibeba wakasimama still. Akasema, " Kijana, nakushow, rauka!"

src: 15.The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
tgt: Jamaa mwenye alikuwa amededi akaketi up, akaanza kubonga, na JC akampeana back kwa mathaake.

src: 16.They were all filled with awe and praised God. "A great prophet has appeared among us," they said. "God has come to help his people."
tgt: Manze wasee wote walikuwa hapo wakafurahi na kupraize sir Godi. Wakadai " Prophet mnoma ametokezea among us,"Jah almighty amecome kusaidia wasee wake."

src: 17.This news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding country.
tgt: Hizi habari about JC zikaenea kote mitaani Judea na zile hood na ocha zimeisurround.

src: 18.John's disciples told him about all these things. Calling two of them,
tgt: Madisciple wa Johnie wakamshow hizi vitu zote. Akawaita wasee wake mtu limbi,

src: 19.he sent them to the Lord to ask, "Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?"
tgt: Aka wasend na sms kwa bwana Jesus kuulizia, "Ero! Ni wewe yule jamaa alikuwa akam, ama tuzidi kupolea tukingoja mwingine?"

src: 20.When the men came to Jesus, they said, "John the Baptist sent us to you to ask, 'Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?' "
tgt: Time wale majamaa limbi walikam kwa JC, walidai, 'Johnie the baptizer ametutuma kwako na message, 'Je, ni wewe yule mse alifaa kukam, ama tudunge waiting tukitarajia another jamaa?'

src: 21.At that very time Jesus cured many who had diseases, sicknesses and evil spirits, and gave sight to many who were blind.
tgt: Hiyo hiyo ithaa JC akakuwa wax meja aki heal wasee wenye maradhi mob, ma diseases na mashaito, hadi akageiana sight kwa wengi wenye walikuwa blind.

src: 22.So he replied to the messengers, "Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
tgt: Kwa ivo akawajibu wale jamaa, "ishieni mrudi kwa Johnie na ripoti ya chenye mmecheki na kusorora: Wasee blind wanaget kuona tena, wasee vilema wana walk, wasee wako na leprosy wanasafishwa, wasee deaf wanaskia, na wasee dead wako alive tena, hadi pia good news inafika mashinani kwa wasee wamesota.

src: 23.Blessed is the man who does not fall away on account of me."
tgt: Ameblessika yule mse haja fall away ju ya works ama CV yangu."

src: 24.After John's messengers left, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: "What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed swayed by the wind?
tgt: Kisha time wale disciples wa Johnie walijikata, JC akaanza kubonga ju ya Johnie kwa wasee wa rende ilikuwa:"mlienda out kulekwa jungle kucheki what? Nyasi ziki dance kwa wind?

src: 25.If not, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? No, those who wear expensive clothes and indulge in luxury are in palaces.
tgt: Kama sio hiyo, mliishia out kucheki nini? Jamaa amedunga cladi finest? Zi, wale jamaa wameng'ara designer na ku live it up in glamor hupoleaga kwa keja palacial.

src: 26.But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
tgt: Lakini ni what mlienda kusorora? Na je prophet? Basi nawashow, tena more than prophet.

src: 27.This is the one about whom it is written: " 'I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.'
tgt: Ju this njo the one ilisemekana about kwa writings:

src: 28.I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."
tgt: Nakushow, kati ya wote wenye wamezaliwa by women hanaku jamaa greater than Johnie; although yule mse msmallest kwa kingdom ya sir Godi ni greater than yeye."

src: 29.(All the people, even the tax collectors, when they heard Jesus' words, acknowledged that God's way was right, because they had been baptized by John.
tgt: ( Wasee wote , hadi hata wasee wa kuvcollectmune ya gava, vile waliskiawords za Jeso, wakatanua enyewe njia ya sir Godi njo ile bora zaidi, ju hadi walikuwa washa baptiziwa na Johnie.

src: 30.But the Pharisees and experts in the law rejected God's purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.)
tgt: Lakini wale mafarisayo na ma pro wa sheria walikwara njia na mpango wa sir Godi juu yao, ju walikuwa hawajabaptiziwa na Johnie.)

src: 31."To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
tgt: "Sasa, wasee wa hii generation nitawa compare na nani? Hao ni wasee aina gani?

src: 32.They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other: " 'We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not cry.'
tgt: Hawa ni kama watoi wadogo wamepolea kwa place yasoko wakipigiana makelele:

src: 33.For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'
tgt: Ju Johnie the baptizer alikam bila eating ama drinking wine, mkasay, 'Ako possessed na shaito.'

src: 34.The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, 'Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and "sinners." '
tgt: Yule mtoi wa adam akakam akisosi na aki drink, mkasay, 'Njo huyu mse mlafi na mlevi, beshte wa wasee wa kucollect munde tax ya gova na beshte ya "wenye madhambi."

src: 35.But wisdom is proved right by all her children."
tgt: Lakini wisdom inakuwaga proven right na watoi wake."

src: 36.Now one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, so he went to the Pharisee's house and reclined at the table.
tgt: Kisha mmoja wa mafaraisayo akamwita JC afike kwake ka supper ivi wasosi tugezza, na JC akacheck in kwa mbanyu ya pharisee bila kuhata akajiweka relaxation kwa tebo.

src: 37.When a woman who had lived a sinful life in that town learned that Jesus was eating at the Pharisee's house, she brought an alabaster jar of perfume,
tgt: Mrembo fulani alikuwa ameishi maisha ya madhambi tu kwa hiyo tao akaskia ati JC anadishi supper kwa yule pharisee, akaleta chupa ya pembe ya ndovu imejaa marashi,

src: 38.and as she stood behind him at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears. Then she wiped them with her hair, kissed them and poured perfume on them.
tgt: akastand behind JC kwa miguu zake akilia, akaanza kumwosha miguu na machozi yake. Kisha akampanguza na nywele yake, akamziss alafu akamwaga ile marashi kwa miguu yake.

src: 39.When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know who is touching him and what kind of woman she is—that she is a sinner."
tgt: Nyakati yule pharisee mwenye alimwinvite dishi alicheki ile drama, akajibongesha akidhani, "kama huyu jamaa alikuwa prophet, si angemesea ni nani huyu mwenye anamgusa na vile yeye ni manzi mwingine sinner."

src: 40.Jesus answered him, "Simon, I have something to tell you." "Tell me, teacher," he said.
tgt: JC akamjibu, :Simo, kuna something nataka kukushow." Simo akajibu,"Mwalimu, nishow,"

src: 41."Two men owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
tgt: JC akasay hivi, "Watu wawili walikuwa na madeni ya munde ya jamaa fulani mkopeshaji. MMoja alikuwa na deni ya soo tano, mwingine alikuwa na deni ya finje.

src: 42.Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he canceled the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"
tgt: Wote walikuwa wamesota hadi wameshindwa kulipa, ju ya hiyo stori akafuta izo madeni za hao mtu mbili kiroho safi. Unadhani nani atampenda zaidi?"

src: 43.Simon replied, "I suppose the one who had the bigger debt canceled." "You have judged correctly," Jesus said.
tgt: Simo akamshow,"Vile nacheki ni yule deni meja zaidi ilifutwa." JC akamshw, "Ume analyse correct."

src: 44.Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
tgt: Kisha akageukia yule manzi akashow Simo, "Unacheki huyu madam? Nilifika kwa mbanyu yako. Haukunigei wode any ya miguu yangu, lakini yeye aliosha miguu yangu na tears zake na kuzi wipe na nywele yake.

src: 45.You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.
tgt: Haukunikaribisha na Kiss, lakini huyu manzi, toka ile time niliingia, hajaacha kukiss miguu zangu.

src: 46.You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.
tgt: Haukunipaka oil kwa kichwa changu, lakini madam alinimwagilia marashi kwa miguu yangu.

src: 47.Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven—for she loved much. But he who has been forgiven little loves little."
tgt: Kwa ivo nakushow, madhambi zake kibao zimesamehewa- ju amependa zaidi. Lakini yule ameforgiviwa dhambi kiasi hupenda kiasi."

src: 48.Then Jesus said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."
tgt: KishaJC akamshow madam, "Dhambi zako zimesamehewa."

src: 49.The other guests began to say among themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"
tgt: Wale wageni wengine wakaanza kuulizana, haiya, "Huyu ni who hadi hata anaforgive dhambi?

src: 50.Jesus said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
tgt: JC akashow yule madam, "Imani yako imekuokoa; ishia na amani."

src: Luka Chapta ya sita-Luke 6 1.One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.
tgt: Sabbath moja JC alikuwaakipiga shortie kwa ma mei, na disciples wake wakaanza kuvuka na cobs za mei, wakizi rub kwa mikono alafu wakidishi zile mei soft.

src: 2.Some of the Pharisees asked, "Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"
tgt: Pharisees kadha wakawauliza,"mbona mna do chenyesi lega siku ya sabbath?"

src: 3.Jesus answered them, "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
tgt: JC akawashow niaje,"Kwani hamjawai soma chenye Davie ali do ile time ye na rende yake ya masoja walikuwa na maubao?

src: 4.He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions."
tgt: Alicheck in kwa hao ya sir Godi,akachukua ile dibre holy,akadishi chenye ni legal tu for ma priest kudishi. Hata akagei masoja wakedibre wadishi."

src: 5.Then Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."
tgt: Njo JC akawashow, "Son of man ni Lord wa sabbath."

src: 6.On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.
tgt: Sabbath ingine akaishia kwa synagogue akaanza kufunza, na mse mmoja alikuwa hapo mwenye mkono yake ilikuwa ime go through recession.

src: 7.The Pharisees and the teachers of the law were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
tgt: Wale pharisees na ma mode wa law walikuwa wanatafuta reason ya ku accuse JC, kwa hivo wakamcheki viseriously kucheki kama ata pull miracle ya healing on the sabbath.

src: 8.But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, "Get up and stand in front of everyone." So he got up and stood there.
tgt: Lakini JC alijua chenye walikuwa wanathink na so akashow yule jamaa na mkono ime go through recession,"inuka na usimame mbele ya kila mse." So akainuka akasimama hapo.

src: 9.Then Jesus said to them, "I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?"
tgt: Kisha JC akawashow, "Nawa ask, ni gani sawa na legal day ya sabbath: ku do poa ama ku do viwiked, kusave life ama kuidestroy?"

src: 10.He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He did so, and his hand was completely restored.
tgt: Akacheki wasee wote, alafu akashow yule jamaa,"stretch mkono yako."Aka do ivo na mara one , mkono yake ikakuwa poa- completely.

src: 11.But they were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
tgt: Lakini wakajam mbaya na JC hata wakaanza kuplot pamoja in secret vile wange do kwa JC.

src: 12.One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.
tgt: Moja ya hizo day JC aliishia kwa place ya mountain kupray, akaspend usiku-kesha akipray sir Godi.

src: 13.When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:
tgt: Nyakati morning ilifika, aliita rende ya disciples wake kwake akachagua wasee twelve, wasee ali make wakuwe apostles:

src: 14.Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
tgt: Simo( mse alikuwa an alias ya Peter), bro wake Andru, Johnie,Philo, bartholomew a.k.a barthez,

src: 15.Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Simon who was called the Zealot,
tgt: Mathayo, Thomas na Jaymo mtoi wa Alphaeus, Simon mwenye aliitwa mmoja wa ma revolutionary.

src: 16.Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
tgt: Jude mtoi chali wa Jaymo na Jude Ischariot, msaliti.

src: 17.He went down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coast of Tyre and Sidon,
tgt: Akaishia down nao akastand kwa place level. Rende bigi ya ma disciples wake ilikuwa hapo na wasee mob toka kila place ya Judea, toka Jerusa, na toka coast ya Tyre na Sidon,

src: 18.who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by evil spirits were cured,
tgt: wale walikuwa wamekam kumskiza na kuwa healed ma disease zao. Wale walikuwa wamehandwa na mashaito walipokea uponyaji,

src: 19.and the people all tried to touch him, because power was coming from him and healing them all.
tgt: na wasee wote wakatry kumgusa, ju nguvu ilikuwa inaflow toka kwake ikiheal wasee wote.

src: 20.Looking at his disciples, he said: "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
tgt: Akacheki ma disciples wake ivi, akawashow niaje:

src: 21.Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
tgt: Mmeblesika nyinyi wenye mko na maubao sasa,

src: 22.Blessed are you when men hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.
tgt: Mmeblesika wenye wasee huwa hate,

src: 23."Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their fathers treated the prophets.
tgt: "Hepi iyo siku na mruke kwa furaha, ju gifthamper yenu ni bigi vinoma heaven.Ju ivo njo wale mabuda wao wali treat ma higherman.

src: 24."But woe to you who are rich,for you have already received your comfort.
tgt: "Lakini olewenu masoknwo, ju msha sortiwa ma comforts zenu mkazipata.

src: 25.Woe to you who are well fed now,for you will go hungry. Woe to you who laugh now,for you will mourn and weep.
tgt: Ole wenu wenye mshashiba,ju mtaenda na njaa.

src: 26.Woe to you when all men speak well of you,for that is how their fathers treated the false prophets.
tgt: Ole wenu vile wasee hubonga poa kila saa ju yenu, coz ivo njo mabuda wao walitreat ma false prophets.

src: 27."But I tell you who hear me: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
tgt: "Lakini nawashow wasee wenye munaniskizia: penda ma haters wako, do poa kwa wote wanaleta hatred kwako,

src: 28.bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
tgt: bless wale wasee wanaku curse, ombea wasee wote wanaku mistreat.

src: 29.If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also. If someone takes your cloak, do not stop him from taking your tunic.
tgt: Kama mse anakuslap kibare kwa cheek moja, mpatie ile cheek ingine pia azidi. Ka mse anachukua mbwenya yako, usimkazie kuchukua hadi robe yako.

src: 30.Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.
tgt: Gei kila mse anadai help, na ka mse anakwachu mali yako any, usikwarena yeye arudishe.

src: 31.Do to others as you would have them do to you.
tgt: Do kwa wasee wengine vile tu ungedai waku doie.

src: 32."If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' love those who love them.
tgt: "Kama unapenda wale wasee wanakupenda, uko aje mbele? Si hadi wasee wa gizani hu love

src: 33.And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' do that.
tgt: Lakini uki do poa kwa wale wasee wana do poa kwako, utaonekanaje uko mbele? Hadi wasee wiked hu do ivo.

src: 34.And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' lend to 'sinners,'expecting to be repaid in full.
tgt: Na ukigeiana loan kwa wasee ukitarajia repayment, ni nini mpango ya mbele na iyo situation? Si hadi wase wa gizani hugeiana loan waki ngoja full repayment.

src: 35.But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
tgt: Lakini love ma haters wako, wa do-iye vitu smarta, hadi wagei loan bila interest ama

src: 36.Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
tgt: onyesha huruma, vile vile sir Godi mbuyuz wako ni mwenye huruma.

src: 37."Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
tgt: "Usi judgemse mtu wangu, na we pia hautakuwa judged. Pia usishatki, na we pia hauta shtakiwa. Forgive wasee, na we pia utaforgiviwa.

src: 38.Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you."
tgt: Peana, na itapeanwa kwako. Size poa imefinyiliwa down, ikashekiwa pamoja na ku overflow, njo itamwagwa kwa lap yako. Ju na ile kipimo una use kwa wasee, ivo ivo itapimwa kwako."

src: 39.He also told them this parable: "Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?
tgt: Pia akawashow hii parable: "Kwani mse blind, anaweza ongoza mse blind? Si watadunda wote kwa shimo?

src: 40.A student is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
tgt: Mstudent hawezi kuwa ameiva kuliko mode wake, lakini kila mse ameivishwa atakuwa ka mode wake.

src: 41."Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?
tgt: "Mbona mnacheki ile sawdust moja kwa jicho ya bro wako na lakini haushughuliki na ile mbao iko kwa macho yako.

src: 42.How can you say to your brother, 'Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,' when you yourself fail to see the plank in your own eye? You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother's eye.
tgt: Itakuwaje unaweza show mse wako, 'Bro, wacha nikusaidie kung'oa ile sawdust kwa jicho yako,' na hiyo ithaa umekosa kucheki ile mbao kwa machoyako? We kabwela, si kwanza un'goe sawdust yenye iko kwa jicho yako, alafu utacheki poa enough kung'oa ile sawdust kwa macho yabro wako.

src: 43."No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
tgt: "Hakuna mti poa inazaa matundambovu, ama mti fake inazaa matunda freshi.

src: 44.Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.
tgt: Kila tree inaget recognition kulingana na fruit zake. Wasee hawawezi okota mkuyu toka kwamiti za miba, ama grapes toka kwa magugu.

src: 45.The good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For out of the overflow of his heart his mouth speaks.
tgt: Yule mse mpoa hutoa vitu poa from ile mambo good iko kwa heart yake, na yule mse mwiked hutoa vitu wiked toka kwa ile vitu wiked imepangana kwa moyo wake. Ju toka kwa ile flooding ya heart mdomo hubonga.

src: 46."Why do you call me, 'Lord, Lord,' and do not do what I say?
tgt: "Mbona mnaniita , 'bwana mdosi, bwana mdosi,' lakini ham do chenye na say?

src: 47.I will show you what he is like who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice.
tgt: Nitawashow chenye ako kama yule mse mwenye amekam kwangu na kuskia ma word zangu na kuziweka kama bidii yake ya daily.

src: 48.He is like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock.When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
tgt: Yeye ni kama mse anabuild hao yake, mwenye alichimba vi deep na akawekelea msingikwa ile rock kubwa. Time flood ilihappen, dhoruba ikashuka lakini ile keja ilibaki wima hai shake, ju alikuwa ameijengapoa.

src: 49.But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete."
tgt: Lakini yule jamaa anaskia ma word zangu na lakini analenga kuziweka into bidii yake ya daily ni ka mse ali build hao kwa grao biula msinngi. ile time storm ili happen na dhoruba ikashuka kwa iyo hao, manzeili collapse na destruction yake ikawa njo kwisha."

src: Luka chapter ya Ngovo - Luke 5 1.One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, with the people crowding around him and listening to the word of God,
tgt: Siku one vile JC alikuwa akisimama kando ya Lake Gennesaret na rende bwaku ikimsurround na wakiskiza word ya sir Godi,

src: 2.he saw at the water's edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.
tgt: akacheki pale kando ya wode boat limbi, zimekuwa parked hapo na ma fishermen, coz walikuwa waki wash net zao.

src: 3.He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.
tgt: Akacheck in kwa boat moja, ile ina belong kwa Simo, akamshow niaje tusonge pale mbele kidogo toka kwa beach. Kisha akaketi down na akaanza kufunza wasee word akipoleaga kwa boat.

src: 4.When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch."
tgt: Nyakati alimaliza kubonga, alishow Simo niaje, "Sasa songesha boat hadi kule kudeep, kwa maji,na ushukishe ma nets njo ucatch fish."

src: 5.Simon answered, "Master, we've worked hard all night and haven't caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets."
tgt: Simo akamshow,"Mdosi,tumedunga wax kwa nguvu night nzima na bado hatujaget any.Lakini ju ni wewe umesema ivo, nitashukisha down ma nets."

src: 6.When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to break.
tgt: Time wali do ivo, walishika fish mob ya ajabu hadimanets zikaanza kubreak.

src: 7.So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
tgt: Kisha wakaanza ku-signal ma partners wao kwa ile boat ingine wakam wa wahelp, na wakakam kujaza boat zote hadi zikajaa zikaanza kusink.

src: 8.When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus' knees and said, "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"
tgt: Nyakati Simon Peter alicheki ivo, aka fall kwa knees za JC akasema, "Ishia na uniache bwana; mi ni msee wa madhambi!"

src: 9.For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
tgt: Ju yeye na wasee wake wote walikuwa wameshangaa ile size ya catch ya fish walikuwa wamekwachu,

src: 10.and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon's partners.Then Jesus said to Simon, "Don't be afraid; from now on you will catch men."
tgt: hadi Jamo na Johnie, ma sons wa Zebedee, ma business partner wa Simo, pia walikuwa wameshtuka. Kisha JCakashow Simo, "Usiogope mtu wangu; ju toka sasa utafish na kucatch wasee."

src: 11.So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.
tgt: Kwa ivo wakavuta ile boat juu kwa shore, wakaacha kila kitu na wakamfuata.

src: 12.While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."
tgt: Time ile Jesus alikuwa ndani ya moja ya zile tao, mse mmoja akatokezea along mwenye alikuwa amefunikwa na leprosy.Nyakati alicheki JC, akaanguka na face yake kwa grao,akambembeleza JC, "Lord, ka uko willing, unaweza ni- make clean."

src: 13.Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" And immediately the leprosy left him.
tgt: JC akareach out mkono yake akatouch yule mse. Akamshow, "Niko willing,kuwa clean!" Na mara one ile leprosy ikamwachilia.

src: 14.Then Jesus ordered him, "Don't tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them."
tgt: Kisha JC akamshow niaje, "Usimshow mse any,lakini ishia ujionyeshe kwa wale ma priest na upeane ile sadaka yenye Mose aliagiza ipeanwe njo ukuwe clean, kama testimony kwao."

src: 15.Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
tgt: Lakini ile news kumhusu ikaspread hata zaidi, hadi ma crowds za wasee wakakam kumskiza na kuwa healed toka kwa magonjwa zao.

src: 16.But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.
tgt: Lakini JC mara kwa mara alijitoa kwa rende akaishia place alikuwa solo kupray.

src: 17.One day as he was teaching, Pharisees and teachers of the law, who had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem, were sitting there. And the power of the Lord was present for him to heal the sick.
tgt: Siku moja akifunza, pharisees na ma odijo wa law ya Mose, wenye walikuwa wameng'oka toka kila village ya Galilee na Judea na Jerusa, walikuwa wamepolea hapo. Na nguvu ya sir Godi ilikuwa hapo ya kuheal the sick.

src: 18.Some men came carrying a paralytic on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.
tgt: Wasee wengine wakakam wakibeba mse paralysed kwa carpet na wakatry kumleta ndani ya keja kumwekelea mbele ya JC.

src: 19.When they could not find a way to do this because of the crowd, they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.
tgt: Vile hawakuget njia any ya ku do ivo ju ya ile crowd,waliishia ju ya roof na wakamshukisha akiwa juu ya mat wakampitisha ndani kupitia zile tiles hadi katikati ya rende, mbele ya JC exact.

src: 20.When Jesus saw their faith, he said, "Friend, your sins are forgiven."
tgt: Vile JC alicheki faith yao, akasema, "Beshte, dhambi zako zimesamehewa."

src: 21.The Pharisees and the teachers of the law began thinking to themselves, "Who is this fellow who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?"
tgt: Wale pharisee na wale ma odijo washeria wakaanza kufikiria aje,"Huyu ni nani mwenye anaongea blasphemy? Nani anaweza kusamehe dhambi except sir Godi alone?"

src: 22.Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, "Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?
tgt: JC akamesea chenye walikuwa wakifikiria akauliza,"Mbona mnathink hizi vitu kwa heart zenu?

src: 23.Which is easier: to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up and walk'?
tgt: Gani ni cheap stuff: kusema, 'Dhambi zako zimesamehewa, ama kusema inuka na utembee'?

src: 24.But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...." He said to the paralyzed man, "I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home."
tgt: Lakini njo mjue son of Adam ana say on earth ya kusamehea dhambi..." Akashow yule kilema, "Nakushow, inuka, beba carpet yako na ukitoe home."

src: 25.Immediately he stood up in front of them, took what he had been lying on and went home praising God.
tgt: Mara one akasimama mbele yao wote, akakwachu chenye alikuwaanalalia akaishia home

src: 26.Everyone was amazed and gave praise to God. They were filled with awe and said, "We have seen remarkable things today."
tgt: Kila msee akabaki amejazika akigeiana praise kwa sir Godi. Wakajazwa na mshangao wakabonga aje, "Tumecheki live live vitu za ajabu leo."

src: 27.After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. "Follow me," Jesus said to him,
tgt: After hii, JC akaishia out akacheki mse wa kucollect munde ya tax ya gava kwa Jina Levi ameketi kwa kiosk yake. JC akamshow, "Nifuate."

src: 28.and Levi got up, left everything and followed him.
tgt: Levu akarauka, akasare kila kitu akamfuata.

src: 29.Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.
tgt: Kisha Levi akahold paree meja for JC kwa kejani yake, na rende bwaku ya work mates wake wasee wa kucollect munde ya tax ya gava na wengine walikuwa wakidishi nao.

src: 30.But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and 'sinners'?"
tgt: Lakini ma pharisees na ma odijo wa law ya Mosee wenye walikuwa wametoka kwa sect same wakazusha kwa disciples wa JC, "Mbona mna dishi na kudrink na ma tax collector mna 'wenye dhambi'?

src: 31.Jesus answered them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
tgt: JC akajibu, "Sio wale wasee wako healthy wananeed doki, lakini wale sick.

src: 32.I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."
tgt: Sijakam ku call wasee wako poa na sir Godi- wako righteous, lakini wenye dhambi njo wa repent.

src: 33.They said to him, "John's disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking."
tgt: Wakamshow, "Ma disciple wa Johnie mara mob wako kwa prayer and fastng, hadi hata disciples wa pharisees, lakini wasee wako kila siku wanadishi na kudrink."

src: 34.Jesus answered, "Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?
tgt: JC akawajibu niaje, "Mnaweza make wageni wabwana harusi a fast nyakati ako nao?

src: 35.But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast."
tgt: Lakini maidhaa inakam, time bwana harusi atachukuliwa from them; hizo masiku wata fast."

src: 36.He told them this parable: "No one tears a patch from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If he does, he will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
tgt: Kisha akawashow hii fumbo: "Hakuna mse hurarua kipande ya nguo toka kwa kladi mpya na kuishonelea ka kiraka ya nguo old. Ju aki do ivo, atakuwa amerarua kladi mpya, na ile kiraka haiwezi match nguo nzee.

src: 37.And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.
tgt: Na hakuna msee huweka wine mbichi kwa wine skins nzee. Ju aki do ivo, ile wine mbichi itaburst zile skins, wine itamwagika na wine skine zitaharibika.

src: 38.No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.
tgt: Zi, kila wine mpya lazima iwekwe kwa wineskin mpya.

src: 39.And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for he says, 'The old is better.' "
tgt: Na hakuna msee baada ya ku drink wine old anataka ile new ju atasema, 'Ile nzee njo poa zaidi.' "

src: Luka ya nne -Luke 4 1.Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit in the desert,
tgt: JC akiwa amejazwa mzeiya, amejazwa na Holy Spirit, akarejea toka Jordan na akakuwa ushered na the Spirit,hadi desert,

src: 2.where for forty days he was tempted by the devil. He ate nothing during those days, and at the end of them he was hungry.
tgt: hapo kwa siku forty alikuwa akitemptiwa na devo. Hakudishi chochote iyo time, na baada ya them days akawa na njaa.

src: 3.The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread."
tgt: Devo akamshow niaje, "Kama wewe ni mtoi wa sir Godi, show hizi stones zikuwe dibre."

src: 4.Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Man does not live on bread alone.'"
tgt: JC akamshow niaje, "Imeandikwa: "Man hawezi live kwa dibre pekee. ' "

src: 5.The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
tgt: Kisha devo akam lead hadi kwa place juu na akamshow in a flash kila kingdom yenye ina exist kwa earth.

src: 6.And he said to him, "I will give you all their authority and splendor, for it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to.
tgt: Alafu akadai aje, " nitakugei kila say yao na kila glamor na mapepe zao, ju zimegeiwa kwangu,na naweza gei mse any na want.

src: 7.So if you worship me, it will all be yours."
tgt: Kwa hivo ukiniworship, yote itakuwa yako."

src: 8.Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.'"
tgt: JC akajibu, "Imechorwa: 'worship tu bwana sirGodi pekee na umserve yeye tu.'"

src: 9.The devil led him to Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple. "If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down from here.
tgt: Devo akam lead hadi Jerusa na akamseti asimame kwa ile highest point ya temple. Akamshow aje, kama wewe ni mtoi wa sir Godi, jiachilie u fall chini toka hapa.

src: 10.For it is written:" 'He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully;
tgt: Ju isha chorwa aje:" 'Atacommand angels wake kukuhusu kukuchunga vi carefully;

src: 11.they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.'"
tgt: watakuinua ju kwa mikono yao, hadi hata hauta jigonga mguuu kwa mawe.' "

src: 12.Jesus answered, "It says: 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test.'"
tgt: JC akajibu, "Word inasema: 'Usimpee bwana sir Godi wako exam ati kumtest.' "

src: 13.When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.
tgt: Nyakati devo alimaliza the great temptation, alimwacha hadi time ingine smarta.

src: 14.Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside.
tgt: JC akarejea hadi hood ya Galilaya ndani ya upako wa Holy Spirit, na 411 yake ikasambazwa kwaile ocha yote surroundings.

src: 15.He taught in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.
tgt: Akafunza kwa synagogues zao, na kila mse akamsifu.

src: 16.He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. And he stood up to read.
tgt: Akaishia hadi Nazareth, place alikuwa amegrow up, na on the sabbath akaishia ndani ya synagogue, kama kawaida yake.Aka stand kusoma.

src: 17.The scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:
tgt: Ile mbuku ya them days-scroll, ya prophet Izzo ikapeanwa kwake. Akai unroll hadi akapata place ilikuwa imeandikwa:

src: 18."The Spirit of the Lord is on me,because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to release the oppressed,
tgt: "Spirit wa God ako juu yangu, ju ameni anoint kupreach good news kwa wasee poor. Amenituma ku proclaim freedom kwa wasee wako jail na kurudishiwa sight ya wasee blind, ku release wasee oppressed,

src: 19.to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor."
tgt: kuproclaim ile mwaka ya favor ya God."

src: 20.Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him,
tgt: Kisha akaroll up scroll, akaigeiana back kwa attendant akatulia down. Macho ya wasee wote kwasynagogue ikawa imekwamilia kwake,

src: 21.and he began by saying to them, "Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing."
tgt: na akabegin kwa kusema, "Leo hizi scripture zimefulfiliwa kwa maskio zenu."

src: 22.All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. "Isn't this Joseph's son?" they asked.
tgt: kila mse alibonga poa wote wakiwa wamejazika kumhusu vile maneno matamu ilitoka kwa mouth yake. Waka ask, "Si huyu ni son wa Joseph?"

src: 23.Jesus said to them, "Surely you will quote this proverb to me: 'Physician, heal yourself! Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.' "
tgt: JC akawashow niaje,"kwa hakika mtanisomea hii proverb: 'Daktari, jiponye msee! Fanya

src: 24."I tell you the truth," he continued, "no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
tgt: Akazidi hivi,"nawashow ukweli,hakuna prophet ako accepted ndani ya home town yake."

src: 25.I assure you that there were many widows in Israel in Elijah's time, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land.
tgt: Nawapatia assurance kuwa walikuwa na widows wengi Israel time za Elijah,nyakati sky ilikuwa imefungwa miaka three na nusu na kulikuwa na famine meja kwa land nzima.

src: 26.Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon.
tgt: Lakini Elijah hakutumwa kwa wowote hao, lakini alisendiwa kwa widow fulani Zarephath kwa ile area code ya sidon.

src: 27.And there were many in Israel with leprosy in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian."
tgt: Na kulikuwa na wasee mob wenye walikuwa na leprosy Israel zile nyakati za prophet Elisha, lakini hanaku hata mmoja alioshwa clean- except Naaman mse m-Syrian."

src: 28.All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this.
tgt: Wasee wote walikuwa wametokezea synagogue wakajam mbaya wakati waliskia izo allegations.

src: 29.They got up, drove him out of the town, and took him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw him down the cliff.
tgt: Wakarauka, wakampeleka mbio hadi nje ya tao, wakamfikisha kwa cliff ya mlima penye tao ilikuwaimejengwa, njo wamtupe down kwa cliff.

src: 30.But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.
tgt: Lakini alipita katikati ya rende na akaishia zake.

src: 31.Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath began to teach the people.
tgt: Akaishia hadi pale capernaum, tao imesit in Galilee, na day ya sabbath akaanza kufunza wadhii.

src: 32.They were amazed at his teaching, because his message had authority.
tgt: Si wakajazika na ile system alitumia ku teach, ju message yake ilikuwa ina say.

src: 33.In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an evilspirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,
tgt: Na ndani ya synagogue kulikuwa na msee fulani alikuwa ameshikwa na shaitula imempossess.Akalia kwa sauti yake yote,

src: 34."Ha! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!"
tgt: "Ha! Unawant nini na sisi, JC wa nazareth? Je umecome kutufinish? Namesea we njo nani- mse mholy wa bwana sir Godi!"

src: 35."Be quiet!" Jesus said sternly. "Come out of him!" Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.
tgt: JC akacommand shaito, "Tulia kimya! Toka ndani yake!"So devo akamtupa huyo mse down mbele ya wasee wote akamtoka bila kum hurt.

src: 36.All the people were amazed and said to each other, "What is this teaching? With authority and power he gives orders to evil spirits and they come out!"
tgt: Kila mse akawa jazzed wakabongeshana, "Ni nini hii teaching? Akitumia say na power aanageiana ma-order kwamashaito na zinakitoa!"

src: 37.And the news about him spread throughout the surrounding area.
tgt: Na ile 411 kumhusu ikasambazika kote vijijini, kwa ile area.

src: 38.Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon's mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.
tgt: JC akatoka kwa synagoguena akaishia kwa hao ya Simo. Sa Simo, mathake alikuwa ana go through high fever, so waka ask JC amhelp.

src: 39.So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.
tgt: JC akainama akakemea fever, ikamwacha ikaishia. Akainuka mara one akaanza kufanya job ya waiter.

src: 40.When the sun was setting, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them.
tgt: Kisha nyakati solar ilikuwa ina set, wasee wakaleta wasee wote walikuwa na maugonjwa mob various, akawawekelea mikono akawaponya.

src: 41.Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Christ.
tgt: Kuzidisha, mashaito zikajichuja toka kwa wasee wengi zikishout, "We njo mtoi wa sir Godi!" lakini aliwashow ka warning wasibonge ivo, ju walijua yeye ni christ.

src: 42.At daybreak Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.
tgt: Sa at daybreak JC akaishia out kwa place solo. Wasee walikuwa wanacheck check out for him ako wapi so vile walimfikia place alikuwa, wakajaribu kumzuia from kuishia.

src: 43.But he said, "I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent."
tgt: Lakini akawashow niaje,"Lazima ni preach hizi good news ya hii kingdom ya sir Godi kwa hizi tao zingine, ju njo maana nilitumwa."

src: 44.And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.
tgt: Na akazidi kupreach kwa zile synagogue za Judea.

src: uka Tatu-Luke 3 1.In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar—when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene—
tgt: Sa ile mwaka ya fifteen ya utawala wa Tiberius Caesar- ile time Pontius Pilate alikuwa gavana wa Judea, ilhali Herod alikuwa mmoja wa wale wadosi four walirule Galilee, pamoja na bro wake Philo kuwa mmoja wa wale wadosi four walirule Iturea na Trachonitis, na also Lysanias akiwa mmoja wa wale wadosi four walirule Abilene-

src: 2.during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the desert.
tgt: matime wadosi wa mapriest walikuwa Annas and Caiaphas, ile word ya sir Godi ikamkamia Johnie mtoi wa Zachs ndani ya jangwa.

src: 3.He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
tgt: Akaishia kwa ocha zote na nchi yote imesurround Jordan, akitema word ya ku-baptiziwa kama show ya kusare dhambi na ku receive forgiveness ya madhambi.

src: 4.As is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.
tgt: Vile tu imechorwa ndani ya book ya mawords za Isaiah yule prophet:

src: 5.Every valley shall be filled in, every mountain and hill made low. The crooked roads shall become straight, the rough ways smooth.
tgt: Kila bonde litajazwa full,

src: 6.And all mankind will see God's salvation.' "
tgt: Na wasee wote watacheki kukam kwa salvation ya sir Godi. ' "

src: 7.John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
tgt: Johnie akasema aje kwa wale wasee walikuwa wametoka nje kubaptiziwa,"Nyinyi ma viper!Nani aliwapea warning njo mkahepa ile hasira ya God iko njiani?

src: 8.Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
tgt: Make-ini mafruit kulingana na repentance.Na msianze kujiambia, 'Tuko na Abraham ka mbuyu wetu.' Ju nawashow hivi, toka kwahizi mawe God anaweza wasimamishia watoi wa Abraham.

src: 9.The axe is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."
tgt: Shoka iko tayari kwa mizizi yamiti, na kilamti itafail kutoa fruits poa itatemwa na kuchujwa kwa nare."

src: 10."What should we do then?" the crowd asked.
tgt: Rende ikauliza, "Sasa tutado what basi?"

src: 11.John answered, "The man with two tunics should share with him who has none, and the one who has food should do the same."
tgt: Johnie akawashow,"Yule jamaa ana koti mbex asaidie mse mwenye hana hata moja,na yule mse ako na dishi pia afanye ivo."

src: 12.Tax collectors also came to be baptized. "Teacher," they asked, "what should we do?"
tgt: Wasee wa kucollect munde ya tax pia wakagatha kubaptiziwa.Wakauliza," Odijo, na sisi tu do what?"

src: 13."Don't collect any more than you are required to," he told them.
tgt: Akawashow, "msi collect munde more than yenye munafaa ku collect."

src: 14.Then some soldiers asked him, "And what should we do?" He replied, "Don't extort money and don't accuse people falsely—be content with your pay."
tgt: Kisha pia masoja wakamwuliza,"na sisi tu do what?"Akawashow ivi,"msi rushe wasee munde na msi accuse mtu na uwongo-tosheka ya mshahara yako buda."

src: 15.The people were waiting expectantly and were all wondering in their hearts if John might possibly be the Christ.
tgt: Wadhii walikuwa wametuliza kungojea JC ile noma wote wakishangaa kwa heart ka Johnie njo alikuwa ni christ lakini ameficha game yake.

src: 16.John answered them all, "I baptize you with water. But one more powerful than I will come, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
tgt: Johnie akawajibu wote one time, "Nawabaptise na wodee. Lakini kuna mse mmoja more powerful than mimi, mwenye atakam, na zile laces za sandale zake sina CV inatosha job ya kuzifungua.Ye atawabaptize na ile holy spirit na pia na moto.

src: 17.His winnowing fork is in his hand to clear his threshing floor and to gather the wheat into his barn, but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."
tgt: Uma yake ya harvest iko mkononi njo afanye clearance kwa floor yake ya kupepeta ngano,na hapo atagatha ile ngano kwa ghala, lakini atatia kiberiti achome ile taka taka yote ya ngano kwa nare moja haizimikagi.

src: 18.And with many other words John exhorted the people and preached the good news to them.
tgt: Akitumia maneno mob Johnie alichallenge wasee na kuwa preachia habari njema.

src: 19.But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of Herodias, his brother's wife, and all the other evil things he had done,
tgt: Lakininyakati Johnie alimkataza Herod mmoja wa wale wadosi four walikuwa wana rule ju ya Herodias waif wa bro wake, na ju ya zile vitu zingine zote wiked alikuwa ana do,

src: 20.Herod added this to them all: He locked John up in prison.
tgt: Herod akaongezea hii dhambi kwa zingine zote:akatupa Johnie kwa prison.

src: 21.When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened
tgt: Wakati wasee wote walikuwa wakibaptiziwa,JC pia alikuwa baptized.Na ile time alikuwa

src: 22.and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."
tgt: na yule holy spirit akamshukia physically kama dove. Na sauti ikatokezea heaven ikidai aje:"wewe njo mtoi son wangu,mwenye na love; na with wewe nimejazika sana."

src: 23.Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,
