src: 23."Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices—mint, dill and cummin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law—justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
tgt: "Ole wenu, ma mode wa sheria na mafarisayo, nyi makabwela!Mna peana tithe hadi ya ma Viungo zenu za upishi{royco zenu}.Lakini mme sare kuconsider zile vitu priority zasheria ka haki, huruma na uholy joe.Mgeanzia hizi na mkiendeleaga na tithe zenu.

src: 24.You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
tgt: Nyi madere blind! Mnachunga nzi toka kwa kinyaji aklafu mnameza ngamia.

src: 25."Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
tgt: "ole wenu, ma mode wa sheria, mafarisayo, nyi makabwela! Mnaoshanje ya kikombe {kuonekana poa mbele ya wadhii}na sahani, lakini ndani vimejaa ulafi na ubinafsishaji.

src: 26.Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.
tgt: farisayo kipofu! Si kwanza ng'arisha ndani yakikombe na plate, alafu kisha nje itakuwa safi.

src: 27."Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men's bones and everything unclean.
tgt: "Ole wenu, ma mode wa sheria na mafarisayo, nyi makabwela! Mko ka kaburi ya {karibu na nyayo} yenye hadi imepakwa rangi nyeupe ya white wash. Njeinakaa smarta lakini ndani zimejaa mifupa ya ma dead man kila kila kitu kichafu.

src: 28.In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
tgt: Hivo hivo, kwanje mnakaa ka mko poa, maholy joe, lakini ndani mmejaa ukabwela, uwikedness.

src: 29."Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.
tgt: "ole wenu,,mamode wa sheria na mafarisayo, makabwela!Mnajenga kaburi za wale ma prophet na ku pimp grave zao wale watu righteous.

src: 30.And you say, 'If we had lived in the days of our forefathers, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.'
tgt: Alafu mnadai,'Ka tungeishi zile enzi za magrand mbuyuz wetu, hatungewai kubaliana naoati tudedisha ma man of God-kumwaga damu yao

src: 31.So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.
tgt: So mnajihukumu wenyewe kwa wenyewe ati nyi njo wakidi wa wale waliuwa ma higherman.

src: 32.Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your forefathers!
tgt: Jazeni basi, ile kipimo ya dhambi ya mbuyus wenu wa kitambo.

src: 33."You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?
tgt: "Nyi Nyoka! Nyi maviper! Mtahepaje kutupwa kwa nare ya hell?

src: 34.Therefore I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.
tgt: Basi nawashow hivi, nitatuma ma higher man wangu, na wadhii walisha sharp. Wengine mtaua, wengine mtasulubisha wengine mtachapa viboko nadi yahekaluni zenu na mtaawafuatwa toka jiji hadi jiji.

src: 35.And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
tgt: So mtawekewa juu yenu ile damu yote ya wasee righteous yenye imemwagika ju ya earth, kutoka ile ya Abel hadi ile blood ya zechariah mtoi chaliwa berekiah ilimwagwa kati ya temple na madhabahu.

src: 36.I tell you the truth, all this will come upon this generation.
tgt: Nawashow cha ukwela, hiyo yote itakam ju ya kizazi hiki.

src: 37."O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing.
tgt: "O Jerusa, Jerusa, nyi wenye huua maprophets na kuwapiga mawe ma messenger, ni mara ngapi nime tamani kugazza watoi wenu tugezza, ka ngweks vile husakanya vifaranga zake chini ya wings, lakini hamna roho.

src: 38.Look, your house is left to you desolate.
tgt: Cheki, keja yenu imeachwa kwenu solo bila msee.

src: 39.For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.'"
tgt: Ju nawashow hivi, hamtanicheki tena kabla hamjasay,'Ameblesika mwenye alikam kwa jina ya sir Godi.' "

src: Mathayo Kinde mbe na mbe- Matthew 22 1.Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:
tgt: Jesus akabonga nao tena kwa mafumbo, akawashow:

src: 2."The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
tgt: "Ufalme wa heaven ni ka mfalme mwenye ali andaa paree ya strength; na ilikuwa ya wedo ya mtoi wake chali.

src: 3.He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.
tgt: Kisha akasend mboch wake kwa wale walikuwa wame make kwa guest list, njo wafike hiyo kayumbex, lakini wakadinda kutokea.

src: 4."Then he sent some more servants and said, 'Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner: My oxen and fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.'
tgt: Akatuma mamboch wengine zaidi akawashow,"washow hao wadhii wamepewa invitation hivi,'nimeandaa ki dinner cha nguvu: ndume yangu na ng'ombe wa kunoneshwa nimeshaa fanya kitoweo, nyam chom is kwa wingi, kila kitu hadi kiko ready. Kamuni paree ya wedo jamani.

src: 5."But they paid no attention and went off—one to his field, another to his business.
tgt: "Lakini wadhii hao hawaku bother na kila mdhii akajitoa kwa shughuli zake,kwa shakee, mwengine njo akazidisha bidii yake kwa bizna.

src: 6.The rest seized his servants,mistreated them and killed them.
tgt: Wale makubaff wengine wakawashika hao mamboch wakawatesa hata wakawadedisha.

src: 7.The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.
tgt: Sasa mfalme akapandwa na mori jo! Hadi akatuma jeshi yake kuwa waste wale wauaji na waka tia nare jiji yao.

src: 8."Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.
tgt: "Jamaa wakashoiwa na mfalme,'Bash ya harusi ni mbichi na imeiva, lakini wale wadhi nili invite hawaku kuwa hiyo level, hawaku deserve kufika.

src: 9.Go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.'
tgt: Ishieni kwa mtaa, mastreet corner na mualike wadhi wote mtakuta wafike.'

src: 10.So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, both good and bad, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
tgt: Kwa hivo mamboch waka hit the streets kusakanya wale streeet bums, chokosh, wadhi wendaa, mahawker kila mdhii bora walimkuta, so wakasakanya both wadhii wiked na wadhi wamestand ki character, hadi wedo ikashona mbaya na wageni.

src: 11."But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.
tgt: "Mfalme basi aka fika bash yake maraundi, kucheki wageni wake, akanotice jamaa moja hata hakuwa na cladi zina fit hiyo bash ya wedo.

src: 12.'Friend,' he asked, 'how did you get in here without wedding clothes?' The man was speechless.
tgt: Akamwuliza,'Beshte,is vipi uliingia paree bila hata nguo za wedo? Mdhii akabaki ameng'edhia.

src: 13."Then the king told the attendants, 'Tie him hand and foot, and throw him outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'
tgt: "Kisha mfalme akashow ma servant wake,'Mfunge guu na kono, mchuje nje, kwa giza, hapo kuna kilio na kugrind meno.'

src: 14."For many are invited, but few are chosen."
tgt: "Ju wadhi wote wanatumiwa ma invitation lakini wasee few wana pickiwa."

src: 15.Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.
tgt: Hapo wale pharisee wakarudi drawing board, kuchora mpango ya kumtega na maneno yake.

src: 16.They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren't swayed by men, because you pay no attention to who they are.
tgt: Wakatumana wadhi wao disciples pamoja na wadhi wa herod kwake. Wakamshow,"T.A, tunajua we ni msee wa nguvu kitabia, na kwa vile haunaga ukora ukora, pia vile unafunzanga way ya God ikiambatana na ukweli. Haupelekwi hivi hivi na wadhii, ju haupeigi attention ati ni kina nani.

src: 17.Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
tgt: Tushow hivi basi, ni nini stand yako? Ni poa kulipa ushuru kwa caesar au ni blunder?"

src: 18.But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, "You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?
tgt: Lakini JC,akiwasoma vile walikuwa na mpango wiked, akawashow,"Nyi wasee fake, mnona munatry sana kunitega?

src: 19.Show me the coin used for paying the tax." They brought him a denarius,
tgt: Nishow ie sarafu ya kulipa ushuru." Wakamletea denari moja,

src: 20.and he asked them, "Whose portrait is this? And whose inscription?"
tgt: alafu kisha akawashow, "picha ya who iko kwa sarafu? Na ni mchoro ya nani?"

src: 21."Caesar's," they replied. Then he said to them, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."
tgt: Wakajibu,"Ni ya caesar,"so akawshow,"ehee, peana kwa caesar chenye ni ya caesar, alafu gei sir Godi chenye ni ya sir Godi."

src: 22.When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.
tgt: Wakati waliskia hivo, wakang'ethia. Kisha wakjitoa hapo wakawachana naye wakaishia.

src: 23.That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
tgt: Siku hiyo tu same saduccees, wenye husema hakuna resurrection,wakakam kwa Jesus na swali{ka komishon of inquiry hivi}.

src: 24."Teacher," they said, "Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and have children for him.
tgt: "Mwalim, Mose alitushow ati mdhi akidedi bila watoi, basi bro wake lazma achukua huyo mjane alafu ampee ball on behalf ya {the fallen soja} bro wake.

src: 25.Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.
tgt: Sa kulikuwa na mabro saba kati yetu. Wa fao akamarry alafu aka kick, na ju vile hakuwa na wakidi, akawachia waif kwa bro wake.

src: 26.The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.
tgt: Kitu same ikatendeka kwa yule wa pili na wa tatu, hadi yule bro wa last, lakini pia huyo bro aka kick.

src: 27.Finally, the woman died.
tgt: Mwishowe, pia huyo waif akakick.

src: 28.Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?"
tgt: Kisha,je, wakati wa resurrection, huyo waif atakuwa legally wa nani kati ya hao wanaume saba, ju wote washa mmarry?"

src: 29.Jesus replied, "You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
tgt: JC akawashow hivi, "mko down na lojic yenu, iko wrong, kwa sababu hamjanyita ,ma chapter za scripcha au uwezo wa sir Godi.

src: 30.At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.
tgt: Kuki go down nyakati za Resurrection,wadhi hawatashughulika kuoana au kuolewa; watakuwa wamefanyiwa upgrade wakakuwa ka angels in heaven{kimaumbile}.

src: 31.But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,
tgt: Lakini kuhusu ma issues za kufufuka wadhii wamededi- hamjaskia chenye sir Godi amewanenea,

src: 32.'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'? He is not the God of the dead but of the living."
tgt: 'Mi njo sir Godi wa Abraham, sir Godi wa izzo na pia sir Godi wa Jacob?/ Basi ye si God wa wanaoishi lakini ni God wa walio alive."

src: 33.When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.
tgt: Rende ikapata hiyo stori vipoa, wakang'ethia vile alikuwa amefunza.

src: 34.Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.
tgt: Kuskia ati Jesus ame wapiga stopu wale saducees.ma pharisee wakajiundia kikundi{task force}.

src: 35.One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:
tgt: Mmoja wao, profesa fulani wa sheria, akamsetia exam ya his swali:

src: 36."Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?"
tgt: "T.A, ni gani njo ile commandment greatest ndani ya sherria?"

src: 37.Jesus replied: " 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.'
tgt: JC {iyo siku alikuwa ameiva mbaya} akamtupia jibu moss moss bila presha:" ' Penda sir Godi na moyo yako yote, na nafsi yako yote na na mind yako yote.'

src: 38.This is the first and greatest commandment.
tgt: Hii njo commandment ya fao na ile priority kubwa zaidi.

src: 39.And the second is like it: 'Love your neighbor as yourself.'
tgt: Kisha ya second na ka ya fao: 'Penda neiba wako vile umejipenda.'

src: 40.All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments."
tgt: Sheria zote na words za prophets zimeshuhaa kwa hizi commands mbe."

src: 41.While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
tgt: Nyakati hizo Pharisee wakiwa bado wamegazza tugezza, JC akatupia exam question,

src: 42."What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?"
tgt: "Mnafikiriaje hii stori kuhusu the christ? Ni mtoi wa nani chali?"

src: "The son of David," they replied.
tgt: Chap chap wakadai,"ni mtoi wa Davie."

src: 43.He said to them, "How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him 'Lord'? For he says,
tgt: So akadrop the bomb hivi,"mbonabasi hata Davie, ambaye ni mbuyu wale,akibonga na spirit ya Sir Godi anamwita,Bwana? Ju ye husay,

src: 44." 'The Lord said to my Lord:
tgt: "Bwana akishow bwana wangu:

src: "Sit at my right hand
tgt: bangaiza hapa chaliyangu, kwa mkono yangu ya right

src: until I put your enemies
tgt: hadi niweke enemies wako

src: under your feet." ' chini ya miguu yako." 45.If then David calls him 'Lord,' how can he be his son?"
tgt: Ka Davie mwenyewe anamwita 'Bwana,' itakuwaje tena akuwe mtoi wa Davie?"

src: 46.No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.
tgt: Hiyo exam ju ilikuwa mambo bad, kila mtu aliumaniwa akashindwa kujibu, kuanzia hiyo day hakuna mdhii airudi kum ask maswali zingine.

src: Mathayo kinde mbe na wahed-Matthew 21 1.As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,
tgt: Sa wakifikia kuget to Jerusa, njo wafike Bethphage juu ya mlima Olives, JC akatuma wadhii wake wawili,

src: 2.saying to them, "Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.
tgt: Akawashow niaje,"ishieni kwa gerro yenye iko mbele yenu tu hapo ivo, mara one mkifika tu hivi, mtacheki punda imefungwa hapo, na mtoi wake.Zifunulie mzibring kwangu.

src: 3.If anyone says anything to you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away."
tgt: Mdhi any akiwashow chochote, mshoini boss anazihitaji sana, kisha watawaachilia chap chap mzilete.'

src: 4.This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
tgt: Sa hii ilifanyika njo kusababike kutokea ile word ilisemwa na higher man:

src: 5."Say to the Daughter of Zion,
tgt: "Bonga na dota wa zion umshow hivi,

src: 'See, your king comes to you,
tgt: 'Cheki mfalme wenu amekam kwenu,

src: gentle and riding on a donkey,
tgt: Kwa upole akiride ju ya punda,

src: on a colt, the foal of a donkey.' "
tgt: kwa kinda ya farasi, yule mtoi wa punda.'

src: 6.The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.
tgt: Wadhii maboi wa JC wakaishia waka do vile JC aliwashow.

src: 7.They brought the donkey and the colt, placed their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.
tgt: Wakabring hiyo donkey na kina yake, wakazicladisha nguo zao, alafu wakakalisha JC juu ya punda.

src: 8.A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
tgt: Rende meja,kubwa ya wadhii ikaanza kuweka kabuti zao kwa rodi ka carpet, wengine wakiongezea matawi ya miti, wakazi sambaza kwa baro poa.

src: 9.The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted,
tgt: Rende ikajiseti mbele yake na ingine nyuma {wakaform peaceful demonstration}, wakaenda wakiimba na kushout,

src: "Hosanna to the Son of David!"
tgt: "Hosanna ziende kwa mtoi wa Davie!"

src: "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"
tgt: "Amebarikiwa mwenya amekam na jina kubwa ya Bwana!"

src: "Hosanna in the highest!"
tgt: "Hosanna juu juu juu zaidi{Moi alicopy hapa}

src: 10.When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, "Who is this?"
tgt: Nyakati JC aliingia Jerusa, ile rende yote ya jiji ikavurugwa amani hadi wakauliza, "Nani huyu?"

src: 11.The crowds answered, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."
tgt: Crowd ikajibu,"Huyu ni JC, yule higher man toka hood ya Nazareth, si unajua pale Galilee?"

src: 12.Jesus entered the temple area and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.
tgt: JC akajisunda kwa temple akaanza kuwatupa nje wote walikuwa waki do mabiz {wadhi wa niya-leo! niya-leo!}. Akapindua ma meza za forex namabench za ndush kama manjiwa.

src: 13."It is written," he said to them, " 'My house will be called a house of prayer,'but you are making it a 'den of robbers.' "
tgt: Akawashow,"ishaandikwa, 'hao yangu itakuwa place ya kupray, lakini nyi mshai make shimo ya wagondi."

src: 14.The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.
tgt: Wale wadhi walikuwaga lame na blind wakamkamia hapo tu kwa temple, wakahealiwa wote.

src: 15.But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple area, "Hosanna to the Son of David," they were indignant.
tgt: Lakini priest wale sonkwo na mamode wa sheria walipocheki zile vitu fiti alikuwa aki do na vile watoi walikuwa waki jazzika ju yake hadi wakishout,"hosanna ziende kwa mtoi wa Davie chali, wakakuwa jealous hadi wakakasirika.

src: 16."Do you hear what these children are saying?" they asked him.
tgt: Wakamwuliza,"Unaskia chenye watoi wanadai?"

src: "Yes," replied Jesus, "have you never read,
tgt: "Ehe," JC aka reply, "kwani hamjawai soma,

src: " 'From the lips of children and infants
tgt: "' toka kwa midomo ya watoi na ma toddler

src: you have ordained praise'?"
tgt: usha panga upate sifa'?"

src: 17.And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.
tgt: Akachomoka hapo akawaacha na ku go hadi nje ya jiji akafika Bethany, akadoze huko.

src: 18.Early in the morning, as he was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.
tgt: Ngwaree ma morning, JC akirudi jiji, akahisii ubao ingine massive.

src: 19.Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, "May you never bear fruit again!" Immediately the tree withered.
tgt: Akacheck hivi akanaona mti wa mkuyu kando ya baro, akishia karibu lakini lo! mti ilikuwa matawi tupu. Akaishoow ivi,"Usiwai zaa mafruits tena!" Hapo hapo mkuyu ikadie, ikaanza kunyauka.

src: 20.When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?" they asked.
tgt: Wakati maboi wake walicheki hivo, waling'ethia tu. Wakauliza,"Kwani mti ilinyauka vipi haraka hivo?"

src: 21.Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and it will be done.
tgt: JC akareply, "Nawashow hivi, ukweli, ka una imani na bila madoubts, sio tu ati utadoo vile ilifanyiwa mkuyu, lakini unaweza do hata zaidi, ju unaweza show hii mlina,'ishia, kajitupe kwa bahari,' na utafanyiwa hivyo.

src: 22.If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer."
tgt: Ka ukiamini, utaget kila chenye unauliza for kwa prayer."

src: 23.Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you this authority?"
tgt: JC akacheck in kwa ma verandah za temple, kisha akifunza hivi, masonkwo ma pasii, na maelders wa wadhi wakamkamia. Wakamwuliza,"unatumia say ya nani ku do hizi vitu na nani alikugei hizo powers?"

src: 24.Jesus replied, "I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
tgt: JC akawajibu,"Nitawauliza swali one.Mkinijibu, nitawashow na do hizi vitu na say ya nani.

src: 25.John's baptism—where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or from men?"
tgt: Baptism ya Johnie, ilitoka where? Ilikuwa from heaven ama from wadhii?"

src: They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask, 'Then why didn't you believe him?'
tgt: Wakachora hiyo swali wakakalia baraza alafu wakasay,"tukisema,'toka heaven,' atauliza,'mbona hamkumbelieve yeye?'

src: 26.But if we say, 'From men'—we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet."
tgt: Lakini tukisay, 'Kutoka wadhii'-tumegwaya wadhii, ju wote waliamini kuwa Johnie alikuwa higher man."

src: 27.So they answered Jesus, "We don't know."Then he said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
tgt: So wakajibu JC,"Hatujui."

src: 28."What do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, 'Son, go and work today in the vineyard.'
tgt: Mnafikiri aje? Kulikuwa na mdhi alikuwa na watoi chali wawili.Akaishia kwa mdhi wa kwanza akamshow,'Boi wangu, nenda u do janta kwa vineyard yangu.'

src: 29." 'I will not,' he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.
tgt: Akamshow, "Tia zi, siishii,'lakini baadayez akabadilisha minds zake akaishia wax.

src: 30."Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, 'I will, sir,' but he did not go.
tgt: "kisha mbuyuz akaenda kwa yule mtoi chali mwingine akamshow the same thing. Akamjibu,"hiyo nitaishia ku do," lakini akaenda zake, akakosa ku do janta.

src: 31."Which of the two did what his father wanted?" "The first," they answered.Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.
tgt: "Gani kati ya hao wawili ali do chenye mbuyu wake alitaka?' Wakamjibu,"wa fao." JC akawashow hivi,"Nawashow ukweli, wale wasee wa ushuru na ma poko wamna make it kuingia kingdom ya sir Godi mbele yenu.

src: 32.For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
tgt: Ju Johnie aliwakamia kuwashow baro ya righteousness, hamkumuamini,lakini wasee wa ushuru na ma poko walimuamini.Na bado mkicheki hivo, bado hamkurepent mumuamini.

src: 33."Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and went away on a journey.
tgt: "skiza niwashow fumbo ingine: Kulikuwa na bwenyenye sonkwo alipanda grapes kwa shakee yake. Akasimamisha ukuta around it, aka chimbia down place ya kukamulia wine toka kwa ma grapes, akajenga mnara ya look out post.Kisha akarentisha shakee yake kwa wakulima akakitoa kwenda safari.

src: 34.When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.
tgt: Magithaa za harvest zikatimia kufika,akatuma wadhi wake wa wax waishia kwa ma tenants kucollect rent ambayo ilikuwa mafruits.

src: 35."The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
tgt: "Wale wapangaji wakawashika wale wadhii; wakapiga mmoja, wakamada mwingine, akasmstone mwingine.

src: 36.Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.
tgt: Kisha sonkwo akatuma wadhii wengine wa wax kwao, wamost kuliko wale wa time ya fao,na wale tenants waka watreat hio hivo.

src: 37.Last of all, he sent his son to them. 'They will respect my son,' he said.
tgt: Mwishoni, akasend mtoi wake wake wa fao kwao. Akadhania,'Watarespect mtoi wangu chali.

src: 38."But when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him and take his inheritance.'
tgt: "Lakini wakati wale tenants walicheki mtoi cahli, wakachora hivi, 'Huyu njo mrithi. Kamuni, tummade kisha tuget hiyo heritance ya boi.'

src: 39.So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
tgt: Kisha wakamchukua wakamchuja nje ya shake ya ma grapes wakammada.

src: 40."Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?"
tgt: "Juu ya hiyo stori, nyakati mwenye shakee ata arrive, ata do whgat kwa hao ma tenants?"

src: 41."He will bring those wretches to a wretched end," they replied, "and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time."
tgt: "Ata waleya juu hao makubaff awa letee balaa, kisha atairentisha shakee kwa wengine, wenye watamgei portion yake ya ,afruit, matime za kuvuna."

src: 42.Jesus said to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures:
tgt: JC akawashow,"Hamjawai soma kwa maholy chapta:

src: " 'The stone the builders rejected
tgt: " 'Ile jiwe ilipewa rejection na wasee wa mjengo

src: has become the capstone;
tgt: sa imekuwa ile jiwe ya kona;

src: the Lord has done this,
tgt: God ame do ivo,

src: and it is marvelous in our eyes'?
tgt: na inajazz kwa macho yetu'?

src: 43."Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
tgt: "Kwa hivo nawashow kuwa empire ya Sir Godi itanyakuliwa toka kwenu na igeaniwe kwa wasee wata hustle mafruit zake.

src: 44.He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed."
tgt: Ye mwenye atafallia ju ya hii stone atabreakiwa vipande, lakini yule itaangukia ata-crushiwa."

src: 45.When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesus' parables, they knew he was talking about them.
tgt: Wakati masonkwo wa mapasii na wale pharisees waliskia mafumbo ya JC, wakajua alikuwa akibonga ju yao.

src: 46.They looked for a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd because the people held that he was a prophet.
tgt: Wakatafuta njia ya kumshika, lakini wakagwaya hiyo rende ju wadhii walishikilia ati JC alikuwa ni prophet.

src: Mathayo Kindee mbili-Matthew 20 1."For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire men to work in his vineyard.
tgt: Sa kingdom ya heaven italinganishwa na sonkwo fulani bwanyenye aliishia out ngware morning kusaka ma kanda ya moko wadunge wakx kwa shake yake ya grapes.

src: 2.He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
tgt: Wakachora MOU ati watalipwa denarii moja kila mse{ kaa pay ya wasee wa inda ya soo nne} kwa kudunga janta ya day muzima akawatuma kwa shake waane.

src: 3."About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
tgt: Hapo ma saa tatu tatu, morning, sonkwo akafika tena kwa soko aka spot wengine wakisimama ndani ya marko waki idle.

src: 4.He told them, 'You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.'
tgt: Akawashow hivi, `Nyi pia ishiene mdunge wax kwa shake yangu ya grapes, nitawalipa do ile inafaa.`

src: 5.So they went."He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.
tgt: Juu ya hiyo stori wakaishia. Mse wa bidii, sonkwo akafika tena dukani ithaa ya saa sita{ma lunch time hivi} na saa tsa kubonga na wadhii wote walikuwa wakituilahuko vi same.

src: 6.About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, 'Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?'
tgt: Sa masaa kumi na moja hivi{wadhii wakifunga wax} akaishia tena jobless corner akacheki bado wananchi wengine wakibangaiza hapo kwa soko. Hadi ikabaki ameuliza, `mbona bado mmetulia hapa a whole working day, hamja do any?`

src: 7." 'Because no one has hired us,' they answered."He said to them, 'You also go and work in my vineyard.'
tgt: Wakamjibu hivi,`ni ju hakuna sonkwo ametuoganaizia kamwax hivi angalao.` Akawashow, ishieni mdunge wax kwa shakee yangu ya grapes.`

src: 8."When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, 'Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first.'
tgt: Sa jioni matimee ikagonga six, bwenyenye wa shakee ya grapes akacheck in akashow nyapara wake,right hand man, `ita hao vijana nilipe wote pesa yao, nikianzilia na wale walifika wa mwisho hadi kueleka wale wa kwanza.`

src: 9."The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.
tgt: Majamaa, kanda ya moko wa wira wakapiga foleni,wale waligeiwa job toka five hadi six wakakanjwa hela zao, denarii moja.

src: 10.So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.
tgt: Kisha wakati wale maboi weingine walipewa job wa fao walisorora hivo, waka conclude lazma wataget moere. Lakini salaale! walikanjwa tu same na wale wengine, denarii moja.

src: 11.When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.
tgt: Wakati wali pokea hizo ganji, wakaanza kununa nuna against sonkwo.

src: 12.'These men who were hired last worked only one hour,' they said, 'and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the work and the heat of the day.'
tgt: Wakateta,Hawa wadhii walipewa janta ya one hour halafu umewaweka wakuwe same tu na sisi wenye tuli do kazi ya siku full na tukachomwa na solar na joto ya midday.'

src: 13."But he answered one of them, 'Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Didn't you agree to work for ,"a denarius?
tgt: Lakini sonkwo akawashow kiroho safi,'Beshte, sijawatenda manze vi unfair. Si mli kubali ku do janta wakati niliwashow itakuwa denarii wahed?'

src: 14.Take your pay and go. I want to give the man who was hired last the same as I gave you.
tgt: Shika pesa yako ukiishiaga. Nawant kugeiana kwa mdhii mwenye aliingia wax late ka tu vile nawakanja nyi wote.

src: 15.Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?''
tgt: Si niko na right ya ku do chenye na want na ganji ya mine? Ama ni kiwaru tu ju ya vile mi ni sonkwo generous?'

src: 16."So the last will be first, and the first will be last."
tgt: Ju ya hiyo stori, hivo hivo njo wasee wa fao watakuwa mkia na wase position mkia watakuwa first.'

src: 17.Now as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside and said to them,
tgt: Sasa JC alivokuwa akipanda juu hadi Jerusa, akakwachu wale maboi wake wa kawaida kando akashow aje?

src: 18."We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death
tgt: Tunashuka down kwenda Jerusa,{na unajua vile huko nina beef na mapharisees}

src: 19.and will turn him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!"
tgt: Na baadayez watamgeiana kwa ma refugee ambao watamdunga dharau na kumwhip alafu wamcrucify. Siku ya three ataraise arudi alive!"

src: 20.Then the mother of Zebedee's sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.
tgt: Kisha masa wa akina Zebedayo akajileta mbele ya JC akiwa na wakidi wake wawili, aka piga magoti, akaulizia kifavour hivi.

src: 21."What is it you want?" he asked. She said, "Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom."
tgt: JC akamwuliza, 'niaje unadai what?' Matha Jamo akadai,"wacha hawa boys wangu watoi ibidi,wakubaliwe wakaage mmoja kwa right na mwingine kwa left ya kiti chako ch nguvu, throne yako, nyakati kingdom yako ita fika."

src: 22."You don't know what you are asking," Jesu s said to them. "Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?" "We can," they answered.
tgt: JC akashow kiroho safi,"Hamjui ni what mmedai, mnaweza hata kupiga tu sip ya kikombe itabidi nimedrink?" Wakadai,"Eehee tunaweza!"

src: 23.Jesus said to them, "You wll indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father."
tgt: JC akawashow,"kweli mutadrink toka kwa cup yangu, lakini kubangaiza kwa right ya kiti changu cha enzi au kwa left sio mi nitadecide.Hizo place zisha allocatiwa {kwa guest list} kwa wale wadhii wameprepariwa wazikalie na mbuyus wangu heaven."

src: 24.When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
tgt: Wakati wale wasee kinde ma disciples waliskia hivo, wakawaamulia cold war wale maboi wawili wa zebedayo.

src: 25.Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.
tgt: JC akawaita tugezza akasay,"Mshaunganisha reality mukajua wale wadosi wa mataifa{marefugee} huwakalia wananchu kichuma, na walee ma official wa gava wenye wako juu yao, pia wanazidia.

src: 26.Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
tgt: Lakini isikuwe hivo na nyinyi.Kueni tofauti, wale wadhii wanadai positions za sonkwo lazma waanzie kama servants kwa ma comrade wao.

src: 27.and whoever wants to be first must be your slave.
tgt: Yule anadai place ya fao juu yenu lazma akuwe mboch wenu.

src: 28.just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
tgt: Ni ka tu vile son wa adam hakukam kupewa service, lakini kuwa mboch wenu, kuwaserve, na kugeiana life yake ka ransom kwa wadhii mob.

src: 29.As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.
tgt: Kisha JC na Maboiz wake wa kawaida wakikitoa from Jeri, rende kubwa ikamfollow.

src: 30.Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
tgt: Wadhii wawili blind walikuwa wameketi kando ya baro, na wakati waliskia ati JC alikuwa amepitia {hiyo shoti ya} njia ya na hapo kwao, wakaangua cry ile meja wakidai,"Boss, mtoi wa Davie, tufeelie kahuruma hivi kiroho safi!

src: 31.The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"
tgt: Wadhii wakawadunga war of words ingine counter wakiwashow wakimye, lakini bado, wadhiihao walishout zaidi,"Boss, mtoi wa Davie, tufeelie kahuruma hivi kiroho safi!"

src: 32.Jesus stopped and called them. "What do you want me to do for you?" he asked.
tgt: Hapo JC ikabidi amesimama kuwaita akawauliza,"Niaje, mnataka niwa doie what?"

src: 33."Lord," they answered, "we want our sight."
tgt: Wakamshow,"Bwana, tunahitaji tu kucheki, kuona poa."

src: 34.Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.
tgt: JC akawaonea huruma, akagusa macho zao. Hapo hapo wakapata sight yao vipoa wakaanza kucheki alafu wakamfuata.

src: Mathayo Ashuu ikijazwa tisa-Matthew 19 1.When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went into the region of Judea to the other side of the Jordan.
tgt: Cheki, Nyakati JC alimada kubongesha wadhii ju ya hizi vitu zote, akakitoa toka galilaya akaingia area code ya Judea ile side ingine ya Jordan.

src: 2.Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
tgt: Rende meja ikamweka bumper kumfuata, akawaheal hapo hapo.

src: 3.Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?"
tgt: Mapharisayo fulani wakamsogolea kinjaro kumpea exam. Wakauliza,"Niaje? ni legal for mse kuchora wiafudhes wake kidivorce ju ya kisababu any?"

src: 4."Haven't you read," he replied, "that at the beginning the Creator 'made them male and female,'
tgt: JC akawapiga reply,"Kwani hamjaiva kusoma,pale siku za fao Jah creator aliwa make chalee na manzi,"

src: 5.and said, 'For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh'?
tgt: akadai,'Ju ya hiyo stori chali atakitoa from mathe na mbuyuz wake na atajoin manzi yake amfanye waif, nao wawili wata become flesh moja, yaani watamarry?

src: 6.So they are no longer two, but one. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate."
tgt: Kwa hivo hawako wawili, wamebecome one. Jua kuwa chenye sir Godi ameput tugezza, mdhi yote asiwa separate."

src: 7."Why then," they asked, "did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?"
tgt: so Wakamwuliza,"Je, mbona Mosee akadai iwe commandment kuwa mdhii ageiane kwa waif wake cert ya talaka na amfukuze aishia away?"

src: 8.Jesus replied, "Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not this way from the beginning.
tgt: JC akawadunga jibu,"Mosee aliwakubali kudivorce mawaif ju heart zenu zilikuwa mawe Jo!Lakini haikuaga hivo toka zamo.

src: 9.I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for marital unfaithfulness, and marries another woman commits adultery."
tgt: Kuzidi hapo nawashow hivi, msee any atapeana divorce kwa waif, na sio ju ya kuhanya, na akwachu mpango ya kando ka waif asha do adultery."

src: 10.The disciples said to him, "If this is the situation between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry."
tgt: Kisha disciples wakamshow JC, "Ka hiyo njo situation jo kati ya waif na hazi, si basi ni beta kubaki umeshikilia celibacy."

src: 11.Jesus replied, "Not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.
tgt: JC akajibu hivi,"Sio kila mse atakubali maisha ya ucelibate{ama atatoboa bila scandal}, lakini wale wadhii imepeanwa.

src: 12.For some are eunuchs because they were born that way; others were made that way by men; and others have renounced marriage because of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it."
tgt: Kuna wadhi wamekuwaga mbaya sector ya jembe tangu wazaliwe ju walizaliwa na jembe haina makali; wengine walifanywa mbaya na wasee;na wengine walitia marriage zii ju ya kingdom ya heaven. Lakini mwenye anaweza kubali akubali {hiyo lifestyle}.

src: 13.Then little children were brought to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
tgt: Kisha watoi wadogo wakaletwa kwa JC njo awawekelee mikono awaombee. Lakini ma disciples wakwahanda wale waliwabring.

src: 14.Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these."
tgt: JC akasay hivi,"wacha watoi wakam kwangu, na usiwakwaze, ju kingdom ya heaven imebaki ku belong kwa wadhi ka hawa watoi."

src: 15.When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.
tgt: Akisha malizia kuwekelea mikono kuwabless, akajikata from there.

src: 16.Now a man came up to Jesus and asked, "Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?"
tgt: Sa jamaa akatokezea akajileta mbele ya christ kuuliza hivi,"Tichaa, ni nini mambo good yenye ni must ni do njo nikwachu eternal life?"

src: 17."Why do you ask me about what is good?" Jesus replied. "There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, obey the commandments."
tgt: JC akadai,"mbona unani ask kuhusu mambo good? Jua kuna jamaa mmoja tu good. Na ukitaka kuingia kwa life, fuata commands zimechorwa."

src: 18."Which ones?" the man inquired. Jesus replied, " 'Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not give false testimony,
tgt: "sa njo gani hizo?" jamaa akaulizia. Jesus akamshow, 'Usicommit murder, usikute vitu vwa waif wa meiba, usiporee mali ya mse, usipeane ma witness report za uongo,

src: 19.honor your father and mother,' and 'love your neighbor as yourself.'"
tgt: heshimu budaako na mathaako,' na penda wadhii ma neiba vile umejipenda.'"

src: 20."All these I have kept," the young man said. "What do I still lack?"
tgt: Boi akadai,"Hizo zote nisha keep, nini ingine bado sijatimiza?"

src: 21.Jesus answered, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."
tgt: JC akadrop the bomb sasa,"ka unadai perfection, ishia, kinda kila possession yako, peana hizo ganji kwa wasee wamesota, hapo utagatha mali heaven. Alafu kamu unifuate."

src: 22.When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.
tgt: Boi karibu akonde jo,wakati aliskia hivo coz aliishia akiwa down{sad} mbaya, ju alikuwa buda sonkwo mwenye kusema.

src: 23.Then Jesus said to his disciples, "I tell you the truth, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
tgt: JC akakagua hiyo stori akabaki ameshow madisciples wake, "Nawashow cha ukwela, for wasee sonkwo kuingia kingdom ya heaven,itakuwa gwan.

src: 24.Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."
tgt: Pia kuzidishia hapo nawashow hivi, ni mambo easy kwa ngamia kupita kwa jicho ya sindano uki compare na ile ugumu ya msee sonkwo kuget ticket ya kingdom ya God."

src: 25.When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, "Who then can be saved?"
tgt: Nyakati disciples waliunganisha hiyo story, ma astonishemnet njo waliweka kwa mfuko hadi ikabidi waulize, "so just nani atasevika?"

src: 26.Jesus looked at them and said, "With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."
tgt: Lakini JC tayari alikuwa asha resolve hiyo risto hivi,"Na majamaa wa dunia, hiyo mchoro ni gwan, hadi impossible lakini na sir Godi kila wax ni possible."

src: 27.Peter answered him, "We have left everything to follow you! What then will there be for us?"
tgt: Pitaa akauliza JC,"Si tuliacha kila kitu ya life zetu kukufuata! So kutaendaje na sisi, kuna nini

src: 28.Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
tgt: JC akamshow,"Cha ukwela, nawashow nyakati za ma renewal ya kila kitu, wakati son wa Adam atakuwa ametulizz kwa chemba yake glorious vimezesha, nyi wenye mumemfuata pia mtachill out na yeye kwa mathrones{VIP section}, mkipiga ramli na kusort kesi zawa israelite.

src: 29.And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.
tgt: Alafu kila mdhii alisare makeja, mabro na masiz au buda ama matha ama watoi, ama land yake ju yangu ataget mara soo ya chenye alisare na pia ataongezewa eternallife{au sio?}.

src: 30.But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
tgt: Lakini jua, wale wadhii walikuwa wa fao watabaki kuwa mkia,na wale wa last watakuwa {watapigwa upgrade hadi wawe fao.}

src: Mathayo Ashuu imejaziliwa nane - Matthew 18 1.At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"
tgt: Hizo nyakati wale disciples wakakam kwa JC wakamwuliza,"who njo the greatest katika kingdom ya heaven?"

src: 2.He called a little child and had him stand among them.
tgt: Akaita mtoi msmall akamshow astand hapo in their midst.

src: 3.And he said: "I tell you the truth, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
tgt: Kisha akasay:" Nawashow cha ukwela, hadi m-change na kuwa ka wale watoi wasmall, hamtaja wai enter ile kingdom ya heaven.

src: 4.Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
tgt: Kwa hivo, mse yeyote anaji humble akuwe ka huyu mkidi njo the greatest kwa kingdom ya sir Godi.

src: 5."And whoever welcomes a little child like this in my name welcomes me.
tgt: "Na yeyote ana welcome mtoi mdogo ka huyu kwa jinayangu amenikaribisha pia.

src: 6.But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
tgt: Lakini kila mse ana cause mmoja wa watoi hawa wasmall wenye wamenibelieve afall kwa dhambi, ingekuwa afadhali angefungwa mawe ile ya rego rego{posho mill} kwa shingo adrownishwe kwa deep sea.

src: 7."Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to sin! Such things must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!
tgt: "Ole wao wasee wa dunia kwa sababu ya samo zenye hu fanya wasee wa do sins!Hizo vitu lazma zikam, lakini ole kwa yule mdhii mwenye anasababisha hivi vitu zi happen! "

src: 8.If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away.It is better for you to enter life maimed or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into eternal fire.
tgt: Ka Mkono yako au mguu yako ina kucause udo dhambi, ikate uichuje away. Ni better kwako kuingia kwa life ukiwa bila mguu au mkono rather uingie flames mzima mzima, namiguu au mikono yote.

src: 9.And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
tgt: Ka jicho yako inaku cause udo dhambi, itoe uichuje away. Ni better kwako kuingia life eternal na jicho moja badala ya wewe na macho mbe zako utupwe kwa nare ya hell.

src: 10."See that you do not look down on one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father in heaven.
tgt: Tia bidii usishow dharau kwa watoi wadogo any. Ju nawashow that ma angels wao heaven kila time hucheki face ya buda wangu heaven.

src: 12."What do you think? If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?
tgt: "Mna dhani what?Ka msee sonkwo ana own sheep soo moja, na moja ya sheep imezurura ikapotea, si atachomoka aache zile sheep ninety nine kwa hills aishie kusaka ile moja imelost?

src: 13.And if he finds it, I tell you the truth, he is happier about that one sheep than about the ninety-nine that did not wander off.
tgt: Na akiiget, nakushow ukweli, atakuwa amejazika zaidi ju ya ilesheep ilipatikana kuliko zile sheep ninety nine haziku stray away.

src: 14.In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should be lost.
tgt: Hivo hivo njo buda wako ako heaven hawezi acha mmoja wa hawa wakidi alost.

src: 15."If your brother sins against you, go and show him his fault, just between the two of you. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
tgt: "Ka bro wako anakuduiya madhambi, ishia umshow mistake yake, mkiwa nyi wawili. Lakini akikuskizia, utakuwa umeshinda bro wako over.

src: 16.But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that 'every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.'
tgt: Lakini asipokuskiza, chukua mse mmoja au wawili pamoja muishie, njo 'Kila issue iwe established na witness wawili au watatu.'

src: 17.If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church; and if he refuses to listen even to the church, treat him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
tgt: Akidindakuwaskiza, elezea wasee wa church; na akidinda bado mtreat ka vile utatreat pagan, au tax collector.

src: 18."I tell you the truth, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
tgt: " Nakushow cha ukwela, chenye unabind kwa earth kitabindiwa in heaven, na whatever munafungulia on earth kitafunguliwa in heaven.

src: 19."Again, I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by my Father in heaven.
tgt: "Tena, ni hivi, ka wasee wawili kati yenu au wasee three mna agree kuhusu kitu any chenye munauliza, mutafanyiwa na mbuyuz wangu heaven.

src: 20.For where two or three come together in my name, there am I with them.
tgt: Ju place wadhii wawili au watatu wakija tugezza kwa jina yangu, hapo hapo nimedunga hema nao.

src: 21.Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother when he sins against me? Up to seven times?"
tgt: Kisha Pitaa akamkamia JC akamwuliza, "Bwana, nitaforgive bro wangu mara ngapi akinikosea? Hadi mara seven.

src: 22.Jesus answered, "I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.
tgt: JC akareply,"Nawashow hivi, sio matime seven , lakini time seventy-seven times.

src: 23."Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
tgt: "Kwa hivo, kingdom ya heaven ni ka king alitaka kumalizana ma accounts na wazeiya wake wa Job.

src: 24.As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand talents was brought to him.
tgt: Kisha akaanza kusort hizo ma account, msee mmoja alikuwa nangiri zake ashu akaletwa kwake.

src: 25.Since he was not able to pay, the master ordered that he and his wife and his children and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.
tgt: Ju alikuwa hako able kulipay, sonkwo akasay family ya huyo msee, waifudhes na wakidi wote wauzwe ili sonkwo aget doh yake back.

src: 26."The servant fell on his knees before him. 'Be patient with me,' he begged, 'and I will pay back everything.'
tgt: Servant akapiga magoti mbele ya sonkwo akam beg, 'kuwa patient na mimi,nitakulipa kila kitu naku owe.'

src: 27.The servant's master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.
tgt: mdosi wa huyo jamaa akamskilia huruma, so aka cancel hiyo debt na akamset free.

src: 28.But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii.He grabbed him and began to choke him. 'Pay back what you owe me!' he demanded.
tgt: Lakini huyo mdhii wakati aliishia nje, alikutana na debtor wake, mse kandaya moko kama yeye mwenye alimu owe soo. Akamshika mashati mbaya, akaanza kumchoke akimshow, 'Lipa deni yako yenye nakudai!

src: 29."His fellow servant fell to his knees and begged him, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you back.'
tgt: Huyo mse waliduigi job naye akamwangukia kwa magoti akiplead, 'kuwa na subira na mimi jo!, nitaku pay deni yako.'

src: 30."But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.
tgt: Lakini akakataa.Instead, akaishia kwa jailman aka make sure jamaa wake ametupwa ndani hadi ile day atalipa deni.

src: 31.When the other servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed and went and told their master everything that had happened.
tgt: Nyakati wale wasee wengine walicheki hivo, waliget madepression meja hadi wakaishia kwa sonkwo kumshow hizo mahappenings zote.

src: 32."Then the master called the servant in. 'You wicked servant,' he said, 'I canceled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.
tgt: "Kisha sonkwo akatumania servant wake amcheki, akamshow,'We mfanyikazi wiked aje,nilishafuta deni zako kubwa hivo, na vile uli cry nikuforgive.

src: 33.Shouldn't you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?'
tgt: Mbona usi do the same, ukuwe na huruma kwa jamaa wako mnadunga wax pamoja, umsamehe deni ka vile nilikusamehea?

src: 34.In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should pay back all he owed.
tgt: Kwa hasira yake, sonkwo alimsare kwa masoja wa jela ashikanishwe ki nyayo basement, hadi ile siku angelipa deni yote.

src: 35."This is how my heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart."
tgt: "Hivo njo buda wangu wa heaven atamtreat kila mmoja wa nyi wasee ka hamtaforgive mabro wenu from your heart."

src: Mathayo Kinde imejaziliwa saba-Matthew 17 1.After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
tgt: Baada ya siku six, JC akachukua Pitaa, Jamo na Johnie bro wa Jamo, akawapeleka juu ya mlima high wakiwa alone.

src: 2.There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.
tgt: Hapo akaanza kubadilishwa vi supernatural mbele yao. Face yake ikang'ara ka sun, na cladi zake zikakuwa white kuliko hata chenye JIK inge do, white kama light.

src: 3.Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.
tgt: Vi sudden Elijah aka appear mbele yao akiwa tugezza na Mosee, wakibonga na JC.

src: 4.Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."
tgt: Pitaa akashow JC hivi,"Lord, si poa tukitulia hapa hivi. Ukitaka, tutawadungia hema tatu, moja yako, moja ya Mose na moja ya Elijah.

src: 5.While he was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!"
tgt: Hivi wakibonga tu, cloud bright ikawafunika, na voice kutoka kwa cloud ikisay,"huyu njo mtoi wangu chali, na ninampenda; yeye amenijazz.Mpeeni sikio!"

src: 6.When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.
tgt: Nyakati ma disciples waliskia hivo, wakadrop na face zao to the ground, wamegwaya.

src: 7.But Jesus came and touched them. "Get up," he said. "Don't be afraid."
tgt: Lakini JC akacome na akawagusa.Akawashow,"amkeni na msigwaye."

src: 8.When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
tgt: Wakati walicheki Juu Hivi,walicheki JC amebaki alone.

src: 9.As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, "Don't tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead."
tgt: Sa wakishuka chini toka kwa mountain, JC akapea maagizo,"Msishow msee any chenye mme cheki, hadi matime mtoi chali wa adam ataresurrect toka death."

src: 10.The disciples asked him, "Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"
tgt: Ma disciples wakamwuliza, "mbona ma mode wa sheria husay Elijah lazma akam wa fao?"

src: 11.Jesus replied, "To be sure, Elijah comes and will restore all things.
tgt: JC akawajibu,"For sure Elijah anacome na atarestore vitu zote zibaki poa.

src: 12.But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him everything they wished. In the same way the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands."
tgt: Lakini nawashow, Elijah alishacome, nao hawakum tambua ni yeye, lakini wame do kwake vitu zote walifeel ku do. Hivo hivo njo son wa adam ata go through kwa mikono zao."

src: 13.Then the disciples understood that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.
tgt: Kisha disciples wakaelewa alikuwa anamaanisha Johnie yule baptist.

src: 14.When they came to the crowd, a man approached Jesus and knelt before him.
tgt: Wakati walifikia rende, msee akasogelea JC na akapiga magoti mbele.

src: 15."Lord, have mercy on my son," he said. "He has seizures and is suffering greatly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
tgt: "Lord, have mercy kwa son yangu," akasay. "Ye amekuwa na ma seizure na anasuffer vimeja. Hadi ya hufall ndani ya nare au ndani ya wode.

src: 16.I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him."
tgt: Nilimbring kwa hawa ma disciples wako, wakashindwa kum heal."

src: 17."O unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy here to me."
tgt: "Oh nyikizazi potovu tena unbelieving," JC akajibu, "Ni lazma how niwe na nyinyi long? Nita watolerate hadi lini? Leteni huyo chali hapa."

src: 18.Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.
tgt: JC akakemea hoyi shaito, ikakam out kutoka kwa huyo boy, na akawa poa from then on.

src: 19.Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and asked, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"
tgt: Kisha ma disciples wakakam kwa JC kichinichini wakamask," Niaje ahungeweza ku cast out pepo?"

src: 20.He replied, "Because you have so little faith. I tell you the truth, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you."
tgt: JC akawashow hivi,"ju mna imani ndogo ajabu. Nawashow ukweli, ka una faith ndogo ka mbegu ya haradali, unaweza say kwa hii mlima,"jitoe uishie toka hapa hadi pale" na itamove. Hakuna chenye kitakuwa impossible kwako{hautakuwa na limits}.

src: 22.When they came together in Galilee, he said to them, "The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men.
tgt: Nyakati Walikam pamoja Galilee, aliwashow hivi,"son wa adam anaenda kuuzwa katika hands ya wasee.

src: 23.They will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised to life." And the disciples were filled with grief.
tgt: Wadhii watamdedisha, na ile siku ya tatu atarise from the dead to life." Na ma disciples wakawa down with grief.

src: 24.After Jesus and his disciples arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, "Doesn't your teacher pay the temple tax?"
tgt: Kisha baada ya JC na Dsciples wake kufika capernaum, wale collectors wa ile ushuru ya peni mbili wakakam kwa Pitaa kumwuliza,"Niaje, Mbona wewe na sonkwo, huyu mode wako hamlipi tax ya temple?"

src: 25."Yes, he does," he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. "What do you think, Simon?" he asked.
tgt: "Ye

src: "From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes—from their own sons or from others?"
tgt: "Kutoka kwa who njo masonkwo wa dunia hucollect tax from, watoi wao ama wengine?"

src: 26."From others," Peter answered.
tgt: Si wengine," Pitaa akasay.

src: "Then the sons are exempt," Jesus said to him.
tgt: "Kwa hivo watoi wao hawalipagi," JC akadai.

src: 27."But so that we may not offend them, go to the lake and throw out your line. Take the first fish you catch; open its mouth and you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for my tax and yours."
tgt: "Lakini njo tusiwa kasirishe, ishia kwa lake, rusha ndoano yako. Chukua fish ya fao itabambwa; fungua kinywa yake utaget peni nne. Kwachu uwagei, italipuia tax yako na yangu."

src: 1.The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.
tgt: Wale ma kuhani wakakam kwa JC kumpatia exam wakamshow awaonyesha evidence, form 16A, sign toka heaven.

src: 2.He replied, "When evening comes, you say, 'It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,'
tgt: Akawashow hivi, "Jioni ikicome, nyi husay aje,'kutakuwa na weather poa, ju sky ni red,'

src: 3.and in the morning, 'Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.' You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.
tgt: Na morning nyi husay aje, 'Leo itakuwa na rain yamaajabu, coz sky huwaga red na macloud cover.' Mnajua kusoma vile skiy inakaa, lakini hamuwezi conclude niaje, mkicheki signs za hizi nyakati.

src: 4.A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a miraculous sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah." Jesus then left them and went away.
tgt: Generation wiked na ya huyanya hanya hutafuta for evidence ya miracles, lakini haitageiwa hata moja, labda tu ile sign ya Jonaa.JC akawaacha hivo akaishia.

src: 5.When they went across the lake, the disciples forgot to take bread.
tgt: Wakati walivuka hiyo lake, madisciples wakasahau kubeba takeaway ya loaf.

src: 6."Be careful," Jesus said to them. "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
tgt: "Chunga sana," JC akawashow. "Kueni alert mkijichunga against ile chapa mandashi ya makuhani, pharisees na saducees."

src: 7.They discussed this among themselves and said, "It is because we didn't bring any bread."
tgt: Wakadiscuss hiyo stori katikati yao wakasay aje,"Ni ju hatukuleta takeaway ya loaf yoyote."

src: 8.Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, "You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?
tgt: JC tayari alikuwa amewasoma,so akaingilia hiyo discussion yao,"nyi wasee wa faith ndogo, mbona mnajibongesha bongesha kati yenu ati hamna bread?

src: 9.Do you still not understand? Don't you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
tgt: Kwani hamnyiti hii story? Mnakumbuka zile loaf ngovo za wasee thao tano, mlijaza juala ngapi, kwanza?

src: 10.Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
tgt: Ama zile loaf saba za kufeed wasee ngovo nne, na vile mlisakanya juala baadaye?

src: 11.How is it you don't understand that I was not talking to you about bread? But be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
tgt: Niaje hamnyiti, siwabongeshi ju ya loaf? Kuweni macho ju ya stori ya baking powder ya ma pharisee na ma saducees."

src: 12.Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
tgt: Wakati walielewa ati hawa show wajipange stori ya baking powder ya bread, lakini ju ya teachings za mapharisees na sadduccees.

src: 13.When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say the Son of Man is?"
tgt: Nyakati JC alitokezea kwaile region ya Caesarea philippi, akauliza madisciples wake,"Wasee husema son wa Adam nani?"

src: 14.They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
tgt: Wakajibu,"Wasee wengine wanasay Johnie yule baptist; wasee wengine wanasay Elijah; na wengine ati Jere ama mmoja wa maprophets."

src: 15."But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?"
tgt: "Lakini nyi je?" akaulizia. "mnasay mimi ni nani?"

src: 16.Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
tgt: Simo yani Pitaa, akajibu,"si we njo christ, mtoi wa Jah the living God."

src: 17.Jesus replied, "Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by man, but by my Father in heaven.
tgt: JC akamshow hivi," Umebarikiwa vi meja, Simo mtoi wa Jona, Ju hii ilishoiwa kwako,sio na msee, lakini na mbuyu wangu wa heaven.

src: 18.And I tell you that you are Peter,and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.
tgt: Nakushow wee njo Pitaa, na juu ya hii jiwe nitabuild church yangu, na the gates za hell hazitaiovercome.

src: 19.I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be[g] loosed in heaven."
tgt: Nitakugei keys za kingdom ya heaven; chochote utabind kwa dunia itafungwa mbinguni, na chochote utafungulia earth kitafunguliwa heaven.

src: 20.Then he warned his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Christ.
tgt: Kisha akapeana warning kwa maboi wake wasishow msee yeyote kuwa yeye ndiye mambo yote, the christ.

src: 21.From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
tgt: Kutoka hiyo githaa JC akabegin ku explain kwa disciples kuwa lazima aishie Jerusa ku-go through, ku-suffer vitu mob in the hands za wazae, wadosi chief priests na ma mode wa sheria, na kuwa lazima adedishwe, lakini on the third day ange resurrect to life.

src: 22.Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. "Never, Lord!" he said. "This shall never happen to you!"
tgt: Pitaa alimkwachu aside na kuanza kumkemea."Haiwezi take place, buda!" akamshow. "Hii haiwezi happen kwako!"

src: 23.Jesus turned and said to Peter, "Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men."
tgt: JC akaturn na kushow Pitaa, "Baki nyuma yangu, shaito!" We ni kikwazo kwa mi; unamind sana njaro za wadhii more than kumind njaro za sir Godi."

src: 24.Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.
tgt: Kisha JC akawashow madisciples wake, "Ka msee any ataniweka bumper, kunifuata, lazima ajideny na ajibebee cross yake anifuates.

src: 25.For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me will find it.
tgt: Ju ulemdhii anawant kuokolea maisha yake atailost, lakini jamaa jule atalostisha life yake ju yangu, ataiget.

src: 26.What good will it be for a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
tgt: Sa ni nini poa na msee kupata the whole world, lakini alost soul yake foree? Ama je, msee anaweza peana nini in exchange for soul yake?

src: 27.For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father's glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what he has done.
tgt: Ju mtoi wa adam atakokezea mtaani matime zake akiwa na bling bling ya mbuyu wake na angels wake, na hiyo time atapeana kwa kila msee kulingana na chenye wame do.

src: 28.I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom."
tgt: Nawashow cha ukwela, wasee wengine wanasimama hapa hawata taste kifo hadi nyakati watacheki mtoi wa adam akija kwa kingdom yake."

src: Mathayo kinde imejaziliwa ngovo-Matthew 15 1.Then some Pharisees and teachers of the law came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,
tgt: Kisha ma pharisee na ma mode wa sheria wakakam kwa JC toka Jerusa wakaulizia,

tgt: Niaje wasee wako disciples wana break sheria za wazae? Mbona hawa wash mikono zao before wadishi!"

tgt: Ju sir Godi alisay,'heshimu mbuyuz wako namathe wako' na 'yeyote amecurse mbuyuz wake au mathake lazima adedishwe.'

src: 7.You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you:
tgt: Nyi makabwela! Izzo alikuwa correct wakati aliprophesy kuwahusu:

src: but their hearts are far from me.
tgt: lakini hawanifeel kunipea moyo zao.

tgt: Wanani worship na njaro ya vako;

src: their teachings are but rules taught by men.'"
tgt: mateachings zao ni ma doe and donts zimechorwa na wasee.

src: 10.Jesus called the crowd to him and said, "Listen and understand.
tgt: JC akaita rende kwake akawashow,"sikizeni na munyite.

src: 11.What goes into a man's mouth does not make him 'unclean,' but what comes out of his mouth, that is what makes him 'unclean.' "
tgt: Chenye kinaingia kwa mdomo ya msee hakiwezi m-make unholy, lakini chenye kinatoka kwa mdomo yake njo kinam make un 'holy.'

src: 12.Then the disciples came to him and asked, "Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?"
tgt: So disciples wakakam kwake wakamwuliza,"mbona wadhi ma pharisees walikuwa wamekasirishwa wakati waliskia hivo.

src: 13.He replied, "Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.
tgt: Wakajibu hivi, "Kila plant yenye mbuyu wangu wa heaven haja panda itakatwa kutoka kwa roots.

src: 14.Leave them; they are blind guides.If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit."
tgt: Wachana nao; hawa ni wasee maguides blind. Ka mse blind anaongoza mse blind, wote wataingia kwa shimo."

src: 15.Peter said, "Explain the parable to us."
tgt: Pitaa akasay, "Explain hiyo parable kwetu.'

src: 16."Are you still so dull?" Jesus asked them.
tgt: "Kwani bado mko hivo blunt?" JC akawauliza.

src: 17"Don't you see that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then out of the body?
tgt: "Si unacheki chenye huingia kwa mouth huenda kwa tumbo alafu inakitoanje ya mwili?

src: 18.But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these make a man 'unclean.'
tgt: Lakini zile vitu zinachomoka kwa mdomo ka maneno zinatoka kwa moyo, na hizi njo hufanya mse akuwe wiked.

src: 19.For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.
tgt: Ju toka kwa heart ya msee ndio hutoka thoughts wiked, uuaji, kuhanya, kukuta vitu zenye si za wife, wizi, fitina na uongo, na kuharibiana wasee cv.

src: 21.Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
tgt: Kuishia hapo, JC akajificha kwa area ya tyre na sidon.

src: 22.A Canaanite woman from that vicinity came to him, crying out, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is suffering terribly from demon-possession."
tgt: Matha fulani wa hiyo area tu akamkamia JC, akicry otu,"Lord, mtoi wa Davie, nionee huruma! Mtoi wancu manzi ana shida bigi ya kuwa possesed na devo.

src: 23.Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, "Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us."
tgt: JC hakumjibu hata word moja. Ma disciples wake waka kam kumshow JC,"mfukuze, aache kucry cry hapa akitufuata.

src: 24.He answered, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel."
tgt: Akawajibu,"nilitumwa tu kwa zile lost sheep za israel."

src: 25.The woman came and knelt before him. "Lord, help me!" she said.
tgt: Huyo manzi akakam akakneel down mbele yake. "Boss, ebu nihelp!" mshii akalia.

src: 26.He replied, "It is not right to take the children's bread and toss it to their dogs."
tgt: JC akajibu,"si poa kuchukua ile loaf ya watoi upatie mbwa zao."

src: 27."Yes, Lord," she said, "but even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table."
tgt: "Ndio, boss," lakini mshi akasay hivi,"hata dogi hula crumbs zenye zinaanguka kutoka kwa tebo za masonkwo wao."

src: 28.Then Jesus answered, "Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted." And her daughter was healed from that very hour.
tgt: JC akamesea hiyo jibu akamshow hivi,"Mathe,uko na imani kubwa jo!Request yako itakuwa granted." So dota wake akaget poa from hiyo githaa.

src: 29.Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.
tgt: JC akatoka hapo akaenda akipass sea ya Galilee. Akaclimb juu ya mountainside akatuliza.

src: 30.Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.
tgt: Wasee wengiwaka kam kwake, wakibring wasee lame, bling, crippled, wasee deaf na wengine mob, wakalaza kwa feet ya JC;na akawaheal.

src: 31.The people were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.
tgt: Wasee wakajazika wakati walicheki wasee bubu wakispeak, wale crippled wakipona,wale lame wakizienda wakiwa poa na wale blind wakiona. Hata wakapraise Jah, sir Godi wa Israel.

src: 32.Jesus called his disciples to him and said, "I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way."
tgt: Sa JC aka call wasee wake disciples kwake akawashow hivi,"na feelia hawa wasee compassion; wametuliza hapa na mimi siku ka tatu na hawajamanga any. Sitaki kuwa send away wakiwa na ubao, ama watacollapse kwa njia."

src: 33.His disciples answered, "Where could we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a crowd?"
tgt: Disciples wa jC wakajibu, "Kwani tutaget loaf mob hivi,ya kutoshea wadhii hawa waote wapi na vile tuko bunduz mbaya?"

src: 34."How many loaves do you have?" Jesus asked.
tgt: JC akawauliza,"Kwani mna loaf ngapi?"

src: "Seven," they replied, "and a few small fish."
tgt: "Saba tu, na hauskii tu-omena tu-few sana." wakamshow.

src: 35.He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
tgt: JC akashow crowd itulie down kwa grao.

src: 36.Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.
tgt: Akabamba hiyo dibre na fish, alfu kwanza akareturn thanks, kisha akishamaliza ku do hivo, akavunja vunja loaf akpeana vipande kwa madisciples wake nao waka gawia wasee.

src: 37.They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
tgt: Wote wakadishi yao yote hadi wakashiba. After hivo ma disciples wakaokota juala saba kubwa zimejaa mabaki ka pieces zimebreak break.

src: 38.The number of those who ate was four thousand, besides women and children.
tgt: Hesaabu ya wasee walijibonda ilikuwaga thao nne, kabla ya watoi na mamatha kuhesabika.

src: 39.After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.
tgt: JC akashow crowd bye, wakaishia ma away, naye akadandia mv faina hadi kwenda kwa outskirts za Magadan.

src: Mathayo Themanya-Matthew 8 1.When he came down from the mountainside, large crowds followed him.
tgt: Time yenye alidondoka mountainside,rende ya wadhii, kubwa ilimfuata.

src: 2.A man with leprosy came and knelt before him and said, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."
tgt: Msee alikuwa na ukoma alikam aka kneel mbele ya JC akamshow,"Sonkwo, ka una will kuniheal, unaweza ni ng'arisha."

src: 3.Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" Immediately he was cured of his leprosy.
tgt: JC akastretch mkono yake akagusa huyo mse. "Niko na nia ya kukuheal," JC akamshow. "Kuwa mclean!" One time huyo jamaa akang'ara akakuwa healed fom hiyo ukoma.

src: 4.Then Jesus said to him, "See that you don't tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."
tgt: So JC akamshow," make sure usishow msee any. Lakini enda ujishow kwa priest na uto ile gift Mosee alicommand wana wa israel watoe , kama tesimony kwa priest."

src: 5.When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking for help.
tgt: Nyakati JC aliingia capernaum, dosi fulani wa army akamkamia, akiulizia assistance hivi.

src: 6."Lord," he said, "my servant lies at home paralyzed and in terrible suffering."
tgt: "Lord," aka say, "msee wa wax kwangu hafeel poa hadi amelala paralyzed kwa bed akiumwa mbaya."

src: 7.Jesus said to him, "I will go and heal him."
tgt: JC akamshow,"Nitakam kumheal."

src: 8.The centurion replied, "Lord, I do not deserve to have you come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
tgt: Sonkwo wa army akamshow,"Boss, hata si deserve wewe ukam personally kwa keja yangu, chini ya bati yangu. Sema tu vile kutakuwa na najua msee wangu wa wax atakuwa healed.

src: 9.For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and that one, 'Come,' and he comes. I say to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."
tgt: Ju hata mimi ni msee sonkwo na nina say, niko na masoja wana ni obey. Nikishow huyu "ishia" ana go; na yule, "ebu kam hapa," ana come. Mi hushow servant wangu, "Do hivi," na ana do."

src: 10.When Jesus heard this, he was astonished and said to those following him, "I tell you the truth, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
tgt: Lo! JC kuskia hivo, ikamuastonish, kwanza ika grab attention yake hadi akashow wadhii walikuwa na yeye bumper,"Nawashow cha ukweli, sijaget msee hata mmoja Israel mwenye ako level ya imani ya huyu generalli, coz yuko juu tu sana.

src: 11.I say to you that many will come from the east and the west, and will take their places at the feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
tgt: Nawashow nyote ivi, wengi watakam kutoka east na west na wachukua place yao kwa paree na Abraham, Izzo na Jacob kwa kingdom ya heaven.

src: 12.But the subjects of the kingdom will be thrown outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."
tgt: Lakini wale raia wa hiyo kingdom watachujwa outside, kwenye ma-gizani,ambapo kutakuwa na sauti ya vilio na kugrind meno.

src: 13.Then Jesus said to the centurion, "Go! It will be done just as you believed it would." And his servant was healed at that very hour.
tgt: So akashow yule generalli,"Enda!" Ita happen kwako vile tu umeamini itahappen." Na servant wake akakuwa poa githaa ile ile.

src: 14.When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw Peter's mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.
tgt: Wakati JC aliingia kwa keja ya Pitaa, aliona mathe in law wa Pitaa ako msick hadi amelala bed na fever{homa}

src: 15.He touched her hand and the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.
tgt: Akamgusa mkono tu hivi na homa ikatoweka, mathe akaget poa saa hiyo hiyo akaanza kum serve ka waiter.

src: 16.When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to him, and he drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
tgt: Wakatijioni ilifika, wasee wengi wenye walikuwa wamepagawa na shaitula waliletwakwa JC, akatimua hizo shaito akitumia just word, akaheal wagonjwa all.

src: 17.This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
tgt: Hii ilikuwakusababisha chenye Prophet Isaiya ali say itahappen:

src: "He took up our infirmities
tgt: Alikwachu magonjwa zetu

src: and carried our diseases."
tgt: akabeba maradhi zetu."

src: 18.When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he gave orders to cross to the other side of the lake.
tgt: So JC akacheck rende imemsurround,akapeana orders wavuke hadi ile ng'ambo ingine ya lake.

src: 19.Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."
tgt: Kisha mode mmoja wa sheria akakam kwake kumshow,"teacher, ntakufuata place yote utaenda."

src: 20.Jesus replied, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head."
tgt: JC akamjibu, Mbweha zina hole za kubangaiza ndani na ndush zina nests,lakini son wa Adam hanaplace ya kulay his head.

src: 21.Another disciple said to him, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."
tgt: Msee mwingine disciple akamshow JC," boss wacha niende nikazike mbuyus alafu nikam."

src: 22.But Jesus told him, "Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead."
tgt: JC akamshow,"Nifuate na uache wasee wamededi wazike wasee wao wamededi."

src: 23.Then he got into the boat and his disciples followed him.
tgt: Kisha akaingia kwa mv faina, na maboiz wake wale disciples wakamfuata.

src: 24.Without warning, a furious storm came up on the lake, so that the waves swept over the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.
tgt: Ghafla kabla wajipange, bila onyo, hurricane ikachapa hiyo lake, hata mawimbi karibu ifanye mv faina i capsize. Lakini JC alikuwa maedoze tu moss moss.

src: 25.The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Lord, save us! We're going to drown!"
tgt: Disciples wakaishia kumuamsha, wakimsho," mdosi niaje, si utusave! Tuna ezaje go down nauko hapa, tutadrown!"

src: 26.He replied, "You of little faith, why are you so afraid?" Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the waves, and it was completely calm.
tgt: JC akawajibu,"nyi kwani mna faith ndogo aje, mbona mnaingiza njeve hivo?" Kisha akarauka na kuletana juu na hizo mawimbi, hadi ikakuwa calm, kabisa tena.

src: 27.The men were amazed and asked, "What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the waves obey him!"
tgt: Walee majamaa wakashangaa kabisa, hadi wakamuask,"Kwani we ni mse wa aina gani jo! Hadi mawimbi zina mskia na kum-obey!"

src: 28.When he arrived at the other side in the region of the Gadarenes,two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs met him. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
