tgt: Vile alicheki J.C. ni ule mzii, hatishiki, Devo akadecide ku-pace juu yenyewe, alikuwa amewezwa. Venye ali-bounce, ma angels wakacome kurudishia J.C. afya juu alikuwa ametired vizii after hizo story zote.

src: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee . Mat 4:13 But instead of staying in Nazareth , Jesus moved to Capernaum . This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
tgt: Lakini badala ya ku-chill Nazareth , J.C. akadecide kuhama mpaka Capernaum – place ilikuwanga kando ya Lake ya Galilee ndani ya territory ya Zebulun na Naphtali.

src: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,
tgt: Kwa hivyo, venye Prophet Isaiah alikuwa amesay kitambo ilikam kuwa ukweli,

src: "Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and east of the Jordan ! Listen Galilee , land of the Gentiles!
tgt: Ati “Skizeni, area code za Zebulun na Naphtali, ploti zenye ziko next na baro na east ya Jordan river . Skiza Galilee, land ya ma-Gentile!

src: Although your people live in darkness, they will see a bright light. Although they live in the shadow of death, a light will shine on them."
tgt: Ata kaa wasee wa hiyo place yenu ni hard sana waoni stima, watacheck ki-light kibigi. Ata kaa wanapozi michochoro imejaa njaro zinaeza leta noma, watacheki light ikiwaangazia.”

src: Then Jesus started preaching, "Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here."
tgt: Saa hizo ndio man J.C. alianza ku-preach akishow wasee, “Ebu repent madhambi zenu! Kingdom ya Sir God itakuwa around hivi karibuni!”

src: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee , he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
tgt: Hiyo mtaa tu, time Fulani akitembea karibu na shore ya Galilee aka check mabro watwice wakitry kushika mafish kwa lake na ma-net. Mmoja alikuwa Peter na wa twice alikuwa anaita Andrew.

src: Jesus said to them, "Come with me! I will teach you how to bring in people instead of fish."
tgt: Jesus akawashow, “Ni-how? Si m-come m-roll na mimi? Nitawashow venye kucatch wadhii badala ya kucatch fish !”

src: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.
tgt: Ma-bro ata hawakuwaste time, walidrop chenya walikuwa wana-do na wakapace na yeye!

src: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him too.
tgt: Mbele kidogo, Jesus akaspot akina Jaymo na bro wake John, wajunior wa boys alikuwa anaitwa Zebedee. Walikuwa wanajob wakifix manet zenye zilikuwa zime-spoil. J.C. akawashow, “Kamini mjoin crew yangu!”

src: Right away they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus.
tgt: Saa hizo hizo, wakadrop chenye walikuwa waki-do wakafuata J.C.

src: Jesus went all over Galilee , teaching in the Jewish meeting places and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
tgt: So J.C. akaenda round Galilee , akiteach wadhii kwa base yoyote majews walikuwa na kushow wasee good news juu ya Kingdom ya Sir God. Pia ali-heal madisease kaa zote aliletewa!

src: News about him spread all over Syria , and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
tgt: Sifa za story zake zilitambaa mpaka Syria na wadhii wote wenye ma disease na ma –ugonjwa kaa zote wakaletwa kwake. Wadhii wengine walikuwa na ma-demons kaa silly ndani yao , wengine wasee walidhani wamechizi na wengine ata hawangeweza ku-walk. Lakini, man J.C. alishughulikia hizo story akawa- heal wote.

src: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis . They also came from Jerusalem , Judea, and from across the Jordan River .
tgt: Juu ya hiyo story, umati bigi ikafuata man J.C. kutoka Galilee na mtaa Fulani inasurround city kama ashu hivi ilikuwa inaitwa Decapolis . Pia walitoka kutoka Jerusalem , Judea na hata across River Jordan .

src: Mathayo Mbe- Matthew 2 1.After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem
tgt: Baada ya Baby JC kuzaliwa mtaa wa Bethlehem Judea na hauu, hizo tu nyakati za sonko Herod, mamajusi wa east walikam Jerusa

src: 2.and asked, "Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him."
tgt: waka ask, "Niasaje? ako

src: 3.When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
